intro: Beatrice (ベアトリス) is a member of the Emilia Camp and the former caretaker of the Forbidden Library at the old Roswaal Manor, until its destruction in the climax of Arc 4. She is one of the main supporting characters in Re:Zero, having had a supporting role to play in every arc except Arc 1 and Arc 3.
appearance:
On the outside, Beatrice seems like a lovely young girl around the age of eleven or twelve. Her face is so sweet that Subaru believed there was no heart that wouldn't melt at the sight of a genuine smile of hers. Her large sky-blue eyes have pink butterfly patterns as their irises. Beatrice's pale cream blonde hair is worn long and tied into frilly vertical drill-shaped twin tails that act like springs when pulled on. In the anime adaptation, the tips of her twin tails are dyed pink.

Most of the time, the Great Spirit of the Forbidden Library can be seen wearing a pink frilly ornate dress with white trimmings and an exposed front that leave her legs visible and are completely covered by pink and purple vertically striped tights. A petite crown is also sported on the right side of Beatrice's large head, serving as a nice accessory which complements her appearance rather perfectly. Beatrice also wears pink shoes with butterfly straps on her feet, and has a large pink ribbon adorned upon the left side of her waist and a pair of similar ribbons tied at the top of her twin tails.

In the Water Plumage Inn in Arc 5, she wears a yukata.
personality:
Beatrice has a tendency to look down on those around her, to the point that she would come off as a haughty person to people she meets. As such, this makes her rather bad at dealing with people who try to get close to her, like when she first met both Ryuzu Meyer and Subaru. She usually speaks, in the third person, referring to herself as Betty. She is also prideful of her vast knowledge of yin magic, disliking when someone disrespects it, and she also displays pride at being Echidna's daughter, though this would at times lead her into spats with others Echidna had taken a liking to. She has also shown a mischievous side of herself; when she messed around with Ryuzu, she cast a yin magic looping spell to pull a prank on her, and she did the same to Subaru when she found herself somewhat annoyed by the commotion his presence initially caused for her. That said, when a prank is done back to her or someone sees through it, she becomes annoyed quite quickly. She has also shown tsundere tendencies, acting haughty around people she was close to yet disliking showing her sensitive or weaker side of herself, which has come to light with both Roswaal and Ryuzu. That said, she is softhearted beyond her perceived stubbornness. She also has a distinct way of speaking, adding "I suppose" (かしら, kashira) and "in fact" (のよ, no yo) at the end of most of her sentences.

Despite being full of bravado, following the attack on the Sanctuary by Hector, when Ryuzu, who was her closest friend and even promised to teach to read, gave her life to defend everyone, she has become a rather lonely person, and though she was willing to wait in the Forbidden Library for centuries after her mother entrusted it to her until the arrival of "That Person", she refused to come out and even shut herself off from each successive generation of House Mathers, and even Toska, who had once tried and failed to bring her out of the library. With numerous people having stumbled upon the Forbidden Library, not there specifically for her but her knowledge and the knowledge the library contained, her belief for the arrival of "That Person" started to wane, to the point that she contemplated if she should continue to exist. She still showed great affection towards Puck, who she found cute and trusted implicitly, but in the time that the two were separated, when she realized that he had changed after meeting Emilia, this made her sense of loneliness stronger.

However, after meeting Subaru for the first time, though she maintained her stubborn and distant attitude, she started showing a slightly more social side of herself, sometimes putting up with the shenanigans caused by Subaru and Emilia, feeling the need to help Rem when she started visiting the library regularly, eating with other members of the Roswaal Manor, and at one point, even attempted to better her singing by placing a bucket over her head to hear her voice better, something that she had seen Emilia doing at one point. Even when others had finally left the mansion and she believed she would have some peace and quiet, with some time having passed without the lively atmosphere of the residents, she started wishing for them to hurry and return. In some of Subaru's loops in particular, she even started showing signs of attachment towards Subaru himself, going out of her way to protect him through loopholes in a contract that she made with him at one point, saving his life when she was on the verge of dying herself despite having no reason to do so, and in one of the trials taken by Subaru, she was even shown crying upon seeing his death, despite not having known him for long and in that specific loop, barely interacting whatsoever. She had believed that Subaru might even be "That Person".

During the events of Arc 4, she was finally forced to confront her loneliness when Subaru attempted to bring her out of the manor. Despite wanting Subaru to be "That Person", his declining the notion every time caused her to kick him out of the library, and she was resigned to let herself die as the mansion burned down, her last act being to prevent Subaru himself from dying. However, when Subaru showed his efforts and refused to let her be alone, wanting to leave an impression on her so strong that she would remember him, even long after he died, though he wasn't "That Person", he convinced her to choose him as her person, and she followed him out of the Forbidden Library, forming an official contract with him and fighting alongside him.

Following the creation of her contract, Beatrice has shed her loneliness entirely, showing a significantly more cheerful attitude than before. She has shown great pride at being Subaru's contracted spirit, and she would often accompany him and take part in many of his moments of playfulness, trust in his decisions involving heavy topics like accepting Spica in spite of her past, or even become enraged on his behalf when someone mocked the memories of someone dear to him, not even wanting him to meet with said person in the belief that he would be irreparably harmed. She would at times sleep in his bed like a little sister, hold his hand often, and at one point, she almost followed him into the bathroom due to a sense of not wanting to be apart from him. She also has become significantly more social with the other members of the Emilia Camp, though she is also weak to people who give her gazes as earnest as Ryuzu once did. Though she remains filled with her own pride and still is shown respect, she has shown to exhibit a sisterly attitude with Emilia, has become friendly with Petra Leyte, and will regularly tease Otto Suwen in much the same way that Subaru does. This side of her has also led to her providing knowledge to others over topics that she was aware of or chiding Roswaal for his actions, both involving his past bodies and his attitude toward Subaru obtaining more Witch Factors. This being said, watching Subaru endlessly express sorrow over what happened to Rem, she began to regret not making her contract sooner, and she began to despise the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony for what they had done to Subaru and Rem, and she constantly wondered what could have been if she had been more cooperative sooner. Because of her regret, she decided to stick by Subaru for the rest of his life so that he would never suffer again.
history:
Early Life
Beatrice is an artificial spirit created by the Witch of Greed, Echidna, over 400 years ago. In the years following her creation, Echidna tasked Beatrice to safekeep her mansion, known as the Palace of the Witch. Throughout the Witch's frequent absences, Beatrice acted in her place, helping out whoever managed to reach the unreachable Palace, together with Puck. Roughly three years after her creation, she and Puck helped Toska in fending off the Silver Dragons led by Fargall.

Some years later, Beatrice started frequently accompanying Echidna to the Sanctuary, where she met the original Ryuzu Meyer and became friends with her. However, disaster struck when the Warlock of Melancholy, Hector, attacked the Sanctuary, as he was hunting down Echidna. To protect everyone in the Sanctuary, Ryuzu offered to use herself to speed up the process of putting up the Barrier around Sanctuary, Echidna's only plan of stopping Hector. Following the creation of the Barrier and the Sanctuary's survival, Echidna told Beatrice to use her Door Crossing to connect her library to Roswaal's mansion, as she wanted the knowledge she had collected to survive. Echidna told Beatrice to protect the library until "That Person" showed up to bring her out of the library.

Throughout the centuries, many people tried to take her out of the library, but they were all interested in the knowledge in the Forbidden Library or using Beatrice, as she is a very powerful great spirit. Beatrice began to close her heart, doubting that "That Person" would ever show up. A couple of months before Subaru's arrival, Emilia was brought to the mansion, and with her, Puck. Though Beatrice was rejoicing at first, she soon realized Puck has changed, as he spent every waking minute hovering around Emilia and not paying much attention to Beatrice, despite their nearly identical upbringings all those centuries ago.

Librarian Beatrice's Log: Restart
Following his victory against Elsa Granhiert, it was decided that he would be brought back to Roswaal Manor to be treated. The night of his arrival, Rem, who was in charge of his treatment, visited Beatrice, who had been reading her favorite book, to inform her of the situation with an injured guest. After the treatment, noticing that the guest had a surprisingly fast recovery and being displeased by her alone time having been interrupted previously, she decided to play a prank on him by looping the hallway with her magic, only for her hopes to be completely crushed once he enters the correct door at the first attempt.

Emilia's Starry Sky Classroom
Before the Wolgarm Incident, Emilia visited the Forbidden Library to get Puck back from Beatrice before going to the garden. While at the library, she spoke with Beatrice and asked her if she would like to look at the stars with her and Subaru, mentioning that Subaru had taught her a whole lot about stars, some of them being Altair, Vega, and Betelgeuse, which she mispronounces as Petelgeuse. Reacting to the name Petelgeuse, Beatrice swiftly kicked Emilia and Puck out of the library.

Librarian Beatrice's Log: Second Page
A short time after his arrival at the manor, Beatrice began to notice how interactions in the manor had begun to change. In particular, their interactions with Beatrice had become more casual, and they would regularly use her Door Crossing for their everyday needs, much to her annoyance; Ram would ask for help in creating a shortcut to get outside to hang clothes, Rem would ask for a quick way to the kitchen, among others. After Subaru entered the library with only his underwear on while completely soaked due to Puck's overusing water magic on him, begging to be taken to his room before anyone else could see him, she complied but scolded him harshly for entering the library like that. To avoid this situation, she attempted to stay outside the library for a day, only to see Subaru and Puck having a serious conversation in the hallway. She quickly hid in a room, not wanting to be bothered, and was surprised when Puck entered it to train poses. Beatrice later thanked Subaru, since she guessed it was Subaru's doing that made Puck do these poses, much to his confusion as he thought she was mentioning the time he flashed her.

The Head Maid's Unrestful Holiday
Noticing how hard Rem worked, Subaru spoke with the other residents of Roswaal Manor, and he proposed that she take a day off. Despite the slight opposition of the others, he was able to persuade them to agree after saying that she could use the day off to think about what she wanted as her reward for her participation in the Wolgarm Incident, and when Rem herself was reluctant to take a day off, Subaru told her to take the day off directly, and she agreed to his command immediately. Afterward, everyone decided on which jobs they would handle to make up for not having Rem’s help and split up to handle their respective tasks.

Anxious, Rem had gone to see how everyone was faring with their tasks, and she went to the bath, where she expected Puck and Beatrice to be doing the laundry. Concerned due to the number of unique outfits that shouldn’t be cleaned together and worried about whether or not they could properly handle the fabric, she rushed to handle those herself. When she got there, however, she found Puck instructing Beatrice how to deal with clothes while cleaning his own load with magic. Overhearing their discussion about the tedium and necessity of doing laundry and coming to an understanding about why Subaru wanted to give Rem a day off, Rem walked away, grateful to them.

Beatrice and Rem's Cumbersome Cleaning
One day, Rem entered the forbidden library and witnessed Beatrice holding a bucket over her head. Beatrice, having noticed her, was surprised by her arrival. Though Rem said to Beatrice to give her best as Emilia had improved her singing with this method, Beatrice angrily denied this and claimed that she only had the bucket to clean the library, to which Rem had been aware that there was no water in it. Taking the opportunity to clean the library, Rem taught Beatrice how to do so properly. Wanting to participate instead of only listen, Beatrice asked to join her. However, because her attempt to clean a bookshelf led to the destruction of one of the books, Rem scolded her, with Beatrice pouting that her being treated in such a way was Subaru's fault.

Beatrice and Rem's Cumbersome Service
A short while later, Beatrice was spooked when Rem entered the library with an angry expression. Checking the bookshelves, she noticed that they were still full of dust, and she proceeded to scold Beatrice harshly for not being able to clean her own library properly. After a while, Rem revealed that her true purpose in coming was not to check on the cleanliness of the library but to ask Beatrice for a favor. She wished to create a dish, specially made for Subaru just as Ram and Emilia had done in the past, since last time she felt quite left out, and she mentioned that Beatrice had a similar taste in food as Subaru did. Though Beatrice was initially unwilling to cooperate since, in the end, it would be something to please Subaru, the smell of the food and Rem's persuasion made her start tasting and rating every dish Rem presented to her. A few days later, Rem was pleased by the results of her efforts, having not told Subaru about Beatrice's help, while Beatrice had gotten slightly chubbier from the taste testing.

Rem's Very Ordinary Happy Day
One morning, a month after Subaru’s arrival at the manor, as Rem watched Subaru and Emilia in the garden, Beatrice appeared nearby and started speaking with Rem, having been keeping an eye on her to make sure she did not overwork herself with the excuse that she did not want to be dragged into another one of Subaru’s ideas. The two discussed how his presence changed the twins and Beatrice, and as Beatrice left for the Forbidden Library, Rem stated she would call for her when breakfast was ready, something that Beatrice started to participate in over the past month.

The Emilia Camp's Great Evaluation Meeting
Following the Sanctuary Incident, Annerose Miload and Clind, who had been tasked with making preparations by Roswaal, arrived at the Sanctuary to board all the villagers on their carriages, intent on leading them out of the snow-covered and heavily damaged forest. Annerose was quick to scold Roswaal for his behavior and approved of his being struck, claiming to Garfiel that she would be his ally should he hassle him again. Moments later, the pair introduced themselves to Subaru and Otto, who had been claimed to be the new internal affairs minister for the Emilia Camp, surprising Subaru with their behavior and titles, and thanks to Clind, Subaru realized that Roswaal had their appearance already prepared. Though Clind claimed that they were a step closer to freeing Roswaal from the "spell" he was under, he teased Subaru when he exclaimed how he thought he said something important. Frederica then appeared and scolded Clind, claiming to Subaru that she knew him and that he was flawed despite his abilities, something which was seemingly proven when Petra said that the villagers had gathered together. Frederica attacked him, though Clind dodged her attacks with ease, and with Otto claiming that he would handle things there, he told Subaru that he should go see Emilia.

Approaching the tomb, where Annerose was talking with Emilia, Beatrice stood by his side, and Subaru warned her not to get too close to Clind. Noticing his state, Ram appeared and claimed that his nature hadn't changed since the last time she met him and that he behaved this way towards her in her youth and even thought that Rem had experienced it. After a warning that Clind did not differentiate between male and female, Annerose approached Subaru and questioned if he was willing to take responsibility for forcing a kiss onto Emilia, though Emilia appeared and defended Subaru by saying it was consensual. Acting like a "rival in love", the two argued, with Annerose even calling Subaru a homewrecker, Beatrice getting angry, and Ram stirring things up. Seeing them all, Emilia touched her crystal where Puck slept and called everyone there precious to her.

An Ordinary Day
Following the Sanctuary Incident, the relationship between the members of the Emilia Camp, both new and old, improved. In one example, one day, Subaru found Emilia and Beatrice sitting in the same chair while waiting in Subaru's room, drawing. However, their drawings reminded Subaru of their terrible artistic sensibilities they showed during Puck's magic release period, and he drew Puck in the notebook they were using, impressing them both, leading to a conversation about how they were happy to have Subaru as their knight and contractor respectively. Afterward, Emilia asked Subaru to draw them and sat down on Subaru's bed with Beatrice on her lap, and he did as she asked.

Librarian Beatrice's Log: Third Page
While the residents of Roswaal Manor left for the Royal Capital for the Royal Selection Ceremony, Beatrice was left alone with Ram in the mansion, thinking that she would finally get some peaceful days without everyone around. However, Beatrice slowly started to beg in her mind for them to return quickly once she realized that the only thing Ram knew how to cook was potatoes, which Ram was somehow proud of. Later on, Roswaal returned, visited the library, and had a cryptic talk with Beatrice regarding visiting the Sanctuary. Roswaal mentioned that she should know full well what this should mean and left. Following this, Beatrice closed her eyes, putting a hand on her chest, and wondered to her mother how much longer she would have to wait.

Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle Line 3
One night, a little while after the goddess statue incident, after managing to finish his work on time for once, he found himself in the company of Ram and Frederica, and the three drank together. The next morning, Otto found himself sleeping in the garden. When Petra went to look at the flowers and saw him, she splashed him in water to wake him up. Later, she was grumbling out loud to Garfiel, who ended up asking Otto about it while he was working. As they talked, they saw Subaru, Emilia, and Beatrice doing radio calisthenics outside. Though Otto didn't think it was a bad thing they were doing it, he showed concern about how Subaru intended to spread it, and after recalling something he had been told in Costuul, he left to go get Subaru and Emilia to stop the misunderstandings in the city.

After they left, Beatrice found herself in Otto's room, telling him where they went and saying it was easy to complain to Otto and entertaining to do so, much to Otto's distress. Beatrice advised him to take himself into consideration for once instead of solely paying attention to others. Shortly after, Emilia returned and visited Otto's room after hearing Frederica mentioning how he woke up that morning to someone who brings things to the mansion. Subaru appeared shortly after, and after Emilia expressed her concern, Otto looked to see how much work he had left, he asked if they could make time to have tea together.

Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose
A few days after the Battle for Priestella, as they were making preparations to leave Priestella, Subaru informed Beatrice that Anastasia had been possessed by the artificial spirit Echidna and asked what they should do. Deciding to observe the flow of mana surrounding the girl, she quickly realized that Anastasia's gate was defective. As she was observing her, however, Emilia appeared and asked why she was watching Anastasia. Although not wanting to lie to her, due to Subaru not wanting Anastasia's condition to spread, Beatrice struggled with what to tell her. Mistaking her observations as nervousness to meet Anastasia, Emilia brought Beatrice over to meet her. After a little bit of small talk, "Anastasia" mentioned to Beatrice that she figured the Subaru had already talked to her about her state, much to Emilia's confusion.

Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose!
After returning to Roswaal Manor, Beatrice was invited by Petra to sleep in her room. Having tea together, Beatrice told the curious Petra what happened in Priestella, to which Beatrice described the battle. Eventually, she asked about how Beatrice was during that fight, as she had barely brought herself up during the explanation, and she said that she was worried as Beatrice had started to imitate Subaru lately. Petra then dragged Beatrice into the bed with her, and they fell asleep. Later, she awoke and left to get a drink for her parched throat, and she came across Frederica. The two decided to have tea together, and Frederica claimed she could imagine just how much danger Subaru and Emilia must have been in in Priestella based on the injuries sustained by Garfiel and Otto, further claiming their next hardships based on their next destination. Frederica then asked to look out for them and herself with a gaze that reminded Beatrice of Ryuzu.

Julius Juukulius's Promise Keeping Notebook III
In the Augria Sand Dunes outside the Pleiades Watchtower, shortly after withstanding sniper fire and Subaru's act of using magic-negation magic, everyone had been separated. Julius, a distance away from the carriage, managed to find it, and Emilia, standing in front of it, said that Beatrice, Meili, and Rem were all still safe. However, Subaru, Ram, "Anastasia", and Patrasche had all gone missing. Beatrice noted that Subaru seemed to have gone farther away while Meili mentioned that witchbeasts were on their way. After realizing that the distortion of space like sent the other farther away from everyone, something landed on their dragon carriage and knocked it over. Julius, who had seen the woman responsible, heard her as she muttered her frustration and realized she had jumped from atop the watchtower. As she was about to leave, Emilia grabbed her leg, causing her to fall and nearly attack her, but when she asked if she knew anything about the friends who had been blown away, the woman lowered her hand and began walking away toward the tower, allowing the others to follow her and muttering "Coming soon". Once everyone gathered together, they chased after her. Later, after the group returned, she and Emilia attempted to pry Subaru's arms off of Ram, but they couldn't.

Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose! In Fact!
The next day, Emilia and Beatrice were observing the first trial of the tower, where numerous stone slabs were floating about. When Emilia touched one, the slabs disappeared and left one behind, and when Beatrice chided Emilia for doing something so careless, she showed that they could try as many times as they wanted. When they returned downstairs, Meili teased them and claimed that they were probably on edge because Subaru hadn't woken up yet. After thinking about her irritation towards Shaula for not answering their question, Beatrice and Emilia decided to check on Subaru and Ram while Meili went to the trial room to see if she could solve it, leaving Beatrice to chide Emilia's carelessness after she claimed that there were no harmful traps within the room.

After arriving at the dragon carriage, they spoke with "Anastasia" and Julius, Beatrice accidentally sounding malicious with her joke towards the effect of Julius's Divine Protection. After Emilia and "Anastasia" talked about Emilia's worry for Subaru, Ram exited the carriage. After asking about Rem, she asked for the details about their current circumstances, only to learn that Subaru had been holding her tightly. Embarrassed, Ram walked toward the carriage with her wand out, claiming she would erase Subaru, leading Emilia to stop her.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
In spite of her constitution as an artificial spirit, Beatrice is recognized as a Great Spirit, and at the prime of her power, Beatrice's magic has been claimed to be capable of fighting against the Beast of the End, one of the current Four Great Spirits, with a small chance of victory. Her battle strength allowed her to easily overpower the Bowel Hunter Elsa Granhiert, a woman with exceptional lethality in her own right. Despite this, due to how much mana she consumes and her current contract with Subaru, who has a less than average gate, she cannot always exhibit her fullest power. After her debut battle alongside Subaru against the Great Rabbit, she lost most of her mana and was forced to drain it from Subaru over time, effectively making her useless in combat for an extended period of time.

Magic/Spiritual Arts
Although she likely is able to use most if not all attributes, Beatrice is particularly adept as a master of yin magic and is capable of casting all kinds of yin magic spells, even those that have been long since forgotten by people in the present. She is capable of doing various things through it such as teleportation, freezing time, tearing space, and fixating her existence. Her control of magic is so masterful that other practitioners can immediately recognize it, and she does not even need to use incantations. Due to her constitution as an artifical spirit, however, she also has a terrible mana consumption rate and formerly got around this by draining mana from people in the mansion while using the library as a medium. She is also unique in that she does not require a crystal like other spirits do and can remain manifested consistently. At present, Beatrice is contracted with Subaru, though according to her, he isn't a true spirit user. As Subaru's contracted spirit, Beatrice is able to sense his condition and whereabouts via her connection with him, although Subaru is unable to do so. This being said, if the two are separated for an extended period of time, in order to preserve her mana, she will enter what Subaru has referred to as "eco mode", in which, although still conscious and aware of her surroundings, she will remain inactive in order to preserve the mana that she has remaining until she can reunite with Subaru. If necessary, she is also capable of drawing upon the mana of glintstones, whether to keep herself active or to cast spells. As she is an artificial spirit, she also has several conditions Subaru is forced to follow:
Subaru cannot form a contract with other spirits.
Beatrice cannot restore mana on her own.
Beatrice cannot use the mana in the atmosphere.
Beatrice can only drain mana from Subaru.

Spells:
thumb|right|250px|Beatrice casting Shamak to obscure the vision of Elsa and provide a covered retreat.
Shamak (シャマク): One of the most basic Yin Magic spells, which even Subaru could use until the collapse of his gate, was Shamak. When cast, a blanket of black smoke would erupt from the user that would cover a significantly large area. Any target engulfed by the smoke would completely lose their spatial awareness. Under the spell's effect, the only thing the target could sense was the ground under their feet and any damage done to their body. Although it was a low-level spell, it proved an effective smokescreen when retreating. Naturally, due to her mastery of Yin Magic, Beatrice is capable of conjuring Shamak.
El Shamak (エル・シャマク): Beatrice's target becomes unable to control their bodies while under its effects.
Ul Shamak (ウル・シャマク): Beatrice creates an immense black hole that swallows her target.
Al Shamak (アル・シャマク): Al Shamak is capable of bending space and time. It is capable of sending its target to a different location in the world or a different dimension. If Beatrice deems it necessary, she can also release what was captured with the spell.
Ol Shamak (オル・シャマク): An anti-Witch spell that was originally created by Echidna. It is a forbidden art that immobilizes its target, preventing them from moving and ceasing the activity of their body's gate. When activated on a target without a Witch Factor or Authority, they are bound in a black light with a contradictory force. The spell can only be used to its full potential when cast on someone with a Witch Factor or Authority, encasing them in a completely black orb. Anyone else who enters the vicinity of the spell while it is being used on a Witch Factor or Authority bearer will also find themselves captured within the orb. The orb can vary in strength, and it has the capability to become so tough that it cannot be destroyed by outside interference or simple brute strength, to the point that only something like a slash from the Dragon Sword Reid can destroy it. It unusually uses an "Ol" prefix, meaning it classifies as separate from the typical prefix classifications. After learning of its existence via Al in a failed loop, Beatrice was able to discern the forbidden art's mechanisms while she and Subaru were sealed, allowing them to recreate this spell together after the latter Returned by Death. Although it is unclear if a person's strength can prevent this, if an ordinary person were to be sealed for an extended period of time, then they would find themselves bedridden and put in a state of recovery after being released. In the Sasageru IF, when Subaru was released from his seal after 400 years, he was put in such a state that if not for specific stimulus, he likely would not have recovered, and even with that stimulus, it took him 40 years to recover.

Minya (ミーニャ): Beatrice's magic that creates stakes made of crystallized mana covered with light purple flames. They are strong enough to penetrate defenses. Any stakes in the air explode and release smaller stakes that fly in all directions which then rips its targets apart. Even should these stakes be shattered by an enemy, the shrapnel can continue to chase the target, and they lose none of their effectiveness.
El Minya (エル・ミーニャ): The number of stakes fired increases to 40.
Ul Minya (ウル・ミーニャ): Beatrice creates a purple ring of light around the target that shrinks and binds them, subsequently spreading across their body. Once the target is bound, a huge purple-blue light appears above them to destroy them. The effect is currently unknown as Beatrice's attempt was stopped partway through.
thumb|right|250px|Beatrice using Murak on Subaru.
Murak (ムラク): Beatrice reduces the effects of gravity. Just by jumping lightly, a person can jump as if they had springs. If Beatrice wished it, it can also be used to fly, although the target will get blown around by the wind like a leaf. That said, the target won't flip around in midair. It can also be used to upset an enemy’s balance and footing, which would grant an opening that would otherwise be unavailable.
Vita (ヴィータ): Contrary to Murak, Beatrice uses this spell to amplify the effects of gravity, making an object heavier. She can also alter the weight of everything affected by making their respective weight increases vary. By Garfiel Tinzel's observations, the level of control to do this is incredibly difficult and can be compared to threading many needles without one's hands.
El Vita (エル・ヴィータ): This spell not only amplifies gravity on a specified target, but it also adds mass to it, making it significantly heavier.
Yin Magic Sealing: Beatrice is able to employ a type of seal made of Yin Magic that can both prevent the target from dying and keep them from moving. It is the same kind of seal that was used to seal the Witch of Envy. According to Al, it works similarly to Ol Shamak, and according to Roy Alphard, anyone sealed this way can still somewhat sense the outside world. It required the combined efforts of Beatrice and Julius Juukulius to create, and the only way to undo the seal would require that the one breaking the seal is skilled in Yin Magic as well.
Healing Magic (治癒魔法, Chiyu Mahō): Beatrice summons water mana to heal the wounds of herself and others, however it only affects physical ones. Power varies by the skill and talent of the individual or partially that of the spirit if the caster is using spiritual arts. Beatrice is highly skilled in this to the point she can regenerate lost organs.

Barrier Conjuration: Using magic, Beatrice can conjure a wall of invisible magical energy. The wall will deflect any magical attack that fell upon it, keeping the caster and their allies safe from physical damage. Beatrice was first seen in Arc 2 generating a magical shield to defend against Ram's Wind Magic. When combining her efforts with Roswaal, they can also conjure a disk-shaped shield to defend their targets from endless powerful attacks from Yang Magic.

Unique Spells:
Door Crossing (扉渡り, Tobirawatari): Door Crossing connects its space to the interior of a single building, otherwise to the place Beatrice most recently knew. It can't connect over especially long ranges, however even if it's long range, if she has deep ties to a place, Door Crossing can connect to it. She can also use a limited version to teleport things.
Infinite Corridor (無限の回廊, Mugen no Kairō): Beatrice can utilize her mastery of Yin Magic to manipulate the fabric of space. She can create a loop in space that ensured an individual walking through a structure would move in a loop, meaning that, if they were walking down a corridor, it would seem endless. The target of this spell can break out of the loop by finding the correct door and/or pathway to walk through. Beatrice used this ability to annoy Subaru on his first entry into the mansion in Arc 2.
EMM (E・M・M; エミリアたんマジ女神, Emiria-tan Maji Megami; "Emilia-tan is Seriously a Goddess"): EMM is an "absolute defense magic". Beatrice uses Yin Magic to interfere with the time and space around Subaru, and while he can't move during activation, he experiences no interference from outside the barrier. It is similar to Regulus Corneas's Lion's Heart, but does not have the same risk, and it renders Subaru and Beatrice unable to move until the spell is cut off or their mana runs out.
thumb|right|250px|Beatrice using EMT to shield herself, Subaru and Anastasia from Shaula's stinger attacks.
EMT (E・M・T; エミリアたんマジ天使, Emiria-tan Maji Tenshi; "Emilia-tan is Seriously an Angel"): EMT is an "absolute negation magic". It is a spherical field several tens of meters long with Subaru and Beatrice at the center is created, which negates effects from mana within it, including the mana within meteors. Meanwhile, Subaru and Beatrice are still capable of casting magic within the field, making their abilities entirely unaffected by the field. Julius remarks that it is useful against mages and those who use mana to assist their techniques. However, the magic only negates the use of mana, and so it has no effect against opponents who fight without it. Likewise, if a magic user is capable of overcoming the feeling brought by the field and writing a new formula, they can cast magic within the field. At the same time, if one is willing to harm themself, they can cast magic from within the body to attack their opponent. Similarly, while it is effective against powerful barriers as well, such as the one around the Pleiades Watchtower, it does not necessarily fully cancel them out. Said barrier still existed after the spell was forcefully cancelled. Due to its nature, it has been claimed that in another era, it had the potential to be labelled a forbidden art.

Intelligence
Vast Intellect: Being over 400 years old, Beatrice has vast amounts of knowledge on a variety of subjects and is always reading books in her library. On top of that, she was also taught by Echidna about magic. Beatrice is also really excellent with magical power theories and using them. In particular, her knowledge on yin magic far surpasses Roswaal's own. Likewise, she is able to instantly recognize the intricacies of magic that others are unaware of, such as the "clump of Yin Magic" that kidnapped Subaru. In a similar manner, she is also able to recognize various meteors that were created by Echidna and how to use them, such as the Star Staff.

Other

Curse Removal: Beatrice, just like Puck, can sense when an individual has been infected by a curse. She can tell where on a person's body a curse has been placed and can subsequently remove it. However, Beatrice can only remove a curse if the caster has yet to activate the curse they had placed on a person. Likewise, if there are too many curses on one’s body, she cannot remove them, as they are all wound together like an intricately tied knot. Furthermore, she can't tell the effects the curse would inflict on an individual without observing the curse in effect.

thumb|240px|Beatrice using Mana Drain against Subaru.
Mana Drain: Unlike most spirits, Beatrice does not absorb Mana from the atmosphere. Instead, Beatrice obtains her Mana from living creatures. By touching an individual, Beatrice can absorb the mana stored in their gate, bolstering her own supply of Mana in the process. The individual affected by the technique would become physically fatigued if enough of their Mana was drained. By absorbing a person's mana, Beatrice could also tell to an certain extent whether the target had hostile intentions towards her or not. She is the only one besides Puck that knows this skill, though Reinhard has shown a similar ability at the end of Arc 1.

Miasma-Attuned Olfaction: Beatrice has the ability to smell the scent of the Witch. It is unknown why she has this ability.

Equipment
thumb|250px|Beatrice's Book of Wisdom.
Book of Wisdom (叡智の書, Eichi no Sho): 400 years ago, Echidna gave Beatrice one of the two imperfect replicas of her Book of Wisdom. The Book's design was similar but wider, taller and thicker than the defective Witch Cult's Gospel although this one was far more specific, when it came to guiding the owner towards their desired path, resembling Echidna's very own, perfect Book of Wisdom more than the aforementioned Witch Cult's Gospels. Soon after Beatrice received the Book and locked herself into the Forbidden Library, her Book suddenly stopped showing new content, leaving Beatrice in the dark for centuries. Eventually, when Subaru saved Beatrice from the burning library, her Book of Wisdom was completely lost to the fire.
Cognitive Disruption Cloak: During the events of Arc 10, Beatrice was offered a cloak built with cognitive disruption.

intro: Camberley (カンバリー), commonly known as Kan (カン), is one of the three thugs that attacked Subaru at the very start of story. He later joined the Felt Camp when Felt employed him after Royal Selection began. He plays a supporting role in Arc 9 and an antagonistic role in Arc 1 and Arc 3.
appearance: Camberley is a short person with brown mushroom-shaped hair and large black eyes.
history:
The Travelogue of the Finest
Roughly 3 to 4 months before Subaru's arrival, Rachins, Gaston, and Camberley met an Imperial traitor, who paid the trio and fifteen other thugs a fair amount of gold coins in order to tail a Divine General who was after his head. The thugs disobeyed the orders and lured the swordsman into a dark alley, wanting to attack, beat and rob the man. However, as they were dealing with Cecilus Segmunt, the strongest person from the Sacred Vollachia Empire and one of the three men who are about as skilled as Reinhard, they were defeated within a second and left beaten half to death. Following their arrest by the Knight guards who rushed the scene soon after, the three thugs were then approached by Julius Juukulius, Ferris, and Chisha Gold, who wanted to know about Cecilus' location. Upon being promised freedom, they spilled the beans and were subsequently freed, with the money they would have gotten from Gramdart.

Behind the Scenes of Life in Another World from Zero
A short while after harassing Subaru and being scared off by Reinhard, he, Rachins, and Gaston, attempted to corner Emilia, who was looking for Felt. However, before they could do anything to her, she quickly cornered them. Afterward, she asked them about the Loot House, and they pointed her in the right direction.

Ram's Flirting Refusal
Later, they attempted to ambush Ram, who was searching for Emilia throughout the capital. However, she easily dispatched them.

Felt-chan Gathers Thugs
While Felt inspected the slums with her camp, she found Gaston, Rachins, and Camberley running away and badly injured. They decided to attempt to rob her to make enough money to get away from Lugunica, as they had attempted to trick Russell Fellow into a shady business that did not end well for them, and they were now marked for death by him. Reinhard easily defeated one of them as the others attempted to run, but they were intercepted by Felt while she was scolding Reinhard, as letting them run away would mean they would be dead by Russell's capable henchman the next day. She then recruited the trio for her camp in hopes of using their help for ruining the country. Since then, Reinhard van Astrea started to train all three of them so they would grow stronger with his help.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Camberley is not a strong fighter, having been easily defeated by the likes of Subaru and various skilled fighters early on. After joining the Felt Camp, he has received training from Reinhard, but it is unclear exactly what this training provided Camberley for combat.

Divine Protection
Divine Protection of Bedroom Wiles (寝技の加護 Nezawa no Kago): This Divine Protection allows Camberley to be skilled in bed.

Equipment
Hexcel: A drug produced with a bokko fruit that generates excess mana through the activation of the gate. The mana produced allows Camberley to use even the Star Staff, which could not be used by amateurs. The drug has a narcotic effect, however, and its usage can cause Camberley to bleed from his eyes and nose, his veins bulge, and his insides will be torn apart.
Star Staff: A meteor created by the Witch Echidna that allows the user to fire the light of Shario from it without any prior knowledge. It has enough power to wound even Sin Archbishops.
