intro: Emilia (エミリア) is the main heroine and deuteragonist of the Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu series. She is a half-elf and a candidate to become the 42nd monarch of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica in the Royal Selection, who met Natsuki Subaru on the day he was summoned to the world. Emilia has played a supporting role in every arc, with major and pivotal roles in more than half of them.
appearance:
Emilia is a beautiful half-elf with long silver hair, purple-blue eyes, and pointed ears. She wears a white and purple outfit along with a white flower in her hair. Although she appears to be in her late teens, Emilia's chronological age remains unknown, though mentally she has been stated to be in her early to mid-teens. She has styled her hair in a variety of ways, as per her contract with Puck, the Beast of the End was the one who arranged her hairstyle.

Though she rarely uses it in the present, for a time, she wore a white cloak with cat ears on the hood that had cognitive obstruction enchanted on it. She can be seen wearing this several times in the early arcs, to protect herself from the sands of the Augria Sand Dunes in Arc 6, and in Arc 7 to temporarily disguise herself.

At the end of Arc 4 during Subaru's knight ceremony, Emilia wore a white dress and a white mantle. The mantle had purple fur lining its edges, and the inside of it was also purple. She also wore a hairpiece that had a flower ornament on each side of her head. In Arc 5, she wore a yukata in the Water Plumage Inn, and after being taken by Regulus, she was made to wear a special wedding dress, though once the fight against him got underway, she ripped the dress at the legs for more freedom of movement. In Arc 6, her outfit is very reminiscent of Fortuna's. During one side story, Emilia also donned a maid's uniform reminiscent of Rem and Ram's.

When Emilia still lived in Elior Forest as a child, she had a different set of clothes with the same color pattern. She had a light green ribbon instead of her necklace, a different flower in her hair, and could be seen wearing a light-purple headband.
personality:
Emilia is a very kind, good-natured, and energetic girl who is also incredibly selfless and likes to take care of others, though she herself sometimes refuses to admit this, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness or something everyone would do in her position despite that often not being true. Emilia has a tendency to use a myriad of archaic words, such as "dunderhead". This quirk of hers is mostly pointed out by Subaru, who has a tendency to tease her about it, though Emilia doesn't pay it any mind. Fortuna has also questioned where she had picked up such a vocabulary. Furthermore, Emilia also has a strong tendency to drag out the word "really", which can be best observed when she's talking about something dear or important to her. This quirk was likely picked up from Fortuna, who had the same verbal tic. She is rarely angered by the people around her, only having been angered by the despicable actions of Pandora, Regulus, and Aldebaran's betrayal thus far. She is a poor liar as well, to the point that people would just be suspicious of her if she tried. She also has a strong belief in promises, having been raised by Fortuna to believe that if someone makes a promise, they should always keep them, something she took to heart not just with the spirits around her but also with the people she interacts with, and it is because of this that she sometimes became emotional with Subaru, a habitual promise breaker. She is someone who believes in a person's good nature, and she displays a kindness similar to Subaru's, typically wanting to befriend others even despite race, appearance, and even position putting herself and others at odds, and she does not want to fight with others if she can help it, preferring to talk with her enemies and understand them rather than fight if it is an option. That said, if she is forced to, she will enter a fight with the intention of killing if it is necessary, though her fighting style still focuses on capturing her enemies alive, something very reminiscent of her gentle nature.

Just like the other Royal Selection Candidates, Emilia is also driven by a strong motive which shapes most of her actions, be it rational or irrational. Following her awakening by Puck in Elior Forest, she desperately tried to do something about the frozen elves in the forest. She cleaned them daily, talked to them, and spent a great deal of time and effort with them, trying to somehow get rid of their icy fate to absolutely no avail. However, a couple of months before the start of the main story, she was visited by an eccentric mage who introduced himself as Roswaal. Though they initially started off on the wrong foot which caused Roswaal and Puck to fight for half a day, the two decided to form a truce, and Roswaal presented Emilia with a plan that would allow her to unfreeze her people in the frozen Forest. By becoming the 42nd monarch of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica, Emilia would gain access to the Dragon's Blood locked up in the vaults of the Royal Castle, its magical properties possibly able to unfreeze the frozen inhabitants of the Great Elior Forest. Emilia hastily accepted the offer and decided to participate in the Royal Selection and forging a goal of having the Kingdom be equal and free from prejudice.

When she was young, Emilia was a mischievous child who was prone to sneaking out of her room, creating messes, or coming up with schemes like faking stomach pains in order to get attention and get what she wanted. However, she was also kind and wanted to be friends with others, and she would feel guilty at seeing others being troubled by her actions. She was usual seen smiling and playful, and she was often happy. However, following the attack on her village and seeing her family killed and manipulated, she showed a vengeful side when she attacked Pandora and lost control of herself, leading to her powers going out of her control. After losing her memories and waking up about a century later, she was diligent about caring for the frozen people of her village and often felt guilt about their situation. She was also exposed to prejudice and hostility for the first time during her trips to nearby villages and the attack by Melakuera. Because of this, though her kind nature did not diminish, she became somewhat closed off, and she remained naive.

Initially, because of her supposed "selfishness" as well as having to protect herself from the prejudice that was flung toward her, Emilia closed herself off from others and did not entrust others with her emotions or how she felt about different situations she was subjected to, as she was always of the mindset to endure passively and maintain a valiant disposition. Likewise, she was quick to give up on things she didn't understand, blame it on something, and then naively assume that listening to Puck was the right thing to do. This resulted in her becoming both mentally and emotionally fragile, which in turned caused her to be overly obstinate and somewhat childish about certain subjects. This led her to constantly depend on other people for support, most notably Puck or Subaru who became her main pillars of emotional support, and without them, she would become more and more emotionally unstable, to a point where in a failed loop she believed that if she succeeded and completed the task that she had been entrusted, despite having failed so many times, Puck or Subaru would return to her.

In Arc 4, following her period of extreme emotional instability after Puck severed his contract with her and Subaru breaking another promise with her, things that respectively affected her since her only family had supposedly left her and her belief in promises was being casually left aside, Emilia completely lost faith in herself, leading her to hide from others. After having an argument with Subaru, however, in which she spilled all of her own insecurities onto him and believed that he was only looking at her through rose-colored glasses without seeing her flaws, not considering her feelings, not putting his faith in her like she was for him, and breaking his promises which she believed was a sacred thing, Subaru not only threw all of those notions aside but even told her all of those flaws and frustrations to her face, and despite telling her what he really thought of her, he still claim to love her and have faith in her, enabling Emilia to stand up and challenge her painful past in order to overcome the three trials presented by the Witch of Greed. With this and seeing everything that Subaru had carved into Echidna's Tomb, Emilia became significantly stronger both mentally and emotionally, able to withstand Roswaal's harassment, shake his beliefs and view of her, and keep faith in herself, and because of this, she started to become more charismatic and reliable, which even the stalwart Ram had come to truly respect, to the point that she wanted to entrust to her the Royal Selection for Roswaal's sake. In the end, she was able to overcome all of the trials, which each tested her mind and beliefs, and liberated the Sanctuary.

Over the following year, Emilia developed a great deal of self-confidence and greatly improved her self-image even after her contract with Puck was severed, forcing her to break out of her shell and live on her own. Thanks in part to this, Emilia's name becoming household, and her scarcely being discriminated against anymore, she came to realize that she was no longer hurt by people referring to her as the Witch of Envy, and the times she went outside with her recognition inhibiting cloak became sparse. Instead of giving up on what she didn't understand and relying completely on others, she came to start trying to understand such things on her own, especially as someone in a position of importance who can directly affect others' lives. Though her view on the world and human relations is still also rather childish and easy-going, she learned how to balance that shortcoming out with a level of professionalism and a unique air of authority. This change is particularly evident in the initial chapters of Arc 5, where some characters even point it out, and, according to Heinkel Astrea, the rumors surrounding her don't seem to be true anymore. Namely, her timidity and indecisiveness she was known for around the Kingdom was nowhere to be seen. She became much bolder, to the point that when she was captured by Regulus, rather than sitting and waiting for someone to rescue her, she took advantage of her position to gather information from the inside, relay that information to a reliable ally, and remain in her dangerous position so that she could protect everyone who was effectively being held hostage. Her kindness remained just as strong, something which led all of those hostages, Sylphy Elmart and the women Regulus took as his wives, to believe in her and entrust her with their fates. Also, despite understanding Subaru's feelings for her after he unleashed them all on her and even kissed her, because she didn't fully understand her own feelings nor the idea of what it meant to fall in love with someone, she did not improve romantically, but despite that, she did believe that she knew who she would fall in love with.

Over time, she began to exhibit other sides of herself when the situation involved Subaru. In Arc 5, when she was split up from Subaru, she believed that he would be able to find and fight alongside her, which was further reinforced when he gave his speech to Priestella. In Arc 6, she started showing signs of jealousy after seeing Shaula's interactions with him, and when Subaru lost his memories, she became very anxious, wanting to hear him refer to the nickname he had given her and say the habitual lines he was known to say. Likewise, when her name was temporarily eaten, though she was a little shaken, her morale was tremendously boosted after Subaru not only retrieved his memories but even remembered her, which allowed her to fight to her best. Following Subaru's being taken to Vollachia, she showed great resolve to go find him, even being willing to risk smuggling herself into the country, despite her position and the closed borders. In Arc 8, she showed a bolder side to her relationship with Subaru, even claiming that while she was not his, he was hers, and she was shown willing to trust in his heavy decision to accept Spica, in spite of her past. In Arc 9, following his capture, she grew extremely angry when he was betrayed by someone he was worried about and felt the urge to go assist him immediately, and even started to recognize an unknown emotion inside of her towards Subaru, which she failed to place but led her to want to be near him again.
history:
Early Life
About a century ago, Emilia lived with her aunt on her father's side, Fortuna, in Elior Forest. For reasons not known to her, she was considered a rather special child and was subsequently forced to spend most of her days isolated from the other elven villagers in a place called the "Princess Room" with only Fortuna and her dolls as company. Eventually, her frustrations reached a boiling point, and in an act of defiance, she broke her promise to not leave her room only to venture into the forest to search for everyone. Free to do what she wanted and not holding obligations that were never explained to her, Emilia snuck out on several occasions while hiding the fact, doing everything from exploring to behaving mischievously. It was in this room she discovered she had an affinity for spirits, and summoned countless lesser spirits to play with her. She did not realize how rare the ability was and referred to them as fairies. 

One day, she snuck into the center of the village and witnessed strange men giving supplies such as food and clothes to the elves. Emilia then witnessed a tall, green-haired man idly chatting with Fortuna, with her calling him Geuse. Emilia started to view him as a rival for Fortuna's affection, as Fortuna made a "special face" at him and smiled, expressions which she only showed to Emilia, as well as having everyone in the village meet them, leaving her in the Princess Room. She overheard Geuse asking about her safety and then asking her about a mysterious seal which was supposedly kept safe somewhere in the forest. After sneaking back into the Princess Room and being visited by Fortuna, she set out to find this seal, and trekked through the forest, led by the lesser spirits who showed her the way. She finally came to a clearing deep within the forest. Before her, stood a pair of huge metal doors that stood by themselves. Deducing that this was the "seal" everyone was talking about, Emilia, now satisfied, decided to head back to her room. By chance, she ran into Geuse, who was strolling around in the forest. When Geuse saw her, he wept tears of joy, leading to Emilia forgiving him.

Elior Forest Team, Waiting for the Thaw
After meeting Geuse for the first time, Emilia wanted to be friends with him. However, Fortuna kept her away from him. Thinking that Fortuna would panic if she faked stomach pains, she believed that Fortuna would ask what she wanted and let her see Geuse. However, when she committed to her act, Fortuna seemed to panic more than she expected, and she brought her to the village square and asked for help. Archi asked if she was acting, getting him into an argument with Fortuna since Emilia had never fallen ill even when the entire village had when they all ate rotten appas. Geuse decided to pray for her since she had helped him before, causing the whole village to lower their heads in silence. Feeling guilty, Emilia began to cry and said that her stomach had stopped hurting, causing everyone to rejoice, and Geuse told her that instead of apologizing when she troubles someone to instead say thank you. Afterward, walking back the way she came, Geuse held the sleeping Emilia on his back while Fortuna thanked him for going along with her act. Fortuna recalled how she worried for her, even after Archi became her guardian, and after Emilia called her a crybaby in her sleep, Geuse claimed that Fortuna was just like Emilia when she was younger with her brother, to her annoyance.

Permafrost of Elior Forest
It's unknown how many times following their first interaction, Emilia and Geuse spent time together; however, sometime later, the duo, together with Fortuna, who supposedly quickly caught wind of Geuse's and Emilia's meeting, went on a walk around the forest. There, Emilia revealed her fairy-friends, leaving both Fortuna and Geuse in utter shock. When the two argued about how she could develop her potential abilities as a spiritual arts user, Emilia commented how they were like her parents, which left Fortuna greatly embarrassed. When Fortuna asked her to return to the Princess Room, Emilia made her promise to let her see Geuse again.

Just as she was about to leave, however, disaster struck, and Emilia's life was changed forever. A white-haired figure stopped in front of them, an introduced themselves as the Sin Archbishop of Greed, Regulus Corneas. Geuse demanded to know why he came, stating that Regulus had broken their agreement, and that they could have discussed this back at their Church, but every complaint was swiftly countered by Regulus to no avail. As Fortuna held Emilia, another figure revealed themselves: Pandora, the Witch of Vainglory. She stated she had come to open the mysterious seal of Elior Forest. When Fortuna saw Pandora, she flew into a fit of rage, stating that she would avenge her brother and sent a huge hurdle of Ice Spikes flying her way. Upon seeing her initial attack has no effect on her, Fortuna proceeded to summon a huge mass of ice and dropped it onto the pair's heads, crushing them to death. However, as the ice shattered into pieces, Regulus stepped forth, not a scratch on him or on Pandora. Geuse then ordered Fortuna to escape with Emilia, saying that their lives were more important than vengeance. As Fortuna ran with Emilia, she witnessed Geuse remove a strange box from his robes, containing an unknown essence. Emilia then screamed, as Geuse slammed the box up to his chest and absorbed the contents, gaining the Authority of Sloth. 

As Fortuna ran deep into the forest, she stated that she would go back to save Geuse. Emilia begged Fortuna not to leave her, but Fortuna said she would be safe. Archi suddenly arrived and informed her that Geuse's men and the elves were repelling the attack from the assailants. Fortuna then apologized to him for bringing Emilia and herself to the village and burdening them, a notion Archi immediately denied, saying they had helped them. Fortuna then declared she would defend the forest and protect the seal, entrusting Emilia to Archi, promising to her that they would always be together, and then heading back toward Geuse. As Archi ran through the forest, they encountered a black robed man, and prepared to attack him, before he stated that he was one of Petelgeuse's fingers. The member then revealed that the Radical Faction and their leader, Regulus Corneas, the Witch of Vainglory, and the Black Serpent, had arrived at the village. When Archi expressed disbelief, stating it was neigh uncontrollable, one of Petelgeuse's fingers whom they had met confirmed his statement, adding that Pandora possessed the power to vaguely guide it to a general location. The forest then erupted around them, with Archi cursing himself, realizing they had stumbled onto its hunting grounds. The Cultist was suddenly licked by something ominous–he immediately recognized it as the Black Serpent. As Archi attempted to save him, the finger told Archi to run, saying that it was too late for him, as the Black Serpent's poison consumed him, withering his body away, until he died before Archi's eyes. Archi turned around and darted deeper into the woods, however, not long after, something entangled his legs and the two fell. The Black Serpent had made physical contact with Archi. Realizing what has happened, Archi hugged Emilia close to his chest and immediately severed his leg above the knee with Wind Magic and cauterized it with Fire Magic; however, he was too late. The poison had already started to consume his body. Archi, knowing his fate was sealed, ordered Emilia to run towards a nearby patch of flowers, which she did without a second guess. As Emilia ran far beyond the flowers she was sent to, the lesser spirits revealed themselves again, and flew away, almost as if wanting Emilia to follow them, which she naively did.

The spirits led her back to the Seal in the depths of Elior Forest. There, Pandora stood, arms widespread. She then revealed she had been controlling the spirits the entire time, helping her locate the Seal. Pandora then asked her to open the seal, to which Emilia responded she couldn't. The Witch naturally didn't react nicely to that, stating she would rip the forest from the ground-up if she didn't, and also stated Fortuna and Geuse are okay, and that she would leave the forest if Emilia listened to her and gave her what she was asking for. Emilia then discovered she indeed possessed the key to the door, but then remembered Fortuna had made her promise never to open the Seal. Before Pandora could react, Fortuna arrived and assaulted Pandora, saying she would not let her harm Emilia. Pandora merely smiled and kept reverting her own death, every time Fortuna had killer her. Shortly after Fortuna, Geuse had made contact with the group as well. The two confirmed Emilia's safety and Pandora's presence and vowed to end it together. As Fortuna rushed forward and engaged in further one-sided slaughter with Pandora, the Witch used her Authority of Vainglory one last time, to trick Geuse's eyes, resulting in him tearing a hole in Fortuna's chest, inflicting mortal and irreparable wounds to Emilia's aunt. Geuse, realizing what he had done, snapped. With his reason for fighting lying in a pool of blood, he succumbed to the effects of the Witch Factor of Sloth, as his mind shattered beyond repair. Mere moments before Fortuna passed away, she told Emilia one last time that she loved her very much. Emilia, enraged, unleashed her full magic and attacked Pandora continuously, killing her over and over again as she used her Authority of Vainglory to rewrite her death. Emilia then lost control, and froze Elior Forest entirely, ending the bloodbath at Elior Forest. The last thing she could see before falling asleep, were Pandora and Geuse, now Petelgeuse Romanee-Conti, the newly born Sin Archbishop of Sloth, leaving the forest together.

Bonds of Ice
Roughly seven years before the start of the Royal Selection, the ice around Emilia melted and Emilia met Puck. The two began to live in the now snow-covered Elior Forest. Exposed to the outside world for some time now, Emilia came to face the hostile reality of what it meant to be a half-elf in the world, especially one with her appearance which was nearly identical to that of the infamous Witch of Envy. Following those days, she suffered many hardships, not just from neighborhood human towns that feared her, hated her, betrayed her, and attempted to sell her into slavery, but even from higher beings such as one of the Four Great Spirits, Melakuera, who governed fire mana who sought to exterminate her for the crime of her existence and dangerous power that slept within her. Because of these issues, Emilia minimized any contact with outsiders, sticking to a frugal life by only leaving the forest to trade the magic stones she could find with people willing to deal with her in nearby towns for food and clothing. Humans, who called her the Witch of Frost, mostly tried to avoid her when she came around, but other than these excursions, Emilia would otherwise stay with the frozen elves as a guardian, as they were connected to her past. After the harrowing incident with Melakuera, Emilia formed a contract with Puck to preserve his life after his Od had been damaged. Puck then began to act as her surrogate father and mentor. He used the contract itself to seal parts of her memories that had been tampered with by Pandora.

Several months before Subaru arrived, she and Puck were visited by an eccentric man who named himself Roswaal L. Mathers, the first human who didn't react negatively to her appearance. He then invited her to the Royal Selection after being chosen by the Dragon Jewel by giving her a way to save the citizens of Elior Forest, through the usage of the Dragon's Blood.

Emily-san's Maid Path
Shortly after leaving the forest, Emilia encounters and helps Annerose Miload and her butler, Clind. Due to this intervention and a letter from Roswaal, Emilia is taken to the Miload mansion, where Annerose decides to take her in as a maid. During her introduction, her name is misheard as “Emily,” a nickname by which she becomes known in that environment. At the mansion, Frederica Baumann explains that it is a place that shelters discriminated demi-humans, allowing Emilia to remain there. However, Emilia misunderstands the situation as a test imposed by Roswaal to evaluate her effort and character, leading her to take her role as a maid very seriously. Despite her determination, her complete lack of experience with human life and household tasks causes her to fail repeatedly in her duties, and she is regarded as incompetent for the role. Even so, Emilia continues to persevere, convinced that overcoming these difficulties is part of her path toward a greater future.

Emilia's Royal Capital Tour Book
During her visit to the Royal Capital, after getting separated from Ram, she wandered around the capital. She soon saw a little girl who was struggling to pay for the food she'd eaten. Emilia at first tried to help by paying for it with her own money, only to realize her wallet was missing. She then quickly thought of showing Puck around while doing tricks to earn some change for her. Her plan worked but not as intended as a citizen recognizes Puck as a great spirit and a whole crowd of people flee en masse, leaving their wallets behind due to hysteria, as they thought a half-elf would unleash the great spirit's wrath upon them if they did not pay. The little girl later thanked Emilia for the help she provided. It was a short while after that that her insignia was stolen by Felt.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Emilia is an incredibly powerful fighter capable of standing toe to toe with beings who declare themselves a Witch, Sin Archbishops of the Witch Cult, mighty dragonkin, and even the husk of a Dragon. Her power is great enough that the Witch of Vainglory was even forced to retreat after being killed multiple times by her. Furthermore, Emilia also has a powerful charisma that is capable of drawing others to her, including her Authority-wielding knight, a former assassin, the Beast of the End, or even those who lived their lives in fear of their captor, something which has given her a large number of allies in spite of the prejudice levied against her.

Magic/Spritual Arts
Emilia has a natural affinity for the fire attribute, though her suitability for ice spells is significantly better, and she has shown this by using her ice in incredibly adaptable ways, such as dropping massive glaciers from the sky which have the potential to devastate entire regions, assaulting her enemy with an ice storm, creating weapons, freezing her enemies solid, or having her ice form in the shape of vines and thorns to bind her enemies. Furthermore, in terms of sheer magical power, Emilia is stated to be roughly as strong as the original Roswaal A. Mathers, though when it comes to capacity, she outclasses even the current Roswaal. Her mana is so abnormally great that she easily has the capacity to freeze over an entire forest or the tremendous amount of water spilled by the Grand Mogolade Geyser, according to Emilia, if she gathers a lot of energy, she can cause an explosion. It isn't until after the first trials in the Sanctuary that she recalled she could use magic on her own.

Spiritual Arts (精霊術, Seirei-jutsu): Emilia is currently contracted with several lesser spirits, and though she now primarily uses magic on her own, spirits will still gather near her and assist her if she asks of it. Previously, Emilia was contracted with Puck, and the two were very skilled at working together with the Spiritual Arts. During the incident at the Sanctuary, however, Puck severed his contract with her, causing her previous pendant to shatter, and she temporarily carried him around in a crystal stone that wasn't pure enough for her to awaken him properly. She later replaces her pendant with a new high purity crystal stone following the events at Priestella. However, she states that she still doesn't have enough mana to form a new contract. Puck himself wasn't a spirit before he was made into an artificial spirit by Echidna and has some sort of contract with her that seals his former memories unless a certain yet-unknown condition is met. It should be mentioned, however, that in the web novel of Arc 4, during Subaru's second trial, Puck and Emilia faced off against Petelgeuse who had just slaughtered the entire subjugation force. For an unexplained reason, Puck regained his memories and forcefully severed his contract with Emilia, in order to prevent the Ordeal from carrying out. This event, alongside the featured failed loop, has been completely removed from the Light Novel. Some of Emilia's contract conditions were:
He will be active only from 9 am to 5 pm.
Do not ask about his relationship with Beatrice.
Do not look into a mirror or go near a large body of water.
Do not hide the fact that she is a half-elf.
He will choose her hairstyle every morning.
Groom his fur regularly.
Do some exercises when she woke up and before going to bed.
Do not be picky about food.
Talk with lesser spirits every morning and evening.

Spells:

Huma (ヒューマ, Hyūma): Emilia creates a shining water barrier that blocks other projectiles and sorts of magic. However, if the incoming magic is stronger than the shield, it will get through it and cause damage to the user.
El Huma (エル・ヒューマ, Eru Hyūma): Emilia forms and shoots multitudes of ice spears from her hands which easily pierces through and crushes flesh that vanish a moment afterwards.
Ul Huma (ウル・ヒューマ, Uru Hyūma): Emilia summons massive ice pillars from the ground that crash into her target.
Al Huma (アル・ヒューマ, Aru Hyūma): Emilia creates a massive pillar of ice that she used to completely crush her target.
Healing Magic: Emilia is able to use magic to heal others.

Unique Spells: After regaining her memories of how to cast magic on her own, she and Subaru came up with several new spells that take advantage of the coldness and fragility of her ice:

Ice Brand Arts (アイスブランドアーツ, Aisu Burando Ātsu): This technique allows Emilia to instantly conjure ice made weapons which she can use and freely manipulate in close-quarters combat. The weapons created are very sturdy and are even capable of withstanding heat. Where Ice Brands Arts shines is in abusing the fragility of ice to its advantage: even if the weapons she uses are destroyed, she can keep combat flowing by instantly creating a new ice weapon. She is also very detail oriented with any ice creations she makes after being told by Subaru that creativity is important. Utilizing the technique also requires a lot of mana to use, so even when it was copied by Gluttony, he could not use to its full extent. Similarly, Emilia has to have a clear picture in mind of what she wants to create, using drawings and objects around her for inspiration, often creating things in precise detail. She can also create numerous weapons over a wide area, which allows her or others to pick up and use. With further improvement, the weapons she creates become capable of freezing any opponent she strikes with them, which can allow her to take an opponent alive instead of killing them.
Ice Brand Arts: Icicle Line (アイスブランドアーツ、アイシクルライン, Aisu Burando Ātsu, Aishikuru Rain): Emilia creates a limited area barrier made of ice particles around her opponent, which she uses to attack in all directions by transforming them into weapons. This barrier of cold can also act to trap her target while simultaneously wearing down their body with excessive coldness, effectively reducing them to being unable to continue fighting. Likewise, she uses this technique in order to limit the space in which she lowers the temperature in order to prevent collateral damage; by expanding the range, the effect of the cold becomes less effective, whereas the more she shrinks the barrier's size, the more effective it becomes. It's becomes so effective, in fact, that even a dragonkin that can resist the cold, like Madelyn Eschart, can be frozen perfectly solid. Subaru helped to create the idea for this move.
Ice Brand Arts: Ice Soldiers (アイスブランド・アーツ: 氷の兵隊, Aisu Burando Ātsu: Kōri no Heitai): Emilia can create soldiers who are completely made out of ice. Uniquely, she shapes them all after Subaru. These soldiers are exactly the same as actual humans and wield weapons made of ice. They follow every order given to them by Emilia. The soldiers' strength depends on the mana density; the more mana Emilia uses, the stronger and tougher the soldiers will be. Regularly, her ice is as tough as steel, making ordinary attacks useless against it. Currently, Emilia is able to create up to seven proper Ice Soldiers and no less than ten soldiers with only their torsos, heads, and arms. When destroyed, these soldiers can regenerate back to their full health as long as Emilia has the strength to do so. Because these soldiers are made of ice, it makes it difficult for people who can read an enemy's movements based off of their muscle movements to predict what they might do.
Ice Wings: Although unable to allow her to fly, Emilia can create a pair of icy wings that allow her to catch the wind and glide when midair. Originally, the design was inspired by Subaru, and Emilia eventually managed to perfectly recreate the wings on her own.
Ice Flower (氷の花 Kōri no Hana): Emilia creates flowers made of ice on wounds of living beings within a certain area that suck the host's life force and bloom by sucking the host's blood. Seven years ago, Emilia couldn't control the affected area and stop it properly. Puck had to use his powers to terminate it.
thumb|right|250px|Emilia freezing Elior Forest.
Absolute Zero (絶対零度, Zettai Reido): Absolute Zero is Emilia's absolute trump card, and the strongest attack in her arsenal. According to one web novel passage, if her normal magic was rated a 1, Absolute Zero would hover around a 10, if not even around 100. It's devastating enough to be able to end pretty much any real battle in a single blow. Absolute Zero allows Emilia to freeze the atmosphere around her to such a degree that a vacuum is created. The majority of beings that find themselves in this vacuum have zero chances of survival. With this ability, she was able to utterly nullify the Divine Dragon's purifying breath, which has been described to be hot enough and strong enough to melt through anything and disintegrate everything it comes into contact with; Emilia's Ice Soldiers were sturdier than even metal, yet they were instantly scorched from existence by Volcanica's purifying breath. Even with Emilia's level of mana, Absolute Zero consumes a massive amount to perform. This ability was named by Natsuki Subaru sometime following the events of Arc 4.
Ice Age (アイスエイジ, Aisu Eiji): This technique was first used by Emilia when she teamed up with Priscilla Barielle against Madelyn Eschart. It is a controlled version of the climate changing magic she used to freeze Elior Forest, and it causes temperature within a given area to drop rapidly. When used, it begins to snow, the sky seems to be dyed white, and anyone caught within the area of effect will feel cold enough that they start to go numb and cannot move freely.

Conditional Spells:
Cocytus (コキュートス Kokyūtosu): Cocytus is a large-scale spell made out of two combined elements, which was used by Subaru and Emilia during their fight against the Great Rabbit. While Subaru used Yin Magic to form some sort of a barricade around the witchbeasts to prevent them from escaping, Emilia used Fire Magic to carefully apply magical energy to the already-casted Minya spell, creating an icy cage and lifting the cage, the witchbeasts, and the ground itself high in the air.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
thumb|250px|Emilia engaging in hand-to-hand combat.
While she leans more on the magical side, Emilia is also apt at close-quarters combat. Like Garfiel, rather than having a known practiced form, she is a more instinctual fighter, relying on her body's natural talents such as its high nimbleness, sharp senses, and above-average physical strength combined with her magical arts. This creates her own unique style. With her melee combat abilities, Emilia was capable of defeating a group of bandits all on her own as well as easily catch the arrows that were shot at her. Additionally, Emilia is highly proficient in the use of the weapons she makes through her Ice Brand Arts.

Other
thumb|right|250px|Emilia speaking to spirits.
Spirit Affinity: Emilia has a rare innate gift to form contracts with spirits. Her gift was so prominent that even in her youth, numerous spirits were attracted to her. In the present day, she speaks with numerous lesser spirits regularly.

Strong Intuition: Emilia is very intuitive by nature, something which has been incorporated into her melee fighting style. Likewise, it also naturally influences the creations that she makes with her ice, such as her wings, which Aldebaran had noted were incredibly difficult to make right in order to glide. Most of all, however, her intuition has also led her to taking actions separate from others, which has led to her preventing the worst possible scenario in certain battles. During the Great Disaster, she relied on this intuition and moved separately from others, which led to her encountering an enemy who was working to further her plan to kill everyone, and because of this, she was able to ultimately prevent said enemy from doing so.

Equipment

Glintstone (輝石, Kiseki): Emilia wielded a magical crystal of this type until it broke after Puck forcefully severed the contract in order to remove the lid off of Emilia's memories, allowing her to challenge the Trials from the Tomb of the Witch of Greed. After the end of Arc 4, she received another glintstone from Subaru, which he got from Frederica Baumann. The glintstone harbored Puck for roughly a year, until the end of Arc 5, when Emilia was given a new and much more powerful glintstone. With it, she would be able to reunite with the Beast of the End, though she still needs to accumulate enough mana so he could manifest.
Recognition Obstruction Robe (認識阻害のローブ, Ninshiki Sogai no Rōbu): A robe that allows the wearer to obstruct anyone from perceiving them unless the wearer allows it or the person is strong enough to overcome its effects. The robe was given to her by Roswaal, in order to avoid any unwanted situations due to her race. Following the events of Arc 4, however, Emilia decided to stop using the cloak, as according to her, one cannot be a proper leader if they're constantly hiding from others.
A Fragment of the Divine Dragon's Talon: Following the climax of Arc 6 and the liberation of the Pleiades Watchtower, Emilia became the Watchtower's administrator, as she was the one who solved all three trials. This resulted in her having control over the tower and its inhabitants–namely, the Divine Dragon Volcanica. In order to prevent the Witch Cult or anyone else to access the Tower, Emilia tasked the Dragon with guarding the Watchtower and warding off anyone who approaches–though in typical Emilia fashion, she also ordered the Dragon not to harm a living being, no matter what. Volcanica then gave the half-elf a fragment of its jet-black talon, which was observed by Beatrice to be brimming with mana. It was soon concluded that the Dragon would be able to recognize its talon from far away and not attack Emilia or anyone else who will be holding the talon at the time. It should be also said that the talon does not have any other purpose besides what has already been mentioned.

intro: Elsa Granhiert (エルザ・グランヒルテ) was an assassin working together with Meili Portroute as the "child" of an individual known as Mother. She was the main antagonist of Arc 1 and one of the two secondary antagonists of Arc 4.
appearance:
Elsa Granhiert was unusually tall for a woman, as she stood around the same height as Natsuki Subaru at the time of his summoning. Her purple eyes angled down towards their edges and presented Elsa with a certain level of calmness and gentleness. Below her left eye Elsa had a beauty spot. Her long wavy hair was the same shade of black as Subaru's (a trait that was very rare in her world) and was braided into a long tail on the left side of her head that reached down to her hips. A single purple flower decorated the left side of Elsa's head. Elsa was a woman of incredible beauty who apparently oozed eroticism with every move she made. Her white skin was unusually pale to the point that it could almost be described as sickening, and Elsa's slim body was well-endowed with large breasts and sultry curves. Her bewitching beauty coupled with her well-endowed body was enough to catch the eye of most people she met.

Elsa's clothing, as if to match the woman herself, was extremely provocative. Her outfit consisted of a pair of black elbow-length gloves with purple trimmings at the top, a pair of black high-heel shoes, a black dress with purple decorations that was both strapless and backless and featured brown tights, and on a couple of occasions, cloaks that were given to her by one of her employers. The dress, that clung to Elsa's body fairly tightly, also had thigh-high slits on either side and an exposed front that flaunted her belly button and cleavage.
personality:
Elsa was a battle maniac, not even hesitating to injure herself if she could fight strong opponents, which was helped by her abnormal healing rate. This was also shown through her persistence. Her favorite things were seeing colorful bowels and touching warm looking internal organs. Within combat, she enjoyed cleaving through the abdominal region with the intent of tearing the target's bowels out.

Perhaps Elsa's defining trait was the arousal she garnered from gutting people and toying with their steaming entrails. Upon facing worthy opponents, Elsa would express excitement at the prospect of gutting them, pondering on random variables such as what color her opponents' entrails would be. After disemboweling Natsuki Subaru she barraged him with a flurry of questions related to the pain he was feeling as he lay dying on the floor of the Loot House, conveying that she received sadistic arousal from the pain others felt due to her actions. Her warped sense of arousal didn't end with her opponents, as Elsa also felt masochistic ecstasy whenever she was wounded by others, such as when Subaru kicked her in the Loot House. She didn't feel any remorse towards those she gutted, even if they were children or the elderly.

Elsa also enjoyed knitting cotton dolls, especially after a good kill, and she is mentioned to have over 10 years of experience. Although it wasn't mentioned, she presumably destroyed them later.
history:
Early Life
Elsa was born to ordinary parents in the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, the northernmost of the world's Four Great Nations, known for its harsh, freezing weather and spiritualism. Due to their living circumstances becoming difficult, her parents sold Elsa into slavery while she was a young child in order to get by. She eventually lost her recollection of her parents, and never came to harbor a grudge against them for their decision. Oftentimes, she would run away from her buyers, stealing from and hurting people in order to survive, although her way of life didn't allow for any happiness or sense of fulfilment. One day, while stealing from a store in a blizzard, the owner of the shop caught Elsa and tried to have his way with her. Without hesitation, Elsa grasped a shard of glass from a bottle of Granhiert and slit her assailant's belly open. The warmth of the man's entrails made Elsa forget the coldness that enveloped her life, and for the first time she felt truly alive. As a result, she developed a gruesome fetish for gutting people and fighting with her life on the line against opponents doing the same. She earned recognition as the "Bowel Hunter," who was feared across the world for her gruesome fetish. 

Apocalypse Girls
Approximately nine years before the start of the story, Elsa after having slain her twelve previous owners and returned to the slaver Oliver Zeppes each time, she was bought by Holosseo Featherrun, a member of the Gustekan Church who intended to indict her into the Featherrun Sisters, and sometime after the purchase, she had a ritual performed on her by Holosseo, which turned her into a Curse Doll. Eventually, in order to truly perfect the Curse Doll curse, Holosseo ordered the sisters to kill each other. Elsa, who had no intention to kill her sisters, wanted to persuade him not to, but as her thoughts were swayed, she instead resorted to force and killed him. Despite this, she was forced to fight and kill Dorothea, Saria, and Hildea anyways. She then fought Ornea after she was poisoned by one of her other sisters, Sithonia. After defeating her, she fought and killed Sithonia, and upon her departure, she entrusted Ornea's care and the Featherrun mansion to Oliver. However, when Elsa departed from the Featherrun mansion, Capella intercepted her, revealing what she truly desired was love from someone who could devote themselves to her. Threatening Elsa with the lives of Ornea and Oliver, Capella successfully managed to acquire her as a new “child”.

Time as one of Mother's Children
At some point, Elsa was sent after Meili Portroute, who was living with the witchbeasts as a feral child in a forest. As instructed, she killed all the witchbeasts and brought the child back. At that time, Meili was in a state where she couldn't speak, so her manner of speech and such was greatly influenced by Elsa. Elsa found a partner in the young girl, who had the power to control witchbeasts. Elsa and Meili became as close as sisters overtime. 

At one point, the Bowel Hunter was tasked with killing an important figure from the Sacred Vollachia Empire, a meritocratic nation located to the far south of the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko. Although she was able to kill her target, she was confronted by Vollachia's Blue Lightning, who was acting as the person's bodyguard. Barely escaping with her life, the event would be forever engraved in Elsa's memory.

Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain
In the months prior to the beginning of the story, Elsa found herself involved in the conflict between Igor Kenash and Viktor Orcos.

Felt-chan's Job
Sometime later, having been hired by Roswaal L. Mathers to attack Emilia, Elsa met Felt, a young thief from the slums, and she hired her to steal Emilia's insignia from her, leading to the events of Arc 1.

Elsa and Meili, Assassin Sisters' Dark Diary
Following Elsa's defeat and near death by the hands of Reinhard van Astrea, she escaped so that her wounds could mend themselves. After being picked up by Meili, who was shocked to hear that she was defeated and that her wounds weren't regenerating like they were supposed to, Meili patched up her wounds, and they decided to leave the Royal Capital in order to escape the people searching for her, leading to Elsa, buck naked, deciding to procure clothes from someone. After causing bloodshed to obtain these clothes, she and Meili used a witchbeast to change their hair colors, and with the help of a guard who didn't recognize them pointing them in the direction of the highway, they left the capital behind. However, Meili had received an objective from Mother, who had told her to stir mayhem in the area around Roswaal Manor, much to Elsa's chagrin. While the two split up, Elsa decided to knit a doll of Reinhard for Meili.

Later, as Meili took on her task, Elsa watched from afar the chaos, and as Roswaal lit the forest ablaze to kill all of the Wolgarms, Elsa made her way to assist Meili, delighted that their roles were reversed from the incident in the capital. As they ran, she gave Meili the doll of Reinhard, and shortly after, she carried Meili on her back, despite the girl's reluctance and frustration, and ran beyond the mountains. Soon enough, they found themselves surrounded by witchbeasts, which Meili decided to speak with and have them regroup with other witchbeasts to rebuild her numbers.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
thumb|230px|Elsa fighting against Garfiel.
Elsa was an infamous assassin who was highly talented at manipulating and using blade techniques to overwhelm her opponents. She was easily capable of defeating Rom, Felt, and Subaru with ease, fought on par with Emilia and Puck while both were contracted and in a weakened state, and was able to go toe to toe with a warrior of Garfiel's caliber during his early days of fighting. Although not among the strongest of combatants, easily outclassed by a fair number of warriors, she was still extremely dangerous for her ability to kill her targets, and ridiculously hard to kill because of her curse, and because of this, she ultimately was able to kill her enemies and escape, even after being forced to face two of the world's most powerful people.

Curse
thumb|230px|Elsa regenerating from Garfiel’s attack instantaneously by utilizing her Curse Doll curse.
Curse Doll (呪い人形, Noroi Ningyō): Elsa's seeming immortality was caused from a curse that made her into a so-called "curse doll", which was cast on her by Holosseo Featherrun. It is a curse art which involves the user carving a curse mark that includes the information of the target they want to kill on someone, and upon activation, the person with the curse mark gains immortality, but as a cost, they lose their sense of self and can't do anything else but kill the target and they die when the target is killed. Also, there seems to be a limit to the immortality. However, there's a way to cast the curse without the person losing their sense of self, which is what happened to Elsa, though repeatedly dying turned her into a curse doll. People who become curse dolls are mistakenly referred to as vampires due to a curse doll once drinking blood in an attempt to die. In the past, she mockingly called her curse a Blessing, a term used for abilities that originate from Gusteko.
Regeneration: Elsa had the ability to rapidly recreate lost or damaged cells. She could instantly recover from major lacerations and was able to regrow severed body parts. She was able to regenerate after having her entire body crystalized and shattered by Beatrice and even survived an attack from the Sword Saint himself. Those who were unaware of her power thought her to be an unstoppable killing machine incapable of dying or tiring. However, there was a limit to how much damage she could sustain, as eventually her healing factor could become overwhelmed by continuous significant wounds that would cause it to stop functioning. Additionally, the strikes of the Sword Saint were capable of delaying or negating the Bowel Hunter's regeneration.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
Enhanced Agility: Elsa is an incredibly fast, agile fighter who is easily capable of fighting her enemies by jumping off of walls, the floor, and the ceiling with incredible ease and speed, giving her the capability to fight in three dimensions.

Enhanced Olfaction: Elsa was born, for no apparent reason, with an unnaturally acute sense of smell. Her heightened sense allowed her to better distinguish the scents of a person in the air, meaning she could smell people who were keeping out of sight and have a better bearing on her surroundings in general. Much like a dog, the Bowel Hunter could determine a person's emotional state through their scent. For instance, she could tell if someone was afraid or trying to deceive her by smelling them.

Equipment

Kukri Knives: Elsa's primary weapons of choice were a set of short ornate black Kukri blades. She always carried multiple spares to be used if her primaries were destroyed, and depending on her mood she would wield either a single blade or a pair of blades. These weapons were a design that originated from Elsa's homeland of Gusteko, and over time, they became synonymous with the Bowel Hunter. Additionally, she wielded ornate short blades, and she had two secret weapons which were specialized blades that she only ever used against special opponents whom she aimed to kill rather than just seeing their guts.
White Blade: A thick kukri with a surprisingly large amount of mass specialized for crushing bone. The bladed portion can extend a string of blades not dissimilar from a snake sword for mid-range attacks.
Black Blade: Looks similar to her standard knives but has distinctive serrated edged that gives it an appearance of animal teeth. It's supposedly created for goring opponents rather than ripping them.
thumb|250x250px|Elsa throwing needles to kill Petra.
Throwing Needles: Elsa wielded needles that could be used to attack people from afar.
thumb|250x250px|Elsa using her magic cloak to defend herself from an incoming magical attack.
Enchanted Cloaks: Upon being hired by Margrave Roswaal L. Mathers, Elsa was given a feathered cloak that was enchanted with a Yang magic enhancement. The enchantment in question ensured that any offensive magical attack that struck the cloak would dissipate and leave its wearer unharmed. However, it is only effective for singular usage, as after negating an attack the cloak would dissipate. Another drawback was that it only worked against spells intended to harm her physically, thus indirect magic like Shamak bypassed it. The cloaks were imbued with a yang magic buff based on the theory established by Roswaal K. Mathers. Elsa was given the cloak to compensate for her natural weakness to magic, and after having used it to negate an attack from Puck, she was given a second one.

intro: Felt (フェルト) is a former thief and a candidate to become the 42nd monarch of Lugunica. After being involved in the Loot House Incident along with Emilia, Natsuki Subaru, and Reinhard van Astrea, she was discovered to be a potential monarch for the Kingdom, and she is forced to participate in the Royal Selection. Having grown up in the slums, she takes the opportunity to get revenge on the Kingdom by making her primary policy to disband all government. She plays a major role in Arc 1 and Arc 9, a supporting role in Arc 5 and Arc 10, and a minor supporting role in Arc 3.
appearance:
Felt is a short girl with fair skin and medium-length golden hair with a black bow. She has a yaeba that becomes prominent when she laughs. She has red eyes and wears a sleeveless black top, red scarf with a golden patch on it, black pants that are incomplete on the left side, and a red ribbon on her left ankle. She also wears a vest, gloves, brown shoes, and has a belt with a sheath where her knife is. When Reinhard took her, he forced her to wear a yellow dress, white gloves on her hands that reached her upper arms, boots, and an orange bun in the center of her hair to look presentable as a candidate for the throne in the Royal Selection. 

After the Royal Selection Ceremony, Reinhard made a new outfit for Felt. Just like her former outfit, it's very light. She wears a black top with long sleeves yet leaves her stomach exposed, a blue scarf with a golden patch on it, a brown leather vest, boots of the same material, black leggings, a black belt, and brown leather shorts that she wears over her leggings. She keeps a few pouches on her belt. In the Water Plumage Inn in Arc 5, she wore a yukata.

Her appearance is considered to be a sign of having royal blood. However, as all members of the Royal Family are currently deceased, there is currently no way to confirm if she actually is part of the royal family.
personality:
Felt is short tempered, hot headed, and rather unladylike. Reinhard has commented about this trait several times with Felt often not caring. She is also very childish about a lot of things, although this childish nature goes away when faced with a dangerous situation. Felt is a stickler when it comes to money due to living in the slums which also blessed her with a mentality of never allowing herself to lose in any kind of way. She cares about Old Man Rom and treats him like her real grandfather. She greatly trusts Rom's word, especially when it comes to appraisals in price. Felt has stated multiple times that she resents everything about the Kingdom and plans to tear it all down, which is likely due to the way Felt grew up. Likewise, though she is aware of how useful it is for the people of the slums and does not believe it to be useless, she herself dislikes being given charity, to the point that she has never gone to collect the bread being given out by the Divine Dragon Church.

After spending a year living a completely different life from what she was used to, Felt started viewing the world in a different light, not being scared of changes anymore as she realized that change is a natural course of action, one she is unable to avoid. As a result, Felt developed a strong preference for the theory of the "Survival of the Fittest", where the one who could adapt to their situation and discern the best manner of survival would survive and strive over those who could not. Consequentially to this mentality, Felt believes she's what she is today due to the belief that she adapted, opting her to accept every decision she made thus far as something natural. Due to this mindset, she has fully accepted the scrutinizing gazes of others, and Felt has a habit of determining whether someone was useful or not to herself or whatever they might be thinking, a habit that has aided her both in life and in the Royal Selection. This being said, she is also the type to play fairly against opponents during the Royal Selection. Likewise, even if it might make the path ahead unclear, she was not unwilling to become friends with said opponents, even if she was aware that it would have been easier for her to act otherwise. Similarly, when it comes to certain secrets involving other camps, such as Otto Suwen's Divine Protection, she will keep quiet about such things to others out of a sense of obligation, even being willing to use her knight as a cover for such things.

She is a calm and collected person, and though she comes off as quick-tempered, she is capable of handling difficult people without giving them an inch, and she is willing to do whatever it takes when it truly matters. She is also a rather frank person. In one case, after dealing with Reinhard's foul-mouthed father Heinkel when he ruined a moment between his family and picked a fight with the Royal Selection candidates, though she was quick to shoot him down, after he left, she decided to use the time afforded to her to chide him for his behavior. She dislikes being followed around everywhere and prefers being able to make decisions on her own without outside input, something that leads to her having a somewhat strained relationship with her knight. Because of this, she will do what she can to ditch such people and any requests they might have in favor of doing as she wishes. This often leads to her trying to escape from her knight, and in one case, she even ignored him when he asked her to remain in a safe spot during an attack and instead went to assist in repelling the attackers. Likewise, even when she finds herself in a complicated situation and has extremely limited options and means to obtain information, such as her isolation during the Lugunican Subversive Conspiracy, Felt is willing to take charge when she needs to or even leave things to chance, as well as to accept when help comes her way.

Felt is also willing to risk her life when it comes to bringing down her enemies. In one of the encounters in a failed loop against the Bowel Hunter Elsa Granhiert, she viciously targeted her after she defeated Rom. More prominently, when she was held hostage by Heinkel in order to force Reinhard's hand, she did not flinch and instead told Reinhard to do his duty as a knight instead of worrying about his charge. Later, she is shown to be willing to let Al use her as a hostage to prevent any deaths while using her position to secretly relay information to her allies. She is also honorable, willing to properly compete with the other Royal Selection candidates rather than eliminate them one by one, as claimed by her knight and Al.

Despite becoming aware of the fact that her existence may be that of Filore Lugunica, the princess who had gone missing during the Royal Abduction Incident, Felt never considered herself to be a part of the royal family, and never once did she attempt to that to her advantage. However, she could not disregard the expectations that she might be that princess. Although she herself had scoffed at the idea of being royalty, when Filore appeared and made her existence known, although the question of herself being the missing princess had not been repudiated and the facts remained uncertainties, she still felt a deep turmoil in her soul, not due to wanting to be royalty herself but for the disappointment and possible betrayal of those who had hope in her caused by circumstances beyond her control.
history:
Early Life
Felt was born roughly 14 years before the start of the main story, under circumstances that remain unknown until this day, though it's been heavily implied by multiple high ranking and knowledgeable individuals such as Miklotov McMahon and Reinhard van Astrea that she was, in fact, born as the last daughter of Ford Lugunica, the younger brother of the 41st and last King of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica, Randohal Lugunica. At an unknown age, early in her life, Felt was picked up by Rom, who gave her current name and acted as her adoptive grandfather. For over a decade, Felt spent her days in the slums of the Royal Capital, unable to get along with the children who stuck together and often disliked by even those of the same gender, causing her to choose to remain alone except for her only family, Rom. However, she did not rely on his kindness alone out of her sense of pride, so she would solve her own problems. In order to earn enough money to move out of the slums and start her own life, at some point, Felt started stealing from people. Starting off with simple pickpocketing, she broadened out and started accepting requests from other people. Soon, she became a master thief, earning a considerable amount of money through dirty business.

Lone Wolf of the Slums, Felt-chan's Noisy Days
One day, after witnessing the attempted kidnapping of a child from an old man in a part of the slums that wasn't her turf, she attacked the kidnappers, helping the two escape, before being chased around by the dozen kidnappers, who were all intent on selling her off, and she started running back in the direction of her turf. When one of the men warned the others about not harming her face after they fired an arrow at her, she turned the tables on them by jumping on their heads and attacking the man in charge. After slipping away from the group, who hesitated to pursue her, she blended in with the crowd, casually pickpocketing passersby. Sometime later, however, the kidnappers found and surrounded her, claiming that it was because the people who hated her had sold her out for money. In response to them, Felt pulled out a whistle she stole from a guard and blew into it, summoning the guards who patrolled and causing them to take down the kidnappers with ease while she escaped. Later, she arrived at the Loot House, where Rom was waiting for her.

Felt-chan's Job
On the day of Natsuki Subaru's arrival to the new world, Felt accepted a very profiting job from a shady woman with a snake-like gaze, thinking this would be her last job, as 10 gold coins would be more than enough for her to start a new life somewhere outside of the Royal Capital's slums. It didn't take her long to locate her target: a woman with white clothes with golden birds woven on it, and long, dazzling silver hair. Just as she was about to approach the woman and steal the object of interest, she was tasked to take, another person grabbed the opportunity and snatched away the woman's purse. Just as he was about to scurry off into the back alley, a tall old man in a black suit pressed his sword against the man's throat, demanding the thief to return what he stole. Noticing Felt, who was staring at the whole ordeal, he casually walked towards her, noting he knew she had the same intentions as the man he had just caught. Despite that, he kindly asked Felt to return the stolen purse to its owner. When Felt started objecting and stating she'll just scurry off with the purse, the man calmly rebuked her, and for a moment, his stare became as sharp and cold as a blade, prompting Felt to agree to his request in fear. Right after, another person called out to the old man, catching his attention. Felt used the chance to escape to a back alley nearby. In the alleyway, she tried to confirm the object of interest was in the stolen purse, however, all she could find was change, barely enough for a short shopping spree. Annoyed, Felt returned to the main street and quickly located the woman who was, at the time, in the middle of a commotion, trying to get attention so she could pay for a demi-human child's meal. Felt used the opportunity to throw the woman's purse back to her, making sure she found it right after. Felt then continued to tail the woman who was aimlessly wandering around the Royal Capital. After some time, Felt was finally blessed with a situation that would allow her to snatch away the object of interest. She used her Divine Protection to scale a large building, jumped off behind the woman and snatched away what she was keeping safe in her waist pocket. What Felt found was a black dragon-shaped insignia with a red stone shining inside her palm.

Felt-chan's Imprisonment Life
After the Loot House Incident, Felt woke up to find herself naked in an unfamiliar room. Reinhard appeared and said that her clothes were currently being washed and that they would be returned soon. In her frustration, she asked where they were and why Reinhard brought her there, to which he revealed that he brought her to the rarely used Astrea Manor in the Royal Capital. Afterward, he gave her another insignia, and after it shined in her hand, he explained that it meant that she was chosen by fate and needed to appear at the castle. This angered her, and though when she attempted to deceive him by asking for a pair of clothes to wear, she attempted to escape, only to easily be caught. Reinhard claimed that if she was able to escape the manor, then he would not go after her. However, he and the servants would attempt to prevent her from doing so. Inside, the maid had prepared a dress for her in place of her ordinary clothes, and Reinhard asked her to wear what they had at the manor while she was there.

Felt-chan Saw!
In the ten days that followed the Loot House Incident, Felt tried several times to escape, having managed to escape Reinhard's side only once successfully before being caught. Being served confectionaries by Carol, Felt enjoyed it and asked if Carol wouldn't go with her when she escaped, to which she appreciated the offer but claimed that she had to refuse for Grimm's sake. After finishing her snack, Felt wandered the mansion thinking of a way to escape when she stumbled upon a room that she was warned not to enter. Looking inside, she found a woman asleep inside, and when she got suspicious if Reinhard had kidnapped someone else, Reinhard appeared and said that the woman was his mother, Louanna Astrea, and that due to unknown reasons, she was in the Sleeping Beauty state. When she exited the room, Reinhard asked her not to tell anyone about her and thanked her for her concern. Afterward, he informed Felt that Rom ran away from the guardhouse during his treatment, to which she claimed he was fine. Looking at him, she claimed that Reinhard did look like his mother, which seemed to make him happy, though Felt was still annoyed by him keeping her there.

Felt-chan Rises to the Center Stage
On the way to the Royal Castle, Felt, who had lost a bet to Reinhard, started to kick at him in annoyance. She ultimately failed to hit him even once, and she asked once more where they were headed. Though Reinhard wanted to keep it a secret, they reached the castle, much to her frustration. Inside the castle, Reinhard left her side and Felt was brought to be dressed by maids while Carol watched on. However, Heinkel, having come in response to Reinhard's arrival, entered the room, much to Carol's anger and Felt's annoyance. Afterward, Carol informed Heinkel of Felt's reason being in the castle was for the Royal Selection, which he laughed at. Though Felt was ready to attack him, Heinkel stepped in front of her quickly and claimed that they were both in the same position before leaving. Felt asked Carol about her Heinkel, and she replied that she, Grimm, and Reinhard all had connections to him, and she was dismayed that Reinhard had apparently guessed correctly. Deciding to get things back on track, Felt positioned herself to continue getting dressed while a couple of the maids cleaned up a mess Heinkel had made, and while that was happening, Felt noticed Heinkel's hair tone being like Reinhard and claimed she knows people with red hair suck.

Felt-chan Gathers Thugs
Felt, Reinhard, and Rom were on a carriage on their way back from the Royal Selection Ceremony. Rom and Reinhard had a cryptic conversation regarding a kidnapping that happened years ago and the incident of the old royal guards being restructured.
Felt asked the carriage to stop at the Loot House in the slums, as Felt wished to see what remained of it. While Felt inspected the slums with her camp, she found Gaston, Rachins Hoffman, and Camberley running away and badly injured. They decided to attempt to rob her to make enough money to get away from Lugunica, as they had attempted to trick Russell Fellow into a shady business that did not end well for them, and they were now marked for death by him. Reinhard easily defeated one of them as the others attempted to run, but they were intercepted by Felt while she was scolding Reinhard, as letting them run away would mean they would be dead by Russell's capable henchman the next day. She then recruited the trio for her camp in hopes of using their help for ruining the country.

Lugunican Papers
In the year that followed the Subjugation of the White Whale, Felt was requested an interview by Shorty Megan and Lululala. Meeting at the Astrea Manor, Shorty witnessed the usual interaction between Felt and Reinhard, which he felt was peculiar. Likewise with the other candidates, Felt gave her opinion on the Royal Selection and the other candidates. Having both grown up in the slums of the Royal Capital, they both understood the plight of the people there and were able to agree on numerous things. In the end, Lululala drew an image of Felt and Reinhard, which Felt felt dismayed about.

Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle Line 4
Following the Battle for Priestella, after hearing Garfiel Tinzel's resolve not to lose to Reinhard when he was speaking to Otto, Felt visited the injured Otto with Reinhard in tow and teased him. Though Otto found it funny thinking that he used to call himself a humble merchant and that he seemed to have gone pretty far from that ideal, Felt sympathized, but she claimed that duty called and she had to fight. Afterward, though she joked that she was there to visit him to help eat the fruits he'd been gifted, she was there to thank him for his assistance, both in the battle with Lye Batenkaitos and Heinkel before that, and Reinhard agreed with her gratitude. Felt also claimed that they had a debt towards Otto now, which made Otto twist his expression unconsciously. Then, Felt and Reinhard took their leave, leaving Otto thinking about work.

The Lion’s Ferocity
Following the Battle for Priestella, she and Reinhard were responsible for escorting the Sin Archbishop of Wrath to the Royal Capital’s Prison Tower. Due to Sirius’s attraction of trouble, it took two months before they arrived. When Reinhard took her up the tower, Felt was invited to dinner that night by Russell Fellow. She ultimately accepted, and that night with Reinhard, she went to dinner and spoke with Russell about the heretic hunts of Gusteko, the declining balance of power between Kararagi’s mayors, and the signs of a civil war in Vollachia Empire. Likewise, they spoke about how the times were changing drastically, with Felt associating those changes with Subaru and Emilia.

Meili’s Witchbeast Observation Record
Sometime later, after the successful Pleiades Watchtower Expedition, she took part in a meeting with Meili Portroute and the Council of Wise Men, and she helped negotiations smooth out, resulting in members of her camp and Meili being tasked with investigating the conquered Pleiades Watchtower. As they made their way through the Augria Sand Dunes, Volcanica attacked them, leaving Reinhard to defend them. However, thanks to Meili, Volcanica stopped attacking, and they successfully reached the tower. Inside, the group bore witness to the innumerable Books of the Dead, and Felt suggested to Reinhard to look for the book of his grandmother, to which he was grateful, though she was curious as to why there were so many empty books laid on the ground. However, the nearby birds caught their attention, and after the crimson scorpion killed the one they’d caught, Reinhard and Ezzo Cadner began slaughtering the others, as they were being used to spy. Though they didn’t know the assailant, the group decided to leave the tower, with Ezzo and Flam Remendis remaining in the tower. In the Royal Capital, Felt reported their discoveries to the Council of Wise Men.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Although Felt is quite scrappy, strong-willed, and a good escape artist, she is not particularly powerful, having just enough power to protect herself and escape from most ordinary pursuers. Despite this, she makes up for this with her people skills and her instincts, something which has led to her coming out of most situations untouched,

Divine Protection
thumb|250px|Felt, confronting Elsa with the assistance of her Divine Protection.
Felt has a currently unnamed Divine Protection which Elsa mentions is related to wind. Felt mentions that she's used to using this ability rather than relying on tools and weapons. The Divine Protection allows Felt to dash ahead as fast as the blink of an eye, exactly like the wind, releasing a gust of wind when she stops moving. During Arc 5, Felt has also shown that she can use her Divine Protection to climb up walls and buildings.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
From a young age, Felt has physically trained herself to utilize her full agility while fighting. She is so quick that she can steal the insignia from Emilia without her realizing it, and she is quick to draw her knife when she is forced into a dangerous situation. However, she does not know the Flow Method, and her physical strength is on par with most humans.

Expert Thief: Felt has been a pickpocket for years, and she became heavily experienced in thievery over the course of her life. She became rather well known in the slums for it.
Parkour: Felt is rather capable in parkour. With assistance from her Divine Protection, she can jump and run off of walls, roofs, and trees.
Stealth: Felt is also rather accomplished with stealth. Throughout the entire fight against Al in Arc 9, she trailed behind him without letting him, Heinkel, or even Yae Tenzen catch wind of her.

Intelligence
Street Smarts: Having grown up in the slums, Felt is considerably smart when it comes to handling other people. Naturally, this makes it hard to trick her. She can speak to people as shrewd as Russell Fellow and those who work in underground organizations such as in Flanders with no issue, and she can quickly understand darker political matters associated with them without allowing them to walk circles around her. Likewise, she also used these street smarts in order to bring the people of lower class to her side during the Royal Selection.

Equipment
Knife: Felt wields a knife that she has used since her time as a thief.
Whistle: It is unknown whether she still possesses it, but at one point, Felt had stolen a whistle from one of the Kingdom's knights that would signal to other knights to appear at the location it was blown at.
Star Staff: By the time of the Battle for Priestella, she came into ownership of Echidna's meteor staff, which can be used to fire the light of Shario at an opponent, and it is strong enough to defeat even a Sin Archbishop. Though, Felt has also attempted to use it as a melee weapon due to her lack of knowledge in how to use it.
