intro: Fortuna (フォルトナ) was Emilia's paternal aunt and the guardian of the seal in Elior Forest. Roughly a century before the events of the main story, she took care of a young Emilia instead of her parents.
appearance:
Fortuna was a beautiful woman with a fit physique whose glistening silver hair was cut fairly short. Her almond-shaped violet sanpaku eyes, which looked similar to Natsuki Subaru's, glistened like gemstones and were sharp and intimidating. As an elf, her ears were abnormally pointed. In her hair, Fortuna wore a silver hairpin shaped like a four-petaled flower, which Emilia decided to wear following her demise.

Like every elf in Elior Forest, Fortuna wore clothing that was primarily white and violet. Her outfit, which prioritized ease of movement, consisted of a sleeveless skin-tight violet unitard, white knee-high boots with violet soles, a band consisting of identical white flowers on her right thigh, and a white cold shoulder jacket with violet edging that went down to her waist and was open below the breasts. A golden brooch in the shape of a pair of open wings was affixed to her collar.

In Emilia's Second Trial, Fortuna wore a white sun hat with a light blue band and a long dress in a similar style to her usual outfit.

As an elf, Fortuna had an unspecified lifespan that far surpassed a human one. At the time of her death, she had lived for at least over a century, yet she still maintained the physical appearance and athleticism of a young woman.
personality: Fortuna was a kind-hearted and modest woman who cared deeply for her loved ones and would give anything to protect and nurture them, and according to Geuse, she was similar to a young Emilia when she was younger. She seemed to have low self-esteem, as she routinely understated her positive features. As a result of her pessimistic outlook on herself, Fortuna became easily flustered by compliments given to her by her loved ones, particularly Geuse. In a weak attempt to hide her embarrassment, she would usually admonish the person who complimented her and act as though she was angry with them. Despite her self-esteem problems, the elven woman was courageous in battle, refusing to yield even if she stood no chance of victory and would die as a result of her failure.
history:
Early Life
Fortuna was an elven woman whose brother married a human woman and bore a half-elven girl named Emilia. However, after her brother and sister-in-law could no longer take care of their child, Fortuna took Emilia in and raised her as her own daughter. At some point, the pair moved into an elven village in the Great Elior Forest, where they were warmly welcomed. Emilia, for unclear reasons, was of paramount importance and, as such, was protected by the villagers. The settlement would occasionally receive supply deliveries from Geuse Romanée-Conti and his Witch Cult underlings. Fortuna and Geuse shared a long history, and both had unspoken feelings for the other.

Elior Forest Team, Waiting for the Thaw
After meeting Geuse for the first time, Emilia wanted to be friends with him. However, Fortuna kept her away from him. Thinking that Fortuna would panic if she faked stomach pains, she believed that Fortuna would ask what she wanted and let her see Geuse. However, when she committed to her act, Fortuna seemed to panic more than she expected, and she brought her to the village square and asked for help. Archi asked if she was acting, getting him into an argument with Fortuna since Emilia had never fallen ill even when the entire village had when they all ate rotten appas. Geuse decided to pray for her since she had helped him before, causing the whole village to lower their heads in silence. Feeling guilty, Emilia began to cry and said that her stomach had stopped hurting, causing everyone to rejoice, and Geuse told her that instead of apologizing when she troubles someone to instead say thank you. Afterward, walking back the way she came, Geuse held the sleeping Emilia on his back while Fortuna thanked him for going along with her act. Fortuna recalled how she worried for her, even after Archi became her guardian, and after Emilia called her a crybaby in her sleep, Geuse claimed that Fortuna was just like Emilia when she was younger with her brother, to her annoyance.

Permafrost of Elior Forest
One day, the village was attacked by radical members of the Witch Cult led by the Sin Archbishop of Greed, Regulus Corneas, as well as Pandora. After ordering Archi to evacuate Emilia from the forest, Fortuna attempted to defeat Regulus and Pandora alongside Geuse. The Witch of Vainglory was able to separate herself from the fight and catch up with Emilia, who herself had already been separated from Archi. When Geuse and Fortuna arrived on the scene, Pandora was able to use her power to trick Geuse into killing Fortuna using his Authority. Fortuna died in the arms of Emilia, who subsequently froze the entire forest in her rage. Petelgeuse, driven insane by his accidental actions, joined the Witch as she left the frozen forest.
abilities_text:
Magic (魔法, Mahō): Fortuna was an experienced fire magic user.

El Huma (エル・ヒューマ): The user forms and shoots multitudes of ice spikes from their hands, which easily pierce through human flesh and immediately vanish after impact.
Ul Huma (ウル・ヒューマ): By freezing the air around her, Fortuna could produce large amounts of sturdy ice that she could then telekinetically direct. 
Al Huma (アル・ヒューマ): A bit different from the standard version of a spell, Fortuna summoned a giant ball of ice so large as to encompass the entirety of the visible sky to crush her foes.
Ice Weapons: Fortuna was able to form weapons out of ice, such as swords and spears. They were sharp enough to easily cut Pandora in half.

intro: Frederica Baumann (フレデリカ・バウマン) is a maid in service to Roswaal L. Mathers and a member of the Emilia Camp. Frederica has played a supporting role in Arc 4 and a lesser supporting role in Arc 7 and Arc 8.
appearance:
Frederica has very long pale gold hair and green eyes. She is a little taller than Subaru, has a muscular build, and a mouth with sharp fangs. She is mentioned to look like a carnivorous hunter locking onto its prey when she narrows her eyes. According to Subaru, Frederica would be a beautiful woman if she covered her mouth. She is also commonly seen wearing maid’s attire, as her job requires. When she was young, Frederica’s unkempt hair reached her shoulders, and she wore a pink dress with a red scarf and red socks.

During her outing to Costuul, Frederica wore a white and green dress, and she wore a green mantle over her shoulders with yellow designs along its edges.

When she transforms, she becomes a golden leopard that even the People of Shudrak found beautiful. When she transforms back from her leopard form, her clothes have either been forsaken or torn off, leaving her completely naked.
personality: Unlike her younger brother Garfiel, Frederica uses her father's surname Baumann. She is a kind person, although she can be strict at times, especially to Petra who started working as a maid. She also cares deeply about Garfiel and used to send him letters regularly when he was still in the Sanctuary, and after learning from Roswaal that he enjoyed reading, she also sent him books. As children, she used to spar with him and often sent him flying, completely ignoring the seven-year difference between them. She has a complex about her teeth, which causes her to hide them from others. She also seemed to want to be called "big sister" by her junior coworkers, and she was disappointed when Rem and Ram refused to do so. In the past, she was not as polite or graceful as she is in the present day. She had a temper, which she most often showed around Clind, Rem, or Ram, and though she started to become strict due to her position, Roswaal had complained that she was often too stiff.
history:
Early Life
Frederica was born around 21 years prior to the start of the story to a father who was a half-beastman and a human mother, Reshia Tinzel, and was born a quarter beast human. Eventually, after wandering around, Frederica, along with Reala and Garfiel, were picked up by Roswaal and given a home at the Sanctuary. Reala left her children at the Sanctuary to bring back her missing husband. Frederica lived at the Sanctuary until she was 11 years old when she became a maid, working for Roswaal she could give her people and brother in the Sanctuary a home for when the barrier would eventually come down. During her time, she was taught by Clind how to be a servant, and she seemed to be fairly fond of him. However, as she aged, Clind started acting cold toward her, and she came to despise the man.

The Sisters of the Hidden Village
After the destruction of the Oni village, Roswaal brought Rem and Ram back to the manor, and Frederica helped watch over them. After Rem woke up to Ram sitting beside her, Frederica appeared to retrieve Ram and bring her back to her room. Though she smiled at Rem when she introduced herself, she seemed to scare her, causing Frederica to become uncomfortable and hide her teeth. Then she scolded Ram and mentioned how she no longer had her horn, causing Rem, who remembered everything, to lash out. After the two held her down and Ram bit her horn and made her pass out, Ram passed out, leaving the indignant Frederica to deal with the mess. When Rem woke up again, Frederica was present as Roswaal poked at her emotional scars to drag a response out of the despondent Rem. Rem eventually snapped at him, and afterward, demanded to see her sister. Though both Frederica and Roswaal seemed to be against it, Roswaal had Frederica lead her to Ram's room. Along the way, she explained that Roswaal was not as a bad person despite the way he speaks. After arriving at Ram's room, which was heavily locked and sealed behind a magic circle, Frederica fully unlocked the door, allowing Rem, whose instincts were telling her to run, to see Ram, who was chained to the bed with her power going out of control. Rem then ran away to beg Roswaal to save Ram.

The next day, Rem and Ram were hired as maids, and Frederica and Clind saw to their outfits. While there, they explained that Roswaal exclusively hired demi-humans with nowhere to go and gave them a job and an education without asking for anything in return. When the twins noticed that it was different for them, Frederica claimed to suspect that it was because the girls would have run away otherwise, which they could not refute. Over the following months, she and Clind were responsible for teaching the girls how to work and other education, and they learned about Ram's backlash from the horn getting in the way of her work. One day, two months after hiring them, Roswaal took Ram with him to the Sanctuary, Clind had gone somewhere unspecified, and Frederica was taking some of the other maids to find themselves another place to work, as they had been found to have been ready to do so. After she returned, however, she was furious at Roswaal and Clind for the state Rem was in, having been forced to fight with someone they claimed was an intruder.

Another month later, Roswaal, Frederica, Ram, and Rem visited the Royal Capital, which was celebrating the Tammuz Festival, to buy a gift to celebrate the birth of the child of House Miload. Deciding to split up to search for a gift, Roswaal took Ram with him while Frederica took Rem, and the two decided to meet up again later. As the two looked at the stores, Frederica asked about the kinds of gifts that Rem and Ram would give to each other, setting off Rem to go and buy a gift for Ram now that she had the chance. However, Frederica stopped her, and having been inspired by Rem's answers and responses, they looked through various shops. Eventually, however, Rem's nose caught a whiff of the same scent that came off of Fogg, and she followed it, leading to a bag containing a magical miasma stone. Deciding to reunite with Roswaal and Ram, the former of which had bought gifts for the latter, they discussed the possible plans that the Witch Cult were scheming. Deciding to split again, Roswaal and Ram went to alert the capital's guardsmen while Frederica beastified and took Rem with her to look for the scattered stones, which Ram had predicted the locations of.

After dealing with the stones, the two came across Sado, the man planting them. Having been prepared to escape at a moment's notice, he dodged Rem's morningstar, which she had been training with, and summoned other Witch Cultists to hold them off while he flew away. Although the two were cornered and were nearly forced to retreat, much to Rem's outrage due to knowing that she would never come across the man again, a young Reinhard van Astrea appeared and offered to hold off the remaining Witch Cultists, allowing for Frederica and Rem to chase after Sado. However, as the two approached more heavily populated areas and Sado was off in the distance, the two were forced to stop. However, thanks to her Clairvoyance and Synesthesia, Ram was able to see through Rem's eyes, and using her new wand fashioned from her horn and gifted to her by Roswaal, she used her magic to sever Sado's limbs from afar, effectively defeating him. Rem and Frederica then chased after Sado. Upon meeting him, Rem attempted to question him, but the man merely said that he pitied her and gave his name before he died, giving her no answers and frustrating her. Afterward, Reinhard appeared, having successfully captured all of the Witch Cultists alive, and after deciding to preserve the scene to allow Frederica to revert back and clothe herself, she and Rem left, with the intent to explain things to the guards. As they left, Rem solidified her resolve before mentioning they would have to find a gift for House Miload now.

Following the attack on Miload Manor and the deaths of Dudley and Grace Miload, because most of the staff had either been killed or resigned, Frederica and Clind were sent to take care of the infant Annerose Miload, and they would continue Roswaal's hobby of hiring and educating demi-humans at the Miload Manor.

In The Years That Followed
Two years before Subaru appeared in the world, Frederica, who was still working with House Miload, had been summoned to the manor and asked to deliver a message to the mayor of Arlam Village. There, she met a young and vain Petra, who she asked for directions and was taken by her cuteness. There, she claimed that she would have liked to be Frederica's friend, though unbeknownst to Frederica, she was thinking of her pinafore as reference rather than thinking too much of Frederica. Afterward, she led her to the mayor.

Emily-san's Maid Path
Shortly after leaving Elior Forest, Emilia encounters and helps Annerose and Clind. Due to this intervention and a letter from Roswaal, Emilia is taken to the Miload mansion, where Annerose decides to take her in as a maid. During her introduction, her name is misheard as “Emily,” a nickname by which she becomes known in that environment. At the mansion, Frederica explains that it is a place that shelters discriminated demi-humans, allowing Emilia to remain there. However, Emilia misunderstands the situation as a test imposed by Roswaal to evaluate her effort and character, leading her to take her role as a maid very seriously. Despite her determination, her complete lack of experience with human life and household tasks causes her to fail repeatedly in her duties, and she is regarded as incompetent for the role. Even so, Emilia continues to persevere, convinced that overcoming these difficulties is part of her path toward a greater future.

Frederica and Petra's Maid-san Days
Upon hearing that Ram couldn't handle the mansion by herself following the erasure of Rem's existence, Frederica returned to Roswaal Manor, and she put up posters in Arlam Village that the manor was hiring for new servants. Though hopeful that there would be takers for the position due to the improvement of the villagers' opinions of those in the manor, shortly after Subaru's return and meeting him for the first time, Petra, who had requested the other village girls not to accept the request so that she could work at the manor, was the only one to appear. Though intending to turn her down for her age and the lack of time to train new maids in the basics, she still interviewed Petra's qualifications, receiving responses that made her favorable to Frederica to want to hire her. Warning Petra that her behavior would reflect on Roswaal, Frederica accepted when she was told that Petra would not give up for the person she cared for, and afterward, had Petra refer to her as her big sister. Afterward, Frederica went to speak with Petra's mother about her decision to hire her, and after mentioning her concerns about coming to do so due to the lack of applicants from the village, Frederica was told about Petra's pleading convincing the others not to take the position.

After hiring her, Frederica began instructing her, only to find that Petra was already excellent at completing her tasks. Commenting on how a young Ram could have learned from Petra, the two headed to the village. While there, Frederica shopped for what she could while the half of the villagers were still gone, while Petra spoke with her friends. On their way back to the manor, however, Petra was in a bad mood, having been defending Frederica after they said her mouth was scary. Moved, Frederica urged her to speak with her friends again, who looked like they wanted to apologize.

One night, she and Petra shared a bath, in which Frederica told Petra about Clind and warned her to stay away from him due to his proclivities. Recognizing the complicated emotions in Frederica's voice, Petra asked to stay the night in her room. Later, after leaving food out for Beatrice, she appeared in Frederica's room, where she learned of one of Frederica's old bad habits. After laughing about it, the two went to bed, hoping that by the next morning, the food left for Beatrice would have been gone. The next morning, as she was preparing breakfast, Petra spoke to Frederica, apologizing for her behavior on the day that the two first met. Though Frederica said there was nothing to apologize about since she had almost forgotten, she recalled Petra mentioning wanting to be friends, and now they were. Asking Petra what made her think of apologizing, Petra claimed that something had been bugging her and she had remembered. Believing she believed what caused her to remember, Frederica began to panic, only for Petra to say it was because of something she had said the night before. Afterward, she helped Frederica prepare breakfast.

The Emilia Camp's Great Evaluation Meeting
Following the Sanctuary Incident, Annerose and Clind, who had been tasked with making preparations by Roswaal, arrived at the Sanctuary to board all the villagers on their carriages, intent on leading them out of the snow-covered and heavily damaged forest. Annerose was quick to scold Roswaal for his behavior and approved of his being struck, claiming to Garfiel that she would be his ally should he hassle him again. Moments later, the pair introduced themselves to Subaru and Otto, who had been claimed to be the new internal affairs minister for the Emilia Camp, surprising Subaru with their behavior and titles, and thanks to Clind, Subaru realized that Roswaal had their appearance already prepared. Though Clind claimed that they were a step closer to freeing Roswaal from the "spell" he was under, he teased Subaru when he exclaimed how he thought he said something important. Frederica then appeared and scolded Clind, claiming to Subaru that she knew him and that he was flawed despite his abilities, something which was seemingly proven when Petra said that the villagers had gathered together. Frederica attacked him, though Clind dodged her attacks with ease, and with Otto claiming that he would handle things there, he told Subaru that he should go see Emilia.

Approaching the tomb, where Annerose was talking with Emilia, Beatrice stood by his side, and Subaru warned her not to get too close to Clind. Noticing his state, Ram appeared and claimed that his nature hadn't changed since the last time she met him and that he behaved this way towards her in her youth and even thought that Rem had experienced it. After a warning that Clind did not differentiate between male and female, Annerose approached Subaru and questioned if he was willing to take responsibility for forcing a kiss onto Emilia, though Emilia appeared and defended Subaru by saying it was consensual. Acting like a "rival in love", the two argued, with Annerose even calling Subaru a homewrecker, Beatrice getting angry, and Ram stirring things up. Seeing them all, Emilia touched her crystal where Puck slept and called everyone there precious to her.

Poltergeist Story
Two months after the Sanctuary Incident, Roswaal called for the maids of Roswaal Manor. Intending to begin making allies with other nobles with Emilia for the Royal Selection, he set his sights on first targeting Viscount Torion Aruz, he tasked the girls with cleaning a villa that was once the workshop of his father, Roswaal K. Mathers. Two days later, the girls arrived in the evening, birds attempting to steal their luggage having delayed their arrival. There, they found that the workshop was covered in ivy and vines and was practically falling apart from disuse. As nighttime approached, despite Frederica starting to panic over the workshop's creepy atmosphere, they decided that they would have to stay the night there.

While Ram remained out front for a while, Frederica and Petra went to the back of the workshop, which is in even worse condition than the front. However, after a hole just large enough for the two to slip into, Petra walked inside, followed shortly after by Frederica. Unable to see Petra, she instead saw a doll in the darkness, shortly before the lights came on. Soon after, she reunited with Petra and Ram, afraid of the doll. Despite Ram's insistence that it was Frederica's imagination, Frederica and Petra heard an explosion-like noise in the distance while Ram heard nothing. Wanting to leave, Frederica clung to Ram as they headed for the front door, only to find that it was storming outside, and Petra had to stop Frederica from beastifying and running away.

Deciding they would investigate the strange sounds and dolls, Petra headed upstairs, hoping to catch sight of a hollow. Frederica, still sticking with Ram, tried to follow after her, only to fall through the floor of the stairs. Shortly after, Frederica became a target of harassment for the doll, and before long, she ended up latching onto one in fear, having mistaken it for one of the other two. In a panic, she beastified and ran off, the doll gripping her tail. She eventually smashed it away with her tail on the roof, only to find others that made her fall. Ram, who recognized what they were, ordered the dolls to catch her. Shortly after, Frederica, her clothes destroyed, and Petra were told that the dolls had been magicreation tools that were defending the manor, and they treated Petra and Frederica as intruders, treating them differently because due to their different sizes. First claiming the dolls could help them clean the place up with them, Petra then thought to dress up the dolls and fix their makeup before calling Roswaal to the workshop.

Before long, Roswaal had flown over to the workshop and wondered how long it had been since he'd been there. Meeting up with the maids, he found 111 of those dolls dressed up and fixed. Surprised that they were still, having created more of themselves to continue protecting the place until the master could return, he thanked them, causing them to bow and finally shut down. Afterward, facing the confused Petra, he thanked them for allowing him to right a wrong, upsetting Petra for his attitude. With Roswaal deciding to help them, Frederica told Petra she could work him hard, while Ram had knelt down and gently thanked the dolls for their service.

A little while later, while they were cleaning, Frederica asked what Roswaal was going to do with the dolls since they had broken down, concerned about hollows potentially possessing them, to which Roswaal claimed that he would reuse the dolls, replace the aged parts, and even potentially create a pseudo-gate, something which Frederica is shocked to learn as attempting to do so is the same as attempting to create a new heart. Roswaal treats it as entirely possible, and though Frederica claims that doing so is implausible by comparing him to his father, Roswaal brushes it away by questioning whether she thinks his knowledge is inferior to his father's. Knowing that he is speaking with full knowledge he can do it, she muttered that it was like he was saying he could recreate anything with magic, which he claimed could be done and that magic was something that existed to fulfill one's wishes, saying that achieving one's goal was the most important part of extending one's bloodline, to pass down knowledge and ideals. She mentions that she isn't sure whether he cares or not about his dolls after claiming to want to use them in his experiments, while he replies that doing so could help to relieve the burden on everyone else as the dolls could keep up with maintenance even when everyone is gone. When Frederica doesn't understand the word "maintenance", as it's a loan word from Subaru's home, she questions whether the artificial gates were for the sake of Subaru and Beatrice, as Subaru's gate had been broken. He claims to want to agree and deny her statement, as while it is true, it was his grandmother who had started this research due to her incapacity to use magic, to which Frederica realizes that this is his way of making amends for causing the Sanctuary Incident. Ultimately, she accepts what he says while making sure to warn him to take care of his body, though Roswaal claims that he already has the formulas for the dolls ready in his head and could finish in a couple of days. Afterward, he tells Frederica that if they wanted, he could help Frederica and Garfiel looking into their bloodline if they wanted, but she declines, as her only family were her brother, the Ryuzus, and her mother, and telling him to ask Garfiel directly if he wanted to know. With Frederica taking over for him, she tells Roswaal to go deal with the dolls, while he leaves coming up with the names for them to Frederica and the others.

Golden Siblings
Sometime after Subaru’s knighting ceremony, Frederica and Garfiel, who were on an outing in Costuul, discovered a man named Hayden Garo who could manipulate the city's magicreation tools and reported the incident to Costuul’s mayor. With Hayden causing City Hall’s collapse by sending a giant magicreation tool haywire and kidnapping Frederica after she and her brother rescued everyone from the collapsing building, Garfiel and Clind ventured to retrieve her and put the incident to rest while Subaru, Emilia, and Beatrice took care of the haywire Lightbugs in Costuul. Frederica's kidnapper, Hayden, intended to make Frederica into the queen of a new nation where demi-humans were dominant and humans were exterminated by unlocking the secrets of rare blood, which he and the kidnapped maid both possessed. Present with him was one of his subordinates, a researcher of rare blood, Leonardo Baroness. The duo of Garfiel and Clind found Hayden and Leonardo's hideout due to Frederica leaving a trail of blood behind. Clind took care of rescuing Frederica, fending off Leonardo when he absorbed his vials of rare blood and transformed into a liquid blood monster. Garfiel successfully defeated Hayden, however, he managed to escape before being captured. He briefly met with Frederica before his escaping, swearing to her that they would meet again, and he allowed her to deal him a scar as remembrance of their encounter.

Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle
After the decision to visit the Watergate City of Priestella was made, Frederica entered the room Otto was working in. Frederica apologized to Otto for Petra's discourteous manner earlier in the day. Otto tried to pass it off as nothing, but Frederica rebutted, saying that it would not be good for the girl's growth. She then continued to speak to Otto, mentioning that she was worried about Garfiel, as he wouldn't be in arm's reach to her where he was going. She was worried that her brother's behavior would cause problems to Emilia, and she politely asked Otto if he could look after everyone, especially Garfiel. Otto pledged that he would do his best and then asked if Frederica would be worried about Otto himself too, to which Frederica showed nothing but confusion.

Petra’s Emilia Camp Struggle
Occurring simultaneously with the Battle for Priestella, Petra took part in the meeting with the western nobles alongside Roswaal, Annerose, Petra, and Clind. There, she witnessed as Roswaal attempted to convince the other nobles into backing Emilia of their own accord. Shortly after the meeting began, Roswaal had Petra speak on his behalf regarding Emilia, much to Frederica’s annoyance, as if he were to do so, it may sound insincere or manipulative. Though reluctant to let her do so, Frederica relented, and Petra did as she was asked and gave her opinion and facts on Emilia, successfully managing to convince the other nobles to back her. Later, they returned to Roswaal Manor.

Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose!
After returning to Roswaal Manor, after Beatrice, who had gone to sleep over with Petra, awoke and left to get a drink for her parched throat, she came across Frederica. The two decided to have tea together, and Frederica claimed she could imagine just how much danger Subaru and Emilia must have been in in Priestella based on the injuries sustained by Garfiel and Otto, further claiming their next hardships based on their next destination. Frederica then asked to look out for them and herself with a gaze that reminded Beatrice of Ryuzu.

Stand by me Pleiades and Missing Child Search
Following the disappearance of Subaru and Rem from the Pleiades Watchtower, the camp members came to retrieve Garfiel and Otto from Priestella with Clind’s assistance. Soon after, the group found themselves in Picoutatte, which they needed to pass through to reach Vollachia. With Otto making peace with Diadora Regundra, they made their way through the Everlasting Darkness with the guidance of the mole humans. However, their travels were interrupted due to Musica wishing to meet with Emilia. After negotiating Petra Leyte, the group was allowed to continue, and they entered Vollachia.

Yae Tenzen's Crimson Sakura State of Affairs
Following the reveal of Priscilla's will, Yae Tenzen met with Frederica in the hallway of the Barielle Estate, and she asked the maid to be friends and brought her to have tea in her room. As they spoke, Yae got the sense that she could have genuinely become friends with Frederica if she hadn't had ulterior motives. After Frederica mentioned that she saw the members of the Emilia Camp like family, something that was foreign to Yae, she asked Yae if her relationship with Schult was anything like that, to which Yae wasn't certain how to define their relationship. As they spoke, Frederica mentioned that she was nervous about being invited by Yae and felt on guard, so to be friends with her, she proposed talking about less intrusive topics. Doing so led Frederica to point out Yae's use of loan words, which she had picked up from Al, though Yae decided to keep it a secret who she learned those words from. Realizing that she was having fun, Yae continued to talk with Frederica.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
While Frederica is a strong combatant and has been capable of combat from a relatively young age, the full extent of her power is currently unexplored. This being said, she struggles to contend with people on the level of Elsa Granhiert.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
Frederica is an adept melee combatant. However, her physical strength pales in comparison with other warriors. The full extent of her physical abilities is unknown.

Improved Senses: Due to having feline-type beast person blood, Frederica's senses are naturally greater than a typical human's.
Heightened Olfaction: Frederica has a heightened sense of smell. With just a sniff, she can determine if plants or fruits in a forest are poisonous.
Night Vision: If she focuses, Frederica is able to easily see in the dark.

thumb|right|250px|Frederica's full beast transformation.
Beastification (獣化, Kemonoka): Thanks to her quarter demi-human lineage from her father's side, Frederica can either fully or partially transform into a large leopard with golden fur and larger and sharper teeth. While she is in this form, she can run at incredible speeds, easily able to traverse through long distances in quick time or overtop the rooftops of the Royal Capital without being spotted, and her eyesight is also given a boost. While in this state, she is easily capable of crushing her enemies' heads with her paws. She is also able to partially beastify, typically doing so with her arms in combat, which can allow her to stop the strikes of even the Bowel Hunter momentarily.

Rare Blood: Frederica's blood is of a rare kind, and according to Clind, there can be dangers associated with it. In fact, Al went out of his way to separate Frederica from Subaru’s group in Arc 9 precisely because of her rare blood, implying that it would provide an obstacle and was dangerous, while Hayden Garo implied that those with this rare blood are special.

Magic
Frederica has an affinity for the wind attribute, but never developed her magic side, preferring melee combat.

Equipment
Glintstone (輝石): When Frederica was younger, she and her brother Garfiel each received a glintstone from their mother, Reshia Tinzel.
Cestus Weapon: In the web novel, Frederica used a pair of gauntlet-like weapons that allowed her to fight in hand-to-hand combat. This was cut from the light novel and replaced by her beastification.

intro: Garfiel Tinzel (ガーフィール・ティンゼル) is Frederica Baumann's younger half-brother, the former guardian of the Sanctuary, and the current military officer of the Emilia Camp. Introduced as a secondary antagonist during the first half of Arc 4, he later became one of the main supporting characters of Re:Zero, with major roles in the second half of Arc 4, Arc 5, Arc 7, Arc 8, Arc 9, and Arc 10.
appearance:
Garfiel is a young and relatively short boy with short gold hair and deep and sharp emerald-colored eyes. He originally kept his hair spiky and long but began to have a significantly neater haircut after the events of Arc 4. Due to his demi-human blood, he has sharp feline like fangs, similar to Frederica's. In fact, both Frederica and Garfiel share a similar face with perhaps the main difference being the large white scar stretching across the entirety of Garfiel's forehead, which he inflicted upon himself when, after experiencing the First Trial and seeing his mother's "death", he fell into a state of panic and repeatedly bashed his head against the walls of the Tomb, leaving him with a permanent X-shaped white scar.

Due to his vigorous training and his demi-human blood, Garfiel is extremely strong and possesses a rather well built and muscular physique. He can usually be seen wearing long black pants and a torn-up loincloth that is heliotrope-purple on the outside and red-violet on the inside and a short black vest with fuchsia accents. To match his color palette, Garfiel can also be seen wearing black long-sleeved gloves with fuchsia in them. A blue glintstone can also be seen dangling around his neck.
personality:
Garfiel is an extremely protective and diligent young man with some chuunibyou tendencies, such as often being impressed with Subaru's naming sense. He's even shown to be rather protective of women and children, as pointed out by Meili Portroute, and he has a sense for a person's romance, which is part of the reason that, despite not seeing eye to eye with Subaru at the time, he did not interrupt his conversation with Emilia in Arc 4. With the exceptions of people like Roswaal L. Mathers and Olbart Dunkelkenn, Garfiel is not good at hating people. For the people he does hate, however, he does not let such hatred cloud his judgement, and he will work with those people if necessary. He cares for his allies, friends, and family, and he will become extremely hostile when those people are threatened. It is precisely because of this that, in his youth, he trained using the regimen detailed in a book detailing Reid Astrea's exercises, and he even went out of his way to learn healing magic in order to heal everyone around him. Because of his strong sense of duty, responsibility, and the need to protect those around him, Garfiel has set his sights and being among the strongest people around, as he does not want to lose anyone. However, he has a tendency to beat himself up over failing to live up to expectations he was given, and in these times, he feels powerless and becomes somewhat self-deprecating, which in turn results in him becoming depressed. Despite this, he usually finds a way to overcome those internal conflicts, usually becoming all the stronger and fiercer for it.

Garfiel has shown to have a crush on Ram, and that is part of his motivation for becoming stronger, often doing what he can to look good in front of her, usually to no avail. Regardless, because of this and the circumstances of his environment when he was younger, he read many stories, leading him to garnering a habit of speaking in idioms from these stories. Though initially, he started speaking with them to impress Ram, those idioms became one of Garfiel's signifying traits, and he can regularly be heard making comparisons to real life via these idioms. Likewise, these stories also ignited his great degree of respect for warriors, something he displayed in his confrontations with both Kurgan and Kafma Irulux. Because of this, he can’t stand when others mock these warriors for a loss, as seen when he defended Kafma from Olbart’s mocking and stood to protect him. Similarly, he greatly respects Dragons. In Arc 7, he expressed his disappointment at not being able to meet with the Dragons that Emilia had, but later, when he got to meet (as enemies) the Cloud Dragon Mezoreia, he immediately recognized its strength and was even honored to do battle with it. This respect was even greater for the Divine Dragon Volcanica, who he immediately recognized as beyond even the Cloud Dragon.

In his youth, Garfiel had a complex over his mother. Though he initially believed that she had abandoned him and his sister, he wanted to believe that she did so so that she could have a better life, something which led to Garfiel becoming protective and looking down on himself, and as a way to remember his mother, he started using her surname Tinzel, unlike Frederica. After witnessing her supposed death in the first trial of the Sanctuary, Garfiel was in denial, and in his distraught and panicked state, he permanently scarred his head. Following this, he considered himself the shield of the Sanctuary, and in order to protect the Sanctuary's residents, he did not want the barrier to be taken down out of his need to protect everyone, coming to believe that the outside world was a harsh and dangerous place.

During the events of Arc 4, Garfiel was forced to confront this side of himself after his confrontation with Subaru and the other members of the Emilia Camp. Despite his rage, trauma, and refusal to allow the destruction of the Sanctuary's barrier, after his defeat, he was convinced to face his past through the first trial again, in which he finally overcame his trauma. Following this, he began calling Subaru his Captain and began teasing him, seeing him, and Otto Suwen before him, a warrior worthy of respect, and he showed willingness to fight alongside him and the rest of the camp. Despite still maintaining a slightly aggressive side to him, he started becoming friendly with everyone in the camp, teasing Subaru and Otto and treating them like brothers, and following Emilia, wanting to help her bring about the Kingdom that she envisions. He even came to rely on Subaru quite a lot, as when Mimi Pearlbaton was injured and he was unable to heal her, his first thought was to find Subaru, as he believed he might be able to do something that he couldn't. And because of how Subaru saved him in the Sanctuary, Garfiel was inspired to do the same for others in a similar manner if he saw that they were suffering. For example, when he could see the anger, sadness, and suffering of Madelyn Eschart through Mezoreia, he resolved to defeat her so that he could speak to her and save her heart.

That said, following his fight with Elsa Granhiert at the end of Arc 4, Garfiel was left somewhat traumatized by the weight of his first kill, and he was temporarily haunted by a black phantom of the Bowel Hunter, who appeared at the edge of his vision every time Garfiel's psyche dropped significantly. Furthermore, following his encounter with the world's strongest person, Reinhard van Astrea, and humiliatingly being forced to flee from the inn before he could even exchange words with the Sword Saint, Garfiel could observe Elsa's phantom looking at him from around every corner, keeping her distance and smiling at him. Despite the eeriness of the situation, the phantom was not real, as Garfiel stated he couldn't smell her scent, and the narration later explained how Elsa's phantom was simply a manifestation of Garfiel's weakness and regrets. Fortunately, thanks to reuniting with his amnesiac mother and meeting his younger brother and sister, some words from Mimi, feeling the effects of Subaru's speech, and witnessing how many people were cheering for him to win during his fight with the undead Eight Arms, Garfiel managed to overcome this, and in doing so, it allowed him to grow to greater heights and become braver.
history:
Early Life
Garfiel was born around fourteen years prior to the start of the story to a father who was a half-beast human and a human mother, therefore, being brought to this world as a Quarter-Beast Human. Eventually, after wandering about, he and Frederica, along with their mother Reala (Reshia), were picked up by Roswaal and given a home in the Sanctuary. Reshia had left her children in Sanctuary to bring back her missing husband. Garfiel and Frederica lived together until she left when he was around 4 years old and he hadn't seen her since. Growing up with the Ryuzu clones who took care of him like their grandchild, he came to love the people of the Sanctuary. However, after seeing his mother's "death" during the first trial when he was young, he began to fear the outside world, causing him to try and protect the Sanctuary. At some point, his sister eventually left the Sanctuary as well to find a home for their people for when they brought down the barrier, leaving Garfiel to live with the Ryuzus.

Garfiel and Ram's Really Really Complicated and Twisted Love Affair ZERO
Shortly after her first visit to the Sanctuary with Roswaal, Ram met Garfiel, who was immediately infatuated and attempted to propose to her twice. However, she rejected him both times, and he continued to have a crush on her. During one of her later visits to the Sanctuary, Garfiel asked why she was working with Roswaal when he didn't really need her assistance. Although she initially joked that her sister Rem was held hostage, she told him that it was more like she had become Rem's shackle. Seeing her sad, Garfiel decided to start studying and reading to help get rid of what made Ram sad. One night, having found an appa, he intended to give it to Ram, but he found Roswaal giving Ram mana. Not understanding what was happening, he unconsciously beastified for the first time and attacked Roswaal but was handily knocked out. When he later awoke to see Ram, she told him what happened and said he needed to get control of it before explaining her circumstances about her severed horn. From then, Garfiel decided to become strong, and afterward, he asked her to marry him many times.

Garfiel and Ram's Complicated Love Affair
A short time after Roswaal brought Emilia to Roswaal Manor, Roswaal and Ram visited the Sanctuary. Garfiel, finding the talk between Roswaal and Ryuzu boring, left the conversation to talk to Ram. After a short conversation about Garfiel's willingness to continue chasing after Ram, despite her love being for Roswaal, he asked for an explanation for their unusual visit, to which Ram told him about Emilia being brought to the manor and the potential involvement of the Sanctuary. Ram gave her impression of Emilia as lacking in every manner, though she didn't give a final conclusion since she hadn't been given the chance to learn anything, and Garfiel realized that Roswaal intended to back her in the Royal Selection for his own schemes, which angered Garfiel and made him question if he'd gone mad. Before he could transform, Ram calmed him down, and soon after Roswaal appeared, saying they wouldn't be staying for long.

Garfiel and Ram's Really Complicated Love Affair
One day later on, intending to let her see the "White Snow Sakura", Ram brought Rem to the Sanctuary. After Rem went to speak to Ryuzu, Ram spoke with Garfiel about why she was there without Roswaal. When Rem returned, she sent Garfiel flying away and started talking with Ram. After Garfiel quickly recovered, he and Rem started to argue, and the sisters playfully complained about Garfiel finding out about what they were there for. Ram worried about how Rem rarely got to act herself, though their worry made her dismiss the thought. Eventually, the arrived at their destination, and the twins were mesmerized by the sight of the trees covered in white flowers. They eventually sat down to eat, and after a moment, Garfiel passed out of Ram's shoulder. After learning from Rem that Rem and Garfiel had actually worked together to bring Ram here, she moved his head to her lap and ran her hand through his hair in gratitude. After a few moments, however, she moved Garfiel so that the jealous Rem could lay her head on her lap instead.

Garfiel and Ram's Really Really Complicated and Twisted Love Affair
Later on, in response to the upcoming Subjugation of Sloth, half of the Arlam Villagers were escorted by Ram to the Sanctuary, where Garfiel was waiting and questioned her. After being told about the evacuation, he told the villagers to behave themselves while they were there before leaving to inform the other residents of the Sanctuary. Although the villagers were given a place to stay in, Garfiel made it known that they were not welcome. However, at seeing the villagers slowly unpacking the carriages while gloomy, Garfiel eventually decided to help them. After teasing Garfiel about it, Ram spoke with Milde Arlam and said she would be tending to Roswaal, leaving them to choose their own rooms. From then on, Garfiel continued to "harass" the villagers before helping on his own. When he was done, Milde thanked him for his help, though Garfiel claimed it wasn't for the villagers but that it was bad for his heart if he didn't help, to which Milde replied her gratitude was in kind. Because he couldn't accept the gratitude so easily, Ram proceeded to reward him.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Garfiel is an incredibly powerful warrior whose potential for growth is abnormally high. Due to his wild combat style, Garfiel is frequently seen avoiding certain death in the most unexpected ways possible. His training matched with his power makes him a combative prodigy who, by his early teens, was capable of dueling legendary fighters such as the Bowel Hunter Elsa Granhiert, Eight-Arms Kurgan, Kafma Irulux, and even the Cloud Dragon. His skill is further improved with guidance from Roswaal L. Mathers, causing someone as dangerous as Olbart Dunkelkenn to take him seriously, and by the events of Arc 10, though he was previously unable to do a thing to Reinhard just a few months prior, his growth since then has skyrocketed to the point that the shockwaves of his attacks and his improved strength, techniques, and style can reach and even shock the Sword Saint.

Divine Protection

Divine Protection of the Earth Spirits (地霊の加護, Chirei no Kago): Garfiel's Divine Protection allows him to use the power of the earth that he stands on to manipulate it, strengthen himself, reduce the effects of Earth Magic, notice disturbances in the earth that even a veteran mage of Roswaal's caliber is unable to detect, and even to heal himself. As long as he has his feet on the ground, Garfiel can freely use this Divine Protection. It should also be noted that Garfiel’s view of the ground is anywhere he can plant his feet, and as such, his Divine Protection will work while standing on said “ground”. Due to the Divine Protection giving an intense physical burden, most of its users would be forced to take a break from using it by removing their legs from the ground. However, due to his physique as a demi-human, Garfiel does not feel the backlash, and he can use it continuously. However, according to Clind, the effect of this Divine Protection is reduced in areas such as the miasma-laden Augria Sand Dunes.
Earth Manipulation: So long as his feet touch the ground, Garfiel is capable of freely manipulating the earth beneath him at will, whether that be to create a shield of earth to protect himself from both attacks and magic, to redirect and divert wide-ranging attacks, or to create explosions that force debris to fly towards his enemy. This being said, it is possible to disrupt the energy generated by the earth, and if that happens, because there is no longer any specific place for the energy to emerge, it can cause extreme widespread damage to the surrounding area.
Increased Recovery Rate: By absorbing power from the ground, Garfiel is able to accelerate the recovery of wounds and stamina. He often combines this with his healing magic to keep himself standing during battle, and though this would ordinarily reduce his life span, thanks to his battle in Priestella, he has overcome this.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
In addition to his natural strength, Garfiel is able to hone his skills in melee combat over the years despite his isolated upbringing. It was revealed that the secret behind Garfiel's strength is an old book about Reid Astrea. In that book, an unknown person described Reid's training in detail. Garfiel took the training regime to heart and spent his entire childhood training like Reid. Interestingly enough, the training primarily consists of hand-to-hand combat, without any weapons whatsoever. He spent years replicating the training that Reid Astrea put himself through, honing himself into a skilled unarmed combatant whose savage fighting style revolves primarily around instinct and is therefore difficult to analyze. He also made use of the enhanced physiology provided by his blood to his advantage in battle, performing feats that his opponents wouldn't think possible. He frequently partially-transforms into a tiger to deliver heavy hits so as catch people off guard, and he is even able to transmit the impact of his strikes throughout the entire body of his enemies when necessary.

Enhanced Strength: Garfiel is extremely strong. In his normal human form, the physical power displayed by Garfiel far exceeds that of an ordinary person. Not only was he unscathed by a bite received from an earth dragon, but he was able to effortlessly perform a suplex on said dragon despite its frame being comparable to a horse's. He's fully capable of stopping a Rock Pig's destructive attack and even lift it up, despite it weighing multiple tons, punch down fully grown trees without much effort, and even rip entire buildings out of the ground and toss them like cannonballs, and do so continuously without much effort. While duking it out with Kafma Irulux, he his blows were described as being strong enough that it would be no surprise if his opponent had died from them. By the time of Arc 8, he is even capable of causing significant damage to a Dragon as powerful as Mezoreia, his fists being compared to a cannonball and the aftershock resounding like a warehouse filled magic stones exploding, and even toss it backwards by the end of its tail, as well as fully redirect a blast from said Dragon's breath.

Enhanced Durability: Garfiel is incredibly physically tough, a fact that is often combined with the healing aspect of his Divine Protection. He has taken beatings from incredibly powerful fighters such as the Bowel Hunter, the Eight Arms, the Fighting Insect General, the Vicious Old Man, and even the Cloud Dragon, and he has managed to not only stay alive, but he even healed and fought back despite the pain, and he is even capable of withstanding the pain of biting out a part of his body that was poisoned, scraping against his own bones in the process, to let it regenerate. He has shown to be able to survive being thrust off of the tall ramparts of Vollachia's Imperial Capital while being simultaneously internally torn apart, igniting himself with fire magic stones during his bout with Kafma, gutting himself to free his insides from being torn apart and bursting from thorns, being crushed between the mighty hands of a Dragon, not only survive but also push through a direct strike from the Cloud Dragon's breath, and survive an indirect blast from the Divine Dragon's Dragon breath.

Enhanced Speed: He can also move at speeds greater than an average human, outmaneuvering most foes and easily jumping over trees and multi-story buildings. His speed is such that ordinary people would struggle to perceive him during combat.

Enhanced Olfaction: The potency of his sense of smell is also far greater than a regular human's. He can distinguish the scents of separate individuals from a considerable distance.

Beastification (獣化, Kemonoka): Garfiel can transform himself into a towering, 4-meter-long golden tiger with massive and thick limbs, as well as razor-sharp fangs and claws, which can easily rip a man or even a fully grown earth dragon in two with a single swipe. Naturally, Garfiel's physical strength in his tiger form increases exponentially, although his speed suffers a reduction due to his size increase. When in this form, he can easily deal devastating attacks and decimate entire areas, but with a cost of losing his reason, making him avoid it if possible. He uses this ability when he is pushed to the limit or facing an overwhelming foe, as seen in Arc 5 when he fought the War God. Garfiel is also capable of partial transformation, and he has shown a habit of often transforming only his arms to increase his strength or catch his enemies off guard.

Magic
Garfiel is proficient in the use of water magic, though he doesn't use it for combat purposes. It is unknown what attribute he has an affinity for.

Spells:
thumb|right|250px|Garfiel using healing magic on Ram.
Healing Magic (治癒魔法, Chiyu Mahō): Garfiel summons water mana to heal the wounds of himself and others. Garfiel is quite experienced with healing magic, having been given many chances since joining the Emilia Camp to use it, and his contributions with this magic allowed him to save numerous lives alongside the Blue, Ferris, during following the events in Priestella. He often combines his healing magic with his Divine Protection as well, and combined with its rapid recovery rate, he is capable of quickly healing any wounds inflicted on his own body. Although doing so would ordinarily strain his body and risk him reducing his life span, thanks to his battle in Priestella, he was able to overcome this. When he heals in this way, steam is emitted from his wounds.

Other
Keen Instincts: Garfiel has great instincts that can allow him to make optimal decisions mid-combat or during a crisis. During the Battle for Priestella, when Mimi was injured, his first instinct was to find his way to Subaru, which in turn led him to Ferris. Likewise, during the battle against Kafma, he was able to avoid a devastating blast from one of his attacks, and later, he even decided to burn insects inside his body, albeit in an absurd way, that would have otherwise been lethal.

Apostle of Greed (強欲の使徒): Garfiel, after attempting the Trial of the Sanctuary, acquired the mark of the Witch of Greed Echidna, which indicates him as an Apostle of Greed. Because of this title, Garfiel has the ability to command the many clones of Ryuzu Meyer created by Echidna, essentially affording him with a small army should the need arise. The clones follow his orders unquestionably, as they are compelled to do so.

Equipment

Twin Shields: Garfiel uses two shields in combat. He's very skilled with them, using them for both offense and defense as they're sturdy enough to withstand devastating blows that would usually shatter his bones or cut off his arms, as well as deliver bone-shattering punches capable of subduing his opponents.
Glintstone (輝石): When Garfiel was younger, he and his sister Frederica each received a glintstone from their mother, Reshia Tinzel.
Fire Magic Stones: During his bout with Kafma, Garfiel used fire magic stones meant for a magic stone cannon to ignite the insects that were infecting him as well as set his body ablaze.

intro: Fourier Lugunica (フーリエ・ルグニカ) was the Fourth Prince of the Kingdom of Lugunica and the childhood friend of Crusch Karsten and Ferris. Though his only mention in the main story was in Volume 7, Fourier was one of the main protagonists in The Dream the Lion King Saw.
appearance:
As a member of the Lugunican Royal Family, Fourier was characterized by his shining golden hair and large crimson red eyes that burned like the twilight sun. His extraordinarily handsome face would've captured the hearts of many women if not for his outgoing personality. He had a yaeba that became prominent when he laughed. Fourier strongly resembled Felt in terms of general looks, like all other members of the Royal Family.

When Fourier grew ill, his physical state greatly deteriorated. His beautiful golden hair lost its shining luster, the burning light of his scarlet red eyes faded significantly, and his usually charming smiles lost their energy. His body completely lost its modest musculature, leaving the prince with an emaciated body and protruding cheekbones.
personality:
Fourier was an energetic and magnanimous young man who appeared more self-assured and assertive than he actually was. That being said, he had a gentle caring heart and a very strong sense of responsibility that earned him the faith and trust of Crusch and Ferris. He had an excessively cheerful personality, and despite his position as a prince, he had even snuck out of the castle numerous times to mingle with the common people. Moreover, he had the potential to be the current generation's "Lion King" due to his unusually sharp intuition that sometimes manifested which made him seem wise beyond his years. This trait of his only grew stronger as he matured over the years. Likewise, despite the rumor of the royal family being more like figureheads than actual rulers, Fourier acted as a true leader at times, making people such as Julius Juukulius believe that the rumors were not entirely true. He also made for an excellent leader, combining his unique intuition and his position to maneuver people around during a crisis, such as during the Raid of Argyle Manor.

Fourier had a dislike of both hot and cold weather, although he found cold weather far more unbearable. Even on a sunny day, Fourier always had a thick fur coat prepared in case the weather turned cold. He could be incredibly prideful and often spoke highly of himself, although the arrogance he exuded was considered endearing instead of condescending by those around him. Whenever he did a good thing unintentionally, he would always act as though he had meant to do so.

Another one of the prince’s charming features was his unconquerable optimism. Regardless of the situation he was in, Fourier almost always maintained a positive outlook. In an extreme case, the withering prince found joy in the peaceful state of the castle gardens, not taking heed of the fact that the reason it was practically deserted was because of the ongoing illness that had already claimed the lives of many of his relatives.

As a member of the royal family, Fourier was carefully nurtured from birth. He was forced to attend classes relating to the history and politics of the Kingdom. Fourier hated these classes, as he found them unbearably boring. Nevertheless, he learned many things from his tutors.

Shortly before the Subjugation of the White Whale, Ferris noted that Natsuki Subaru reminded him of Fourier, as their personalities were remarkably similar.
history:
The Dream the Lion King Saw
From birth, Fourier Lugunica had excellent intuition. Whether it be in arithmetic, history, or board games, the prince displayed paranormal talent at a young age. In an extreme case from his childhood, he once had successfully predicted that a wheel would fall off of his father’s carriage, and, almost as if he were an oracle, the event came to transpire. Even as a boy, Fourier understood that there was something special about how things came to pass around him, and he began to trust in his instincts to guide his actions. As a young boy, Fourier had little patience for his royal duties. He would often do everything he could to avoid studying, causing quite the hassle for those who tutored him. The prince had hated relying on other people to solve his own problems and would never ask them to do so. That being said, he would graciously accept the favor of a person if they showered him with it of their own accord. Sometimes, he would even sneak out of the castle and mingle with the common people, something which would often cause trouble to the people around him; he had even gone to a soup kitchen hosted by the Divine Dragon Church at one point, something that nearly caused friction between the church and castle.

Although they would not properly meet until a little later, when they were both children, Fourier first beheld Crusch in the Royal Castle's courtyard gardens when he found her staring at budding blossoms. He had been so transfixed by that moment in time, he had fallen for her at first sight but would be too embarrassed to approach her. In the later weeks since then, he would sneak out in disguise to the same spot hoping to catch glimpse of her without Crusch being aware. However, one day during his excisions he would accidentally fall into the garden alerting her of his presence for the first time. Thinking he was an assailant after the Royal Family, Crusch would pull a dagger out on him with intent to attack. After frantically clearing the misunderstanding and stopping Crusch for trying to take her own life out of shame of pointing her weapon against a member of the Royal Family, they would become good friends. It was here that Fourier would exchange an important promise with her that would influence Crusch's worldview. As Crusch revealed her thoughts regarding Lugunica's stagnation due to the Dragon's blessing, and lamented being unable to choose a life befitting of her family crest, the fang-bearing lion, because she was a woman, Fourier told her that she ought to never concede herself. Several days later, Fourier asserted that the two of them would resurrect the bond between the Lion King and his loyal retainer, which Crusch and soon Fourier laughed over. 

A year later Fourier would also meet and befriend Ferris and together the three of them – Fourier, Crusch and Ferris – would go through the trials and tribulations of navigating high society over the years of their teenage-to-adult lives. From dealing with his arranged marriage to Tiriena, to supporting Crusch as she dealt with the conflicts of her womanhood and becoming the noble expected of her, to being Ferris' stalwart ally as he confronted elements of his dark past that still had lingering effects on his present. These experiences would reaffirm their eternal friendship to each other.

It would be Fourier who recommended Ferris for knighthood and get him into the Royal Guard to better serve Crusch who was now coming onto her own as the head of one of the most prominent noble houses of the country. It would show his keen understanding of how important it would be both their futures and the one he wanted. At age 20 he played an important role in the Raid of House Argyle doing work behind scenes such as secretly keeping Reinhard on standby to clean up the loose ends, where the maturity of his leadership skills and forethought would be displayed, which would serve to protect Ferris's place in House Karsten. However, it would be from that point on where tragedy would strike–he fell ill to the mysterious diseases that had been affecting the Royal Family of late.

In spite of this, Fourier's condition would gain little national attention due to the commonality of the occurrence among the Royal Family. An entire month later, he would still show no signs of improving despite the efforts of Ferris Argyle and best healers from the Royal Treatment Center. Despite this, Fourier would surprisingly show signs of vitality, but it would merely be a front he kept on from adding to Crusch's worries, who was facing increasing pressure in her political life, as her duties mounted from crisis of the absence of Royal Family. During one of her visits, Fourier would ask Crusch to take him outside. They would go to the Royal Gardens where they first met, then sit on the bench and Fourier would talk about his dreams for the future and the promise he made to her there. He would then finally admit his feelings for her and pass away peacefully in her lap. Fourier's death was payed little to no mind, as the news of his passing came at the same time as the news of the last King Randohal Lugunica's passing, which resulted in everyone for the most part dismissing the Fourth Prince's death.
abilities_text:
Gifted Mind: Fourier was born with naturally excellent intuition in the form of a gut feeling that led Miklotov McMahon to believe he could become a wise ruler like the Lion Kings of old. The wisdom and intelligence demonstrated by the young prince were both well beyond his years. As noted by those close to him, the statements he made, no matter how outlandish they seemed, usually came true. In this regard, Fourier was excellent at predicting future events, almost as if he were an oracle. Under his direction, the incident involving the House of Argyle became a complete military success. Furthermore, as a member of the royal family, Fourier received the very best education the Kingdom had to offer, affording him with impressive academic capabilities, and he was a gifted leader as well, taking advantage of his unique intuition and directing people as needed during crises.

Skilled Swordsman: As a child, Fourier made a promise with Crusch Karsten that she would never wear feminine clothing until he could defeat her in a duel. The young prince regretted the promise greatly, as he could never defeat his beloved, leading him to believe he was the reason she could never express her femininity. As such, Fourier trained diligently to surpass Crusch in terms of swordsmanship. His efforts provided him with skills that far surpassed a majority of nobles. While his skill never surpassed Crusch's, he was able to fight on par with her several times, a fact he felt pride over. He is much stronger than an average knight.

intro: Emerada Lugunica (エメラダ・ルグニカ) was a princess hailing from the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica's Royal Family. She lived before the events of the Demi-Human War and had died at a very young age due to a mysterious illness. Though she has yet to make an appearance in the main story or any side stories, Emerada has been briefly mentioned by Wilhelm van Astrea and indirectly mentioned by Miklotov McMahon at the very start of The Dream the Lion King Saw.
appearance: Emerada is mentioned to have been exceptionally beautiful. Like the rest of the Royal Family, she had gold hair and red eyes. Besides these two facts, however, nothing else is known about Emerada's appearance.
personality: Emerada Lugunica was described as being very wise and capable. Despite that, however, Emerada was said to be extremely cruel, and was considered to be a nonconformist within the Royal Family as she had an immeasurable darkness toward others. According to Miklotov McMahon, she apparently had the qualities necessary to be a Lion King.
history: Emerada lived before the Demi-Human War, more than fifty years before the start of the main story. At an unspecified point in time, she died at a young age due to a disease, and the news of her death was hidden for a while. As the national sentiment was against it, she wasn't given a state funeral, with a surface reason claiming that it wasn't possible under their current circumstances.

intro: Gionis Lugunica (ジオニス・ルグニカ) was the 40th King of Lugunica. He was succeeded by Randohal Lugunica. He played a supporting role in the Sword Demon Trilogy.
appearance: Gionis had glistering red eyes and moderately short gold hair. He was described to have a cheerful look to his face and a relaxed demeanor.
personality: Gionis was a generous and compassionate figure who was beloved by his people. This could be best seen in the handling of Wilhelm's transgression in the end of Sword Saint Ceremony by overlooking them because he was highly moved by the affection he had seen. He was known to not have much of a mind for military affairs, but he was nonetheless a decisive person who did not shy from action to safeguard his Kingdom.
history:
Sword Demon Trilogy
Gionis ruled the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica during the Demi-Human War, commanding the Royal Army who was trying to suppress the Demi-Human uprising, though it's not stated what exactly he did during those days. In the year following the end of the War, Gionis continued to rule the now-united nation. Shortly after the end of the conflict, he hosted a ceremony to award Theresia van Astrea in return for all she had done for the Kingdom in the last two years of the war. After Wilhelm fought and defeated her and took her reason to wield the sword away from her, when Gionis asked Theresia what she wanted for her award, it was to free Wilhelm, who had been arrested for his actions, which Gionis accepted. Afterward, he spoke with Theresia and told her that if she were to wed Wilhelm, he would allow her to retire from the military, something which a young Miklotov McMahon was aware of. In the following days, Wilhelm visited and made a deal with him, that if he could defeat the country's best fighters that Theresia would be allowed to retire, which Gionis accepted. Ultimately, he watched over the battle, which Wilhelm won. However, when Theresia appeared, she scolded him for allowing this, as Wilhelm was unaware of their deal. Afterward, the two were engaged, and three months later, Gionis was secretly present for their wedding.

During the months of Stride Vollachia's devastating rampages across the entire Kingdom, Gionis desperately tried to put an end to the seemingly endless damage caused by him. It was only after Stride had unleashed Valgren onto one of the Five Great Cities of the Kingdom, Picoutatte, in hopes of toppling the entire nation, that Gionis was finally able to make contact with the Divine Dragon itself, summoning it to the devastated city and ending the nightmare once and for all.

intro: Garitch Fabless (ガリッチ・ファブレス) was Ferris's teacher and the healer that previously held the title of Blue. He played a small but important role in Sword Demon Love Story.
appearance: Garitch Fabless was a wizened white haired old man. From the appearance of his blood-colored, poor skin, and his sunken cheeks, he was sometimes referred to his other alias. He was lanky and wore a white garment. Though he had a tendency to narrow his eyes in displeasure due to his nervousness, he had a weak spot in his fondness for frozen desserts.
history:
Sword Demon Love Story
Garitch was a doctor who worked in Picoutatte during the events of the Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte. He treated Veltol Astrea and with his skill with healing magic he was able to confine the curse to Veltol's arm. Following this display of proficiency, Garitch was recommended for a position in the Royal Capital.

Sword Demon Love Story: The Other Side of the Honeymoon
Following the Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte, Theresia van Astrea and Carol Remendis wandered the streets of Picoutatte while Wilhelm van Astrea and Veltol Astrea were recovering from their injuries. As they walked, they came across Garitch and spoke with him. Theresia apologized to him for having destroyed the bridge and creating more work for him, but he waved it off. Still worried about it, Carol tried to pin the blame on the one responsible for the challenge while Garitch said that Veltol could pay for the damages and treatment and nobody would be upset. However, he also asked her if she could get Veltol to reconsider his recommendation of Garitch to the Royal Capital, as he did not want to go to the capital since the mother of his son was there. Though he believed that it would probably be for the best that he didn't go, Theresia claimed that happiness was up to the individual to choose, which ultimately cemented that Garitch did not want to go, saying it wasn't the right time yet, and the girls left his going to the capital to Veltol. Afterward, they asked about the mother, which he described, leading to Garitch telling her that someone so immoral should not be recommended and telling her that Wilhelm was fastidious, so she didn't have to worry, triggering an emotional response from Carol. After he recommended the sherbet, he left, and the two had a bowl for themselves.

In the Years That Followed
After the events in Picoutatte, Garitch ended up receiving the position of the Blue of the Kingdom's titles of color. He eventually got married, though he and his wife had no children together, and she eventually passed away. Garitch was originally the doctor of Louanna Astrea when she was afflicted with a condition known as Sleeping Beauty (眠り姫 Nemurihime). Over the years, Heinkel Astrea started to curse Garitch for not being able to heal Louanna. He later became Ferris' teacher as he would be the successor of his alias. Six years before the events of Arc 1, Garitch was stabbed by a disciple of his, a curse arts user, and died. Ferris attempted to find out who the murderer was, to no avail. Heinkel grieved over Garitch's death, drowning his sorrows in alcohol. In the end, after Garitch's disciple was caught and executed during his state funeral, his casket was laid into the Kingdom Cemetery.

intro: Farsale Lugunica (ファルセイル・ルグニカ) was the 35th King of Lugunica and a member of the Witch Era Party. Farsale is famous for making a contract with the Divine Dragon Volcanica to help protect the Kingdom of Lugunica, and he was the last known "Lion King".
appearance: Not much is known of Farsale Lugunica but considering how he was a member of the Royal Family, it is a high probability that he had golden hair and bright crimson red eyes, the same as the other members of the family.
personality: Alec Hoshin describes Farsale as someone who lives by the principle of lavishness. Alec also states that Farsale's personality is such that he can get on with things anywhere he is. Additionally, Alec claims that Farsale was foreign to the concept of loneliness and wouldn't be able to sympathize with him. By Echidna's claim, he was honest to a fault, even exhibiting traits that could be considered for a fool, which at one point led him to unveil his identity, despite it supposing to have been kept secret. In her words, she claims that he was incredibly open and cheerful and was the type to never intimidated by anybody. She also describes him as an idiot; however, despite her claim, he is actually described as the embodiment of "the line between genius and madness". Despite his sometimes foolish behavior, his actions were not thoughtless, and there was usually reasonable logic behind is actions. However, the thought processes leading to actions were hard to see by others, and they were typically left gaping by the bizarre results that he would produce. He has been known to set Reid Astrea off on a rampage or go along with Alec on a scam. Furthermore, he was willing to ally with a Dragon and make an enemy of a major power to protect a Witch.
history:
In the years predating the Great Calamity, Farsale travelled alongside Satella, Echidna, Flugel, Reid, and Alec for unknown reasons, though according to Alec, it was a journey to save the world. According to Echidna, at the time of their travels, they needed to keep their identities secret. However, at one point during their travels, they ended up in the country of Magrizza. Despite attempting to hide their identities, Farsale declared his own name, resulting in a noble discovering them and inviting them to a banquet of nobles. The nation's crown prince, who was also in attendance at the banquet, became enamored by Echidna and went behind the scenes to arrange a marriage between the two of them, with Echidna's party going along with them after they were split from their capable fighters. However, at some point, for reasons yet to be explained, Reid and Volcanica went on a rampage, ultimately resulting in the marriage being cancelled and them being driven from the nation. It was a short time later that they learned that the Black Serpent destroyed Magrizza. According to Echidna, it was likely that they were being chased by the Black Serpent.

Around 400 years ago, Lugunica and the Vollachia Empire were always in conflict at that time due to unknown reasons and Farsale decided to make a covenant with the Divine Dragon Volcanica to help safeguard and guide the country in times of turmoil, resulting in peace between the two countries.
