intro: Doltero Amule (ドルテロ・アムル) is the head of the Black Silver Coin organization in Flanders. He plays a supporting role in Arc 9.
appearance: Doltero is a pig human, and therefore has the facial characteristics of a pig, as well as has blonde hair and deep blue eyes. He is mentioned to be almost two meters tall and weighs no less than 200 kilograms, with a body wrapped in muscles like armor. He is also mentioned to be agile despite his large body. He is seen wearing a suit and tie.
personality: Doltero is a serious man who takes his duties as the most powerful, influential man in Flanders solemnly. Though he harbors deep love for those closest to him, he prioritizes his position over them, exhibiting the willingness to disown them even in the face of grief on account of it. When coming face to face with an opponent, he will stand up to them down with the will to lose a limb if necessary, and he wouldn't flinch even at the loss of one. Likewise, he is unwilling to properly converse with his enemies. Doltero has a habit of referencing pigs and things in relation to them when he speaks, whether he is rudely calling people he sees as beneath him pigs or making disparaging jokes about his own race.
history:
Doltero is mentioned to have known Rom and is old friends with him. He fathered a daughter named Ilya with his mistress Kalifa, a human woman. Doltero revealed his relationship with them to only one person, his closest and most loyal confidant, Safis.

The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint
Recognizing that Kalifa and Ilya were Doltero's weaknesses, Safis attempted to have them killed out of loyalty to his boss and a desire to remove the "vulnerabilities" he had. As a result, Kalifa was attacked by an assailant Safis sent and had her larynx destroyed, inhibiting her from ever being able to speak again. She and her daughter both survived, and she entrusted Ilya to the Astrea Manor for protection. Doltero sent one of his men after the two, but he was discovered by Felt and Reinhard and revealed his affiliation with the Black Silver Coin once the candidate threatened with the Sword Saint. Shortly afterwards, Gaston, Rachins, and Camberley located Kalifa and brought her back to the mansion, where they discovered that Doltero was Ilya's father. Deciding to visit Doltero in Flanders, Rom used his connection to Doltero to hold a meeting with him. When Felt, Reinhard, and Rom, alongside Kalifa and Ilya, met with Doltero, he discovered that his confidant was responsible for ordering the attack on his mistress and daughter. Safis revealed his intentions, preparing to commit suicide to atone for his misdeeds, only for Doltero to suddenly assault him to keep him alive and demote him to a simple lackey position in the Black Silver Coin unless he could work to regain the Pig King's trust. Understanding Safis's argument, he disowned his mistress and his daughter, much to the displeasure of Felt and Rom. Before leaving, Kalifa turned to Doltero and bowed, showing him the face of his sleeping baby one last time, and Doltero murmured Ilya's name once the room was clear of everyone besides him. Following the incident, Safis was stripped of his executive position in the organization, but was allowed the chance to prove his loyalty and regain Doltero's trust.

Riot in Flanders
Two months after the incident with Safis, Doltero took part in a meeting between the heads of the other organizations in Big Three, those being Toto of the Flower Prison Garden and Manfred Madison of the Balance, as well as the representative of the Flanders branch of the Golden Beetle, Helaine Gatness. The meeting concerned a series of murders that had been committed against members of the Big Three organizations, as well as the Golden Beetle. Helaine proposed the one responsible was Felt, the Royal Selection Candidate being housed by the Sword Saint of Hakuchuri, having received reports that she contacted Doltero and the Black Silver Coin before. As a result, Manfred and Toto went on to seek courtesy visits from her as a means to verify her intentions, with Doltero sending Safis to inform her of their wishes.

Several days after Felt's courtesy visits, the Big Three started began pursuing Ezzo Cadner, who was framed for burning down a brothel in the red-light district and killing members of the Big Three, including a veteran of the Black Silver Coin and Mimosa, a prostitute from the Flower Prison Garden. Once Felt discovered his location at an abandoned mansion and heard his side of the story and Reinhard defeated a hundred members of the Black Silver Coin who had gathered at the mansion to catch the dwarf while using the name of the Masked Knight Veltol, the candidate and the Sword Saint proceeded to Doltero's mansion. Reinhard defeated another hundred men from Doltero's group, and him and Felt met with the Pig King and Safis. Felt suspected that the Black Silver Coin was responsible for the strife in Flanders, having learned that Kalifa and Ilya were targeted again. Neither Doltero nor Safis claimed responsibility, and nobody else in the organization had realized the truth about their relation to the Pig King. However, Safis mentioned that the veteran of the group who died on the night of the brothel's arson had been present when Kalifa and Ilya visited Doltero with Felt, and had revealed this information to Mimosa, who then relayed it to someone else. Ultimately, the incident's mastermind attempted to pit Felt and her group and the Black Silver Coin against each other, and succeeded in guiding her faction's actions. Despite that, Felt maintained confidence and relied on her comrade's approach to resolve the strife in Flanders.

Soon enough, the true culprits were discovered and the incident was resolved, and the Black Silver Coin continued operation. One of the culprits, Mozolite, a traitor in the Balance who attempted to steal Manfred's position for himself, had the eyes in which his Divine Protection's effects resided gouged out and was tortured by his boss in the presence of Doltero and Toto. In the end, the three leaders of the Big Three unanimously concluded that Felt was the candidate they would back. Gaston also managed to earn Doltero's respect for successfully defending Kalifa and Ilya from their attackers.

According to Rom, he has enough strength that if he were born ten years earlier, he would likely have made a name for himself during the Demi-Human War.

name: Faust
first_light_novel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village
intro: Faust (ファウスト) was one of the Witch Cultists that attacked Ram and Rem's village. He was also Sado and Fogg's master and the one who cut off Ram's horn. He was ultimately killed during his Attack on Miload Manor, beaten by Rem and blown up with his own explosions by Ram.
appearance: Faust was a large and muscular man with short hair and fine features.
personality: Faust smokes tobacco leaves and enjoys fire, and one of his motives for attacking the Oni village was to smell the burning onis and confront a true oni to burn. As his hobby and profitable moneymaker, Faust took the initiative to spread the knowledge of fire making and put it into practice, though he seems to have poor opinions of at least one of his apprentices. Despite being a member of the Witch Cult, he had no interest in the organization at all, being only a member because it was convenient.
history:
The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village
Around ten years before the arrival of Natsuki Subaru into the world, Faust, Sado, Sergei, and Fogg attacked the Oni Village. Three months later, he staged an assault on Miload Manor, killing many of the servants and guards in the process. Eventually, Ram confronted him in the hallway, and the two battled. She dodged most of his attacks and attempted to strike him down with Al Fura, but she failed to deal significant damage. Thanks to the arrival of Rem, however, the two were able to fight back Faust, punching him straight through the ceiling before sending him plummeting into his own traps. Then, Ram uses the man's leaf tobacco to trigger the explosions, reducing the man to ash.
abilities_text:
Explosion Technique (爆裂術式): By setting up magic formulas in the air beforehand, Faust can create invisible traps that can explode and kill whoever gets caught in it. Once triggered, it can create a chain reaction with other set-up traps. The technique requires precise calculations and a calm use of the user's magic power, and it can be triggered by the user or from outside stimulation, such as a magic stone or the burning end of leaf tobacco. It is possible to locate the traps beforehand, however, by either smelling miasma in the air or sensing the disturbance in mana in the air, allowing his targets to avoid most of the damage.

Wind Reading: Faust was able to read the wind and taught Sado how to do so. This ability allows him to be scrupulous with preparations and is the reason he is excellent at pursuit.

Equipment: Faust used a knife in combat, though it was shattered by Rem.

name: Fogg
first_light_novel: The Oni Sisters of the Hidden Village
intro: Fogg (フォッグ) was one of the Witch Cultists that attacked Ram and Rem's village. He was also Faust's disciple until he was killed by Rem.
appearance: Fogg was an extremely skinny, unhealthy-looking man, whose cheeks and eye sockets were depressed and made him appear ill. He wore nothing on his upper torso and only a pair of hemp trousers. His body was also covered in burns, lacerations, and scars, suggesting he'd experienced torture.
personality: Fogg was a cruel man who enjoyed hearing the screams of his victims. As an apprentice in arson, he also seemed to enjoy burning things, though he seemed to experience shock whenever his explosion technique, the only thing he was good at, failed to work on someone.
history:
The Oni Sister of the Hidden Village
Around ten years before Natsuki Subaru's arrival, Faust, Sado, Sergei, and Fogg attacked the Oni Village. He was captured during by Roswaal L. Mathers during the attack and was imprisoned under Roswaal Manor. For two months, he got the bare minimum of food and drink. However, one day, he was freed by Rem, who'd smelled the scent of the Witch from beyond his seal. Taking advantage of this, he used his explosion technique to blow her away and attempt to kill her. He found himself quickly cornered by her, however, as she was able to predict and avoid most of the damage by the explosions. Ultimately, he detonated all of his explosions when she managed to set off one of the explosions with a magic stone and blow away part of his face. Although he thought he killed her and attempted to leave, he was hit with a morningstar that Rem picked up. She then proceeded to torture him with the weapon and repetitive healing magic, getting the names of the other three accomplices out of him, before she killed him.
abilities_text: Explosion Technique (爆裂術式): Fogg manipulated mana, creating drifts around him, and placed the Explosion Technique inside of it, using the mana to cause an explosion. The technique itself is invisible and can be set up in a single motion, though it requires precise calculations and a calm use of the user's magic power. It can be triggered by the user or from outside stimulation. His technique is dangerous to use in enclosed spaces, and he has to make sure not to make the explosions too big in such scenarios. Likewise, if one can sense the disturbance in mana or the accompanying scent of the Witch prior to the detonation, one can avoid the worst of the damage.

history:
Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle Line 2
In the Watergate City of Priestella, the night that they arrived there, Otto extracted himself away from Subaru and the others to perform an errand, carrying a bag with the remnants of Roswaal L. Mathers's Book of Wisdom. Though he initially thought to get rid of it, he decided against that and wanted to confirm its contents, leading him to visit the "Master Restorer" Dartz, who was famous for being able to repair items with his restoration magic, including, according to rumors, meteors.

After arriving at Dartz's shop, Otto presented the burnt book to him, and Dartz was able to immediately identify that it was an item surrounded by mystery. Otto asked if it was possible to restore it, and Dartz replied that with the item in this state, returning it to its original state would be a legendary feat. But, he said that he could do it. Dartz continued by asking what Otto intended to use it for. Otto replied by saying that after checking the contents of the book he would burn it completely it so that not even a fragment of it remained. Dartz agreed that he would take the book from Otto, to try and restore it. But before he did, Otto had brought him a present. As Dartz was renowned for his fondness of alcohol, Otto had brought him a bottle. They drank together, and the next morning he returned back to the Water Plumage Inn, completely drunk.
abilities_text:
Magic (魔法, Mahō): Dartz is capable of using magic.
Restoration Magic (復元魔法, Fukugen Mahō): A type of magic that can recover objects to their original state. According to rumors, he has used it to fix numerous objects, including a meteor, and though he claimed it would be a legendary feat, he said he could restore even the burnt Book of Wisdom Otto brought him.

intro: Ezzo Cadner (エッゾ・カドナー) is a mage and a member of the Felt Camp, officially serving as their strategist and as a teacher to Felt. He plays a supporting role in Arc 9.
appearance: Ezzo has short, dark green hair, red eyes, a short stature, and an intelligent countenance. Although many dwarves, including Ezzo himself, look childish, he is actually approaching the end of his twenties.
personality:
Ezzo is a mage with plenty of pride in his craft, as he had mastered many forms of magic, becoming one of the highest-rated mages in the country. He has a logical and pragmatic nature, yet also a compassionate and charitable side to him, which he shows with his desire to act as a teacher to the disadvantaged. He abhors injustice and pursues retribution when he feels someone is wronged, whether it is himself or someone else. He is also rather scholarly when it comes to things that may be related to magic and prideful when it comes to techniques he has developed, showing them off while grinning and explaining their functions. His goal is to take the four titles of color from Roswaal L. Mathers and Ferris respectively, as he believes they are indifferent to the development of magic. To that end, he has written a number of magic theories and attempted to construct techniques that will ease the difficulty of learning magic. He can also be prone to jumping to conclusions, initially believing that Roswaal was a fraud for possessing three titles of color.

Ezzo does not like laziness or complacency. Although he will not judge others for living such a life, such as in the case of his siblings, he refuses to become lazy or complacent, choosing to put all of his hard work and effort into furthering his magic and refusing to settle. It is for this reason that, during the Arc 9 loop, upon witnessing Roswaal's use of magic for the first time, he burst into tears; having initially believed that his titles of color were given to him due to his lineage rather than actual effort, he was happy to see that the person who surpassed him had put in even more hard work than himself.

Ezzo has shown to be a respectful person to others, as he acknowledged both Al and Subaru at the Pleiades Watchtower and spoke respectfully to both of them. He also showed respect towards the former’s master, after hearing of her demise, and upon learning that he wished to read her Book of the Dead, he was fully ready to stop Al if he was hesitant about it, as reading said book would be an invasion of her privacy and contrary to her wishes.
history:
Ezzo was born as the youngest of ten siblings. Unlike his siblings, who were all born with Divine Protections due to dwarves being predisposed to being blessed with one at birth, Ezzo was not gifted one. At some point in his early life, when he discovered a book on magic covered in dust tucked within a box that a street vendor had, Ezzo decided to dedicate himself to magic.

He was first seen between Arc 2 and Arc 3, attempting to steal Roswaal's titles for his own benefit by attempting to trap him into a meteor so that he could claim a defeat on the most powerful magician of the Kingdom and claim his titles. This failed horribly, as he had imprisoned Rem and Subaru (dressed as Roswaal), instead of Ram and Roswaal as he originally intended. He later gained an opportunity to trap Roswaal within the meteor once Subaru and Rem escaped, but he managed to escape from it quickly, proving his merit as a magician. Ezzo then accepted a duel with Rem as a means to compare his strength as a magic user, but was easily defeated by a single punch to his face.

Riot in Flanders
Around a month after the events of the Royal Selection Ceremony, Ezzo was in Flanders. He was taken advantage of by Camberley, who left him penniless, causing him to take up a position as a bodyguard for the Flower Prison Garden. He began tutoring the organization's prostitutes to help them learn reading, writing, and arithmetic skills out of a compassionate desire to aid them. Ezzo had another run-in with Camberley several days later, attacking him on the spot, only to be stopped by Reinhard, who was accompanying Felt on a courtesy visit to each of the three organizations that made up Flanders' Big Three. He attended the knight and candidate duo's meeting with Toto, the Flower Prison Garden's proprietress, getting to know them before and during their discussion with her. On one night a few days later, a lackey of a high-ranking member of the Balance fatally wounded one of Ezzo's students, Mimosa, and killed the customer connected to the Black Silver Coin that she had been with. He cast healing magic on her to ease her pain before her inevitable death, but he was promptly attacked by the murderer. The magic he attempted to cast had no effect on the man due to his having the same Excess Mana Circulation Constitution as Reinhard. The man set fire to the brothel and Ezzo was left as the suspected culprit.

He escaped the red-light district with Camberley's help and confronted Helaine Gatness, exchanging the unpublished magic theories he had created in exchange for an abandoned mansion to use as a safe house. Felt, Reinhard, Flam Remendis, and Rachins Hoffman acquired the information of Ezzo's location from Helaine and met him at the mansion, where he engaged in a clash with Reinhard. Though ultimately ending in his failure, he successfully bypassed Reinhard's Excess Mana Circulation Constitution by rewriting the composition of a magic spell mid-casting. Ezzo proceeded to inform them of the truth of the fire at the brothel and requested their help in his pursuit of revenge for Mimosa's death. When they were surrounded at the mansion, he made a mask and wove a Cognitive Disruption spell within it so Reinhard could fend off their attackers while acting as the “Masked Knight Veltol” rather than the Sword Saint. He made use of another mask with the same technique when he and Flam accompanied Rachins to his face-off with Helaine. When given the chance, he successfully defeated the arson who framed him by using the same method he used to land magic on Reinhard and took revenge for Mimosa, leaving the man's fate to Manfred Madison. In the end, Ezzo rejected Manfred's offer to join the Balance and instead decided to join the Felt Camp, going back to Flanders in his free time twice a month to continue his tutorship hobby.

Priestella Reconstruction Journal
In the aftermath of the Battle for Priestella, he took part in an investigation alongside Garfiel Tinzel, Liliana Masquerade, and Ricardo Welkin in the catacombs beneath Priestella to search for the remains of a Witch, as it had been previously targeted and needed to be placed in a safe location. After several tribulations and overcoming the Witch’s trial, they successfully managed to retrieve the withered arm and brought it back above ground.

Meili’s Witchbeast Observation Record
Shortly after the successful Pleiades Watchtower Expedition, Ezzo took part in a follow-up expedition alongside Felt, Reinhard, Flam and Grassis Remendis, Meili Portroute, and the little scorpion Shaula. There, they investigated the Taygeta library and met the senile Divine Dragon Volcanica. They’d also noticed the same birds that had been flying around the tower. After Shaula killed one with her stinger, Ezzo discovered the birds’ nature and ordered for them to all be killed, which he and Reinhard got to immediately. Deciding to report what they found, Felt took most of the group back to the Royal Capital while Ezzo remained behind with Flam.
abilities_text:
Magic (魔法, Mahō): Ezzo is able to use all six magic affinities. He is a talented magic user who regards himself as the second-best mage in the Kingdom behind Roswaal L. Mathers. He does not need to utilize incantations and is skilled enough to disguise the chant of one spell as another spell. Ezzo can cast several high-level magic spells in quick succession or at the same time, and he can rearrange the magic composition of a spell while casting it, though doing the latter results in him receiving multiple lacerations. His control of magic is also quite impressive, displaying the ability to summon and manipulate numerous balls of water at once and either attack with them or use them all to support his allies simultaneously. His ingenuity with magic is such that he is able to quickly understand numerous theories and techniques regarding magic as well as repurpose said theories and techniques in order to refine them. Likewise, he is able to integrate new techniques for his own casting of magic, as he did after studying the theories and techniques crafted by Roswaal J. Mathers and explained to him by Roswaal L. Mathers. When working together with the latter Roswaal, the two are even capable of coming up with other new methods to cast magic, and they are quickly capable of learning how to cast the strongest magic known to man.
Multiplefold Magic: Like Roswaal, Ezzo is capable of casting multiple spells at the same time, albeit not at the same level as Roswaal individually.
Al Sextet (アル・セクステット, Aru Sekusutetto): By combining his magic with Roswaal's, they cast six Al level spells simultaneously, creating an aurora pillar with enough power to rewrite the laws of heaven and earth. A target caught within can have its own strength used as fuel for the magic and increase its density. It has enough power to shatter Volcanica's dragon halo. It is considered to be a miracle of magic that even Echidna and Myonmyon were unable to use. Due to the Arc 9 loop having been undone, however, he has yet to achieve this.
Ul Goa (ウル・ゴーア): Ezzo fires a large number of powerful fire bullets. A powerful flame scatters when the bullets land.
El Shiha (エル・シーハ): Ezzo gathers water from the atmosphere to bind a target in place.
Cognitive Disruption (認識阻害, Ninshiki Sogai): A spell effect that can be woven into objects, such as cloaks or masks. It inhibits people from being able to recognize the person wearing the object that the spell is enchanted into.
Magic Composition Rewriting: Ezzo can rewrite a spell's composition. By changing the composition of a spell mid-casting, it is possible for Ezzo to disassemble a spell into mana, absorbing it through his own gate. Furthermore, by utilizing this magic technique, he was even able to circumvent the effects of Reinhard's Excess Mana Circulation Constitution and land a blow on the Sword Saint with magic.
Silencing Magic: An application of Yang Magic that makes a person’s voice so high that it cannot be picked up by the ear.

Excellent Intuition: Ezzo is very experienced, to the point that he can determine a person’s relative power level shortly after meeting them. He was even able to somewhat determine the ability of Al’s Authority as something separate from magic after a short confrontation with him. Likewise, he can quickly analyze a person's abilities mere moments after witnessing them for himself, and he can act with appropriate measures to assist them with minimal effort.

Equipment:
White Fox's Nest (白狐の巣):thumb|200x200px A meteor which captures people and makes them do trials based on the owner's magical experience and mana. The targets cannot escape unless the trial is finished or once the user considers that the subjects failed the trials and allow them to escape, the targets of the meteor cannot die within the trials. Once the trials start, more subjects cannot be imprisoned until the trials inside it are over either due to failure or success. He has used this meteor to imprison both Rem and Subaru at the same time in the past. When activated, the person using the meteor cannot use any magic or they will be released from the trial.

intro: Flam Remendis (フラム・レメンディス) is the granddaughter of Carol and Grimm Fauzen and the older twin sister of Grassis Remendis. She later joined the Felt Camp along with her sister. She plays a supporting role in Arc 9.
appearance: Like her sister, she is a short girl and has peach hair with yellow ribbons in her hair. She wears white and pink clothes. Unlike her sister Grassis, her fringe is lateral.
personality:
Though she is a maid, according to Ezzo Cadner, she is not afraid to speak of things she does not want to do. She also has a rather sharp mouth, as she often interrupted or made fun of Ezzo while he was speaking. Apparently, her attitude reminds Natsuki Subaru of Ram. Flam is still kind, nevertheless: for instance, she did not hesitate to join a group hug for Subaru despite only being acquaintances. She and her sister are also mischievous, habitually teasing others. 

In times of emergency, Flam can become vicious, using whatever means she has to in order to bring down her enemies. Likewise, if she is put in a position where she must use her Divine Protection but is unable to relax and sleep to be able to use it again, she will not hesitate to strangle herself to force herself to sleep. She and her sister also hold grudges towards those who wrong the members of House Astrea, particularly when it comes to Heinkel Astrea, and they will show no qualms in delivering ruthless beatings towards their enemies.
history:
Born to one of Carol and Grimm's children, servants of House Astrea, she and her sister Grassis have been trained by the family they've served since birth.

Meili’s Witchbeast Observation Record
A short time after the successful Pleiades Watchtower Expedition, members of the Felt Camp, which included Flam and Grassis, were tasked with reaching the Pleiades Watchtower and investigating it. During their travels through the Augria Sand Dunes, the Divine Dragon attacked them to protect the tower, leaving Reinhard to defend the party. Fortunately, Meili Portroute, who was protecting the party from witchbeasts as they made their way toward the tower, presented Volcanica’s talon, and they were allowed passage into the tower. There, they came across the Books of the Dead, which Meili explained to them, much to the fascination of Ezzo. Understanding their importance, Felt suggested Reinhard find the book of his grandmother, and though he was hesitant to do so, when Felt persuaded him to find it at some point, he was grateful.

Shortly after, they noticed the same birds that Subaru and Eridna had witnessed before. With one captured for study, Ezzo quickly discovered its true nature, and the crimson scorpion being carried by Meili killed it in his hands. Realizing the birds were being used to spy, Ezzo and Reinhard set to killing them all. Deciding to return to the capital, they left Ezzo and Flam at the tower.
abilities_text:
Divine Protection (加護 Kago): Flam and her sister both have the Divine Protection of Mindspeak (念話の加護 Nenhanashi no Kago), which allows them to speak to each other through their mind. The distance between them does not matter, but it can only be used once a day. According to Petra's observations, the once-a-day condition seems to be connected to the amount of time that she sleeps rather than a full 24-hour time period.

Flow Method (流法): Despite being young, Flam is an expert in using the Flow Method. By enhancing her strength with it, a strike from her hand is easily enough to pierce through the body of a grown man, bringing about near-instant death, and her recuperation speed is increased. She is shown to be powerful enough to beat the three thugs, Gaston, Rachins and Camberley, with ease. Flam is also mentioned to be stronger than Felt, Rom, and the other Felt Camp members except Ezzo Cadner and Reinhard van Astrea.

Stealth: Flam is able to hide her presence excellently. While within the Pleiades Watchtower, while everyone was distracted by the events taking place, she managed to successfully sneak up on Al and kill him in several loops.

personality: It was claimed that Drizen unthinkably believed the unwritten rule that the strong were absolutely right, something that had led to internal corruption within Vollachia.
history:

When he was older, he had 67 children—including Prisca Benedict and Vincent Abellux—then left all of them around the country. At some point in time, he bestowed Arakiya to his daughter, Prisca, as a gift for unknown reasons. On his deathbed, he gathered all of his surviving children together and commenced the next Imperial Selection Ceremony by allowing the Yang Sword to incinerate him.

name: Frufoo
affiliation: Kingdom of Lugunica ; Otto Suwen ; Emilia Camp
intro: Frufoo (フルフー) is Otto Suwen's earth dragon.
appearance: Frufoo is an earth dragon of thickset complexion. Her skin is blue with a white underside. She has a crest with yellow edges.
personality: Frufoo has a sarcastic and straightforward attitude. She is docile towards humans, especially Otto, whom she, despite often questioning and scolding, cares for and obeys.
history:
Frufoo was raised in the Suwen household, located in Otto's hometown, Picoutatte. She has known Otto since he was a child, and the two used to have conversations via Otto's Divine Protection. When Otto was banished from Picoutatte, he took Frufoo with him. They have been traveling together since.

Otto's Peddling Record of Joy and Sorrow
At one point, having made a successful business venture in the town of Guineb, as he and Frufoo prepared to leave, he was invited by the town's mayor, Colin Lavril, to his residence. There, he was asked how he crossed the mountains, to which Otto refused to discuss his secret. Colin then introduced Otto to his son, Aheem, and stated that his fiancée, Marone Lisbon, had been kidnapped, and because of that, he wanted to know how to cross the mountains. Though Otto still refused to give up his secrets, he proposed to relay a rescue service for the girl. Afterward, he was guided by his son, but along the way, Aheem led Otto into a trap, which resulted in Otto being imprisoned by slave traders.

In a cell, he met a girl who called him Number Two and introduced herself as Marone. According to her, Aheem was not her fiancée. He had deceived her and given her to the slave traders. After a while, some of the slave traders appeared, and when he asked where Frufoo was, they claimed that she worked for them. At some point after this while still in the cell, he told Marone that he had the "Divine Protection of Guidance" and made an agreement with her. Afterward, when they were put on his dragon carriage, he was told to reveal his path through the mountains. The deal with Aheem was that he would provide the traders women in exchange for leaving Guineb alone. With Frufoo taking the carriage, Otto directed the traders where there was a supposed path that they could use. Then, after calling out to Marone as part of their agreement, they held on tight as Frufoo was signaled to crash the carriage.

Otto and Marone had their injuries treated in a hospital in a nearby town, where he revealed that Guineb's mayor and son were likely to be investigated for the incident and Aheem likely arrested. Upon asking if she would return to Guineb, Marone refused. When Marone asked for his name, he said she could keep calling him Number Two, and he gave her his own savings, enough for her to start a new life anywhere she wanted, lying to her by saying it was a reward for taking down the slave traders. Then, Otto took off, Frufoo scolding him for lying but believing it was fine, and she looked forward to seeing his dream come true.
abilities_text:
Divine Protection (加護 Kago): Frufoo has the Divine Protection of Wind Evasion (風避けの加護 Kazeyoke no Kago), which enables her to be unaffected by the wind and not encounter any wind resistance while running. The effect also applies to a dragon carriage that she pulls. After activation, there is a cooldown before she can use it again.

Endurance: Frufoo is physically strong and has high stamina. According to Otto, she is able to run for three days without having to rest.

personality: Due to his membership and eventual exclusion within the Witch Cult, it can be deducted that Dorkell was an outcast even amongst those who are said to be "loathed by the world". Due to his only actual presence being through Lye and Rui using Solar and Lunar Eclipse, there are no concrete examples of Dorkell's personality other than his eccentric nature.
history: Originally, Dorkell was but an everyday merchant living in Kararagi but after a specific event in his life, he strayed off of his merchant path. At some point, he connected to Od Lagna by some means, attaining a supernatural ability that changed his life: the Leaper technique. He threw away his family and his life, becoming an eccentric man who chose to believe in non-existent things and ideals. Becoming a destroyer of order, he assassinated numerous people with positions of power. He eventually joined the ranks of the Witch Cult. However, his Leaper technique was regarded as a heresy within a heresy, and he was cast out from even the cult itself. Sometime after that, the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, Lye Batenkaitos, defeated him and ate his name and memories, effectively putting Dorkell in suspended animation.

intro: Flop O'Connell (フロップ・オコーネル) is a merchant and the older brother of Medium O'Connell. He played a supporting role in Arc 7 and Arc 8.
appearance: Flop has long bangs and long cream blonde hair, which is the same color as his sister. His eyes are a sky blue, which complement his pale skin rather well. He is also described as shorter than his sister Medium. Compared to her, Flop is also not physically strong.
personality:
Flop is a kind-hearted man who dislikes violence and is friendly to everyone he meets. Flop is extremely helpful to almost everyone he meets, as shown when he helps Subaru, Rem, and Spica into the city of Guaral, and he even helps them sell off the horn of the Elgina so that Subaru can fund his trip back home. He is also shown to be very caring for people, as shown when he rushes to the aid of a man who was thrown through a window and when he tries to stop Subaru from giving away all his money to Rowan. He was also willing to sacrifice himself to save Subaru from Todd Fang when he was about to kill him, and he later did the same for Rem to protect her from Madelyn Eschart. Likewise, even after only having known him for less than an hour, he was quick to trust Subaru when he suddenly yelled at an unseen enemy and was willing to listen to him and help him escape from the town. His kind-hearted and naive thinking, however, can get in the way of negotiations when dealing with people of opposing thought processes, such as Vincent Vollachia, which can lead to a standstill. This being said, it is because of his honest and straightforward personality that people can trust him. In fact, it is partially for this reason that the man posing as the false emperor, Chisha Gold, entrusted him with a message to Vincent for the instance he was able to return to his side.

He is also a quick thinker and risk taker; despite having taken a severe injury and was on the verge of both losing his consciousness and even dying, he was able to convince Rem to use his injury and her ability to heal him as a bargaining chip against Madelyn, who wanted answers from him after she saw Carillon's baby teeth, in order to get her to stop attacking Guaral during the Flying Dragon Cataclysm. Likewise, he was even willing to have his healing slowed so that he could use his position to both protect Rem and himself as well as gather information. He is also quite perceptive and apparently fearless. After meeting the false emperor, he quickly saw through him, and he showed no fear at all while speaking to him, despite the man essentially holding his life in his hands.

Due to the way he was raised with his sister in an abusive orphanage, despite being given the chance to get payback on the man responsible for his and his sister's suffering, although he did not stop Medium or the other children from giving the man what he deserved, he chose not to do so. Instead, he vowed to get revenge on the world. However, because he believed that violence wouldn't solve anything, his version of revenge against the world is to spread kindness to everyone he comes across, something he believed would slowly but steadily affect the world, and with that goal in mind, he decided to become a traveling merchant. Thanks to this, many people owe him favors, and his influence has left a positive impact on those he has come across.

Despite his overall positive stance and attitude, he is also rather ambitious. A part of the reason he joined the Imperial Civil War on Vincent's side, while indeed intent to help his new friends, was also because he knew he could take advantage of his position to gain greater influence and further his dream. Later on, though he still kept her best interests in mind while making the offer, he was even shown willing to offer up his sister for marriage to Vincent while negotiating. In the same conversation, he also admitted to the emperor's face that he had considered that, if he didn't believe Vincent was worthy of it, he was even willing to remove Vincent from the throne and have Subaru take his place, though he ultimately decided against it due to the best interests of everyone involved and the fact that he approved of Vincent.
history:
When he was young, he and his sister Medium grew up in an orphanage in a small town called Averyk, where they were routinely beaten by adults. One day, an imperial soldier named Miles arrived at the orphanage and promptly beat and tied up the adults in charge of the orphanage. As Flop watched as the other children, his sister included, started beating the adults for all the years of their abuse, Flop realized that this cycle of violence is what leads children and adults alike into reprehensible situations like theirs. Combined with the unjust treatment he’d also received, Flop resolved to get vengeance on by replacing violence and cruelty with kindness.

Soon after, he and Medium were brought to the Dracroy Domain, where Serena Dracroy resided. Understanding their circumstances, she became an older sister figure to the two of them and allowed them to reside in her domain. A few years after this, they met Balleroy Temeglyph, and they helped him raise the newborn Carillon. At some point, when Carillon lost some of his baby teeth, they were made into a necklace that he started to wear.

Some years after this, he decided to set out from the Dracroy Domain to become a merchant to achieve his revenge, with his sister acting as his bodyguard. During his travels, however, he heard of the demise of Balleroy, Carillon, and Miles, each of which saddened him and his sister.

Undead Busters
During her time as empress consort, Medium regularly practiced with the imperial soldiers, which Flop praised her for. However, as she anxious about how to be a good wife to Vincent, she sought out marital advice. Soon after she received her advice, Flop and Medium's group met with Cecilus Segmunt's party as they returned to Garkla, intending to speak with Vincent about how to handle Volcas.

intro: Gaoran Peitiet (ガオラン・ペイシット) was a High Count of the Sacred Vollachia Empire. He was killed by Rowan Segmunt after attempting to start a rebellion and failing.
appearance: Gaoran was described as a relatively old man with a large frame. As a zombie, he possessed a vessel of earth, pale skin bereft of color, various cracks that ran across her body, pitch-black sclera, and radiant golden irises.
personality: Gaoran was a somewhat naive and reckless Count, who was willing to send his entire army and his famed flying dragon, Feyron, into death, simply to have an opportunity to kill the emperor. Furthermore, Gaoran seemingly wasn't that good of a tactician, as he marched straight towards the Crystal Palace, betting everyone's lives on a surprise attack, which obviously failed.
history:
A couple of months following the seventy-seventh emperor Vincent Vollachia's coronation, Gaoran sprung various insurgencies across the nation's larger cities, prompting Vincent to disperse the Nine Divine Generals away from the Crystal Palace which weakened its defences. Gaoran then gathered his troops and attacked the Crystal Palace head-on, betting it all on a surprise attack. His forces were quickly surrounded and taken out one by one by the defending armies led by Third-Class General Zikr Osman, while Gaoran was circling the battlefield on his flying dragon, Feyron. After his dragon was shot down and killed, Gaoran encountered Vincent and blindly sprung towards him. Just as he was about to pierce the emperor's chest, however, a slash from Rowan Segmunt deflected his halberd's end and another slash cut him down diagonally across his body, ending the High Count's life almost in an instant.

Following his death, Vincent ordered every one of Gaoran's captured troops to be executed on the spot, in order to demonstrate a point.

intro: The Earth Spider (土蜘蛛) is a spirit. It currently resides in the city of Pappelt, under the care of Regin Suwen and Marone Lisbon.
appearance:
The spirit's original appearance is unknown.

Starting from an unspecified time in the past, the spirit began gathering various living beings and mixing them into a single mass, which became the spirit's provisional body. This mass was covered in skin of different colors: one part red, one part black, and one part white. Its surface exhibited fibers similar to fur, along with several eyes and mouths scattered unevenly on it. It also had around twenty limbs, plus tentacles, which is why it was named the Earth Spider.

The size of its body increased with each new creature that the spirit incorporated into the mass. The first reported sighting of the Earth Spider indicated that it was nearly the size of a child at the time, whereas three months later, at the time of its last sighting, it was more akin to the size of a hill.

After being adopted by Regin and Marone, the Earth Spider freed all the creatures mixed into its provisional body and took the form of a small spider, which it currently maintains.
personality:
The Earth Spider was born as an emotionless spirit, with barely any conscience.

It started developing interests of its own when it first witnessed the anguish of dying creatures. After fusing with one of those creatures and vicariously experiencing the fear of death, which was the first emotion the spirit ever felt, the shock drove it to develop an obsession with saving every being from death. Thus, the Earth Spider began to absorb other creatures while searching for a method to save them.

When Regin, Otto, Garfiel, and Marone first tried to reason with it and tell the spirit that its goal was impossible, the Earth Spider refused to accept the truth. However, in the end, thanks to Regin and Marone's words, it abandoned its fixation on death and accepted the two as its mentors.

name: Ghajit
intro: Ghajit (ガジート) was a gladiator at the Gladiator Island Ginunhive. He sought to escape the island by participating in Ubilk's rebellion and later assisting in quelling it, but he was ultimately unsuccessful, having been killed by Al.
appearance: Ghajit was a man with a distinct hairstyle that was shaved on the left side of his head and long on the right side. In addition, he wore a black outfit.
personality:
Ghajit desired to escape the Gladiator Island through any means necessary, though this made him prone to being influenced by others. He was willing to feign acting nice to Priscilla, yet he was not above pointing his blade at her. Once he realized that he was played by Ubilk and used as a pawn in a greater scheme, Ghajit grew increasingly panicked and violent. 

Throughout the island's uprising, Ghajit acted as an arbiter of sorts between the captives and his fellow rebelling gladiators, but he lacked the courage to act as a leader when Ubilk was present. He was also acquainted with Al and thought of him as an idiot for failing to join Hornet's side. By the time he and Al dueled, Ghajit accepted that everyone at Ginunhive, including him, would be gladiators until they died.
history:
The Tale of the Scarlet Princess
Ghajit was among the many gladiators who were cajoled by Ubilk to participate in an uprising at the Gladiator Island. When the insurrection began, Ghajit was in the group who searched for Serena Dracroy amidst the spectators. He and his comrades took Priscilla Pendleton—who claimed to be Serena—and her husband, Jorah, to the murdered island owner's room, where Ubilk was waiting for them. Priscilla relayed that the mutiny was futile because the Nine Divine Generals would be dispatched to swiftly end it, instilling doubt in Ghajit and causing him to question Ubilk about the claim's truth.

A short time afterwards, Priscilla convinced Ghajit and the gladiators alongside him to turn against the other revolting gladiators. Both he and Balleroy came to rescue her when she was confined. He began to panic upon realizing that he was used as a pawn by Ubilk, and when Priscilla said that he was easy to manipulate, he pointed his saber at her neck until Miles arrived and subdued him with a chunk of debris, putting him out of commission for the rest of the coup. After the mutiny ended, Al fought Ghajit in a match and skewered him with an attack to the stomach, ending his life.
abilities_text: Equipment: Ghajit wielded a saber that he was well-acquainted with using. It was his weapon of choice during deathmatches and the Ginunhive uprising.

intro: Eugard Vollachia (ユーガルド・ヴォラキア) was the sixty-first emperor of the Sacred Vollachia Empire and the former lover of Iris. He played both an antagonistic and supportive role in Arc 8, and he is one of the main characters of the Iris and the King of Thorns EX chapter.
appearance:
Eugard was a short and thin man who had dark green hair that was nearly black and almost reached his shoulders, blue eyes, and a handsome face. He had a vague resemblance to Vincent Vollachia. As a zombie, he possessed a vessel of earth, pale skin bereft of color, various cracks that ran across his body, pitch-black sclera, and radiant golden irises. He returned to his original form upon being slashed by the Fiend Sword.

He has been shown to wear royal garments that were red and charcoal grey, as well as a red cloak with charcoal grey shoulders. He wore a thorny crown around his head, and he carried with him a scepter, of which the top bore resemblance to a flower, with a red "bud", four black "petals", and black thorns that wrapped around the upper handle. He also wore a sash with the symbol of the Sword Wolf on it.
personality:
Eugard is portrayed as having a cold, emotionless personality, stated to be split half-and-half between his natural personality and how it was shaped by his solitude due to his curse. Despite being born with his curse, which forced him into solitude, he did not consider himself unhappy, and in fact, he was actually quite indifferent to his curse, comparing it to something similar to a birth defect, and thus, something that could not be helped. In fact, with the world the way it was, he even considered himself lucky to have survived in such a state.

Despite his portrayal as emotionless, Eugard was actually someone whose love spread to everyone around him, which was reflected in the indiscriminate effects on the people around him. He was not one to cast blame so simply, not even toward the nameless person both cursed him and ordered his curse. He is also typically forgiving towards small discourtesies, such as a small lie or foul language, and does not take such issues seriously, simply referring to such issues as irreverent. It is said that amongst all of the emperors of Vollachia, he is the one who was least reserved about handing out compliments. Despite his demeanor and way of speaking, he often praises those he comes across, similar to the Admirer, though not to the same extent. Even after his death, this was true. During his battle with Groovy Gumlet, he complimented his strength as greater than the Nine Divine Generals of his time, and against Halibel, despite his hatred for the man's kind, he complimented him for his skill. He was also quite studious and harbored a sense of duty before he ever decided to partake in the Imperial Selection Ceremony, having gathered as much knowledge as he could so that he could serve both the imperial family and his country.

Because of his natural state being that of one without much expression and as one who never had to exert his full might, due in part to his curse, Eugard had never felt much toward the concept of battle, merely swinging his sword because he had to due to his position or to protect himself or others, seeing swinging the blade as little more than an execution. However, when he confronted Halibel during the Great Disaster, he, for the first time, felt a strong surge of emotion during battle, having for the first time produced a roar with all of his might as he refined his skills against Halibel, and the emotions and roar shocked him.

Eugard's life was changed forever when he met Iris. Her presence had become one with which she had produced a tremendous change in his life. It was because of his love for her that Eugard had resolved himself to take part in the Imperial Selection Ceremony of his era, as he believed that without the throne, he could not live with Iris in his life. He respected her wishes, and he would often allow her certain privileges that others were not allowed, such as sneaking up behind him or looking at him with certain gazes. It was also a daily occurrence that Eugard would promptly ignore matters while in the presence of Iris, only paying her attention.

Eugard is intensely vengeful towards those who steal the lives of those he loves. Eugard personally killed the Nine Divine Generals of his time when they turned their fangs on Iris, and due to the conspiracy revolving around the death of Iris, Eugard held an immense hatred for the mole and wolf humans, and he personally killed the people responsible. His hatred was so intense that he became responsible for organizing their mass genocide and leaving the command for their demise active for the next three centuries. This hatred even affected how his Curse of Thorns worked on them: none of them were afflicted with it as the curse does not work on anyone he has no love for. However, after his battle with Halibel, where the Admirer became responsible for removing his curse from him, and his reuniting with Iris, who had been reincarnated as Yorna Mishigure, he was willing to ask the present-day emperor, Vincent, to revoke his command that sent the races into hiding. This being said, thanks to his battle with Halibel, Halibel's removal of Eugard's curse, and his reuniting with Iris during the Great Disaster, he was willing to forgive the wolf and mole humans, and he had even gone out of his way, at the end of his time as a zombie, to request from the emperor of the present day, Vincent, to rescind the order of the genocide of the two races.
history:
Born with congenital analgesia, which prevents him from feeling pain, Eugard Elcanti (ユーガルド・エルカンティ, Yūgarudo Erukanti), the future Emperor of the Briar, was cursed with the Curse of Thorns as an infant by an unknown curse arts user who was either sent to curse the boy or did so of their own volition as a result of envy directed at the Elcanti family of Special High Counts as part of sabotage for the Imperial Selection Ceremony. Although his congenital analgesia prevented him from feeling the pain of the Curse of Thorns, the curse still affected those around him, forcing him to live a life of solitude while still experiencing a feeling of suffocation from the curse still eating into his body. At some point, his body accustomed itself to the thorns, giving it a symbiotic relationship with the Curse of Thorns. He began training himself in the sword and, with his talent and a body that could utilize that talent, increased his strength to bewildering heights.

Around 300 years before the present era, Eugard met a village girl named Iris, but had to part with her until he was betrayed and ousted from the throne. Thereafter, Iris began to shelter Eugard, supported his path to return to his position, and the two fell in love. However, when a betrayal from the mole human and wolf human races cost the life of his beloved, he descended into madness and abandoned the paradise he had once intended to build. In his madness, he chose to eradicate the races that betrayed him, and he brought his beloved back to life by casting a curse known as the Soul Marriage Curse on her, which forced Iris's soul to rise again while preventing it from ever returning to Od Lagna, causing her to endlessly reincarnate.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Eugard's skill with the sword and strength was so great that, even if he lacked the Curse of Thorns, he would have been able to slay the Nine Divine Generals from his era regardless. Unable to have any guards because of his Curse of Thorns, he learned and mastered an assortment of sword techniques to defend himself with, and in time, Eugard was recognized as the Empire's strongest emperor. According to Groovy Gumlet, Eugard is a master martial artist, and his skill in combat improved during his fight with Halibel.

Curse
Curse of Thorns (茨の呪い, Ibara no Noroi): Eugard had the Curse of Thorns, a curse placed onto him by an unknown yet talented curse arts user that caused him to bind himself and the people around him with intangible thorns. He had the capability to bind people with sharp, ashen grey thorns that pierced the heart of their targets and had no tangible form, making them impossible to remove. The effect of the thorns were dependent on the target's Od. So long as a target met the conditions, the thorns indiscriminately applied themselves to anyone within who entered a given distance centered around Eugard and more intensely harmed them the closer they got to him. The curse could not activate on a target unless the person with the curse loved them; because Eugard directed his love to everyone in his life, the curse afflicted everyone he came into contact with, until Iris's death led to wolf humans and mole humans being excluded from the curse's effects. These rules also applied to Eugard. As a result of Eugard's congenital analgesia, he felt no pain from the thorns and was able to become accustomed to them when his body optimized itself because of their presence, thus allowing him to increase his power. Originally, the range of his Curse of Thorns was only one hundred meters, but when he was separated from Iris, its range increased to hundreds of meters and started piercing through those he had attempted to speak to through a Conversation Mirror. While he was an undead, Halibel plundered the Fiend Sword from the King of Thorns and attacked him with it, removing the curse from him and transferring it to Groovy Gumlet, and it was destroyed by the Fiend Sword shortly after.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
Master Swordsman: Although he had never been given a chance to polish his swordsmanship in life, Eugard was still a proper swordsman, and he could was able to wield his swords with ease. After reviving as an undead, however, when he fought against Halibel, he was able to gain a large amount of experience, and his swordsmanship was able to become polished rapidly. During his clash with Halibel, he was even shown to be able to leave numerous wounds on the wolfman.

Enhanced Strength: During his battle with Halibel, Eugard displayed impressive strength. As he clashed with the wolfman, when their strikes collided, they were able to create shockwaves that could blow away the flames and rubble that surrounded them.

Enhanced Speed: Eugard is rather fast. He is able to propel himself with such force that he damaged the ground behind him, and likewise, albeit for a short moment, he was able to match Halibel's speed.

Intelligence
Keen Observation: Eugard is also rather observative. During his battle with Halibel, he was able to determine his fighting style after a few short clashes and even manage to counter him by catching the shinobi off guard. Likewise, even during his battle with Halibel, he was aware of Groovy's presence and was even ready for him to make his move.

Equipment
In life, Eugard primarily wielded a sword that was a family heirloom, and later, as a member of the imperial family, the Yang Sword. He could use a sword with such effectiveness that his skill surpassed even the Nine Divine Generals. After being resurrected as a zombie during the Great Disaster, he temporarily acquired the Fiend Sword of Cecilus Segmunt that the Blue Lightning left behind after undergoing infantilization and skillfully brandished it in battle.
Family Sword: The sword Eugard originally used was a family heirloom that had been bestowed to them by a past emperor and had been almost exclusively displayed as a decoration. Because he was unable to have bodyguards with his Curse of Thorns, in case he ever needed to defend himself, Eugard mastered a number of sword techniques to such a great degree that he was able to become the most skilled combatant in Vollachia.
Yang Sword Vollachia (陽剣ヴォラキア, Youken Vorakia): As a member of the Imperial Family of Vollachia, Eugard was capable of summoning and using the Yang Sword Vollachia, otherwise known as the Yang Sword, an ornate crimson sword with light that shines like the sun. The sword appears out of thin air when the user wishes to use it, and it cuts and burns whatever the user desires. Unlike other users, Eugard makes a habit of abusing its unique sheathing method to catch his opponents off guard, such as when he throws his blade or decides to switch which hand he wields the sword in. He can also unleash long-range slashes from the blade as well as a burst of flame that can burn everything within a certain radius around himself, as well as superheat the atmosphere around him to generate explosions. Furthermore, he can also use his sword's flames to increase the strength of his strikes, using the force to damage and send flying even someone as strong as Halibel.
Fiend Sword Murasame (邪剣ムラサメ, Jaken Murasame): The Fiend Sword Murasame is an Enchanted Sword belonging to Cecilus Segmunt that Eugard temporarily acquired and wielded. It has a cutting edge so mighty that crafting a sheath for it was riddled with complications. Murasame has the ability to sever the perceived “point” signifying something's essence that exists in everything, no matter the person, object, phenomenon, or concept. This allows it to cut through things without a physical form, including curses and contracts. The sword has a very long and storied history. Due to it being an Enchanted Sword, it requires sacrifice and blood in order to satisfy its hunger for violence. In other words, the owner of the Fiend Sword must use it as a killing tool rather often. It also needs suitable compensation in order to be wielded, something that would cost an average wielder their very life. According to Julius, even when sheathed, Murasame emits extreme cruelty and bloodlust. Murasame was originally a sword with a different form that was reforged into a katana by Groovy Gumlet.

intro: Fareed Impusen (ファリド・インプセン) is the leader of the Golden Wing Faction.

He was concerned with issues such as the relations between humans and demi-humans, internal interference from foreign nations, and the Brotherhood. However, Fareed was unable to make use of passion for the Kingdom on his own, allowing Russell Fellow to advise him in such a way that he never realized that the merchant was effectively influencing and directing his choices.
history:

Around the same time as when Marcos Gildark founded the Brotherhood, spearheaded by Russell Fellow's advise, Fareed founded the Golden Wing Faction, a gathering of nobles who felt patriotism for their country but lacked the purpose to act on it.

One day, Russell came to Fareed and offered him a chance to attend a meeting between the Golden Wing Faction and The Brotherhood that would be hosted by Roswaal L. Mathers. He attended this meeting, and after much conversation with Marcos, Russell, and Roswaal, it resulted in both groups agreeing to move to Costuul so they could begin to create magicreation tools there. Because the members of the Golden Wing Faction had to prepare and sort out their courses of action, Fareed saw Roswaal and The Brotherhood off before they set course for Costuul. Some time later, the members of the Golden Wing Faction, including Fareed, moved to Costuul.

name: Fujirou Tenzen
intro: Fujirou Tenzen (フジロウ・テンゼン) was a shinobi instructor of Vollachia's shinobi village and the one who gave Yae Tenzen her name.
appearance: Fujirou's appearance was never described.
personality: Befitting of a shinobi instructor, Fujirou desired to tap into the potential of a person training to be a shinobi and make them in his ideal image. When faced with a genin who possessed immense talent, he grew enthralled by their ability and his desire morphed into obsession. He remained resolved in his conviction to the point that he refused to accept any other outcomes, clinging to the possibility that repeating the same process would produce his desired result. Due to his obsession and refusal to concede on his outlook, his premature death was brought about at the hands of Yae.
history:
As an instructor in the shinobi village, Fujirou was among those responsible for handling the memory disposal process for kidnapped children who were to be trained as shinobi. After performing the memory disposal on a young red-haired girl assigned the name Red Number 8, he was left speechless by how effective and smooth the procedure had been. In time, he was given the chance to tell her about his surprise personally, and ended up becoming her teacher. On the day she qualified to become a genin, Fujirou bestowed the girl with the name Yae, with the reason she received the name being unknown to her, and she also inherited his family name, Tenzen.

Fujirou was captivated by Yae's talent and potential as a shinobi to the point that molding her into what he viewed as the very model of an ideal shinobi became an obsession to him. To this end, he arranged the Kodoku, a ritual resembling the Imperial Selection Ceremony in which Yae and thirty other genin were brought to a forest and ordered to fight to the death until a sole victor remained. However, in the end, while Yae had succeeded in victory as he and the other shinobi who came to harbor the same expectations as him they had all hoped, not only did she go on the offensive, choosing to overpower those who came after her instead, but she also permitted the escape of a fellow genin from both the Kodoku and the shinobi village as a whole. This roused the rage of Fujirou and his allies, who resolved themselves to repeat the Kodoku until Yae fulfilled their expectations. As a result, all of them were killed by Yae, with Fujirou's last words to her being that she would overturn the very way of what a shinobi ought to be.

In a twist of fate, Yae grew to be the very opposite of Fujirou's image of an ideal shinobi, distancing herself from that model of her own accord.

intro: Filore (フィルオーレ) is a nun and the Saintess of the Divine Dragon Church, and she is a candidate in the Royal Selection to become the 42nd monarch of the Kingdom of Lugunica. She plays a major supporting role in Arc 10.
appearance: Filore is a young woman who has the characteristic gold hair and crimson red eyes of Lugunica's royal family. She wears the garments of a member of the Divine Dragon Church, which is composed of a dark blue habit with a white chest and shoulders, a long dark blue veil that trails behind her, purple pants, and white boots. She also wears the symbol of the church around her neck.
personality:
Filore has displayed a dignified demeanor that is capable of shocking numerous political figures, including members of the Council of Wise Men and various civil officials. She has also shown to be used to dealing with such treatment, implied to be due in part to her appearance, which bears resemblance to the royal family. Likewise, when dealing with business matters, she mostly speaks in a friendly business-like manner, and even if she has personal opinions regarding certain matters, she will set those opinions aside in order not to be sidetracked or distracted from her original purpose. This being said, she also tends to act impulsively and is easily swayed by her emotions, leading her to act on her own without informing others in her impatience, is somewhat airheaded and rather childish, something which is believed to stem from her sheltered upbringing and isolation from the world, craves to see the outside world due to this upbringing, is the type to never overlook any problem which is presented to her and completely destroys any plans she has for the day, and she seems to have a habit of reading from her scripture, whether to pass the time or to make excuses for whenever she is caught by her colleagues when she acts on her own. She has even recognized that she has a habit of becoming too impassioned when she speaks, especially when it comes to helping others, and she is bad enough at lying that most others can see right through her and become suspicious of her. She is also uncomfortable in silence, and when exposed to it, she will try to find a way to fill that silence. Despite all of this, she is also trusting of other people, and she is willing to put her faith in someone even when others, including the person themself, tell them it is not a good idea to do so, and she is willing to attempt to restore said person's honor, as she believes that a person's past should not dull contributions in the present, and that there would be many opportunities for said person to save the lives of others that wouldn't have been saved otherwise.

Filore has a strong will to help others, which has led her to losing her patience with the church's inactivity and acting without informing the church. Filore is somewhat free-spirited. Even after learning that she had the qualifications to be involved in the Royal Selection, appeared to ignore it, and she could even be seen playing around with children while showing off the glowing Dragon Insignia. However, she is quick to fluster when she's caught doing so. Likewise, because of her hasty and reckless nature, she is able to sympathize with someone like Natsuki Subaru, who had also made similar mistakes. Due to her circumstances, she was bereft of friends growing up, and when she finally made her first friend in Emilia, she quickly became attached, clingy, prone to jealousy, even towards people she seems to get along with, like Subaru, and pouty towards people who separate her from her. Similarly, this leads her to speak with a slightly yandere quality when concerning Emilia's attention, and it is believed that it was due to her desire for friends being overly directed at a single person due to having never had a friend before. Likewise, she became quick to sneak out of the church and search for her and complain to her about not wanting to be in the Royal Selection, even being willing to, at most, use her position to back Emilia and help her reach the throne instead. This being said, after being lightly rebuked by Emilia and told her perspective of why the candidates are participating in the Royal Selection, Filore gathered her resolve to participate as well, claiming that she wanted to strengthen the bond between the church and the nation by participating so as to allow the church and the castle to extend their hands without the hesitance caused by formality.

Filore is friendly and determined by nature, with someone such as Heinkel believing that she has an innate goodness that harbors no ulterior motives, and her core attributes, which can mobilize her surroundings just by speaking her desires, are such that her knight has recognized them as a core trait of the Lugunican Royal Family. Filore is also very bold and refuses to give up when the situation calls for it. During the events surrounding the Royal Selection, when all of her attempts to visit Emilia and Felt and to heal the victims of the Battle for Priestella were effectively rejected by both the castle and the church, Filore chose to work against both parties involved, whether it meant losing her position as a Saintess of the church and a Royal Selection candidate, in order to bust the two captive candidates out of the castle. She is willing to take the initiative instead of sitting around and praying, believing that doing so would be counterproductive and would make not only others but even herself not believe in her.
history: According to Filore, just over fifteen years ago, when she was a baby, she was abandoned in front of a church, and she has been raised by the Divine Dragon Church ever since.
abilities_text:
Techniques
Sacraments (秘蹟, Hiseki): Filore is capable of using an ability, different from magic, that seems to be tied to the Church and is not to be shown to outsiders, which is capable of countering the effects of curses and supposedly Authorities. With it, she was able to remove the effects of the curse that had plagued Crusch Karsten. According to Filore, whether someone can be healed or not depends on the state of their soul, and there is a chance that there are some people who might not be affected. Either way, by Heinkel's observation, based on the way it seems to work, it appears capable of "reaching for the unreachable". Using it seems to visibly fatigue Filore, and though it is unclear if it is related to the fatigue she felt or due to the secrecy involved with them, but she was told that she should not use the Sacraments too much.

Intelligence
Keen Observation: Despite her usual airheadedness, Filore is very observant. Throughout her visits to the castle, she noticed the way the knights moved, the layout of the castle floors, and various other factors and used it to make a map of the castle in preparation for a breakout.

Equipment
Scripture: Filore carries around with her scripture from the Church, which she can be seen reading from at times.

intro: Edmon Quayle (エドモン・クウェイル) is the representative of the town council in Limbus.
appearance: Edmon is a man in his late thirties with a carefully trimmed moustache and an unusual atmosphere to him. He attempts to present himself with neatness and style. Toward the end of the conspiracies in Limbus, his arm was charred. It is unclear if he lost his arm or if remains on him, severely injured.
history:
At an unknown point in time, Edmon had affairs with two women from Limbus, which resulted in the births of his daughters Mireille Hetia and Nananna Pezza. In order to cover it up, he had them banished from Limbus. One day, because of an illness that had taken hold of Limbus, numerous people found their lives in danger, but thanks to an elderly healer coming up with an appropriate medicine, lives were saved and the illness vanished. However, a rumor declared that she started the illness in order to provide the solution and increase her reputation. She was then declared a Witch and burned to death. Following the healer's death, the council members began to get rid of anyone the council considered inconvenient, including the noble who had once taken the healer's cure, and they declared it the response of a Witch, resulting in the subsequent Witch Hunts. At some point around this time, Mireille was appointed to be a subordinate to a government official in Limbus, where she learned of the healer's execution, and she began committing murders with her spiritual arts in the town against relatives of the council members. Later, Nananna was sent to deal with the strange killings in Limbus, where, having heard about the execution of the elderly healer as well, Nananna conspired with Mireille to bring down their father and the people of Limbus for their transgressions, with Mireille getting rid of any other officials who came to the town.

Witch Trials
One night, the Omega Party arrived in Limbus and were nearly declared Witches and attacked. However, thanks to Nananna, they were freed of suspicion, and they were allowed to assist in that night's Witch Hunt for a man named Piditz, who had been tipped off to be a Witch. Unfortunately, he was killed by Mireille, and because Omega was found near the body, she was declared a Witch and arrested. Later, Colette visits Omega, and they point out that killings began before the party arrived, which should clear Omega's name, but instead, Mireille decides to have her executed anyway, and Palmyra objects to Edmon. Later, as part of the plan to free Omega of suspicion, Noelle Tuérico joined Nananna, who had been speaking with Edmon about finding Piditz.

The next day, the Witch Trial is being held for Omega, overseen by Nananna and the Town Hall, while Palmyra acts as Omega's attorney. Despite her arguments, Edmon countered with his supposed knowledge of the Witches and Omega's chatter does not help. Colette speaks up and claims that she believes that things will not go as the council claims, as people will begin to notice that the entire event seems off, which resounds with the townsfolk. Because of this, Palmyra claims that there is a conspiracy, which Edmon fights against and asks for Nananna's assistance. Because she sides with the town, Lilac and Shion believe her to be part of the conspiracy, and they decide to use their dream arts to influence the people's mental states. Palmyra then claims that the council is using the Witch rumors to get rid of inconvenient people, which Edmon also fights against, though is quickly silenced when she states she heard it herself from a council member and declares that there is no Witch. Unfortunately, Omega claims otherwise.

Despite angering Palmyra, Omega decides to clear things up by declaring that there were two conspiracies taking place in town. Despite Nananna trying to prevent her from talking, Omega quickly ignores her and explains that many of the victims were relatives of council members, and she claims that Nananna is the second conspirator, calling her the bastard child of Edmon whose mother was banished from the town, and as a result, she despised the town. Noelle later appears and confirms that her actions were in response to the death of the elderly healer, and she claims that Nananna tried to remove her from the trial by knocking her out since her only ire was with Limbus. Afterward, Noelle declares that the secretary, Mireille, was helping Nananna, as she was a bastard child of Edmon as well, and she stated how the corpses of Piditz and other people connected to the council and other outside officials were already dumped in a hole. Omega also declares that she witnessed Mireille killing Piditz. Enraged, Mireille uses her spiritual arts to char Edmon's arm with blue fire, and with the intent of killing the entire council, surrounds the council with blue fire, and she and Nananna stand against them. Although Omega is fine with leaving things as they are and taking their leave, Colette states she doesn't want things to end like this, and Omega decides to end the fighting in response to her plea, burning through her restraints and declaring herself a Witch. Later, as Omega's party begins to leave the town, it is claimed that Edmon's position is under threat with both his severe injuries and the loss of the citizens' trust.
