intro: Leip Barielle (ライプ・バーリエル) was a baron, Priscilla Barielle's former husband, and the Dragon History Stone's former administrator. Once a triumphant yet conceited commander during the Demi-Human War, he sought to gain control over the Kingdom of Lugunica after his failures in the civil war's Battle of Aihiya Swamp disgraced his name.
appearance: Leip was an older man with a honed build, slicked back hair, and a moustache. He wore clothes befitting that of nobility. Despite being in his seventies, Leip possessed an energetic body and ambition-filled eyes that reflected the age of someone who was in their fifties.
personality: Leip was known to be a strict person to himself as well as to others and was considered to be a competent commander. An ambitious man, he desired to seize the throne of Lugunica for himself and would take any steps necessary to achieve his goal. For example, in an attempt to further his goals, once the inscriptions of the Dragon History Stone revealed the process of the Royal Selection, he found Priscilla before the royal family died and conspired to make her into a mindless puppet he could control. Despite this, he experienced a deep-seated pathological distrust and paranoia of other people, and as a result of this, he prepared contingencies for any possible outcome, creating hidden passageways in his mansions and having hidden hideouts within his domain, such as the abandoned house Sphinx was held in. Because of his self-centered personality, he was not very well liked among his vassals and citizens who struggled under his rulership, and likewise, he was disliked by his subordinates as a commander in the Demi-Human War. He was a ruthless, cunning, and arrogant man who was almost always one step ahead of everyone in his ambition and always sought to remove any thorns in his side.
history:
Sword Demon Love Song
Around 43 years before the events of Arc 1, in the midst of the Demi-Human War, Leip served as a successful commander on the battlefield at the age of thirty. However, he was disliked by his subordinates for his cruelty. Upon meeting Wilhelm Trias, he struck the young man for perceived insubordination. During the Battle of Aihiya Swamp, the Royal Army suffered catastrophic losses due to the enemy's magic circles. As the commander, the failure of the battle was pinned on Leip, and he was branded by some as a war criminal. Although he tried to restore his honor, not only did his actions of tyranny against his subordinates come back to haunt him, but he was also accused of murdering the previous commander, Crumère, leading to the denial of his protests. As punishment for the devastating loss, he was stripped from his position as a viscount and became a baron.

By the time of the Invasion of the Royal Castle, Leip would be relegated to the role of a castle guard. After encountering three of the Zergev Squadron's most notable members, Bordeaux Zergev, Grimm Fauzen, and Wilhelm Trias, he was initially apprehensive towards them and doubted their claim that the Demi-Human Alliance's leaders were about to attack the castle. Before he could reject the trio from entering the castle, Roswaal J. Mathers arrived to join the three of them with Carol Remendis, and she forced Leip to step aside by floundering her rank over him. Soon encountering a few demi-humans who attempted to enter the building, Leip would accordingly chase them down to the underground sewers to finish them off. However, he encountered Sphinx in the sewers, and seizing an opportunity for him to take advantage of, he incapacitated her and took a necklace with a ring in her possession. Shortly afterwards, Leip would encounter Roswaal again, who was pursuing the escaping Witch, and lie about her death. After giving Roswaal the necklace and being left by himself, Leip would subsequently take Sphinx's body and keep her alive for his own ambition.

The Dream the Lion King Saw
Many years later, Leip was entrusted by the Lugunican royal family to have the responsibility of administrating the Dragon History Stone. Having read the stone's inscription regarding the existence of the Royal Selection before the royal family ever succumbed to their sickness, he used the information about the prophecy to his advantage. He searched for a candidate and found Priscilla, who had lived in Lugunica for several years. With the ambition to seize the throne in the Royal Selection through her, he married Priscilla prior to the announcement of the Royal Selection and attempted to introduce her as the first candidate following the royal family's purported extinction, pretending that the inscription detailing the was brand new. However, after revealing the existence of the Royal Selection to the nobility, Crusch Karsten was discovered as the first candidate before Leip's scheme could be realized.

Priscilla's Cheers for Me, Entertainment Part
Leip rigged a tournament for her to find a knight to have in the selection. She was originally to choose from among the top four, not knowing that in reality the contest had been fixed and all of them were his pawns in order to be used control her unpredictable behavior. However, Priscilla picked a man named Aldebaran, who had made his way to the top four himself, botching part of Leip's machinations yet again. After this event, he would review his plan to take over Priscilla's body with Sphinx. In addition, before his incapacitation and eventual death, he hired Yae Tenzen.

The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star
As a way to rectify the issue with the knight tournament later, Leip brought Gilian Endymion to replace Al and to later use him in his plot to make Priscilla into a puppet after the opening ceremony of the selection. However, Schult objected to this idea, and Leip attempted to kill him as a result. Thanks to a change of heart caused by Leip's cruelty and his lack of desire to work for a "geezer" who could not see Priscilla how he did, Al used his ability to break the old man's mind, foiling his plans in the end. Leip eventually died sometime before the beginning of the Royal Selection, and as a result, Priscilla assumed his authority and land.
abilities_text:
Military Prowess: In his younger days, despite the unsavory rumors surrounding him, Leip was a successful and capable commander who boasted a record of success until the Battle of Aihiya Swamp. He trained his body diligently, allowing him to be powerful enough to catch Wilhelm off-guard, and could have potentially even rivalled Bordeaux in combat prowess. He retained his honed training of his body up until his death.

Magic (魔法, Mahō): Leip could use fire magic.
Goa (ゴーア): Leip could manifest a blaze of fire to incinerate foes.

Equipment: Leip had a short tube-shaped meteor which amplified the power of his spells.

intro: Mimi Pearlbaton (ミミ・パールバトン) is one of Anastasia Hoshin's followers and is one of the three vice captains of the mercenary group known as the Iron Fang. She plays a supporting role in Arc 3 and Arc 5.
appearance: Mimi has aqua green eyes and long orange hair which she ties into two tails. She has orange cat ears along with a tail and wears a white robe. After the Battle for Priestella, she received a large scar on her chest from when she defended Garfiel from Theresia van Astrea.
personality:
Mimi has a bright and optimistic personality with straightforward intentions. Unlike her brothers, she talks in third person. She typically acts like a child, often causing problems for her brothers Hetaro and Tivey. She considers the other members of the Iron Fang to be family and loves them, referring to Ricardo as their father, though as it's her own unique way of loving others it tends to cause problems especially for her brothers.

Mimi is one of the few people who never had any intentions of betraying or killing Natsuki Subaru throughout the series. As of the beginning of Arc 5, she has developed feelings for Garfiel, leading her to drag him around Priestella and claim to "feel weird" while blushing when he patted her head.

Mimi has shown a matured and rational side to her, offering to comfort the crying Garfiel after the latter found out about his mother’s amnesia, as well as suggesting to the feisty Garfiel that they should escape rather than engage Theresia and Kurgan head-on.
history:
Early Life
Sometime in the past, Mimi, Hetaro, and Tivey were abandoned by their parents. When they were two, Tivey was about to be kidnapped. Mimi attempted to fight off the kidnappers, but she was stabbed four times in the process, and Hetaro was also injured. As they were running away, they ran into Roshi Pearlbaton, who healed them, and after taking them in, he taught them how to survive.

Kararagi Girl Meets Cats and Kararagi Girl & Cat's Eye
Mimi and Hetaro attempted to rescue Anastasia, but they were incidentally captured instead by Razcrew. Razcrew planned to sell them on the slave markets in the north of Kararagi. However, his plan was thwarted, and he ended up being enslaved himself. Before Ricardo could meet his end by Shiroro, Mimi quickly rescued him, the fight ended in a draw, as Shiroro did not intend to involve harming children. After the fight, she and Ricardo stopped and defeated Reisel. After the defeat of Reisel, Anastasia vowed that if anything happened to Roshi, she would take the Pearlbatons under her care.

Eventually, Roshi made a kamikaze attack while on a mission, blowing up with an enemy in the process. A funeral was held for him, and Mimi cried afterwards, which only Anastasia knew. Ever since, the siblings have lived with the Iron Fang under Anastasia and Ricardo's care.

Joshua Juukulius's Careful Encyclopedia
As Mimi, Hetaro, and Tivey had entered his room the moment they realized that there was food, Joshua Juukulius, who was honored to have finally been chosen to do something for Anastasia, was concerned that he had to act as a messenger to invite Emilia to Priestella, nervous and somewhat fearful of her due to her race and the rumors of her appearance being a match for the Witch of Envy. However, Mimi declared that Emilia wasn't scary, and recalling that Hetaro and Tivey had interacted with the Emilia Camp for the Subjugation of the White Whale and the Subjugation of Sloth, he asked for their opinions. While Tivey claimed that Emilia didn't seem to be scary, Hetaro declared that he only ever talked with her knight, Natsuki Subaru, someone else that Joshua had heard rumors and was wary of, as his origins were unknown and he had no known power. He also recalled the other worrisome rumors about the camp, which only increased his worries, and then, he went ask Anastasia about her intentions directly.

Mimi Pearlbaton's Chomp of Love and Passion
After arriving at Roswaal Manor to invite the Emilia Camp to Priestella, Mimi, who saw Garfiel for the first time, was entranced by him, and she asked for his name while introducing herself. He introduced himself, but she ended up dropping her staff on his foot, and Ram appeared to tell him not to leave their guests standing at the entrance. Taking a liking to calling him Garf, they were invited inside, and Mimi recalled what Roshi had once told her about the feelings she felt after seeing Garfiel. While she was waiting with Joshua inside and acting like she was trying to stay serious, she couldn't take her eyes off of Garfiel, causing him to ask what if something was wrong. Red-faced, Mimi ran away, and Ram scolded the guys for being inconsiderate.

Kararagi Reaper Incident
Sometime after the Battle for Priestella, the Pearlbatons returned to Banan in Kararagi. However, at some point after the events of the Great Disaster, the Slasher, Zarestia set a windstorm on the town, destroying half of it and raising everyone in town sans Ricardo into the sky - an event that would be remembered as the Shinigami Disaster. Believing Ricardo to have stolen her Light Sphere, the two confronted each other, worrying the Pearlbatons. However, after withstanding all of her attacks, she stopped attacking him, made the windstorm dissipate, and lowered everyone to the ground. Sometime after Ricardo quelled Zarestia's rage, Anastasia's group arrived and were led by Mimi to the holding cells in Riften Magoji's mansion, where Zarestia was being held. During their conversation, Anastasia learned that Riften had gone missing, Julius noticed that Zarestia was a Great Spirit and introduced himself, and Halibel unintentionally riled her up by noticing her strange constitution, that something was missing. However, when Anastasia mentioned Zarestia being responsible for other such town-destroying wind cataclysms, Zarestia declared otherwise, saying that she only rampaged in Banan. Shortly afterward, this is confirmed when a massive tornado appeared outside of Banan, not made by Zarestia. After giving her orders and securing Zarestia's assistance, the group made their way to stop the tornado. Although they managed to quell the winds, however, they soon realized that Anastasia and Echidna had gone missing.
abilities_text:
Overall Abilities
Despite her size, Mimi is capable of combat, and she is said to be the strongest between the Pearlbaton siblings. She is at least adept enough in combat to defend from particularly skilled corpse soldiers for a short time alongside another strong warrior. The full extent of her strength, however, is unknown.

Divine Protection
Divine Protection of Trisection (三分の加護 Sanbun no Kago): Her Divine Protection, which she uses in conjunction with her brothers Hetaro and Tivey, enables them to bear each other's physical and emotional burdens and can also be used to split damage between them such as to block death blows. However, as Mimi is the strongest out of the three, her brothers are often stuck with bearing her burdens. In addition, they can launch a destructive interference wave using the Divine Protection and the other siblings, though Mimi is limited to five times and Hetaro and Tivey are limited to two times, so the maximum usage per day is four times.

Magic
Mimi has a natural affinity for the earth attribute, and she is capable of using both earth and water magic. Though it is unclear how adept she is with her magic, she is at least capable of conjuring earthen walls, healing injuries, and creating barriers.

Spells:
thumb|250px
Healing Magic (治癒魔法): Mimi can use a simple application of healing magic to heal the wounds of herself and others. She used this during the battle against the White Whale to heal soldiers' wounds.
Multi-barrier: Mimi is capable of producing a dual-layered, wind-based barrier that can block physical attacks. However, the barriers can be shattered with sufficient force, as in the case of Theresia van Astrea.

Other

Roaring Wave (咆哮波, Hōkōha): The triplets unleash a burst of a violent destructive mana from their mouths together. Only two of the three of them can do it at a time. This ability was learned from Ricardo as he is the originator of that ability.

Equipment
Staff: Mimi, like her brothers, carries a staff with her.

intro: Miklotov McMahon (マイクロトフ・マクマホン) is the representative of the Council of Wise Men who are currently ruling over the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. Many have considered Miklotov to be the true brains of the Kingdom who, in the event that the royal family were to disappear, would be a suitable replacement ruler. He played a supporting role in the Sword Demon Trilogy and The Travelogue of the Finest, and a minor supporting role in The Dream the Lion King Saw. He also plays a role in Arc 10.
appearance: Miklotov has long white hair and a long white beard that nearly touches the ground. The glimmer in his eyes has been compared to the sharpness of a blade. He is short and wears the robes of a member of the Council of Wise Men. Roughly 40 years before the events of the main story, Miklotov had grey hair and was a gentle-looking man with mischievous yet intellectual-looking eyes and a warm presence.
personality: Miklotov is a highly intelligent and perceptive man, which he displayed when he quickly realized the true intentions behind Roswaal and Puck's performance during the Royal Selection, which even the other members of the Council of Wise Men hadn't. He is also a believer in the qualities of the Lion King, having asked Fourier's teacher to check if he had the qualities of one, though the teacher failed to notice Fourier's potential.
history:
At some point in the past, Miklotov was familiar with Emerada Lugunica and knew of her ability as a Lion King before her death.

Sword Demon Trilogy
During the era of the Demi-Human War, Miklotov played a vital role, greatly assisting the Royal Family as a trusted advisor of King Gionis Lugunica. He went to great lengths in order to help his friends or people he respected. When Valga Cromwell was captured, he was held in Miklotov's own manor. Gionis frequently made visits to Miklotov's manor to speak to Cromwell in this period. After Wilhelm returned to the Royal Capital and was intent on finding a way to rejoin the military and allow Theresia to retire, he spoke with Miklotov, who warned him that allowing the latter would be difficult, leading Wilhelm to drag the king into his mess. Afterward, the two oversaw his battle with the Zergev Squadron, and afterward, they informed Wilhelm of the deal that Theresia had made with the king prior about Wilhelm and Theresia being wed to remove her as the Sword Saint. Three months later, Miklotov was the one to officiate their wedding.

In the months following the end of the Demi-Human War, Stride Vollachia launched a series of terrorist attacks, targeting the city of Picoutatte, the Astrea manor, and the McMahon manor. Though Miklotov himself was away during the attack, several of his guards were killed during the event. Many years later, Cromwell escaped his imprisonment through unknown means.

The Dream the Lion King Saw
Not much is known about Miklotov's actions in the following four decades. However, roughly 17 years before the events of the main story, Miklotov spent his days counselling Fourier Lugunica, the youngest Prince of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. After the entire Royal Family perished, he, as well as other select members of the Council of Wise Men, took control of the Kingdom, assuming the highest authority in the nation.

The Travelogue of the Finest
Roughly 3–4 months before the events of the main story, Miklotov, alongside Bordeaux Zergev went on a diplomatic mission to the neighboring Sacred Vollachia Empire. They were accompanied by the Sword Saint, the Blue, and the Finest of Knights. Following their failed negotiations with the Emperor of the Vollachia Empire, the diplomats were situated in one of the guest rooms, located in the Crystal Palace in the Imperial Capital of Lupugana. After an alleged kidnapping of the Emperor, orchestrated by the three Royal Knights, both Miklotov and Bordeaux were held hostage in their room, not being permitted to venture outside. After the dispute was settled, they signed a non-aggression pact between the Kingdom and the Empire, marking their mission as a success.

relatives: Leilani Alnair (mother) ; Roy Alphard (brother) ; Rui Arneb (younger sister) ; Unnamed father (deceased)
magic: Water Magic ; Fire Magic ; Wind Magic ; Likely other types as well
intro: Lye Batenkaitos (ライ・バテンカイトス) is a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing the Gourmet aspect of Gluttony. First introduced in the Arc 3 interludes, he later served as a major antagonist in Arc 5 and one of the main antagonists of Arc 6, alongside his brother and sister.
appearance:
Lye Batenkaitos stood at four feet and eleven inches tall, making him a fairly short youth, the same height as his younger brother. Like his siblings, he appeared to be roughly twelve or thirteen years of age with a high-pitched voice that denoted his apparent youthfulness. He has straight, unkempt dark brown hair with red tips, and it trails down to his knees, falling over his face in a way that obscured his right eye. His diminutive and slender physique had a surprising amount of musculature to it, and his dark skin was littered with a multitude of grotesque scars that varied from whip to bite marks. His limbs are also covered in dirt and grime. His most distinctive facial features were his repulsive emerald green eyes and fang-like sharp teeth that usually formed a sadistic smile.

Like most other Sin Archbishops, Lye's clothing deviated from the religious black habit worn by most Witch Cultists. Much like his body, the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony's clothing was tattered and dirty. His primary piece of clothing was a skin-tight purple bodysuit that exposed his arms, bare feet, and chest and had horizontal pink stripes across it. Over the top of his bodysuit, he wore a tattered black cloak with red patterns that reached down to the ground. A pair of Witch Cult daggers were strapped to his forearms that served as his primary weapons.

In Arc 5, Lye fully showed off his body, revealing a multitude of grotesque and horrid wounds, ranging from whip marks to bite and scratch marks. He gave off an unnatural and bizarre aura; completely opposite from what you would expect from a child.

After utilizing Solar Eclipse and breaking out of his shell, Lye took on a more monstrous and distorted appearance; an amalgamation of most of his victims. One could see body parts of Neiji Lockhart, Beli Hainelga, Dorkell, Rem, and numerous others. His limbs were of different length, his head was of distorted proportions with a part of it belonging to Dorkell, part of it resembled Rem's, and so on. Lye himself was unaware of this change.
personality:
Lye believed that everything came down to experiences and the one who manages to get better knowledge is the one who enriches his life and wins over people. Remarking that knowledge is power and memories are bonds, he ultimately concluded that it meant that he and his philosophy were the greatest. Because of that, Lye focused on the quality of the lives he ate, often giving his opponents a chance to "prove" themselves as worthy meals before ultimately eating them and claiming their abilities for himself with his Authority of Gluttony, which befitted his title of Gourmet.

Unlike Roy, Lye strongly believed that if the number of lives in the world is limited, then the amount of worthy food is limited, and so he would not miss a single chance to eat someone. Due to their differences in how they approached eating, Lye held distaste for Roy's way of fighting, thinking that just trying to eat anything would lead to the loss a "gourmet" platter. Lye also showed to look out for Rui, pointing out how she may be happy if he was to eat Otto, Felt, and Dynas, though he would ultimately abandon her for himself if put in danger. Although his past with his siblings is unclear, Lye seemed to show a strong dislike towards merchants.

Lye remarked how Subaru was his "savior", as he is able to remember the people who have gotten their names eaten and pointing out how the forgotten feelings of rage and revenge were a source of dissatisfaction for him, but Subaru was an exception. Upon being confronted by Ram within the Pleiades Watchtower, Lye attempted to eat her, believing that both his desire to devour her and the gluttony that he felt were the ultimate form of love, and he directed his warped love toward Ram up to his very end.

Additionally, Lye spoke in a collective manner using us and we instead of first or third person. When he used Solar Eclipse and changed his form into a person that he had ate, Lye took on the mannerisms and way of speaking that they previously had.
history:
Early Life
Due to the young age of the Gluttony siblings, they were assumedly born less than two decades prior to the beginning of the story. As one of the three children of the previous Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, Leilani Alnair, Lye and his two siblings were kept in the womb by their mother for over three years through sheer force of will. After Leilani conquered the Augria Sand Dunes and became the first person to arrive at the Pleiades Watchtower in hundreds of years, she attempted to overwrite Shaula's memories with her Authority, causing the Star Keeper to shoot a white light through her chest and subsequently eject her from the tower. The shot was presumably responsible for killing one of her unborn triplets, this being Rui, and Leilani was later found by a man with medical knowledge who ascertained that one of her children had died, but the other two were alive. Against Leilani's own wishes, her two surviving children, Lye and Roy, were saved and delivered, and she died a few moments after they were born. Following Leilani's death, Rui's soul somehow persisted in the Corridor of Memories without being subjected to the soul filtering process, and the three siblings inherited their mother's Witch Factor of Gluttony.

Lye bears numerous scars that litter his body, which may indicate that his life prior to becoming a Sin Archbishop was rough and brutal. Likewise, he also seems to have a history with merchants, judging by the grudge and harsh view he seems to bear toward them. At some point after becoming a Sin Archbishop, Lye met his sister Rui when she used Solar Eclipse to take over Roy’s body. It can be implied that the same can be said vice versa, as both brothers are aware of her.

Joshua Juukulius's Careful Second Encyclopedia
In Priestella, as the Witch Cult's attack began, Lye was attacking guards before confronting Joshua Juukulius, who had stepped in his way when Lye was about to attack a defenseless woman. Though the woman got away, Lye was more interested in Joshua, and he decided to devour his name and memories instead.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Due to his vast collection of abilities given to him through the use of his Authority, Lye is among the most skilled of martial artists in the world, capable of fighting and outclassing most warriors by using a wide variety of physical techniques, magic, and other such abilities alongside his Authority, which could also allow him to instantly defeat any number of strong warriors so long as he touched them and knew their names. What makes him even more dangerous is that, due to the unique aspect of his Authority, he had gone completely unheard until his ability was recognized after the events of Arc 3, meaning that he is not only strong, but he was also more than capable of escaping his enemies without anyone realizing exactly who or what he was.

Authority
Lye was one of the previous holders of the Witch Factor of Gluttony and could use its respective Authority, which granted him powers relating to consuming the memories, names, and souls connected to Od Lagna's Register of Names and replicating their abilities for himself.

thumb|right|250px|Lye using the Authority of Gluttony to eat the name and memories of Hicks Hartmann.
Gluttony (暴食, Bōshoku): Lye could eat the name and memories of his opponent. To eat a name, he had to touch them with his left hand, then licked the palm of the same hand as well as chant their full name. Things such as experience, talent, and the likes and dislikes of human relationships served as food for him, allowing him to take advantage of any and all abilities or memories his opponents had. Likewise, he can choose whether or not to eat only names, only memories, or both, though Roy claims that it difficult and is like trying to eat only the ingredients in a sandwich without removing the buns. However, if Lye eats a fake name, or if he attempts to eat the previous name of a person who has managed to change their name, such as through marriage or adoption, he becomes plagued with severe nausea. Similarly, attempting to devour the name and memories of someone with a soul too large and powerful puts Lye at the risk being taken over by said spirit, as seen when his brother devoured the name of Reid Astrea. It is possible for Lye to regurgitate the names and memories that he's devoured. According to Roy, anything that the siblings eat goes to the same Stomach of Souls (魂の胃袋, Tamashī no Ibukuro), from which they can share and pull the same names and memories that their siblings have eaten. Lye claimed that he did not share everything he ate with the others, indicating the possibility that he may have kept some of the names and memories he plundered for himself, but following his death, Roy has since exercised the main three techniques employed by his brother.
Those that had their names eaten had their existences erased from the world, destroying any human relationships along with negating any contracts with spirits. Not even the people closest to them could remember a single thing about them.
Those that had their memories eaten became amnesic and any characteristics they may have had are reset, effectively making them into a different person.
Those that had both their name and memories eaten simply became a shell, and although they were alive, they no longer ate, excreted waste, or aged, putting them in suspended animation.
Lye could not eat the same person twice until that individual gained enough new memories to establish a different sense of self from their old one.
Lye could not eat the names or memories of non-humanoid beings, such as different animals, witchbeasts, or earth dragons.

Eclipse (蝕, Shoku): Eclipse was considered to be the trump card of Gluttony and it also had two types; Solar Eclipse and Lunar Eclipse.
thumb|200px|Lye using Dorkell's, Beli's, and Neiji's skills via Lunar Eclipse.
Lunar Eclipse (月食, Gesshoku): This allowed the holder to use their victims' memories and harvest their skills and knowledge. Lye used Lunar Eclipse to boost his physical strength and perform numerous techniques, including Palm of the Fist King and Leaper. However, Lye cannot bring forth the true potential of techniques in this manner, only being granted a portion of the technique's power. It is worth noting that by eating a person's name and using Lunar Eclipse, Lye did not gain his victims' Divine Protections, spiritual arts, or Authorities. On top of that, Lye could also combine any number of memories and skills which would in turn allow him to create any sort of synthesized super-class technique he desired.
Solar Eclipse (日食, Nisshoku): This allows the holder to harvest their victims' name and transform their appearance accordingly. Rui, for example, transformed into Neiji Lockhart and numerous other victims she and her two brothers had eaten throughout the years using her sibling's body. By doing so, though he became limited in the number of techniques he could use, the techniques that belong to those who Lye had transformed into can achieve their full potential. Originally, Lye never used Solar Eclipse as he didn't like the side effects of morphing into his victims; according to him, he felt like he was losing himself. After his fierce battle with Ram however, Lye was forced to use Solar Eclipse to morph into Dorkell in order to escape certain death and effectively overcame his fear of using the aforementioned Solar Eclipse by finding a way to retain his own sense of self. Following that incident, Lye freely started using both Solar and Lunar Eclipse, greatly amplifying his fighting strength as by morphing into the original owner of a specific skill he planned on using, the effect will be much greater; by morphing into Dorkell, Lye was able to leap much farther, and by morphing into Neiji Lockhart, the Palm of the First King was much more devastating.

Life Creation: Rui stated she and her brothers can create life with the usage of her Witch Factor of Gluttony, just like how Daphne created the witchbeasts four centuries ago. However, Rui has also stated she and her brothers had no reason to do so, hence they never followed through the idea. While all of this was strictly stated by Rui, it's safe to assume Lye was also capable of creating life through his Witch Factor of Gluttony.
Witchbeast Control: Because Lye, Roy, and Rui each possess the Witch Factor of Gluttony which was previously in Daphne's possession, they could direct witchbeasts to attack certain areas. This was why the White Whale's attacks were coordinated with those of the Witch Cult. In Arc 6, Lye and Roy were able to get to the Pleiades Watchtower in half a day by commanding the witchbeasts in the Augria Sand Dunes and ordered them to attack the Watchtower. The White Whale, as well as, to an extent, the Great Rabbit can obey the Factor holder's will.

Physical Traits/Flow Method

Master Martial Prowess: Through the accumulation of souls eaten with his Authority, Lye gained any abilities his victims once had, such as martial art techniques and weapon skills by using Lunar Eclipse. In turn, this granted him extraordinary combat strength. He was able to overpower multiple strong opponents at once, as shown in Arc 6. According to the author, Lye Batenkaitos is one of the most skilled Sin Archbishops in hand-to-hand combat. 

Techniques
Palm of the Fist King (拳王の掌, Ken Ō no Tenohira): Palm of the Fist King allowed Lye to strike his opponents with an extremely powerful fist, and its destructive force granted him the capability to blast and drill through steel or flesh. This ability originally belonged to Neiji Lockhart.

Carnivorous Beast (肉食獣, Nikushoku-jū): Carnivorous Beast allowed Lye to strengthen his body and gave him two advantages: he could withstand powerful attacks and strengthen his limbs to deliver devastating blows. With this ability, he was able take a hit from Emilia's ice spear and come out unscathed, then deliver a retaliating punch that, from Subaru's perspective, would be as devastating as getting hit by a car. This ability originally belonged to Beli Hainelga.

thumb|250px|Lye using Leaper against Rem.
Leaper (跳躍者, Chōyaku-sha): Leaper allowed Lye to use a short-range teleportation in quick succession, essentially allowing him to "leap" behind his opponents or avoid extremely precise and quick attacks. He was also capable of utilizing it vertically, making it appear as if he's flying. This ability originally belonged to Dorkell.

Magic
Like with his hand-to-hand skills, Lye was able to utilize various magic abilities after eating people with his Authority. However, this does not affect his mana pool, meaning that he may not be able to use any spell to its fullest potential depending on their respective mana consumptions.

Spells:
Huma (ヒューマ): Lye created a shining water barrier that blocked other projectiles and sorts of magic. However, if the incoming magic was stronger than the shield it would get through it and damage Lye.
El Huma (エル・ヒューマ): Lye formed and shot multitudes of ice spikes from his hands which easily pierced through human flesh and immediately vanished on impact.

Unique Spells:

Ice Brand Arts (アイスブランドアーツ): During the events of Arc 6, Lye replicated Emilia's Ice Brand Arts. This technique allowed Lye to instantly conjure ice made weapons which he could use and freely manipulate in close-quarters combat. Lye could even conjure weapons known only in Subaru's world by pulling from his memories, which he used to recreate a Pile Bunker. The weapons were very sturdy and were even capable of withstanding heat. However, due to the mana cost of using Ice Brand Arts, Lye cannot use it as freely as Emilia can.
Unnamed Invisible Wind Blade Technique: This ability allowed Lye to hide invisible blades made of Wind Magic in a fixed space of his choosing, making them unable to be blown away by even Ram's Wind Magic. He could launch an attack with a wind blade that could cut through a person's clothes and body, and he could jump atop the blades as footing to move through the air with. This ability originally belonged to an unidentified shinobi.

Equipment
thumb|right|100px|Lye's Witch Cult Daggers.
Witch Cult Daggers: Lye skillfully used two standard Witch Cult daggers that were wrapped around his arms. He was able to masterfully deflect extremely precise attacks, block strikes that would shatter any sword and easily overpower even the strongest knights.
Gospel (福音): As a member of the Witch Cult, Lye was the owner of a copy of a Gospel. Each Gospel was a replica of the Book of Wisdom, a book that had been in the possession of the Witch of Greed Echidna. The Book of Wisdom would provide exact details of future events concerning the Witch of Greed, essentially bestowing Echidna with a form of precognition. Unlike the original Book of Wisdom, the Gospels of the Witch Cult were imperfect replicas, meaning that, although they detailed the future of its owner, the events conveyed were subject to change and the information provided was often up for interpretation. The Gospels took the form of small black books that could only be read by their owners.

intro: Minerva (ミネルヴァ) was the Witch of Wrath. She formally debuted in Arc 4 as a supporting character.
appearance:
Minerva was a beautiful young woman who stood at exactly five feet tall. She has been noted to have been in her late teens years and had vivid slightly slanted sky-blue eyes that were almost transparent. Her long gleaming golden hair was tied into a messy ponytail on the left side of her head that rubbed against her face. A pretty pink and blue love heart pin was also fastened to the left side of her head. She had bountiful breasts and a shapely bottom that lent her a fair deal of sex appeal in the eyes of Natsuki Subaru.

Her primary outfit consisted of an extremely short sleeveless form-fitting one-piece purple dress with a cleavage-displaying cut-out, a translucent sleeveless light purple bodysuit worn under all of her clothes, a pair of thigh-high white boots with purple interior, a pair of long white gloves with purple interior, and a long white sleeveless coat with a cleavage-displaying cut-out that allowed a part of her dress-covered breasts to spill out.
personality:
Minerva was a naive and very kind woman, to the point that, according to the author, she was the easiest to fool both among the Witches and in the world overall, and she was regularly being deceived. Because she was so kind, she hated the despicable actions of other people, which included them hurting other living beings, and she openly disliked conflict, regularly lamenting it. Because of this, she became easily frustrated and brought to tears, which she would mistake for anger and use as an excuse for when she began to cry. Minerva does not like watching people get hurt in front of her, watching other be deceived, or someone choosing suicide to run away from what they do not understand, and she will actively interfere when she sees anything of the like, all of which she did for Subaru.

Upon awakening her Authority, she would regularly strike at people and heal them at the same time. She was seen being prideful of her work, and she often acted very hostile by punching people out of nowhere or scolding them for putting their "lives in danger". However, her adorable way of doing so and the notion of helping, made it impossible for people to get offended by her actions. Despite this, although she became aware of the side effects of her Authority causing natural disasters and ending lives elsewhere, because Minerva cared more about healing the people that were in front of her eyes, she completely disregarded the side effects and continued her healing spree. This being said, however, if she encountered someone that she couldn't save or someone with no injuries, she would immediately turn away from them, as she didn't have time to waste, believing that there was no end to the people in the world mourning the pain and suffering they could do nothing about.
history:
At some point in her life, Minerva came into contact with and absorbed the Witch Factor of Wrath. The Witch Factor within her eventually blossomed into the Authority of Wrath, a power that allowed Minerva to heal a person's wounds by striking them. As the possessor of the Witch Factor of Wrath, Minerva was counted among the Witches of Sin, a collection of people who wielded the nine Witch Factors that each correlated to one of the deadly sins. Due to her Witch Factor and her connection to the Witches, Minerva became known as the Witch of Wrath.

In the past, people in the world around Minerva were constantly fighting, which greatly angered her. Eventually, she realized that crying wouldn't solve anything and decided to train herself in order to gain enough power to be a deterrent to fighting, though that still didn't change anything. As she fought, she came to understand that she'd been crying out of rage and not sorrow, causing her to start punching people, resulting in their wounds being healed. From that moment on, she traveled the world to heal people wherever she found people in need. Many nations sent troops after her, trying to capture and/or defeat her, but no one was able to successfully catch her. Furthermore, for reasons unknown, she seems to share some history with Emilia based on her interaction with her, though it is unclear what the connection is.

At some point in the past, Minerva and Daphne found themselves in the same location, where they found themselves in an infinite loop of eating and healing, angering each other. However, the context for why this is is unclear.

It is claimed that over 400 years ago, someone used a larger group of elves as collateral damage in order to trap Minerva. The elves were sent as a suicide squad, and in order to save them, Minerva ran to their rescue and fell under the influence of said trap, where she eventually went mad and subsequently died by the hands of the Witch of Envy. Echidna later located and collected her soul, allowing Minerva to manifest in Echidna's Castle of Dreams, alongside the other Witches of Sin that had perished 400 years ago.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
In terms of sheer power, Minerva is one of the weakest characters in the series. Due to how her Authority works, she is incapable of directly dealing damage. However, despite this, Minerva is still one of the most dangerous characters introduced due to her Authority's side effect, which has given her the highest kill count among the characters introduced in the series.

Authority
thumb|229x229px|Minerva healing Subaru's shattered body with her Authority of Wrath.
Authority of Wrath (憤怒の権能, Fundo no Ken'nō): As the Witch of Wrath, Minerva was a user of the Authority of Wrath and was a compatible holder of its corresponding Witch Factor. Her Authority gave her powers related to healing.
Healing: Minerva's Authority of Wrath allowed her to drain mana directly from the soul of the world to forcibly rewrite cause-and-effect, and by then attacking her desired target, she could heal any living creature. She could also use weapons, whether it is a melee weapon like a knife or a projectile like arrows and bullets, to administer her striking aid; so long as it was an attack made by Minerva, it would heal. Although she was never able to demonstrate it, Minerva's Authority was capable of overcoming the Divine Protection of the Death God used by Theresia van Astrea. and it could even undo the damage done by Typhon's Authority of Pride. Despite this, her Authority worked automatically, meaning she would heal everything even if it wasn't her intention to. The properties of her power meant she couldn't even kill an insect by stepping on it, meaning she literally couldn't hurt a fly. Naturally, this meant that she could not actively kill anyone or anything with her own two hands unless she went out of her way to set up something akin to a pitfall trap, which is technically not an attack by her. This ability had the side effect of taking mana from random places in the world, causing natural disasters to occur and effectively making it so she killed many more people than she saved. It is also important to note that her Authority only works on injuries categorized as wounds. This means her Authority will not cure things such as diseases, cancer, old age, starvation, genetic diseases, mental diseases, curses, or the likes of an Authority focused on transformations, such as Capella Emerada Lugunica's Authority.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
Enhanced Strength: Although incapable of dealing any damage, Minerva still contained enough physical power that her punches could cause the ground beneath her to tremble.

Enhanced Speed: Minerva's increased physical strength allows her to run at great speeds. Although many nations attempted to chase catch her, once she started running, none of them could keep up with her.

intro: Liliana Masquerade (リリアナ・マスカレード) is a bard who is currently associated with Kiritaka Muse. She plays a major role in Arc 5.
appearance: Liliana is a petite, brown skinned woman with bright yellow hair tied in two tails and big round eyes of the same color. She is mentioned to have lively features and wears revealing clothes, an orange cape, and decorates her hair and body with ornaments that use nuts and animal bones.
personality:
Contrary to how she is when she performs, Liliana is shown to be an eccentric person that's constantly excited and her words and actions are mentioned to deviate from the norm. She is interested in famous people, possibly due to her work, and tends to follow new trends. Liliana mentioned herself to be lightheaded and not being made for the mental work. However, she still believes that once she's singing, everyone should be enthusiastic about her and put all their focus on Liliana.

She has a habit of saying “Please listen” before singing, and if she is about to sing a song she has come up with on the spot, she exclaims “Inspiration has flashed”.
history:
Liliana was born in a family of poets. She and her parents were extremely poor, and her parents barely cared about her. She always dreamed of becoming a traveling bard with freedom and independence. 

At the age of thirteen, she decided to run away from home. Her parents barely cared about her leaving, with her father stating that it would result into them having more food, and her mother saying that they could get another kid. But in reality, Liliana saw it as the final gift her parents gave her to support her and sever her connection with them, allowing her to pursue her independence. As she ran away, she could barely get by, and she ended up falling sick after eating bad food. Eventually, she found her talent as a bard with the assistance of her Divine Protection, and she started performing for the public, becoming known as the Songstress. At some point after this, Kiritaka Muse noticed her and became an avid fan of hers.

A Heroic Tale Starting from Zero
Between Arc 2 and Arc 3, she visited Roswaal Manor and played for the Emilia Camp.
abilities_text:
Divine Protection (加護 Kago): Liliana has the Divine Protection of Telepathy (伝心の加護 Denshin no Kago), which enables her to tell other people her thoughts telepathically. While it's normally used to tell close friends certain thoughts, she can combine it with her singing to increase the strength and effect range.
Bard Domain (歌人領域): thumb|250px|Liliana using her Bard Domain to nullify the effect of Sirius's Authority on the citizens of Priestella. According to Liliana in the web novel, the Bard Domain is a place where people's consciousness resides once they are caught within Liliana's singing effect. She used it during the battle against Sirius, to save everyone who was caught by her Soulwashing. However, it's also stated that it is impossible to enter the Bard Domain if she has too many worries or is not concentrating, yet it appeared to be powerful enough to cleanse the Authority of Wrath's effects. The explanation of the Bard Domain was removed in Volume 19, but its effects are still performed when Liliana uses her Divine Protection of Telepathy to take advantage of Sirius's Authority.

Equipment: Liliana performs using a musical instrument known as a lyulyre, which is a cross between a guitar and a ukulele in appearance.

name: Libre Fermi
alias: Poison Snake (毒蛇 Dokuhebi) ; Demi-Human Hero (亜人族の英雄 Ajin-zoku no Eiyū)
intro: Libre Fermi (リブレ・フエルミ) was one of the three leaders of the Demi-Human Alliance during the Demi-Human War. He was an influential warrior who was renowned for his prowess in battle and had a reputation as a hero among demi-humans. He played an antagonistic role in Sword Demon Love Song.
appearance: Libre was a snake human and had a long body with green scales and yellow eyes. He wore a Jiangshi hat, had a black and purple uniform with red ribbons, and carried a twin-bladed weapon with him in combat.
personality:
As the moral heart and center of the Demi-Human Alliance, Libre was one of its most influential leaders. Compared to Valga and Sphinx, Libre sought to use war as a way to force humans to the negotiating table, and not for the destruction of humans or making use of them in experiments. Compared to the extremes of Valga and Sphinx, Libre sought the middle ground of compromise. During his time with the pair, Libre realized that if the Alliance lost the war, it would be because Valga could not quell his rage.

Libre was an honorable man who detested unnecessary violence or the desecration of dead humans and demi-humans alike. Among the three leaders in the Demi-Human Alliance, Libre was the one who wanted to reconcile with Lugunica the most. However, he believed that he needed to embody the anger of demi-humans, so he went against his wishes and chose to fight. He also enjoyed fighting strong opponents and held commend for warriors that could make him bleed and weep. With his high appreciation for warriors, he recognized Wilhelm' strong vitality, sought to give him a painless death, and promised to put a flower on the Sword Demon's grave out of respect for the boy's abilities. In addition, he chose to behave femininely, speaking in a feminine style and being willing to take on the role of something like a mother figure for other people.
history:
While Libre's early history is unknown, he saved Valga Cromwell from slavery in the past. He became Valga's friend, teacher, and mother figure before the Demi-Human War. 

Sword Demon Love Song
As one of the leaders of the Demi-Human Alliance, Libre fought side by side with Valga under a shared purpose of advancing the rights of demi-humans, despite their different goals. The situation between the two changed when Valga found and brought Sphinx into their ranks. As the Witch's methods started to become increasingly questionable, Libre began to grow estranged from Valga over the his support for her. Although Libre continued to argue with Valga and was threatened with death by Sphinx, he continued to work alongside them, as they were indispensable to the Alliance's success. Before dying, Libre entrusted his copy of a glintstone that was necessary for entering Sphinx's Testing Grounds to Cragrell Dawson, the third leader of the Demi-Human Alliance.

At the Battle of Aihiya Swamp, Libre ambushed the Zergev Squadron and engaged in combat with them. One by one, the squadron's members fell to him, including Pivot Arnancy, who died and became a corpse soldier, and Grimm Fauzen, who sustained a permanent throat injury to his throat that left him unable to speak. After an intense fight, Libre finally claimed the upper hand against Wilhelm Trias. Before he could deliver a killing blow to Wilhelm, Sphinx arrived to shower Libre with multiple incantations of Jiwald, much to his rage and disappointment at the betrayal. He was murdered by another barrage of Jiwald spells, and she turned him into a corpse soldier to cover her escape.

Following the conflict at Aihiya Swamp, Libre's corpse was used as Sphinx's puppet in the Invasion of the Royal Castle, where he fought against the remainder of the Zergev Squadron once more. He battled Bordeaux Zergev until he suffered a severe amount of damage and the remainders of his soul would "return" due to the Sacrament of the Immortal King's effects. In his corpse's last act, Libre turned on Sphinx, cleaved off her arm, and promptly turned into ash.
abilities_text:
Double-Blade Fighting-Style: Wielding a fierce and tricky combat-style with his double-blade sword, Libre was a terrible and overwhelming foe on the battlefield. He possessed enough skill that he was capable of defeating even Wilhelm, marking him as one of Sword Demon's greatest challenges in the Demi-Human War.

Innate Traits: As a snake human, Libre has access to traits unique traits that are sometimes seen in snakes.
Poison: His lineage allows him to poison his targets with a natural toxin.
Regeneration: Libre is capable of regenerating any wounds his body receives. Though the regeneration is not instant, it is strong, allowing him to regenerate entire limbs that have been lost. This being said, his regeneration is not all-powerful. He cannot recover excessive or instantly lethal damage. When a hole was blasted into his chest by Sphinx, though he was able to survive for a short period of time, his regeneration would have been incapable of saving him after having just had a fierce bout with a warrior of a young Wilhelm's strength and receiving numerous wounds, and when Sphinx shot him in the head, it killed him instantly.

Equipment: Libre wielded a sword with both blades at both ends of the hilt. He was extremely proficient with it and was even able to overpower young Wilhelm. He would have easily killed him if it wasn't for Sphinx's interference.

name: Miles
previous_affiliation: Vollachia Empire ; Imperial Army ; House Dracroy
intro: Miles (マイルズ) was a Private First-Class from the Sacred Vollachia Empire's Imperial Army and a flying dragon rider who served Serena Dracroy. Though he did not appear in the main story, Miles played a minor supporting role in The Tale of the Scarlet Princess and antagonistic role in The Dream the Lion King Saw. During The Travelogue of the Finest, Miles's death at the hands of Reinhard van Astrea was the driving force for Balleroy Temeglyph's thirst for revenge on him.
appearance: Miles had a wrinkled, unattractive rat-like face, grey hair, and jade-colored eyes. He wore the standard uniform for a member of the Imperial Army. While he was disguised as a merchant, he wore a white cloak.
personality: Miles was an unscrupulous and vile man, who delighted in tormenting those he viewed as better than him. However, he had friendly relationships with those that he cared about, such as Balleroy Temegylph.
history:
In the past, Miles, who was a subordinate of Serena Dracroy, visited an orphanage in Averyk, where he tied up the head of the orphanage and provided the children a chance to get payback on them by beating and kicking them. Two of the children that he met here were Flop and Medium O'Connell, who he ended up bringing back with him to the Dracroy Domain, and he became practically family to them and Balleroy.

The Tale of the Scarlet Princess
Some 7 years before the main story, Serena sent both Miles and Balleroy, who also served Serena, to the Pendleton Estate in order to invite Jorah Pendleton and his wife Priscilla Pendleton to the Gladiator Island Ginunhive. While they were there, the gladiators attempted to spark a revolution that would render the island independent from the mainland, which later ended up failing thanks to the intervention of the Imperial Army. Serena, Priscilla, Jorah, Balleroy, and Miles then went back to the Pendleton mansion after this incident. Later, he and Balleroy were sent to find Priscilla after Priscilla managed to escape execution, and after finding her, they and Serena helped smuggle her into Lugunica.

The Dream the Lion King Saw
At some point, Miles was tasked with acquiring information on the Sacrament of the Immortal King, an ancient forbidden art that could potentially be used to revive the dead. To complete his mission, Miles posed as a merchant selling corpses to the head of House Argyle, Biehn, who possessed a monopolization on information pertaining to the practice of the spell that Miles sought.

Biehn sought to use the Sacrament of the Immortal King to revive his late wife, who he had killed in a fit of rage two years prior. Miles agreed to procure corpses for Biehn while secretly taking note of aspects of the spell. Ultimately, this plan was foiled when Crusch caught them in the act, forcing Miles and Biehn to kidnap her in the mansion's basement. Upon finding out about Crusch's kidnapping, the Royal Prince himself organized a raid on the Argyle mansion, led by himself, Ferris, and Julius Juukulius. The attack would later result in the deaths of Biehn Argyle and Hannah Regret.

After Crusch killed his undead bodyguards and nearly took his life at the same time, Miles, who had personally faced the Duchess, was gravely wounded. He managed to fake his death and flee through a secret passageway to where his Flying Dragon was hidden. Lamenting the fact he was returning empty-handed, grabbing a book of information compiled on the Sacrament of the Immortal King, Miles made his way back to the nearby border with the Vollachia Empire, hoping to turn over what little information he had acquired to his superior, a General. However, this did not last long, as he soon found Reinhard van Astrea standing behind him, on his flying dragon. When Miles refused to surrender and managed to throw the Sword Saint off, the knight took out both him and his dragon on the spot.
abilities_text: Flying Dragon Rider: Miles was able to tame dragons and was skilled at it. He also taught Balleroy Temeglyph how to tame flying dragons. His dragon was named Gaius.

intro: Meili Portroute (メィリィ・ポートルート) is a witchbeast tamer and a former "child" of Mother. She was first introduced in Arc 2 as the hidden main antagonist and one of the two secondary antagonists of Arc 4 alongside Elsa Granhiert. After the events of Arc 4, she was imprisoned, but she later joined the Emilia Camp, serving as a major role in Arc 6 and a supporting role in Arc 9 and Arc 10.
appearance:
Meili has refined yellow-green eyes that give off an air of mysticism and an equaled well-formed nose. Her long dark-blue hair is kept out of her face and tied into a triple-braid that flows down to her hips. A pink flower ornament with white outlining, which Elsa used to wear prior to meeting her, is framed to the left side of her head. During her undercover stay in the village, Meili's braid traipsed over her left shoulder so that it rested over her chest and her hair wasn't decorated with an ornament. She looks the same age as Petra Leyte. When not concealing her true nature, she gave off the foreboding impression of someone who would grow up to be a true demon.

The outfit Meili commonly wears is befitting of a girl with her moral character. Her ensemble consists of a long-sleeved black one-piece dress with a frilly white hem and white cone-shaped cuffs, brown tights with vertical-facing lighter brown stripes, a white cravat, and a pair of black boots that have cuffs with purple feathery trimming along their edge. Her dress has a black collar and reaches past her hips. Like Elsa, she wears a long purple-brown cloak that reached down to her ankles and had purple trimmings, although unlike Elsa's cloak, Meili's has a golden pendant serving as a strap and no hood. When she was undercover as a villager, Meili wore a short blue long-sleeved one-piece dress with a flap collar similar to a sailor's. On her feet she wore a pair of brown sandals, and apart from these and the dress, Meili wore no further clothing as a villager. Later, she replaces her hairpin with a small bow near the bottom of her braid.

For a short time in Arc 6, she wore a cloak to protect herself from the sands of the Augria Sand Dunes, and while she was being held in a room beneath Roswaal Manor, she wore a gray dress and socks with horizontal purple stripes on them.
personality:
When she was first introduced, Meili acted like she was shy and meek. She was not usually the center of attention, and she acted overly polite and timid, stuttering as she spoke. However, as this was part of her acting skills in play, this was not her true personality. Despite her young age, Meili is a mature girl who became privy to the ugly side of humanity at an early age. Meili failed to display any semblance of the childish innocence usually exhibited by kids her age. She was perfectly willing to kill people, regardless of whether they were innocent or children like herself. She also had a penchant for deception, such as when she mimicked the behavior of a regular child. According to Natsuki Subaru, she had grown up without having learned the difference between right and wrong. Meili has shown to find witchbeasts to be cute and is very fond of them. If possible, she likes to avoid letting them die when she can, and she will prevent her allies from killing them in her presence unless absolutely necessary. At one point, she had become close with a pet Guiltylowe, and later, she had become attached to Shaula, referring to her with "naked onee-san" and was typically seen hanging over her shoulder. She also has great instincts when it comes to a person's strength or their level of danger; when faced with the Council of Wise Men, particularly Miklotov McMahon, she could sense something strange from his gaze, and after meeting Reinhard van Astrea, whose strength was terrifying to her, she started to panic, barely containing her feeling to attack and attempt to flee from the scene. She also finds it annoying when people around her provide her unnecessary assistance or treat her like a child, such as when Elsa did both after the events of Arc 2. Despite this side of her, she still at times acts like the young girl that she is, finding the sewn-together dolls that Subaru made for cute and playing with them while she lived in Roswaal Manor. She also has a habit of stretching out the end of her sentences. She has shown herself to be rather friendly and familiar toward others, even toward her targets.

At some point after her birth, when she was seemingly abandoned, she was a feral child who was unable to talk. She was raised by witchbeasts, protected by them, and taught how to survive through them. Because of this, when Elsa first appeared in front of her and killed all of her witchbeasts, she was very hostile and animalistic, even biting at her despite knowing that she would not be able to win against her. However, after Elsa began taking care of her as an older sister figure, she relearned how to speak, the basics of life, how to act, kill and take care of wounds. Elsa had ultimately become the latter's purpose to live, despite sometimes being at odds. She is also shown to be quite terrified of the superior, Mother, having once been turned into frogs by her, and this fear was part of the reason that after she was later defeated, she allowed herself to become the Emilia Camp's prisoner.

Following the events of Arc 4 and Elsa's death, though she at first cried for her death, Meili was confused about how she should act because of it, as Elsa was the closest thing she could call family despite not quite being family either. Because of this, despite getting along well with the members of the Emilia Camp, when she was given a chance during the events of Arc 6, she attempted to take vengeance on Subaru for Elsa's death in an attempt to quell the emotions that were roiling within her. However, after being stopped and being offered a hand by both Subaru and Emilia, she took them in order to learn from them almost like a daughter figure.

Following these events, she seemed to show regret for her actions, and she was willing to speak with people as powerful as the Council of Wise Men and help the next Pleiades Watchtower expedition team in order to pardon herself so that she wouldn't provide any problems for the Emilia Camp. In particular, she had become somewhat attached to Petra and tended to worry for her, and she often listened to Petra's complaints about the other members of the camp. However, the biggest display of attachment she has displayed toward the other camp members was her willingness to give up her Divine Protection in order to compensate for the use of Clind's Authority in order to gather everyone to save Subaru, though Petra ultimately stopped her from doing this. At the same time, she also worries whether her being forgiven is too good to be true, as if everything was leading to some form of great retribution for her. At the same time, because she looks up to the other members of the camp, wants to use them as examples to follow, and wants to live up to them, she is fully willing to throw away her chance at remaining redeemed and cared for little of what happened to other people so long as she could be of help to the people of the camp, even if she would shed tears for doing so.
history:
Early Life
Meili was born with a powerful Divine Protection that allowed her to manipulate the behavior of man-eating predators known as witchbeasts. She was seemingly abandoned by her parents and subsequently grew in the wilderness surrounded by witchbeasts that protected her. As a result, Meili was a feral child incapable of basic speech and etiquette. One day, an assassin known as the Bowel Hunter appeared before the feral girl and killed the beasts that protected her. Noticing that the name "Meili" had been sewn into the rags the feral girl was wearing, Elsa decided to call the girl Meili despite being unsure if it was her real name, abducting the girl and taking her in.

Meili was taught many things by Elsa, including how to talk and behave properly. She quickly began utilizing witchbeasts and deceptive youth to execute her targets. She was frequently paired up with Elsa on missions, whom she considered an older sister of sorts. Meili, like other "children", feared their leader known simply as "Mother". On one occasion, Mother turned Meili into a pile of frogs as an example of her power. She was particularly fond of a Guiltylowe that she considered a pet.

Red Snowfall on the Orcos Domain
A short while before the events of Arc 1, she and Elsa were involved in the conflict between Viktor Orcos and Igor Kenash, in which Meili set a Guiltylowe on Igor and killed him. Soon after, she followed Elsa into the Kingdom of Lugunica.

Elsa and Meili, Assassin Sisters' Dark Diary
Following Elsa's defeat and near death by the hands of Reinhard van Astrea, she escaped so that her wounds could mend themselves. After being picked up by Meili, who was shocked to hear that she was defeated and that her wounds weren't regenerating like they were supposed to, Meili patched up her wounds, and they decided to leave the Royal Capital in order to escape the people searching for her, leading to Elsa, buck naked, deciding to procure clothes from someone. After causing bloodshed to obtain these clothes, she and Meili used a witchbeast to change their hair colors, and with the help of a guard who didn't recognize them pointing them in the direction of the highway, they left the capital behind. However, Meili had received an objective from Mother, who had told her to stir mayhem in the area around Roswaal Manor, much to Elsa's chagrin. While the two split up, Elsa decided to knit a doll of Reinhard for Meili.

Later, as Meili took on her task, Elsa watched from afar the chaos, and as Roswaal lit the forest ablaze to kill all of the Wolgarms, Elsa made her way to assist Meili, delighted that their roles were reversed from the incident in the capital. As they ran, Elsa gave Meili the doll of Reinhard, and shortly after, she carried Meili on her back, despite the girl's reluctance and frustration, and ran beyond the mountains. Soon enough, they found themselves surrounded by witchbeasts, which Meili decided to speak with and have them regroup with other witchbeasts to rebuild her numbers.

Later on, after the events leading to Roswaal Manor burning down, she was escorted by Garfiel Tinzel to see the remains of the mansion and possibly Elsa. There, she reminisced over one of their conversations about whether Elsa could die, and with Garfiel looking the other way, Meili cried over Elsa's death.

Julius Juukulius's Promise Keeping Notebook III
In the Augria Sand Dunes outside the Pleiades Watchtower, shortly after withstanding sniper fire and Subaru's act of using magic-negation magic, everyone had been separated. Julius, a distance away from the carriage, managed to find it, and Emilia, standing in front of it, said that Beatrice, Meili, and Rem were all still safe. However, Subaru, Ram, "Anastasia", and Patrasche had all gone missing. Beatrice noted that Subaru seemed to have gone farther away while Meili mentioned that witchbeasts were on their way. After realizing that the distortion of space like sent the other farther away from everyone, something landed on their dragon carriage and knocked it over. Julius, who had seen the woman responsible, heard her as she muttered her frustration and realized she had jumped from atop the watchtower. As she was about to leave, Emilia grabbed her leg, causing her to fall and nearly attack her, but when she asked if she knew anything about the friends who had been blown away, the woman lowered her hand and began walking away toward the tower, allowing the others to follow her and muttering "Coming soon". Once everyone gathered together, they chased after her.

Beatrice's Everyone is Troublesome, I Suppose! In Fact!
The next day, after observing the first trial of the tower, Emilia and Beatrice returned downstairs, where Meili teased them and claimed that they were probably on edge because Subaru hadn't woken up yet. After thinking about her irritation towards Shaula for not answering their question, Beatrice and Emilia decided to check on Subaru and Ram while Meili went to the trial room to see if she could solve it, leaving Beatrice to chide Emilia's carelessness after she claimed that there were no harmful traps within the room.

Meili’s Witchbeast Observation Record
Following the successful Pleiades Watchtower Expedition, Meili was tasked with reporting to the Council of Wise Men about the tower being conquered, and she was handed a talon that belonged to Volcanica itself. Along with Annerose Miload, she met the old men and reported this. Soon after, Felt and her knight arrived and took part in the meeting. Though Meili felt instinctive fear towards Reinhard, who shortly after pointed out the hiding Crimson Scorpion hiding on her person, Felt came to her aid and started talking smack about her knight. Afterward, Meili revealed that she was an assassin, as even if she was a part of the Emilia Camp, her origin would come out eventually, and she could use it as a bargaining chip to assist the next expedition unit to go to the Pleiades Watchtower. Being given a chance to wipe her slate clean, she was tasked to assist the Felt Camp in making it past the Augria Sand Dunes with her Divine Protection.

In the dunes, the group was assaulted by Volcanica, who was tasked with defending the tower. Fortunately, thanks to the talon, Meili was able to prevent any further attacks, and they successfully reached the tower. She showed them the Taygeta Library, and she told them about the Books of the Dead, which prompted Felt to convince Reinhard to find his grandmother’s book. Afterward, the group noticed the birds floating around, which Meili had noted were there even during their own stay at the tower. After the crimson scorpion killed the one that they’d caught, Reinhard and Ezzo Cadner set about slaying the rest, as the birds were being used to spy. Afterward, the group returned to the capital, leaving Ezzo and Flam Remendis behind, and with the success of the expedition, Meili was pardoned for her crimes.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
While Meili's actual physical abilities make her incredibly weak, she more than makes up for this with her assassination skills and Divine Protection. Her strength comes in the form of her being a Witchbeast User, which allows her to summon and command strong beasts as a veritable army.

Divine Protection

Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation (魔操の加護 Masou no Kago): Meili's Divine Protection allows her to control witchbeasts. Reinhard van Astrea notes that Meili's Divine Protection can only be possessed by one person at a time, with him being unable to use it himself because of this. With the Divine Protection acting in place of the witchbeasts' horns, Meili can control their actions, effectively making them her puppets. As seen with the Guiltylowe, witchbeasts can still retain their reason and will. She can control numerous species of witchbeasts, including powerful ones. There are limits to her power, however. Some witchbeasts, such as Courtesan Bears, are incompatible with her Divine Protection, making them much harder to control. Likewise, exceedingly powerful witchbeasts like the Black Serpent and the White Whale are completely immune to her control, although it is possible to influence them and make their movements sluggish. She is able to control at least a hundred witchbeasts, but her control has limits, and some will not listen to her if she tries to control too many. Overusing her Divine Protection, such as using it to halt the movements of the Black Serpent, causes her great pain, as if her blood and soul were on fire.

Other
Assassin Skills: To complement her role as an assassin, Meili uses her acting skills to pretend to be a normal child while using that disguise to determine a target, as well as some extent of stealth mastery to erase the sound of her footsteps, though she is not as skilled as Elsa in the latter quality. However, despite this, she has not learned any physical combat skills.

Aura: Meili apparently emits a miasma-like aura, which is the reason why the Emilia Camp chose to imprison her underneath Roswaal Manor for a year. It is unknown whether this is because of her Divine Protection or not.

Equipment
Fragment of the Divine Dragon’s Talon: After Emilia became the administrator of the Pleiades Watchtower, she was given a piece of Volcanica’s Talon to use to prevent said dragon from attacking her and her party should she return to the tower. She passed it along to Meili so that she could take the second expedition party to the tower.

intro: Louanna Astrea (ルアンナ・アストレア) is Heinkel Astrea's wife and Reinhard van Astrea's mother. Though not appearing in the main story, she was brought up in Arc 5 and plays a vital role in both Heinkel and Reinhard's character arcs.
appearance: Louanna is an inhumanly beautiful woman with long blonde hair and blue eyes.
personality: Louanna was a kind and easygoing woman. While she was awake, she wholly believed that Heinkel would succeed Theresia as the Sword Saint.
history:
Once Upon a Time in Astrea
Louanna was born into the noble family of House Hartley. However, her parents died in an accident, leaving Louanna to pay off their debts by herself. Eventually, she met Heinkel, and he saved her from a masked man who had been pursuing her for witnessing the scene of an assault by saying that he would marry her. The two eventually got married and Louanna would give birth to Reinhard.

When Reinhard was two years old, Louanna was afflicted with Sleeping Beauty, a condition that has similarities to people who are victims of the Authority of Gluttony but ultimately a separate ailment, and she is still sleeping to this day without any changes to her body. As speculated by Felt and confirmed by Heinkel, the infant Reinhard was seemingly responsible for her slumber. Sometime later, Ferris examined her but determined that she did not need to be treated. By the time the Royal Selection begun, she had been in this state for 17 years. 

Felt-chan Saw!
