intro: Natsuki Subaru (ナツキ・スバル) is the main protagonist of Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu. A former hikikomori, he was transported to Lugunica through unknown means, where he was given the Authority which he calls "Return by Death" by Satella and became the knight of the Kingdom and the personal knight of the Royal Selection Candidate Emilia.
appearance:
Born and raised in Japan, Natsuki Subaru is a young man in his late teens. He stands at a height of 172 cm with an athletic physique which he maintains both prior to and during his summoning to Lugunica. He inherited a shared mix of physical traits from both of his parents; his medium-length thick black hair bore a striking resemblance to his father as well as his face shape, while his black (brown in the anime) sanpaku eyes which have small irises that made the whites of his eyes stand out, were inherited from his mother although some people find them intimidating, with the exception of some individuals who like them, namely Emilia. Just like his father, Subaru has quite an athletic build, as back in Japan, he was raised as an athlete by his father. Despite his shut-in nature later on, he nevertheless continued to train himself to maintain his physique. In Arc 2, as he was learning to work as a butler, his hands became littered with small scars caused by cooking knives.

Subaru's main attire throughout the early parts of the series is his cheap, athletic-theme outfit he was summoned in. The ensemble consists of deep-grey tracksuit bottoms with an orange stripe down the side, black sneakers with vibrant orange laces and soles, and a black t-shirt. Additionally, Subaru has with it a zipped-up white tracksuit jacket with a stand-up collar, deep-grey sleeves with an orange line running down their sides and orange cuffs, and deep-grey shoulders. On the left breast of the jacket is a black brand symbol that is reminiscent of the letter N. During the first trial in Arc 4, he can be seen wearing his school's official uniform, which consists of a blue blazer and trousers and a red tie. Later in the same arc, during his knighting ceremony, he wore the knight's official uniform, and a purple cape with the crest of House Mathers on its back was draped over his shoulders.

In Arc 2 and Arc 3, however, he wore a butler's uniform with an eagle emblazoned in the sleeve. In the Water Plumage Inn in Arc 5, he wears a yukata. Later on, during the Battle for Priestella, Subaru's right arm and leg were affected by Capella's cursed Dragon blood, thus he wrapped a bandage around his leg to hide the wound. Following his battle with the Elgina, the cursed blood that was visible on his arm is no longer there, and it appears to be back to normal.

During his adventure in the Pleiades Watchtower in Arc 6, Subaru wore an outfit better suited for travelling. The outfit in question consisted of an orange scarf that matched the color featured on his track suit, black trousers tucked into lighter brown boots with black lacing, a black shirt that matched the shade of his trousers, a light brown buttoned blazer worn atop the shirt that ensured that only the shirt's collar was visible, a brown belt matching the shade of the boots, and an open green jacket. He also occasionally wore a long black hooded cloak alongside the outfit. However, he has returned to wearing his tracksuit as of Arc 10.

In Arc 7, Subaru was forced to cross-dress and adopt the name Natsumi Schwartz. During the Bloodless Siege of Guaral, Subaru wore a transparent primarily white and orange long dancer's dress adorned with ornaments and gems, and a black wig, as well as a fake chest and a large amount of make-up. Following the group's victory and the departure for Chaosflame, Subaru clad himself in a black wig and a primarily red and black military outfit with a red beretta, disguising himself as Vincent Vollachia's female military advisor in order to not garner too much attention. He also briefly dons the appearance of Natsumi Schwartz later in Arc 10, wearing a dark dress, carrying a holding fan to cover his mouth, and giving the impression of someone who knows how he was being perceived and was acting appropriately.

Later in Arc 7, Subaru took on the form of a 10-year-old child due to Olbart Dunkelkenn's infantilization technique. He began wearing an oversized green shirt with rolled sleeves and a yellow collar, as well as a yellow band serving as a makeshift belt for his jeans. However, he eventually returned to his original form towards the end of Arc 8.

In the Sloth What-IF story, where Subaru chose to abandon Emilia to run away with Rem, Subaru's hair was longer. Although he kept his basic messy hairstyle, Subaru now had a clump of hair tied up in a ponytail, apparently influenced by the style of Wilhelm van Astrea. Furthermore, he ditched his signature tracksuit, for a more comfortable and environment-specific dark-blue kimono and a pair of simple wooden zori. In the Gluttony IF, Subaru had given himself a scar on his head that damaged his eye and blinded it, and his hair had also turned white. In the Sasageru IF, Subaru had properly aged during the course of 40 years, and his hair had turned white.
personality:
Subaru is a playful person who, despite the impression that his eyes and face tend to give off, has a tendency to interact with the people around him with kindness, even if they are not fond of him, something which people like Otto Suwen, Rem, and even Petra Leyte noticed and found to be one of his best qualities. He also has a tendency to speak before he thinks, with one of his more tactless comments being about Frederica Baumann's teeth, and he is a habitual promise breaker, to the point that other have learned to not trust when he makes a promise. Despite speaking before he thinks things through, that trait has apparently helped other people, whether to keep calm or to give them courage when they needed it most. This being said, because his self-esteem had been reduced from the time that he was a child and the fact that he was given Return by Death, Subaru has come to harbor a bad habit of trying to carry the burdens of the people around him on his shoulders alone, something which not only worries the people around him but also causes them to scold him regularly.

He is also a fiercely loyal person who treasures his relationships, and though he might not get along well with the people around him at times, especially in cases such as Julius Juukulius, whose impression rubs him the wrong way; Vincent, whose ideals counter his in almost every way; and even Todd Fang, who was his enemy in nearly every interaction they've had and was even responsible for the deaths of the people around him at times; he does not want to see any of those people die, being willing to use his Return by Death to save them if they died around him. This and his Authority have a tendency to confuse the people around him, and in Todd's case, it even caused him to greatly fear Subaru; however, even then, he has still been shown to forgive those who have wronged him, such as Roswaal L. Mathers or Spica, and even extend his hand to people in need, including trying to assist someone whose mental state was shaken by the events that had assailed them, such as Aldebaran following the Great Disaster. His naiveté extends even to people he recently meets, and as such, does not condone sacrifices, and he is willing to go out of his way to help others while not showing the same concern for himself. Because of this, however, he can also become very shaken if he fails to save the people around him, like with what happened to Rem and Crusch Karsten in Arc 3, Shaula in Arc 6, and Priscilla Barielle in Arc 8.

Due in combination to his experiences with Return by Death and his trust in his friends and allies, Subaru is willing to put his faith in the people he knows and is more than willing to put himself in harm's way if it means there is a chance to overcome his and his allies' enemies. In fact, multiple times over, he has purposefully put himself through harsh experiences and came up with plans that revolved around him receiving great injuries, having allowed himself to effectively let one enemy break his arms and have his nearby comrades wait and put up with his pain until the right moment, or even convincing someone as gentle as Melty Pristis to stab him for the sake of his plan, as he believed Ferris, who they were going to the location of, would be able to recognize their plot and save him in the nick of time. That being said, this is also a trait that leads to him being scolded by those very people.

However, after arriving in Lugunica and experiencing multiple tragedies, Subaru has grown to fiercely detest the Witch Cult, to the point that in one of his failed loops, he had been so angry that his aggression led him to try to gain allies to fight them but failed in each attempt, even having been used for information while he was experiencing his severe tunnel vision and hatred. Of course, while he has been able to curb his hatred of them and act much calmer since then, his hatred for them is still intense, and even being accused of or hypothetically thinking of himself as being associated with them gives him an immense feelings of disgust and goosebumps. In particular, his hatred for and fear of the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, who was responsible for Rem's comatose state for over a year, was much more severe than the rest. Likewise, he is very liable to become hostile and extremely distrustful towards people that seem like his enemies, such as when he snapped at Eridna when she revealed herself to be "Echidna", who he already distrusted, and her behavior being so close to the original's only fed into that distrust, or his initial behavior toward Spica, who was born from one of the Gluttony siblings, Rui, despite her having no memories as Rui.

Despite his hatred and distrust for such enemies, Subaru is not unwilling to forgive most of them and is even capable of properly speaking to them. Although he and Sphinx were on opposite sides and the fact that Sphinx was responsible for several of his deaths, when he confronted her at the end of the Conquest of the Undead Capital, he spoke to her about if it could have been possible for her to not have done as she had, and he told her happy birthday, something that she may have never experienced. In the case of Todd, he was willing to put aside their enmity and work together with him, and though he couldn't trust him, he still cried over the fact that they could not reach an understanding and remained enemies. In Spica's case, although he detested her since the start of the events in Vollachia, after she had repeatedly saved his life and died over and over again to do so, he was willing to vouch for her and help her start anew, giving her a new name in the process. Even in the case of Meili Portroute, because she had fortunately done no harm in the main timeline to his allies, he was willing to harbor her for safety, speak with her freely during her isolation, and trust his life to her. Even after he lost his memories, despite her having killed him, he was still willing to forgive her and give her a proper second chance at life, and after regaining his memories again, choosing to ask her to become a daughter to him.

As a child, Subaru was much more confident and often a jokester who always stood out and was the center of attention, and he was often surrounded by friends who would play around with him. However, as time went on, despite initially feeling pride at being compared to him, Subaru became a very insecure person suffering from a severe inferiority complex due to growing up in his father's shadow. This caused him to develop a fundamental misunderstanding of relationships where he believed he would be abandoned if he wasn't the center of attention. He began acting eccentrically, performing actions in a way he thought was similar to his dad in an effort to try and make friends and not be alone. Even his otaku-tendencies were really just another method he used to stand out. Ironically, though, these desperate attempts to connect to others only caused him to make a fool of himself and push others away, and the more stressed he became, the more he acted out. In the end, however, he started pulling himself away from the public eye, going to school less and less, and eventually, not at all, and he started becoming somewhat distant from his parents, not even telling his worried mother goodbye when she told him kindly to take care, as he believed that his parents would be better off without him.

After being summoned to a new world, he saw this as a chance to make a fresh start. Then, despite realizing he hadn't been given overpowered abilities typically accompanied by isekai protagonists, upon meeting Emilia and becoming enamored with her, he decided to devote himself to becoming the one closest to her and always saving her. Upon realizing he had been given the unusual ability of Return by Death, despite experiencing the pain accompanying it, he started to realize that he could challenge fate, which led him to believe that so long as he was around, he would be able to stop anything untoward from happening to the people he cared about, something which has led him to problematic situations, including a beating/public humiliation. Ultimately, he did not change as a person, and following his decision to continuously save Emilia, he was eventually exposed for what he was: a person who thought of himself as the hero of his own story and forcing their feelings on someone else, and he realized that his white knighting did not work out in the real world.

The world then proceeded to show him how weak he was, that he couldn't save anyone. After facing numerous failures and deaths, witnessing the endless deaths of everyone around him and everyone pointing out all of his flaws, he felt utterly broken, and he wanted to run away. However, following his conversation with Rem, in which he pointed out everything negative about himself and that he hated himself, upon hearing Rem tell him everything she loved about him, including that he wasn't one to give up and that in her eyes he was a hero and that she loved him, he began to see himself in a somewhat better light. This became the turning point for his character; he truly made an effort to change himself rather than expect that as the supposed protagonist, everything would work out. Subaru began reflecting on his actions and taking steps to amend his broken relationships, ultimately learning to become more considerate of Emilia's feelings rather than just forcing his expectation that she would reward him. Now, he tries to live up to the expectations of a hero that Rem had for him.

Furthermore, following the events of Arc 4, upon experiencing the second trial, speaking with the Witches of Sin, and coming to understand somewhat the love that Satella had for him that she would even give him Return by Death, he resolved himself not only to save her, but also not to abuse his Authority in the same manner he does in the Greed If, only using it when he needs to challenge fate and save the people around him. This, in time, caused Subaru to end up gaining self-harming habits, such as biting his lips or scratching his arms until they bleed, and so that he wouldn’t forget or become used to the feeling of pain that goes alongside his Return by Death, he’d even requested the poison he’d use later to be painful, something which others have questioned.

In Arc 6, he started seeing himself in a much better light after witnessing his memoryless self take on every challenge that assailed him in the Pleiades Watchtower, despite being pushed to the brink of despair brought about by Rui Arneb's machinations and mind games. Seeing from the perspective from an outsider boosted his confidence, and it allowed him to see what other people see.

After his infantilization in Arc 7, Subaru regained much of his confidence that he’d lost as he aged, which when paired up with his usual habits alongside his Authority, have made him much more of a force to be reckoned with, as well as significantly bolder, allowing him to pick fights with and persuade people as stubborn as Gustav Morello and Jawsrough into following him. Likewise, he has shown to be even more charismatic, managing to gain the loyalty and friendships of nearly 1000 people during his travels in Vollachia, as well as the assistance of numerous similarly stubborn people such as the Nine Divine Generals and Vollachian Emperor. After reverting back to his original form, his personality has gone back to how it originally was.

Subaru was deeply affected by the events that led to Al's sealing, and because of this, an ambition was born within him to uncover the history of both the Kingdom and the world, as now, he believes he can no longer remain ignorant of it. Thanks to this, he has started to question some of the most base and fundamental aspects of culture, including the Dragon History Stone's prophecies, which he had a less than positive impression of after meeting a Stargazer, as well as the intentions of those behind it, as he suspected foul play, especially when considering the plague that took the lives of the royal family. At the same time, because of Al, and before him, Todd, he refused to lose anyone again without first attempting to talk things through with them, something which led to his decision to plead with and later assist Crusch in her crusade to locate and purge national traitors and corruption.
history:
Back in his original world, Subaru was the only son to two odd, but well-meaning parents, Kenichi and Naoko. From a young childhood age, Subaru idealized his dad in particular, a popular man in his community who was highly talented in whatever he did, a loving father who prioritized his family above everything else and had a boisterous personality that charmed anyone he met. Kenichi was everything he wanted to be and growing up around him had a huge influence on Subaru's life. Taking pride in being his son, Subaru worked to live up to the expectations that came with that in his mind. For a time, he achieved this, as Subaru found himself smarter, more physically able, and popular than his peers. When he received praise, Subaru would hear how it was expected of him being Kenichi's son, which made him feel special and entitled to a sense of superiority.

However, as the young boy's small world started to gradually expand upon entering middle school, Subaru would come face to face with limits of his own ability. Suddenly, he found people who were becoming smarter and faster than he was and, in general, being better at the things he used to be. He felt as if he was slowly losing his place and began to harbor a deep sense of shame at letting down his parents and fear of everyone leaving him for failures, doubt and self-loathing began to develop in his heart. But rather than prioritizing getting better at those things to combat his anxieties, Subaru instead placed more importance on doing daring and outrageous things to maintain his fragile dignity and keep himself the center of attention. However, the more reckless Subaru's actions became, the fewer people wanted to be around him. Yet Subaru continued to deceive himself and believe his own lies because as the son of his seemly indomitable father, he couldn't be seen as a failure. Eventually, one day, Subaru noticed he no longer had any friends, and, in his loneliness, Subaru realized he wasn't anyone special.

From then on, the comparisons between his father and himself turned into a curse that wounded and suffocated him everywhere he went, yet his strong admiration for his dad made it impossible to show that pain to anyone. Eventually, he stopped trying to stand out and when high school came, he found himself in a new environment where no one knew his past. Seizing this opportunity, Subaru tried to build new interpersonal relationships, but he had no idea how to be himself around others and instead only ended up emulating his father, his only frame of reference which instead led to others to treat him as a clown and classmates simply ignored his existence altogether. One day, Subaru skipped a day of school in a week, followed by skipping once every three days, then every two, until within three months, things had snowballed to the point that he had stopped going to school. When out of public spaces, Subaru felt liberated, but more than that, his own degradation meant people would start distancing him from Kenichi, and in a twisted sense of hope, he wanted them to acknowledge him as worthless and cast him aside in self-abandonment.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Subaru has at one point been declared among the weakest characters in all of Re:Zero. However, in spite of his overall lack of trained combat skills, Subaru has shown to be extremely crafty in the manner with which he utilizes his various Authorities, is a highly capable leader, and has used everything at his disposal in order to come out of the most dangerous of scuffles with as few casualties as possible. It is thanks to this that Subaru has established himself as a considerably dangerous opponent to have, and numerous people of considerable strength and standing have considered him to be a truly dangerous and considerable threat, one capable of potentially bringing the downfall of entire organizations that have existed for centuries or could be troublesome in the event of a national dispute, or an incredibly reliable ally whose insight and presence are deemed necessary in order to overcome the most hopeless of threats. Within a year and a half of arriving to the other world, Subaru had helped orchestrating the downfall of the Sin Archbishops of Sloth, Greed, and Gluttony, the Bowel Hunter Elsa Granhiert, the Witch Sphinx, and two of the Three Great Witchbeasts: the White Whale and the Great Rabbit. Furthermore, due to his influence, he has arranged a wide array of allies and friends in high places, and those connections are what exemplifies his "power" the most.

Authorities
thumb|right|250px|Subaru activating Return by Death.
Return by Death (死に戻り, Shinimodori): Subaru's trump card and the most recognized ability from the series, Return by Death allows Subaru to return to an unspecified, unpredictable, and uncontrollable "save point" that was set some time before his death. It happens instantly after his life is taken, there's no lag between the point of death and the point of resurrection, and there is no known limit to how many times Subaru can "Return by Death", making this ability an effective way of permanently bypassing an unnatural death. In Arc 4, it is revealed by the Witch of Greed that Return by Death is actually an Authority given to him by the Witch of Envy in order to prevent him from being shackled by mortality, granting him a means to challenge fate itself and beat impossible odds in which he's destined to die in the cruelest of ways. However, no actual conclusions of which Sin it represents have been drawn yet. In fact, following the revelation that Authorities can be borne by being influenced by someone who does have a Witch Factor, as well as the fact that, after he had taken both Sloth and Greed, Roswaal had mentioned that he had "two" instead of three, it is entirely possible that Subaru's Return by Death may not have been applied to him by the conventional method of granting him a Witch Factor, though whether this is the case is unknown.

When Return by Death is triggered, to Subaru, it looks exactly as if someone switched camera angles inside his head, and the sudden influx of new information and sensations often makes him feel dizzy and confused. Because of the lack of lag between the moment he died and the moment his mind goes back in time, depending on the way he died previously, it may take him time for his mind to recover. For example, when Subaru was initially killed by the Great Rabbit, the intense pain his mind was forced to experience carried over, and if not for the interference by Echidna, his mind would have been in danger of shattering from the phantom pain. Later, in Arc 10, due to the intense spinning brought about by his extended death from a literally endless fall, the spinning sensation and dizziness carried over, leaving him temporarily unable to move or even think properly for a time. Likewise, the Witch seems to have some control over his checkpoints, as when the connection between her and Subaru was temporarily severed in Arc 7, his checkpoints not only became erratic, but they also seemed to reduce in time with every reset. Having said that, Subaru's application of this Authority – namely to use it to save his friends and loved ones from their untimely demises – is something willingly and consciously done by Subaru alone. This often results in Subaru being given almost absurdly short times between his save points and deaths, and at times, even preventing him from saving some of his friends, such as when Rem's name and memories were eaten by the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, where Subaru was given a save point hours after Gluttony and Greed's attack on Rem's carriage convoy.

It should be noted that, although Return by Death can prevent him from facing a permanent death from unnatural causes, it is implied through different side stories that he is not completely immune from a permanent death. In the Pride IF, because Subaru had achieved his goal, he accepted his final death, and by doing so, Return by Death did not trigger, bringing about a permanent demise to him. This is also implied to be the case in the Wrath IF, in which he ultimately chose to allow Ram to end him for good. Furthermore, Return by Death does not seem to prevent Subaru from aging. In the Sasageru IF, over the course of 40 years, Subaru’s body aged as naturally as any other regular human, so it can be assumed that Subaru can still die of old age. However, as of yet, it is unclear if this is truly the case.
Future Recollection: The trait that makes Subaru so dangerous is without a doubt his ability to recall the futures he had experienced through Return by Death. The fact that he can recall the events of the previous loops he had died in, means that Subaru inherently knows the rough actions the people around him will take, almost like a form of precognition. As he usually tries to do different things every time he returned to life, Subaru is able to gather more intel on how his allies and opponents behave under specific conditions, allowing him to predict their movements and plan strategies accordingly. Although he is average at best in terms of intellect and strategic planning, Subaru's recollections of failed futures as well as his basic problem-solving abilities essentially turned Subaru into someone who expertly manipulates the events around him. His recollection of the future also allows him to forge better relationships with those he considers allies, allowing him to amass an impressive web of political connections and friends in high places.

Penalties: Subaru is unable to reveal his ability to others, either verbally or otherwise. There are a few primary penalties for attempting to do so:
If Subaru tries to tell someone about his ability, the Witch of Envy will stop time and squeeze his heart. This penalty does not work within the Castle of Dreams as it is outside of the world.
It will increase the density of the Witch's Scent at least for a short time, drawing any witchbeasts in the immediate area to him like moths to a flame, which Subaru has used to his advantage. However, the scent does not seem to derive from the Authority but his connection to Satella, as when his connection to her was temporarily severed during the events of Ginunhive, he was not attracting the witchbeasts on the island, despite the number of times he had died. It was not until he re-established his connection with her that the scent returned and the consequence was reapplied.
In a situation where Subaru resolved to tell Emilia about his ability no matter the consequences he could face for it, it resulted in her heart being crushed by the Witch's hand. The exact explanation about this penalty is currently unknown, as this penalty is so far only confirmed to affect Emilia. Thus far, it is unknown if it can affect anyone else.
According to the author, if Subaru tried to tell Reinhard van Astrea specifically about Return by Death regardless of the consequences, his own heart would pop.
In the event that someone attempts to possess Subaru, such as in the case of Petelgeuse, Subaru can deliberately attempt to mention the name of his Authority to trigger his penalty, in which case Satella will appear and will forcefully eject the intruder with her shadowy hands in her anger for attempting to enter the "space" meant solely for herself and Subaru.
Though there were no penalties within the Castle of Dreams, the Witch of Envy still possessed Emilia in the outside world and devoured everything with her shadows in response to revealing Return by Death to Echidna.
In the case of Rui Arneb, who had attached a separate consciousness of herself to him through a part of her Witch Factor, the Witch of Envy summoned a mass of shadows to force Subaru to reset until she was removed.
In the case someone discovers the exact abilities of his Authority via an alternate method, such as reading his Books of the Dead, Satella will attack them personally and attempt to kill them with her shadows. However, it is possible to bypass this consequence if an alternate method was used in a space disconnected from the world and Satella's supervision, such as Od Lagna's Corridor of Memories, as Rui managed when she used her Authority of Gluttony on him.

Invisible Providence (インビジブル・プロヴィデンス, Inbijiburu Purovidensu): When Subaru killed the Sin Archbishop of Sloth, he absorbed the Witch Factor of Sloth that resided within the madman for the past century, and after being synchronized with the Witch Factor thanks to Echidna, he developed its respective Authority of Sloth. It is a power that allows Subaru to summon a single invisible hand-like appendage from his chest and move and extend it telekinetically. If Subaru focuses enough, he can even make the hand phase through matter as though it wasn't there, giving him the potential to attack a target from inside their bodies. Subaru's version of the Authority of Sloth is far less powerful than both Petelgeuse's and Sekhmet’s Authorities of Sloth, as although Petelgeuse for instance could summon roughly one hundred hands at his maximum potential with little effort, Subaru can only summon a single hand with minimal range and damage output. At times, however, it seems that this ability can cause significant harm to his target, as he managed to severely damage Todd Fang’s face with it during a failed loop, and he can also use it to disarm an unsuspecting opponent if necessary.
Penalties: As a side effect of calling forth his Authority, Subaru's internal organs begin to flare up, he feels his soul becoming more and more tainted, and he is assaulted by a violent coughing attack accompanied with him throwing up small amounts of blood. There are even times when he blacks out because of the severe drawbacks of its use, leaving him unconscious for at least two days, whereas other times, he will get away with just a nosebleed.

Cor Leonis (コル・レオニス, Koru Reonisu): When Reinhard killed Regulus during the assault on Priestella, the Witch Factor of Greed latched onto Subaru. Toward the end of Arc 6, Subaru was able to develop his Authority of Greed, which he has dubbed Cor Leonis. Its ability is centered around the redistribution of burdens onto oneself and those who are deemed part of Subaru’s “kingdom”, though it is determined to only work so long as both he and his target(s) perceive each other as a friend, ally, or comrade in some manner. Like with Regulus, his Authority is divided into two separate abilities: Base Shift and Second Shift.
Base Shift: The base shift of Cor Leonis allows Subaru to take on the burdens of people he himself considers allies. Once he is connected to someone with his Authority, so long as he does not pass out or fall unconscious, the connection will be maintained no matter the distance. His power still works even in the event that he is sealed and is in a state of semi-consciousness.
Fatigue/Pain Transference: He is able to shoulder fatal injuries and save his allies' lives by taking on the pain of the wounds they are dealt, but this comes at a cost of potentially receiving the same wounds himself as his body naturally reproduces the sources of pain he suddenly receives, a deadly side effect which can easily kill him if ignored. He can also eliminate issues such as lack of dexterity for his comrades in combat.
Ally Tracking: When using this power, Subaru is able to locate his allies' position and status as he sees pale white dots, wherever they're located. Depending on the movements of these dots, Subaru can determine how far away they are from him, whether they are moving or idle, or whether or not they have entered combat. However, his allies must also consider Subaru their own ally, otherwise Subaru will not be able to sense their location. In the very beginning of Arc 7, Subaru tried to locate Rem's location but was unable to, as due to her loss of memories, she did not recognize him as her ally. It only works on people he recognizes as his friends and allies. Furthermore, in the event that Subaru is trapped by an ability that distorts his sense of direction, it is possible for Cor Leonis to overcome said ability, as its status as an Authority supersedes the majority of other abilities, and he can still make his way toward an ally that he can sense.
Empathic Perception: Using his Authority, Subaru is able to determine the emotional state, the strength of those emotions, and the various violent fluctuations of the people around him, which can give him a rough idea of the events going on around him, even if he is within a seal.
Second Shift (セカンドシフト, Sekando Shifuto): Second Shift, alternatively referred to as Division of Labor (負担の分配, Futan no Bunpai), works very similarly to Regulus' very own Lion's Heart, in a sense where Subaru can divide the burden between the allies of his choosing, and he can freely regulate how big of a burden he'll employ on each person, kind of like opening or closing a tap.
Fatigue/Pain Transference: By sharing the burden that Subaru has carried from his base shift to other people who are willing to share in that burden, he can divide his burdens equally among them, reducing the load he has to carry. The more people he shares the burden with, the more divided that burden becomes lighter. Naturally, the same side effects will apply to each and every bearer of the shared burden, meaning their lives rest in Subaru's hands for the entire duration.
Strength Distribution: Subaru is also capable of sharing the burdens of positive effects as well, such as a form of enhancement placed upon himself, and by doing so, he can share the excessive strengthening among his allies and collectively make them stronger in a uniform and unburdening manner. During Arc 7 and Arc 8, the war cries of the Pleiades Battalion's members were able to induce an effect similar to that of yang magic in Subaru, which he then distributed to the battalion's members in order to strengthen them.

High Witch Factor Compatibility: Subaru has displayed a strange affinity towards Witch Factors that no other character thus far has shown. While most people would find themselves incompatible with a Witch Factor from which an Authority derives from or at the mercy of said Factor's influence, Subaru is not only compatible with the Witch Factors he currently possesses, but he is also uniquely capable of bearing multiple of them at one time within his body, at one point having held at least three of them simultaneously. Likewise, he has not shown to have any form of change in his personality nor a physical recoil at carrying them or manifesting respective Authorities from them. The reason for this has yet to be explained.

Unique Authority Interactions: For reasons unknown, Subaru seems to bear unique interactions with the Authorities of other users. In the case of the Unseen Hands wielded by Petelgeuse, Subaru was able to see all of the hands he emitted from his body, whereas nobody else could see them. He is also resistant to the effects of the Authority of Gluttony held by the three Sin Archbishops of Gluttony. Even when his friends or allies have had their names devoured, he can still remember them. Furthermore, when Rui Arneb attempted to devour his name and memories, though she managed to glimpse into his memories, he was not affected at all, and the only reason he lost his memories in the subsequent events of Arc 6 was due to Rui's scheme locking away his memories of the previous year into the Corridor of Memories. Although it is not confirmed, this apparent resistance to the Authority likely stems from the fact that he is not a native of the new world.

Intelligence/Leadership
Deductive Ability: Arguably Subaru's greatest asset, aside from Return by Death, is his own mind. Though he wasn't blessed with particularly noteworthy intelligence, he has always had great deductive ability, something he prides himself on. This works well with his time-looping, as the information it provides would be useless if he wasn't able to think and act on it to find the optimal course of action. Likewise, it is because of his deductive ability that he has been responsible for uncovering the truth behind certain people's and witchbeasts' abilities. If not for this, certain battles, such as with the White Whale and Regulus, would have been lost. Similarly, Subaru is able to quickly piece together when people he knows are acting strange and deduce that said person is an impostor, even if the person in question is someone he has only spoken to in relatively brief periods. It is because of this that he was able to quickly recognize that Eridna had taken over Anastasia Hoshin's body following the Battle for Priestella, even if he wasn't aware of the specifics of the possession itself.

Leadership: Numerous times throughout the story, Subaru has shown to be an excellent leader, as he has often been seen acting like a general in several battles. Of course, while a big part of this comes from knowledge obtained from his Return by Death, even without it, he has shown to be capable of directing everyone around them to places they need to be, with the Battle for Priestella being one of the most prominent examples of his leading skills. Similarly, he has shown to have great charisma, as he managed to obtain many followers during the Imperial Civil War and create the Pleiades Battalion, which he promptly led as its commander.

Skilled Tactician: Like his leadership, even without Return by Death, Subaru is skilled at coming up with various kinds of strategies during times of tension, and a good number of his strategies have been critical in achieving victory against troublesome opponents, including the likes of the White Whale, Regulus, and certain members of the Beloved Children. Garfiel Tinzel, Reinhard, and Vincent have complimented Subaru's strategic ability.

Astronomical Knowledge: In his own world, Subaru studied the stars, constellations, the stories surrounding them, and similar subjects. This knowledge has become vital to Subaru, as thanks to it, he is able to determine how the Authorities of other wielders work and discover their weaknesses, as well as uncover the hidden meanings behind puzzles such as the Taygeta trial in the Pleiades Watchtower. As this knowledge has become vital to understanding some of the more key aspects of the world, it is perhaps one of the most important things in Subaru's arsenal.

Magic/Spiritual Arts
Subaru has an affinity for the yin attribute and was once capable of casting basic yin magic, although he was only a novice. According to the author, Subaru could learn how to use other types of magic if he dedicated his life to it. However, after his gate broke, Subaru lost access to his ability to cast magic, and the only way he can do so is through spiritual arts through his contract with Beatrice.

Spiritual Arts (精霊術, Seirei-jutsu): Subaru is contracted with artificial spirit Beatrice, effectively making him one of the few spirit users and the only other Spirit Knight (精霊騎士 Seirei Kishi) within the Kingdom of Lugunica besides Julius Juukulius. With her aid, they are able to directly bypass his broken gate in order to cast spiritual arts together, and they have even created spells unique to them together. In particular, they each have a strong affinity for the Yin attribute. Likewise, thanks to the contract between them, Subaru does not suffer from an overabundance of mana within his body, while Beatrice will be able to maintain her form by absorbing the mana that builds up within his body. As Beatrice's contractor, Subaru's condition and whereabouts can be sensed by Beatrice via their connection, although Subaru is incapable of sensing her. However, he is capable of remotely calling Beatrice out if he focuses enough on his link with her. This being said, according to Beatrice, he isn't a true spirit user due to the many stipulations of contracting with her. She has a terrible mana consumption rate and formerly got around this by draining mana from people in the mansion using the library as a medium. Due to her mana consumption rate from Subaru, the two cannot cast spells freely. As she is an artificial spirit, she also has several conditions Subaru is forced to follow:
Subaru cannot form a contract with other spirits.
Beatrice cannot restore mana on her own.
Beatrice cannot use the mana in the atmosphere.
Beatrice can only drain mana from Subaru.

Spells:

Shamak (シャマク, Shamaku): One of the most basic yin magic spells, and the only spell Subaru could use until the collapse of his gate, was "Shamak." When cast, a blanket of black smoke would erupt from the user that would cover a significantly large area. Any target engulfed by the smoke would completely lose their spatial awareness. Under the spell's effect, the only thing the target could sense was the ground under their feet and any damage done to their body. Although it was a low-level spell, it proved an effective smokescreen when retreating or for masking attacks. As it was the only spell he was capable of using, Subaru was particularly fond of Shamak. he used it a number of times, and even came to grow attached to it, calling it "Shamak-san." He is still able to use the spell through Beatrice.
Ol Shamak (オル・シャマク): An anti-Witch spell that was originally created by Echidna. It is a forbidden art that immobilizes its target, preventing them from moving and ceasing the activity of their body's gate. When activated on a target without a Witch Factor or Authority, they are bound in a black light with a contradictory force. The spell can only be used to its full potential when cast on someone with a Witch Factor or Authority, encasing them in a completely black orb. Anyone else who enters the vicinity of the spell while it is being used on a Witch Factor or Authority bearer will also find themselves captured within the orb. The orb can vary in strength, and it has the capability to become so tough that it cannot be destroyed by outside interference or simple brute strength, to the point that only something like a slash from the Dragon Sword Reid can destroy it. It unusually uses an "Ol" prefix, meaning it classifies as separate from the typical prefix classifications. After learning of its existence via Al in a failed loop, Beatrice was able to discern the forbidden art's mechanisms while she and Subaru were sealed, allowing them to recreate this spell together after the latter Returned by Death. Although it is unclear if a person's strength can prevent this, if an ordinary person were to be sealed for an extended period of time, then they would find themselves bedridden and put in a state of recovery after being released. In the Sasageru IF, when Subaru was released from his seal after 400 years, he was put in such a state that if not for specific stimulus, he likely would not have recovered, and even with that stimulus, it took him 40 years to recover. This being said, Subaru's condition may have only been exacerbated due to the orb being destroyed by the Yang Sword Vollachia, due to the Dragon Sword Reid or Aldebaran, the original caster of the spell, having been unavailable.
Minya (ミーニャ, Mīnya): Subaru can create stakes made of crystallized mana covered with light purple flames as an offensive attack via spiritual arts. They are strong enough to penetrate defenses. Any stakes in the air explode and release smaller stakes that fly in all directions which then rips targets apart.
El Minya (エル・ミーニャ, Eru Mīnya): The spell works very similar to normal Minya. The only difference is the number of stakes, which increase to around 40.
Murak (ムラク, Muraku): Subaru reduces the effects of gravity. Just by jumping lightly, a person can jump as if they had springs. If Subaru wishes to, it can also be used to fly, although Subaru will get blown around by the wind like a leaf, but he won't flip around in midair. He can also use this on his opponents to throw them off balance and combine it with his whip to send opponents as large as a fully transformed Shaula flying.

Unique Spells: In the year that followed the creation of their contract, Subaru and Beatrice created three unique spells that each have wildly different effects. At present, only the third spell has yet to be seen, though it is implied to be specifically made for combat compared to the other two more defensive type spells.
thumb|240x240px|Beatrice and Subaru using EMM against Regulus.
EMM (E・M・M; エミリアたんマジ女神, Emiria-tan Maji Megami; "Emilia-tan is Seriously a Goddess"): EMM is an "absolute defense magic". Beatrice uses Yin Magic to interfere with the time and space around Subaru, and while he can't move during activation, he experiences no interference from outside the barrier. It is similar to Regulus Corneas's Lion's Heart, but does not have the same risk, renders Subaru and Beatrice unable to move, and can be used until mana runs out.
thumb|240x240px|Subaru and Beatrice using EMT to nullify Shaula's Hell's Snipe.
EMT (E・M・T; エミリアたんマジ天使, Emiria-tan Maji Tenshi; "Emilia-tan is Seriously an Angel"): EMT is an "absolute negation magic". It is a spherical field several tens of meters long with Subaru and Beatrice at the center is created, which negates effects from mana within it, including the mana used in meteors. Julius remarks that it is useful against mages and those who use mana to assist their techniques. Meanwhile, Subaru and Beatrice are still capable of casting magic regularly within this field, keeping their abilities unaffected by the field. However, the magic only negates the use of mana, and so it has no effect against opponents who fight without it. It is also claimed that if a mage rewrites a formula and overcomes the feeling that washes over them, it is possible to cast magic within this field. At the same time, if one is willing to harm themself, they can cast magic from within the body to attack their opponent. Due to its nature, it has been claimed that in another era, it had the potential to be labelled a forbidden art.

Conditional Spells: On occasion, Subaru has cast different spells in combination with other people outside of his usual spiritual arts.
thumb|right|240px|Subaru using "Rental Goa" against Petelgeuse.
Rental Goa (レンタル・ゴーア, Rentaru Gōa): Not being one of his spells made after forming a formal contract with Beatrice, this was instead a Goa used on the spot during Subaru's provisional contract with Ia, hence why he chose to call it a "rental" spell. It was used against Petelgeuse to set him on fire after being doused in oil.
Cocytus (コキュートス, Kokyūtosu): Cocytus is a large-scale spell made out of two combined elements, which was used by Subaru and Emilia during their fight against the Great Rabbit. While Subaru used Yin Magic to form some sort of a barricade around the witchbeasts to prevent them from escaping, Emilia used Fire Magic to carefully apply magical energy to the already-casted Minya spell, creating an icy cage and lifting the cage, the witchbeasts, and the ground itself high in the air.

Defective Gate: After overusing his gate, it became defective, meaning he could no longer cast any kind of magic or expel mana on his own. Should he be separated from Beatrice for an extended period of time, the accumulation of mana within his body would eventually reach the point where he would be incapable of moving and eventually die if he could not expel it somehow. However, during the events of Arc 7, when he was separated from Beatrice, Subaru managed to withstand having an immense amount of mana gather within his body, which should ordinarily have been lethal with his broken gate. Though his mana has since been subdued after reuniting with her and even gave her a greater amount of mana to work with, Subaru has speculated that the irregularity with the mana in his body was caused either by his connection to the Pleiades Battalion or by the infantilization on his body causing an abnormality with his gate, with the former option being more likely.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
Mediocre Physical Abilities: Subaru grew up an active athlete in his early years in his school, and although he drifted from partaking in any school activities prior to his transportation to the new world, he nevertheless still maintains a strict fitness regimen, and as a result, he has raw athletic prowess and a high degree of physical strength, reflex, and stamina, at least in comparison to those of his own world. Subaru personally mentions that he is able to bench 80 kg (176 lbs). Before being teleported into the new world, he maintained a fitness regimen of one hundred push-ups, sit-ups, and squats a day, allowing him extremely above average physical ability, especially for a hikikomori whose diet consisted of mostly convenience store items, and even after his summoning, he continues to keep his body in shape, regularly partaking in radio calisthenics as well. Despite all that, Subaru is not as skilled as the vast majority of warriors he's encountered during his time in the new world and can barely hold his own against normal people. According to the author, a fistfight between Otto Suwen and Subaru would always end in Otto's win. This being said, he is still capable of scrapping with normal people if he can catch them by surprise, such as Ton, Chin, and Kan in the very first arc. To somewhat make up for his fighting shortcomings, Subaru has sharp reflexes and demonstrated it when he was able to dodge Felt’s confused swings when she confused him for an intruder and Rem's flail attack in the second attempt for his life. It should also be noted that he cannot use the Flow Method.

Below Average Sword Skills: He did kendo in middle school for a time, so he understands some of the basics of swordsmanship. After his humiliating defeat at the hands of Julius, Subaru received some rough sword training under Wilhelm van Astrea at the Karsten mansion. Thanks to his small amount of experience in kendo, he was able to get a basic grasp on swordsmanship. However, despite this, because Subaru has basically no talent for a sword, he would not be able to win against any other sword wielder.

Parkour and Survival Skills: During the following year after the incident at the Sanctuary, Subaru learned the basics of parkour from Clind and began training himself. The butler also provided Subaru with essential survival skills, which came in handy to Subaru in the start of Arc 7.

Whipmanship: After the events of Arc 4, he was taught by Clind how to use a whip. Though he doesn’t usually use it directly for offense, he uses it in tandem with his parkour and survival skills and other various tricks in combat. At times, he also uses the crack of the whip to temporarily catch his enemies off guard, and he even uses it in tandem with his Yin Magic, mostly with Murak.

Expert Needlework: Subaru is surprisingly talented at sewing. In later arcs, his skill improves to the point where he can even make stuffed toys.

Curses
Subaru is currently afflicted by two types of curses: curses from numerous Wolgarm witchbeasts and a curse from an unnamed Dragon's blood. He also once had a distance-surpassing killing curse once before, but it no longer afflicts him.
Wolgarm Curse: In Arc 2, Subaru was bitten by numerous Wolgarms that attempted to drain his mana with their curse. Although they were all slain before the curses were activated, the curses were too numerous to be removed, so he was forced to keep the curses inactive within his body.

Curse of the Dragon's Blood: After his fight with the Sin Archbishop of Lust and getting afflicted by the curse within her Dragon's blood, Subaru's entire right leg was miraculously healed, despite having it torn off after his fights with the Sin Archbishop of Greed and Lust. This very same leg was covered in thick and pulsating black veins, turning it completely black, and it attained the ability to regenerate from damage it took, as tested by Priscilla. It also seemed to have given him a form of enhanced leg strength as he found that he could leap impressive distances while he was being pursued by Regulus through Priestella, even allowing him to run along the surface of walls with ease. Similarly, he took in even more of the curse into his right arm after touching Crusch, who had the very same curse within her, making his arm look as though it was covered in black veins. Roughly three months later, during the events of Arc 7, Subaru lost his right hand while fighting against an Elgina, and immediately after falling unconscious, the curse spilled out of his bloody arm and completely regrew his hand, which was beneath a layer of black, rubbery, peelable skin. As such, the curse that once rested in his arm is gone. Unlike his leg, this hand was not able to heal.
Distance-Surpassing Killing Curse: During his time as a gladiator on Ginunhive, Subaru, like the rest of the people on the island, was given a curse connected to a curse tool created by Groovy Gumlet. If he was a given distance away from the tool, then it would kill him. While others died instantly, Subaru was assailed with intense pain and was bleeding because of it, having taken intense internal damage. This is likely due to his apparent resistance to the curse. It has since been removed from his body.

Curse Resistance: For unknown reasons, Subaru has displayed a seeming resistance to curses, as seen from his reactions to the Dragon blood's curse and the distance-surpassing killing curse.

Others
thumb|250px|Subaru heavily resonating to Spirit Magic.
Spirit Affinity: Subaru has a rare innate gift to form contracts with spirits. His affinity for it is also rather high, as when Julius attempted to use his spirits to break out of a spell, it resonated with Subaru to the point that he was barely able to move, leaving the Spirit Knight baffled and mentioning he'd need to adjust the frequency of his spell in order for it to adapt to Subaru. Similarly, despite not being contracted with him, some spirits show willingness to assist him, as in the case of one of Emilia’s lesser spirits in Priestella and Ia during the Subjugation of Sloth. Likewise, his body is highly compatible with spirits who intend to possess his body; even the evil spirit Petelgeuse commented on the high level of compatibility he had with Subaru when he managed to possess it in one failed loop.

Apostle of Greed: For partaking in the Trial of the Sanctuary, Subaru was given the mark of the Witch of Greed Echidna that indicated him as an Apostle of Greed. Because of this title, Subaru was capable of commanding the many replicas of Ryuzu Meyer created by Echidna centuries ago. The replicas were compelled to follow any order they were given, regardless of their own thoughts on the matter. Despite having had his right to take the trials in the Sanctuary revoked, he retained his title as an Apostle.

Talented Actor: Although he often doesn't need it, Subaru is talented at acting and immersing himself in different roles. In particular, he has shown particularly skilled in playing the part of Natsumi Schwartz, who has been put in a position of the married noblewoman and a military advisor. His skill in acting has proved enough to completely deceive many people and allow him to work undercover. His acting is so good that in the Azamuku IF, very few people were able to realize his identity, allowing him to survive in his precarious position.

Equipment
Since the beginning of the story, Subaru has been forced to use a wide array of items and weapons in order to overcome most of the situations he was thrown into, though most of the items that he has used have either been discarded or destroyed in one manner or another:
Cell Phone: When he first came to the world, he had his cell phone on him. Though he could no longer make calls with it, it came in handy alongside his Return by Death, allowing him to obtain an accurate time of when certain beasts may appear or using it in negotiations. He gave his phone to Russell Fellow sometime after Arc 3.
Spiked Club: Though temporarily, Subaru wielded Rom's Spiked Club to fight against Elsa during the Loot House Incident. However, it was cut in half.
Sword: During the Wolgarm Incident, Subaru was given the sharpest sword that the Arlam Villagers had to fight with. However, it was broken during the fight and lost towards the end of the incident. He was later able to use another one on Ginunhive during the Sparka event, though he no longer uses it.
Cloak of Concealment: During the events of Arc 3, he took temporary possession of Emilia's cloak, which allowed the user to mask their appearance. However, he later returned the cloak to her. During the events of Arc 10, he was given another one.
Glintstone Necklaces: During the events of Arc 4, he carried Frederica's glintstone necklace, which was connected to the Sanctuary, and later, during two of his failed loops, he also carried Garfiel's. However, following the incident's conclusion, he now carries neither.
Petra's Handkerchief: During the events of Arc 4, Petra Leyte gifted him a white handkerchief that tied around his wrist. During one failed loop, said handkerchief was somehow weaponized by Echidna, which allowed him to stab himself. It is unknown whether he still has the handkerchief.
thumb|Subaru's Guiltywhip.
Guiltywhip (ギルティウィップ): Subaru uses a whip as his main weapon. Like his parkour, Subaru learned the basics of using it from Clind. In the Light Novel, it was revealed that his preferred whip was made of the witchbeast they fought in Arc 4, the Guiltylowe. He named said whip the Guiltywhip.
Vincent's Dagger: During his traversal across the Buddheim Jungle, Subaru was temporarily given a dagger with a wolf motif to cut through the foliage, which he failed to realize the significance of. In one failed loop, due to its significance, it even gave him just enough sway over the imperial soldiers there that he would not be harmed and was even treated as a temporary guest. However, he no longer carries the dagger.
Meteor Ring: For a short time in Arc 7, he was given a meteor ring that was imbued with the element of fire which required a kiss to activate. He ultimately destroyed it during the battle against the Elgina.
Lethal Poison Packet: Throughout the events of Arc 7 and Arc 8, Subaru kept poison, created by Null from the Gladiator Island Ginunhive, packed between his molars that he could easily smash between his teeth if he required it. He used this when he needed to guarantee his death and trigger his Authority. The packet has since been removed by Sphinx.

intro: Puck (パック) is an artificial spirit created by Echidna that Emilia was formerly contracted with. He is counted among the Four Great Spirits as the Beast of the End. He played a major supporting role in Arc 1, Arc 3, and Arc 4, and he played a supporting role in Arc 2.
appearance: In his smaller form, Puck stands at nine centimeters tall and is small enough to fit in the palm of a person's hand. Aside from his diminutive stature and the fact that he usually stands on his hindlegs, Puck is fairly physically reminiscent of a common house cat, specifically an American Shorthair. The light grey and white fur that coats his entire body is well-groomed and very soft. His eyes are Bright Aqua blue, and his pink nose is another trait that separates him from a house cat. Puck's tail is abnormally long to the point that it is the length of his body, and his ears are floppy yet extremely soft to the touch. On his left ear, Puck wears a single golden hoop earring that makes his ear droop down. He can also occasionally be seen carrying around a miniaturized magenta handbag that fits his small size perfectly.
personality:
Puck is generally a nice spirit. He is usually in a very good and happy mood and usually stood at Emilia's side to protect her, affectionately calling her "Lia" or "my daughter". He occasionally shows his goofy side as well, which can be clearly observed during the events of Arc 2, where Puck nonchalantly teases both Subaru and Emilia with seemingly no end. Furthermore, Puck gets along especially well with Beatrice. However, Puck's demeanor greatly changed in loops where Emilia died. When such tragedy struck, he was willing to destroy the world to save Emilia and to fulfill his vows with the Witch of Greed.

Despite his seemingly never-ending happy-go-lucky attitude, Puck usually reacts and acts very cold and sometimes even hostile with everyone else besides Emilia, Beatrice, Roswaal, Rem, Ram, and Subaru. During the Royal Selection Ceremony at the start of Arc 3, Puck was mere seconds away from freezing the entire Royal Throne Room, killing everyone inside it; though, it was revealed soon after that the entire exchange was a plan devised by Roswaal in order to have Emilia make a memorable impression on the Council of Wise Men and the other four Royal Selection Candidates.
history:
Loving the Days Gone By
Around 400 years ago, Puck was a humanoid being, but he was turned into an Artificial Spirit by Echidna to watch over Emilia. Roughly three years after his creation, he and Beatrice helped Toska in fending off the Silver Dragons led by Fargall. At some point during this time, he also became aware of other figures such as Hector, the Warlock of Melancholy, and Altair Mathers.

He left Echidna by the time she moved into the Sanctuary to look for Emilia. After having searched for her for hundreds of years, he managed to find her frozen within Elior Forest. Several decades before the present day, according to a story relayed by Julius Juukulius's grandfather, after him and his some of his comrades were left behind in a snow storm during a clash between the knights and Gusteko's Temple Knights along the borders of the countries, he dragged the bodies of his comrades and struggled to escape the blizzard they were caught in until he found himself in a frozen forest. Within the forest, he met a “phantom”, who said that if they caused any chaos near his beloved daughter, he would never forgive them. Suddenly, the knights appeared in the middle of a plain, and they managed to regroup with the Royal Knights. Although Julius's grandfather reported what happened, he was not taken seriously, and the tale, known as “The Phantom Father in the Snow”, would come to be seen as a delusion that was induced by the extreme cold and the snow storm.

Bonds of Ice
Seven years before the start of the Royal Selection, Puck unfroze Emilia and began to act as her mentor and father figure. Sometime after unfreezing her, Puck and Emilia ended up in a conflict with one of the Four Great Spirits, the Arbitrator, Melakuera. After defeating the spirit, Puck succeeded him as a member of the Four Great Spirits, and he formed a contract with Emilia, causing both his and her memories to be sealed.

For the next seven years, he continued to live with and protect Emilia inside the forest. One day, however, Roswaal L. Mathers appeared in the house that they were using, and because of the suspicion Puck had for the mage, the two wound up in battle. Eventually, Roswaal managed to talk with the Great Spirit, and he offered Emilia the Dragon Insignia, in which the Jewel glowed and determined her worth as a Royal Candidate. Despite Puck’s reservations, when Emilia learned of the Dragon’s blood that the ruler of the Kingdom has access to, she accepted the offer to come to Roswaal Manor, and Puck decided to follow her. There, he reunited with Beatrice, and he became friendly with the maids.

Emilia's Royal Capital Tour Book
During her visit to the Royal Capital, after getting separated from Ram, she and Puck wandered around the capital. She soon saw a little girl who was struggling to pay for the food she'd eaten. Emilia at first tried to help by paying for it with her own money, only to realize her wallet was missing. She then quickly thought of showing Puck around while doing tricks to earn some change for her. Her plan worked but not as intended as a citizen recognizes Puck as a great spirit and a whole crowd of people flee en masse, leaving their wallets behind due to hysteria, as they thought a half-elf would unleash the great spirit's wrath upon them if they did not pay. The little girl later thanked Emilia for the help she provided. It was a short while after that that her insignia was stolen by Felt.

Behind the Scenes of Life in Another World from Zero
Shortly after Felt stole her insignia, Emilia attacked her with magic and chased after her. After entering an alleyway, they couldn't find Felt, and nearby, they could hear a guard's whistle in response to the commotion. Though Emilia thought about asking for their help, Puck reminded her that she couldn't do that since she knew she was a Royal Selection candidate and couldn't let anyone else find out. Deciding to escape the area, she created an ice staircase and started running along the rooftops of the Royal Capital.

The two talked about how they should proceed, whether to look for Ram and get her assistance or to solve the issue on their own and not owe Roswaal anymore before the Royal Selection started. Thinking about where Felt could be, they concluded that she was probably in the slums. Before heading there, however, Emilia noticed a tearful Plum Risch who was separated from her parents. Although the timing was bad, Emilia still attempted to help her, getting her to open up with ice sculptures and having Puck dance. Afterward, the two walked through the capital until they arrived at an appa stand, where the girl's father and mother were. When Kadomon asked her how he could repay her, though she didn't give the full explanation, she asked about Felt and how something she had was stolen, leading him to tell her about the Loot House and warning her not to go there. Emilia still resolved to go there, and before she could go, Plum offered her a red flower ornament as thanks for her help.

On her way to the slums, she found herself on the opposite side of a few thugs. However, before they could do anything to her, she quickly cornered them. Afterward, she asked them about the Loot House, and they pointed her in the right direction. Eventually, she found the Loot House, where three people inside were talking. When one of them noticed, she heard a young man say not to open the door or that they'd die, leading to Emilia pouting about not being so short tempered and the Loot House Incident.

Emilia's Starry Sky Classroom
Before the Wolgarm Incident, Emilia visited the Forbidden Library to get Puck back from Beatrice before going to the garden. While at the library, she spoke with Beatrice and asked her if she would like to look at the stars with her and Subaru, mentioning that Subaru had taught her a whole lot about stars, some of them being Altair, Vega, and Betelgeuse, which she mispronounces as Petelgeuse; the last name brought out a reaction from Beatrice, and she kicked Emilia and Puck out of her library. Outside in the garden, she talked with Puck and mentioned that Subaru told her his name was inspired by the stars and could mean "Pleiades" from where he came from. She also said he taught her the story behind the Altair and Vega stars during Tanabata. Shortly after she finished the story, Subaru appeared, meaning that soon after, another sky classroom would begin.

The Head Maid's Unrestful Holiday
Noticing how hard Rem worked, Subaru spoke with the other residents of Roswaal Manor, and he proposed that she take a day off. Despite the slight opposition of the others, he was able to persuade them to agree after saying that she could use the day off to think about what she wanted as her reward for her participation in the Wolgarm Incident, and when Rem herself was reluctant to take a day off, Subaru told her to take the day off directly, and she agreed to his command immediately. Afterward, everyone decided on which jobs they would handle to make up for not having Rem’s help and split up to handle their respective tasks.

Anxious, Rem went to see how everyone was faring with their tasks, and she went to the bath, where she expected Puck and Beatrice to be doing the laundry. Concerned due to the number of unique outfits that shouldn’t be cleaned together and worried about whether or not they could properly handle the fabric, she rushed to handle those herself. When she got there, however, she found Puck instructing Beatrice how to deal with clothes while cleaning his own load with magic. Overhearing their discussion about the tedium and necessity of doing laundry and coming to an understanding about why Subaru wanted to give Rem a day off, Rem walked away, grateful to them.

The Great Spirit Puck's Nyan Nyan Nyan Sunny Day
A few days after Puck was caught acting leisurely while in his free time, Puck searched for Subaru asking for help and tips, as Emilia seemed to be rather angry with him over the past few days. Subaru mentioned that it was his own fault for having proven with his actions that he was not the ideal role model he made himself out to be in front of Emilia. Ignoring Subaru's argument, Puck decided that the reason was because he needed to act much cuter. Since he had become much more serious as of late, he decided to go train poses to win Emilia's forgiveness. Much later, while Emilia was talking to Subaru about how she was still mad at Puck for lying to her about what he did in his free time, Puck appeared and did his poses as planned. In the end, Emilia forgave him, and Subaru, slightly annoyed, mentioned that "a pet only misbehaves if the owner spoils it rotten".

Rem's Very Ordinary Happy Day
One night, Rem was summoned by Roswaal and Puck, who requested snacks for their drinks. After she prepared the snacks, she was invited by the two to keep them company. After some small talk about their handling of alcohol and the night of the stargazing party, they began speaking about Subaru’s gate, which had been damaged during the Wolgarm Incident. Intent on bringing the best healer in the capital, Ferris, he had discussed with Puck about using something from within Elior Forest, the magic stones, to bargain with Ferris, who was already a critical part of House Karsten and the Crusch Camp. After assigning Rem the task of keeping a close eye on Subaru, she left, having been slightly affected by the smell of the alcohol.

The Great Spirit Puck's Nyan Nyan Tricks
On the way to the castle for the Royal Selection Ceremony, Roswaal, Puck, and Emilia had a small talk in their carriage. Puck mentioned that the Dragon has a bad habit of choosing only women as priestesses to keep the lineage going. Emilia got confused as to what he meant, leading Roswaal to mention that Puck had a very overprotective nature to Emilia for not telling the whole story about the selection, which Puck replied that Emilia wouldn't become interested in something she isn't aware of. When they finally arrived at the castle, Roswaal asked Puck for a minute of his time for a private talk at a distance from Emilia. As they walked away, Puck noticed the castle was filled with imagery of the tale of the three heroes. Puck considered them works of art with a bad taste for their inaccuracy. Roswaal moved on to the main topic, mentioning that he wanted Puck's help in a little scheme of his, and he asked him to not grow violent inside the castle, revealing that he had a feeling that someone would insult Emilia during the ceremony and that Subaru would try to protect her. Puck immediately said to Roswaal that if he told Subaru to disobey Emilia's request to not come to the castle, then he would fight him right then and there. Roswaal denied his assumption, saying that he merely had a hunch. The conversation ended after Puck reluctantly agreed on the scheme.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
At one point, Puck was declared by the author one of the strongest characters in the series. Despite being an artificial spirit, he was able to defeat the previous member of the Four Great Spirits and even take his place, while he could also fight evenly with Roswaal, whose own magical prowess is among the best in the series, as well as delay his spells for a time. Although he was unable to display his true might because of his contract with Emilia, his strength is so overwhelming that he could very easily make good on his vow to end the world in the case of Emilia's death.

Magic/Spiritual Arts
Puck is very skilled at different types of magic, capable of using most, if not all, attributes of magic. However, he excels the most with the fire attribute. In fact, being the great spirit that presides over fire mana, it can be said that Puck is perhaps among the most proficient fire magic users in the series, and the sheer power of his fire magic even surpasses Roswaal's. However, like Emilia, Puck prefers using fire magic to produce ice. However, being an artificial spirit, he has a terrible mana consumption, and during the time he was contracted with Emilia, the two were actually considerably weaker. As such, to make up for his deficiency as an artificial spirit, should he need power from a source besides a contractor, he will drain it not from the atmosphere but from the surroundings, often leaving things frozen over in the process.

Spells:

Shamak (シャマク): Puck's target becomes unable to sense where they are. However, they can still feel the ground and sense what is happening to their body.
Healing Magic (治癒魔法, Chiyu Mahō): Puck utilizes healing magic to give simple first aid to others. However, he does not have an aptitude for it, so he can only lessen someone's pain and is unable to treat major wounds.

Unique Spells:
Ice Flower (氷の花, Kōri no Hana): Puck has demonstrated the ability to plant a seed within someone from which flowers of ice can later bloom. The flowers bloom by feeding off of negative emotions and sucking the host's blood and life force.
Absolute Zero (絶対零度): Puck can freeze things to absolute zero temperatures, causing the target to quickly crumble to pieces under their own weight. He was also able to release Emilia from being frozen, despite having been frozen at absolute zero by her own power for almost a hundred years, and the fact that only someone with equal power to Emilia could unfreeze her.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
As an artificial spirit, Puck has several drawbacks. He has a terrible mana consumption rate and cannot absorb mana from the atmosphere. Because of this, he requires either a contractor or to draw mana from the surroundings, which can leave behind negative aftereffects. Similarly, thanks to a vow that he made, during his time contracted with Emilia, he broke another vow that led to his temporary loss of memories and other issues, such as when he could appear. Even now, he is struggling to manifest because of the crystal he is being held in, which does not contain enough power to allow himself to appear.

Star Beastification (星獣化 Seijuuka): While normally staying small in size, Puck's true form is a monstrous, 20 meter, glowing yellow eyed (in the anime it's been shown that Puck is able to keep his icy green eye color in that form if he controls his temper) cat-like beast, dubbed "the Beast of the End". As he needs an incredible amount of mana to stay in this form, he forcibly drains it from his surroundings, causing them to freeze.

Size Manipulation: Puck is able to manipulate his size somewhat freely. He can be the size of the average cat, smaller than one’s palm, and, in rare cases, the rough size of his Star Beastification. Though he usually has no need for the excessively large size, he can use it to trick his enemies into thinking he is using his full strength to catch them off guard. However, he does not have complete freedom over his size. If he does not have enough mana, he might not be able to do much as maintain his proper size.

Other
Curse Removal: Puck, just like Beatrice, can sense when an individual has been affected by a curse. He can tell where on a person's body a curse has been placed and can subsequently remove it. However, Puck can only remove a curse if the caster has yet to activate the curse they have placed on a person. Furthermore, he can't tell the effects the curse would inflict on an individual without observing the curse in effect.

Mana Drain: Unlike most spirits, Puck does not absorb mana from the atmosphere. Instead, Puck obtains his mana from living creatures. By touching an individual, Puck can absorb the mana stored in their gate, bolstering his own supply of mana in the process. The individual affected by the technique would become physically fatigued if enough of their mana was drained. He is the only one besides Beatrice that knows this skill, though Reinhard displayed a similar ability at the end of Arc 1.

Pseudo-Telepathy: Puck is capable of reading the surface thoughts or intentions of individuals he comes into contact with to an extent. He can also communicate telepathically through this with anyone who has an affinity with spirits, even without Emilia being aware. Likewise, Puck is capable of freely and remotely communicating with Beatrice by using something similar to his telepathy. However, this ability seems to be one-way, as it seems Beatrice cannot reply. The range of this ability is unknown, but it seems to work across different dimensions, as Puck was able to call Beatrice from inside the mansion while she was still in the Forbidden Library with Subaru.
