intro: Priscilla Barielle (プリシラ・バーリエル) is an exiled imperial princess of the Sacred Vollachia Empire, the Matriarch of House Barielle, and a candidate to become the 42nd monarch of Lugunica. While only a supporting character in Arc 3 and Arc 5, she had a major role in Arc 7 and Arc 8. She was also one of the main protagonists of The Tale of the Scarlet Princess.
appearance:
Priscilla's long orange hair shone radiantly like the sun itself and flowed through a single barrette before spilling down her back. Her crimson eyes had a glimmer of strong will that betrayed her commanding personality. She had pale, white skin and faintly pink lips. She was considered a woman of true divine beauty. Additionally, her dainty figure possessed noticeably bountiful breasts and other shapely features. She stood at 164 centimeters (5'5"), the same height as Emilia.

Priscilla wore exquisite clothing that matched the crimson color of her eyes. The dress she most frequently wore was an opulent black and red aristocratic dress with wrapped off-the-shoulder sleeves, a wide-hemmed heel-length red skirt, a black petticoat, a large black ribbon with red striping attached to the right side of her waist, and a black flowery ornament with red edging and emerald jewels decorating each petal that was adorned on the opposite side of Priscilla's waist. The dress was also backless and prettified by various emeralds fastened to the skirt. Under her dress, she wears translucent reddish-brown holdup stockings with a black elasticized band at the top. She also had a black choker, a pair of red high-heel shoes, and a pair of long black fingerless opera gloves. She often carried a crimson handheld folding fan that she claimed from a half-sister she felled. Finally, her middle fingers ware bedecked with a single emerald ring each and similarly colored teardrop-shaped earrings dangled from her earlobes. The jewels enriching Priscilla's figure were all of such fine craftsmanship that anyone could tell they were incredibly expensive at a glance. Natsuki Subaru estimated that her full outfit from top to bottom was worth at least a hundred times his own money.

When she was inside her mansion, she wore a red outfit that highlighted her body a bit. She had a small coat with a black bow in the center and has a black clip on her hair, in which she had a ponytail. She also wore a pair of black studs. She kept her fan between her breasts.
personality:
Priscilla was an arrogant, proud, and absurd woman, and she held the conviction that the world, which she extolled as beautiful, worked for her convenience. She classified people according to their interests; if someone was not of her interest, she would not remember their names and would not pay attention to them anymore. This happened with Subaru a few days after meeting him, though despite this, she later spoke of him as if she had still been paying attention to him. Her biggest enemy was boredom, so the things she did were to avoid it. She repeatedly hit Al or ordered him to do something to entertain her. She was also able to position herself in situations unimaginable to any gentleman, such as leading a dangerous expedition simply because she was curious. In her speech during the Royal Selection Ceremony, she declared that under her command, everyone would be able to get what they wanted. She was, according to Aldebaran, very volatile and very dangerous when she was angry, and she also had a habit of purposefully antagonizing others merely because she believes it would be entertaining, as she showed by bringing Heinkel Astrea with her to instigate the other members of House Astrea in Priestella at the time. Despite her self-centered attitude, Priscilla valued ​​people who keep their pride, as seen when, in a failed loop, she kicked Subaru for choosing to abandon his pride to get what he wanted, or when she was amused when she spoke to Felt, where Felt refused to take an easy way out of a situation she was in.

Priscilla showed confidence in her actions since she typically always came out on top. She was also not afraid to fight since she knew how to fight and defend herself, and she was not intimidated when she had to face Sirius, when she encountered zombies in her territory, or when she went to search for the thieves within her domain. Even in the face of one who wanted revenge on her, she showed no fear as she looked them in the eyes, and despite her opponent's goals to inflict despair on her, she stood proudly, entirely unaffected by that enemy's efforts. Though she was well known for being a woman who over the years ended up being a widow, Priscilla did not seem to mind at all. She considered her last husband, Leip, to be an old pervert and did not care for her marriage with him. She also displayed a seeming lack of care for the predicaments of the people around her. Despite seeming lack of care for people, however, Priscilla is able to understand other people after meeting them for a mere few moments. With extended conversations with other people, she can even glean an insight into the truth of their personalities and conflicts, even when the words conveyed were few. She also imitates her brother's habit when she enters contemplation, and she admires his attitude as well upon weighing his responsibilities, though she believes that such actions are excessive, that there were some that one could meet only by closing their eyes.

True to her self-centered demeanor, she had no need to deceive others, nor did she like to. She respected everyone's freedoms, and though she claimed that everything would become hers should she become the country's monarch, she had no intentions of hoarding everything nearby her, as she believed doing so would be akin to locking a bird in a cage and depriving it of the beauty of flight and freedom. She loved when people attempted to reach for an objective outside of their capacities, and whether the person succeeds or fails in reaching their goal, she loved it regardless. Despite her apparent lack of love for others, she actually does love other people, as evidenced through her Soul Marriage Technique, which affects everyone she loves and those who harbor emotions for her, which reflected her love through the gifts her husbands gave her; her love seemed to encompass all of life as well, as her Soul Marriage Technique not only affected those in a city she was in at one point, but also the people in an entirely different city that was more than a day away, effectively both strengthening and protecting them all. Priscilla has shown to be willing to sacrifice herself for others as well, which she did when she once acted to remove poison directly from Arakiya by ingesting said poison herself and dividing the effect, when she believed that her mother and Arakiya were both in danger at the start of the Great Disaster, and, not fearing death, she even later willingly burned away her body and ended her life to fight alongside her allies. She was also not shy of complimenting other people for their accomplishments, even if others were unable to see exactly what those accomplishments were, and such words of acknowledgement and gratitude were some of the very last words she spoke.
history:
The Tale of the Scarlet Princess
Priscilla was born in the Vollachian Empire as one of the many children of the then emperor Drizen Vollachia and Sandra Benedict, one of the many reincarnated lives of Iris. Her birth name was Prisca Benedict (プリスカ・ベネディクト, Purisuka Benedikuto). Sandra died in childbirth, leaving Priscilla alone until, for unknown reasons, her father decided to gift her with Arakiya, who became her foster sister and later her sworn sword. Prisca took part in the Vollachian Empire's Imperial Selection Ceremony at the age of 12 after witnessing her father burned by the Yang Sword and being deemed worthy by it. Despite not liking the system of succession forcing her to kill her siblings, she participated in it anyway, personally felling one of the frontrunners, her older half-sister Lamia Godwin, during her Siege on the Abellux Castle, as well as a descendant of the Evil Eye Tribe, Palladio Manesque. With the only other candidate, Vincent Abellux, remaining in the selection, Arakiya ended up betraying her, fearing she would be killed by her half-brother and agreed to a deal of his that would involve setting up a plot to fake her death, ingesting poison that Prisca took a portion of from her to save her life. The plot succeeded, and Prisca was regarded as dead. As a result, Vincent won the ceremony and became the emperor whilst Prisca took the name Priscilla, a name belonging to one of her deceased body doubles.

After escaping certain death, Priscilla married her first husband, Jorah Pendleton, and she changed her name to Priscilla Pendleton (プリシラ・ペンダルトン, Purishira Pendaruton). Sometime later, Serena Dracroy sent her servants Balleroy Temeglyph and Miles to the Pendleton Estate in order to invite Jorah and Priscilla to the Gladiator Island Ginunhive. While they were there, the gladiators attempted to spark a revolution that would render the island independent from the mainland. Priscilla feigned being Serena and was taken captive by the gladiators and their ringleader, a member of the Evil Eye Tribe named Ubilk. However, rather than seeking independence, Ubilk's true plan was to bring the Nine Divine Generals to the Gladiator Island for unknown reasons. After Priscilla used a broadcast to reveal Ubilk's plan, the rebellion ended up failing thanks to the intervention of the Imperial Army and a gladiator named Aldebaran. After the group left Ginunhive and returned to Serena's estate, Priscilla thanked her for the invitation in the stead of her resting husband.

Soon afterwards, Jorah was accused of attempting to overthrow Vincent Vollachia, from his position. As a result, Goz Ralfon visited his manor in an attempt to take custody of him and Priscilla for a scheduled execution. Jorah fended Goz and his escorts off for Priscilla's sake, knowing that he would meet his end in just mere moments. This bought time for Priscilla to escape until she had a chance meeting with Arakiya on the way. In the end, Arakiya let Priscilla escape and announced that she had committed suicide. At an unknown point in time after Jorah's execution, Serena ordered Balleroy and Miles to look for Priscilla, as there was a rumor going around about some bandits who kidnapped a girl looking like her. The duo successfully found her and managed to bring her to the estate. From there, Serena found a way to smuggle Priscilla out of the Empire and into the Kingdom of Lugunica. She was married six to six different men for a period of several years, but every husband of hers fell into ruin and met unnatural deaths, earning her the moniker “Bloody Bride”.

Priscilla eventually married Leip Barielle, the baron of the Barielle Domain. Leip, who had found that she was one of the candidates for the Royal Selection, sought to use her as a tool to achieve his dream of power, but Priscilla proved to be much harder to manipulate than he thought and decided to make her into a puppet by using the abilities of a curse arts user he was acquainted with. He also planned to prepare a knight who would look good alongside Priscilla as a sort of public relations strategy to improve her standing among citizens. Around this time, Priscilla met a starving, impoverished, orphaned, and nameless boy from a farming village in her domain. Despite being on the brink of death, he caught her interest because they shared the same eye color. She decided to call him Schult and she took him back to her manor so he could become a butler.

Priscilla's Cheers for Me, Entertainment Part
One day, Leip organized a tournament to decide who Priscilla's knight would be. She quickly got bored with the fighting while viewing the tournament, causing her to ask Schult for his thoughts. Schult decided to recommend Al, as he believed that the man showed care for Priscilla, unlike the other combatants. Priscilla thought Al was entertaining enough and that his fighting style was interesting, and she consequently selected him as her “clown”. This infuriated Leip, as he had tried to fix the tournament so that a winner would be under his control.

The Day I Gave Up on Being a Following Star
A few days later, Leip attempted to bring Al and Schult under his control, but he was refused when he revealed his intentions to make Priscilla into a puppet. Al clashed with Leip by using his ability, which resulted in the baron being incapacitated. In due time, Leip passed away before the commencement of the Royal Selection, leading Priscilla to take over as the governing lord of the Barielle Domain. Under her rule, the land, which was previously ravaged by severe poverty, quickly got back on its feet, and its people started to live much happier and better lives all thanks to Priscilla's leadership of the territory.

Sunlight Illuminating the Water's Surface
One day, Priscilla wanted Al to entertain her, though this resulted in her flicking him into a fountain on the grounds. With Schult worried about him and mentioning his helmet, Al mentioned that it wouldn't be destroyed so easily, after which he revealed to Priscilla he had acquired his helmet from and lost his arm at Ginunhive. With Priscilla becoming bored of listening to him, Priscilla told Schult to entertain her, leading him to tell her of a rumor that heading toward the spring near the town of Ladrima would allow one to see the deceased. Her interest piqued, she took them and headed toward the forest near Ladrima. There, Al questioned whether she wanted to see someone who had died, whereas she questioned his being against seeing the dead due to not wanting to see someone. Shortly after, Al was separated from his companions. After ordering Schult to take care of the fog, Priscilla dispelled the illusion assailing Al, and shortly after, the fog was lifted from the spring. This resulted in a short-lived fight with an evil spirit. Sometime later, when she was brought Kurenai flowers by a villager at her manor, Al realized that the actions Priscilla took were just so that she could see those flowers, and she ordered Al and Schult to decorate the manor.

Pride and Prejudice and Zombies
After the Royal Selection's commencement, a man named Array Denkuts came to the Barielle Manor in order to plead Priscilla to go to his home village, Coffleton, and eliminate the undead that had appeared there. Together with Al and Yae Tenzen, Priscilla went to Coffleton and discovered that the undead had some sort of parasite within them. The men of the town had all turned into undead who looked exactly as they did in life, while the women and children housed the parasites yet were still alive. Priscilla used the Yang Sword to remove the parasite from them, she gathered her private army, the Crimson Battlefront, to visit two other villages among the Tenrill River to eliminate any undead, and she brought Yae and Al with her to an unaffected village to investigate why there were no undead there. They visited a watermill and found that the manager there, Edda Rayfast, had become the leader of the undead, and she opened a trap door that led Al into a wastewater treatment plant.

On Priscilla's order, Yae retreated to search for Al. In the meantime, Priscilla conversed with Edda and discovered her plan to create a "paradise" for her "maker". When Yae found Al, he had cleared through waves of numerous undead and decided to save Priscilla from Edda. He went back to the watermill, successfully defeated Edda, and rescued Priscilla. With the undead's leader defeated, they returned to the Barielle Manor. However, at midnight, Yae made an attempt to visit Priscilla's room, as she was an assassin who made an attempt to kill her supposed mistress. She was stopped by Al, and after losing to him in a short-lived fight, she decided to “resign” due to “familial matters”.

Lugunican Papers
In the year following the Subjugation of the White Whale, she was requested an interview by Shorty Megan and Lululala. Already having a meeting with Anastasia Hoshin, the interview was scheduled on the same day. There, they discussed their opinions on the Royal Selection and the other candidates. In particular, both Anastasia and Priscilla claimed that Emilia didn’t stand a chance, as public discrimination against her was heavy as she was a perfect resemblance and of the same race as the Witch of Envy. Even with the slaying of the White Whale and the Sin Archbishop of Sloth under her belt, they claimed that it was an achievement the reflected more on her knight than her, which even Anastasia’s knight Julius Juukulius agreed with, though Al argued that his achievements also reflect on her. Eventually, the interview came to a close.

Priscilla's Cheers for Me, Drunk Father Part
At some point later that year, Priscilla made her way to a bandit den, where she found Heinkel Astrea, who had slaughtered all of the bandits in an effort to collect a cup rumored to have been capable of restoring anyone who drank out of it to full health. Though this turned out to be a sham, after bringing him back to a town and hearing his story, Heinkel offered his service to her as a means to counter the Felt Camp, who had the Sword Saint in it. Ultimately, Priscilla accepted him into her camp.

Priscilla-sama's Cheers for Me!
Not long after returning from the Battle for Priestella, Priscilla’s camp returned to the Barielle Domain. However, not long after arriving, Priscilla was confronted with assassins sent by Chisha Gold. Realizing they came from Vollachia, she swiftly dispatched them and decided to leave for her home country. However, Al was heavily against this, leading to him using his Authority to try and stop her. Though he died over 1000 times, in the end, he was unable to convince her, and the rest of her camp decided to go with her. Before setting out, however, Priscilla wrote her will to adopt Schult in the event of her death and name him as the heir to House Barielle, speaking aloud as she was being watched by Yae while hiding her will in a place only Yae knew of. Sometime later, with the assistance of Serena Dracroy, she managed to smuggle herself into Vollachia.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Priscilla was an accomplished fighter whose skills are considered equal to or superior to Crusch Karsten at one point. Her skill with the blade allowed her to easily repel most enemies, and combined with her signature Soul Marriage Technique, she was an incredibly difficult person to bring down, having even been capable of fighting and defeating the likes of the Sin Archbishop of Wrath, the Second of the Nine Divine Generals, and even the Witch Sphinx.

Divine Protection
Divine Protection of the Sun (日輪の加護, Nichirin no Kago): Priscilla's Divine Protection increased the effects of buffs, in addition to boosting her abilities while she is under the sun.

Techniques
Soul Marriage Technique (魂婚術, Konkon-jutsu): Soul Marriage is a long-lost secret technique of the old world that has been forgotten by most people. By dividing her own Od and bestowing it onto someone of her choosing, Priscilla imbued them with power more or less reflective of her own, and she greatly boosted their healing capabilities to the point someone acting under her Soul Marriage can receive multiple fatal wounds and be healed completely in a few short moments. However, in order for Soul Marriage to work, Priscilla must have not only loved the receiver of this ability, but she must have also be loved by that person in return. If this condition isn't met, Soul Marriage will not work. During the Flying Dragon Cataclysm in Guaral, Priscilla used this ability to protect Schult from being harmed by ensuring that he'd be healed from against any attack towards him. By kissing Liliana in Priestella, Priscilla was able to place her under the effects of Soul Marriage, freeing her from Sirius's Soulwashing. Furthermore, due to her love seeming to encompass life, the distance of her reach seems to be eliminated, as it managed to affect every living person in Lupugana and Garkla, which was more than a day away, simultaneously during the Conquest of the Undead Capital. The proof of being under that protection is in the painless fire that burns from their eyes. She can use this ability on herself, with her commenting that items like jewelry were bestowed to her by her past husbands and could be used to defend herself. Soul Marriage could also be used to block a lethal attack on the user by sacrificing one of the recipients of the user's Od, which typically results in her beloved articles receiving damage meant for her and being destroyed.

Intelligence
Keen Intellect: Despite her rather carefree demeanor, Priscilla had an unusually high level of insight, and she was able to come with the correct answers towards various matters despite being given limited information within a limited environment. Even Sphinx had admired her insight, as Priscilla was able to glean Sphinx's true intentions and limitations through little more than Sphinx's attitude and behavior and no outside perspectives. Likewise, because of this, she was able to learn that Subaru and Aldebaran each wielded an Authority that allowed them to fight against fate, with Priscilla even once mentioning how Subaru always seemed to have "good timing" in a similar manner to how Ram did during the events of Arc 5. Furthermore, she was able to easily discover the gathering of the Royal Selection candidates in Priestella despite not being invited, see through the facade of the artificial spirit, Echidna, when she took over and attempted to pose as Anastasia, to understand who sent assassins after her and the potential reason as to why, discover Sphinx's identity as the one who instigated the incident in Coffleton despite having never met her, and it was implied that she saw clear through her head chamberlain, Yae, as an assassin meant to watch over and potentially kill her, even apparently purposefully allowing her actions to be seen by her when she should have had no reason to believe she was being watched.

Magic
Priscilla has an affinity for the yang attribute. However, although she exhibited the ability to cast yang magic in the early web novel, she is not shown using magic at all in the light novel. As such, it is unclear if she retained the ability to use yang magic. Furthermore, according to the author, she has neither reached the pinnacle of using magic, nor has she put any effort into it.

Non-Canonical Spells:
Akra (アクラ): Priscilla produced pale colored light around the target that enveloped them in a veil of golden light. The veil presumably strengthened the target, allowing them to use their body more freely while at the same time making them more sensitive to pain. This magic was cut from the Light Novel.

Other
Great Intuition: Priscilla had great intuition, which allowed to guess the right and safest path towards the lost Schult during their stay in Priestella. She claimed that it didn't matter what choice she makes, since she'd always be right and it would always be positive for her.

Private Army: The Red Plates (赤拵え, Aka Koshirae), originally called the Crimson Battlefront (真紅戦線, Shinku Sensen) in Pride and Prejudice and Zombies, are a private army that was owned by Priscilla.

Equipment

Yang Sword Vollachia (陽剣ヴォラキア, Youken Vorakia): As a member of the Imperial Family of Vollachia, Priscilla was capable of summoning and using the Yang Sword Vollachia, otherwise known as the Yang Sword, an ornate crimson sword with light that shines like the sun. She mentions that it has a terrible mana consumption rate and therefore had it dissipate back into the atmosphere when she was not using it. Priscilla's Yang Sword could incinerate anything upon contact and could also throw and extinguish at will some white flames which are said to be inextinguishable, as those ignited even water. The Yang Sword seems to have its own will which tends to obey its wielder, as it cut down and burn those that it wishes to cut down and burn, rendering the slashes and fire harmless to everyone bar the desired target or targets, which was how Priscilla managed to destroy the parasites nested inside of the villagers with a swing of her Yang Sword, without harming their hosts. However, the Yang Sword's will doesn't necessarily always follow its wielder's will as Priscilla stated so, resulting in the Sword losing its shine which then can come back with time; while the drawbacks are not clear, Priscilla mentioned that the sharpness disappeared, but also said that the Yang Sword was still able to burn upon contact.
Fan: Priscilla could use the fan that she claimed from Lamia as a weapon. It has been shown to easily sever flesh while in Priscilla's hands.
Beloved Articles: As a user of Soul Marriage, gifts that were loved by Priscilla and were given with love become viable substitutes for lethal damage. Many pieces of her jewelry and hair ornaments, which she received from past husbands or a Vollachian jeweler, fall into these criteria, and they will receive damage in her place.

intro: Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti (ペテルギウス・ロマネコンティ) was a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing Sloth. In addition to his position as a Sin Archbishop, he was a spirit who lived for four centuries and a co-founder of the Witch Cult. He was the primary antagonist of Arc 3, and he is regularly referenced in many of the following arcs in one way or another.
appearance:
The vessel that Petelgeuse possessed was a thin man who stood at 180 centimeters tall, slightly taller than Subaru. His cheeks were gaunt and the skin on his bones was unusually thin. If it weren't for the twinkle of madness in his grey eyes, the Sin Archbishop would appear completely devoid of vitality. His complexion and lips, mirroring the rest of his figure, were deathly pale and had a sickly green tint to them. Sloth's deep-green hair was fairly short but still long enough to catch someone's eye. Despite his madness and general lack of social decorum, Petelgeuse's hair was stylized neatly into a bowl cut. In the anime adaptation, Petelgeuse's eyes were black instead of grey. According to Subaru, Sloth's breath and body both smelled repugnant. He did have a strange and twisted sense of fashion as he could usually be seen sporting a pair of crimson-red teardrop-shaped earrings, similar to that of Regulus, with a small exception of Petelgeuse's being a tiny bit smaller and, of course, of different color.

Out of the Sin Archbishops, Petelgeuse's outfit was the most similar to the standard dark-purple Witch Cult robe. He wore a clerical cassock that had a green stripe down the front and baggy sleeves with peach-coloured frills. Over the top of his cassock, Petelgeuse wore a purple cloak with an upturned collar, red seams, and pinkish interior. The cloak had a hood attached to it in the traditional Witch Cult style although Sloth was never seen wearing it, with the only exception being when he possessed his fellow fingers, but even then, it was rare to see him so. Lastly, a purple zucchetto with a grey ring around its edge rested atop his head.

About one hundred years ago, Petelgeuse could be seen as a much more normal member of society, sporting a rather tall and somewhat thin physique and sane and lively brown eyes. His hair bore perhaps a bit lighter shade of green, was much longer, and was evenly cut and tied to a small ponytail. His face wasn't as crazed and devoid of life, with his manner of speech being more calmed down and normal. He also did not harm himself, meaning his fingers were not as disfigured as in the years prior to his demise. Emilia described him as very tall and skinny, but in a leaner way than frail.

It is also worth mentioning that due to his nature as a spirit that took human bodies as anchors out of necessity and his ability to possess non-contracted people who had an affinity for spirits, Petelgeuse often shifted between bodies. At some points, he even possessed women.
personality:
Petelgeuse was the general depiction of insanity, preferring to talk while in weird positions, such as tilting his head or bending his waist, and also liked to engage in self-harming activities, such as crushing his own fingers, pulling his hair out, smashing his head onto nearby walls of the cave he was situated in, etc. Despite him being the Sin Archbishop of Sloth, he adhered to principles of living consisting of diligence and love. His love for Satella was the largest among the Sin Archbishops. He diligently followed and carried out orders from his Gospel, always acting first in various situations, causing his name to be known as the most active Sin Archbishop, who was responsible for more than half of all the Witch Cult's activities and attacks.

Prior to losing his mind, Petelgeuse carried himself as a moderate, upright, and rational man. He was a close friend of Fortuna and Emilia, enough to be described as being like family to them. He could be emotional to the point of being moved to tears, as he did when he cried out of relief and happiness when he first met Emilia. He was also very respectful toward certain people, such as the elves of Elior Forest and the Sage Flugel. He was willing to sacrifice himself for the safety of Fortuna and Emilia, a trait which Pandora commended, and one which he would pass on to his future mad self. However, when Regulus and Pandora attacked their village, he accidentally killed Fortuna through Pandora's power, which combined with the damage he received when taking in the Witch Factor of Sloth, which he lacked compatibility with, causing him to go insane.

It is worth noting that both in his past and present, the members of the Witch Cult held him in high regard and carried out his orders diligently and without question.
history:
Early Life
Born 402 years ago, Petelgeuse started his life as a lesser spirit of earth. Roughly 400 years ago, alongside either one or multiple other founders, Petelgeuse participated in co-founding the Witch Cult for an unknown reason. In the following centuries, Petelgeuse acted as the leader of the Moderate Faction of the Witch Cult, carrying out different tasks. Even without having an Authority, he was appointed the title of Archbishop, though he was not entrusted with Sloth until much later. Going by the name Geuse, he was acquainted with the Sage, Flugel, who he expressed reverence to, and the Witch of Greed, Echidna, who he had a cordial relationship with, going so far as to tutor her "daughter", the artificial spirit Beatrice. At some point, he met Fortuna, befriended her, and learned of the elves of Elior Forest and the seal they guarded through her. A bit over a century ago, Petelgeuse started to involve himself with Elior Forest and its residents, periodically bringing them new clothes, accessories and sometimes even food from the outside of the forest. In the following months, he met Emilia who was, for an unknown reason, of great importance to him, causing him to break down in tears, due to happiness.

Elior Forest Team, Waiting for the Thaw
After meeting Geuse for the first time, Emilia wanted to be friends with him. However, Fortuna kept her away from him. Thinking that Fortuna would panic if she faked stomach pains, she believed that Fortuna would ask what she wanted and let her see Geuse. However, when she committed to her act, Fortuna seemed to panic more than she expected, and she brought her to the village square and asked for help. Archi asked if she was acting, getting him into an argument with Fortuna since Emilia had never fallen ill even when the entire village had when they all ate rotten appas. Geuse decided to pray for her since she had helped him before, causing the whole village to lower their heads in silence. Feeling guilty, Emilia began to cry and said that her stomach had stopped hurting, causing everyone to rejoice, and Geuse told her that instead of apologizing when she troubles someone to instead say thank you. Afterward, walking back the way she came, Geuse held the sleeping Emilia on his back while Fortuna thanked him for going along with her act. Fortuna recalled how she worried for her, even after Archi became her guardian, and after Emilia called her a crybaby in her sleep, Geuse claimed that Fortuna was just like Emilia when she was younger with her brother, to her annoyance.

Permafrost of Elior Forest
After that first meeting, he started to bond with Emilia and Fortuna even more; however, the trio's happy times didn't last long. To his horror, Regulus Corneas and Pandora made their appearance in the forest, bringing with them the wrath of the Black Serpent as well as the Radical Faction of the Witch Cult who engaged in combat with the Moderate Faction. In dire need for a power strong enough to stop Greed and Vainglory and allow Fortuna and Emilia to escape, Petelgeuse resorted to his trump card: the Witch Factor of Sloth. Apologizing to Flugel, Petelgeuse took in the Witch Factor which immediately started ravaging through his body, making him suffer excruciating pain and crying tears of blood. As a side effect, however, he gained the Authority of Sloth which he named the Unseen Hands. This caused Pandora to grant him the seat of Sloth, which he turned down, expressing his disinterest in it. He then proceeded to fight Regulus. However, no matter how many times he pummeled the white-haired Sin Archbishop, he wasn't able to overpower and defeat him. Soon, Regulus had enough of it and with a single wave of his hand, cut Petelgeuse's right arm off by the shoulder and well as decimating his legs by throwing dirt and gravel at him. Just as he was about to curb stomp his head, Pandora stopped him, causing Regulus to get unreasonably angry at her, killing her on sight. Upon using her Authority of Vainglory to erase her death from the past, Pandora removed Regulus' presence from the forest, reverting all the damage done by him which effectively healed Petelgeuse's near destroyed body. What followed was an intense battle between Pandora and a duo consisting of Petelgeuse and Fortuna. Their battle concluded in the very depths of the forest, next to the Seal Pandora wanted to open; with her Authority of Vainglory, she tricked Petelgeuse into thinking Fortuna was Pandora, causing him to tear out her chest with his Unseen Hands. After realizing what he had done, Petelgeuse's mind utterly shattered, plunging him into the depths of insanity and utter despair. After realizing there was no way to convince Emilia to open the Seal, Pandora urged Petelgeuse to accompany her from the Elior Forest while Emilia slowly pushed the land into an everlasting permafrost.

Life as the Sin Archbishop of Sloth
In the following century, Petelgeuse accepted the seat of Sloth, joining the Radical Faction of the Witch Cult. He became notorious for his cruelty, frequently slaughtering entire towns and villages, acting strictly according to his Gospel's writ. At some point, Petelgeuse came across Sirius Romanée-Conti, telling her on the day they met that if hope can pull on one's hands, despair can push on one's back. Petelgeuse also encountered Stride Vollachia, giving him a Gospel of his own and assisting him with the handling of his Hubristic Ten Commandments, with the latter becoming the Sin Archbishop of Pride.

Decades later, Petelgeuse was lured by Aldebaran to meet him, and he questioned why Al did not appear in his Gospel. Afterward, Al used his Authority to fight Petelgeuse and drag information out of him. After succeeding in that, Al escaped, much to Petelgeuse's displeasure.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Petelgeuse is a powerful spirit who had caused havoc for over a century and was among the most destructive members of the Witch Cult, could easily escape death due to his nature as an evil spirit, and was capable of easily defeating numerous warriors with ease. Despite this, however, this is primarily due to the nature of his Authority being invisible to nearly everyone. When faced with a person capable of seeing or at least seeing through his Authority, his overall power is at least equal to a warrior of Julius Juukulius's caliber before his strength increased.

Authority

Unseen Hand (見えざる手, Miezaru Te): Petelgeuse was the previous holder of the Witch Factor of Sloth and could use its respective Authority. The Unseen Hands was an ability that allowed Petelgeuse to summon numerous invisible hand-like appendages from his body that he could move and extend telekinetically. An Unseen Hand was strong enough to tear through flesh, bend and break bones, and shatter rock. The Hands could be combined together to create larger and more powerful hands. While all ten of his fingers were alive at any give time, the maximum number of hands Petelgeuse could conjure was limited to seven, but when all of the pieces the Witch Factor he bestowed to his fingers returned to his body, he was able to summon over a hundred of them. At his maximum potential, the Unseen Hands and the force behind each one was akin to a cannonball. Save for Subaru, Petelgeuse was the only person who could see the Unseen Hands. Petelgeuse also displayed the ability to propel himself forward through the air using the Unseen Hands, making it appear as if he's flying, though in reality, he's simply playing catch with his body being the thrown object.

Non-Canon:
Mental Contamination (精神汚染, Seishin Osen): Petelgeuse could let out a black wave toward his surroundings, corrupting the minds of those who have no knowledge of spiritual arts. Those affected experienced hallucinations, auditory hallucinations, and severe pain, then exposed the whites of their eyes, foamed at the mouth, and were nearly driven mad. It has been described as a “slothful cancellation of the actions of others”. He used this ability as a test to determine potential candidates he could possess. Though grouped up as falling under Petelgeuse's Authority in the text of the web novel versions of Arc 3 and Arc 5, it is unrelated to his Unseen Hands. This ability was cut out of the light novel.

Magic/Spiritual Arts
As an evil spirit with command over earth mana, Petelgeuse was capable of using earth magic. Since his absorption of the Witch Factor of Sloth, however, Petelgeuse opted not to use magic in combat, instead relying on his Authority of Sloth. That being said, he still used it as a fallback for when his Authority failed him or when he was backed into a corner.

Spells:
thumb|250px|Petelgeuse using "Ul Dona" to defend against Julius Juukulius.
Ul Dona (ウル・ドーナ, Uru Dōna): Petelgeuse could use this spell manipulate the earth around him to create a large protective dome.

Other
Possession (憑依, Hyōi): As a spirit, Petelgeuse took control of humans that were compatible with spirits and had no preexisting contracts. Because Petelgeuse differed from the norm as a spirit, he was required to use human bodies as anchors out of necessity, and he could not exist otherwise. He was usually accompanied by special followers, called the fingers (指先, yubisaki), ten Witch Cultists who acted as sub-commanders and spare bodies for Petelgeuse, with each one leading a group of several lower-ranking cultists. The fingers themselves had positions that corresponded with the names of fingers on the human body. Up until he took in the Witch Factor of Sloth, Petelgeuse's followers were willing to serve as vessels for him. After becoming the Sin Archbishop of Sloth, Petelgeuse needed to share a part of his Witch Factor in order to successfully possess a finger. Although he was able to continue using his Authority within their bodies upon possessing them, this decreased the amount of Unseen Hands he was able to manifest until he regained all of the parts of his Witch Factor he shared to them. Because Petelgeuse was incompatible with his Witch Factor and, accordingly, was unsuited to using his Authority, his body would break down quickly, forcing him to replace it often. Before becoming a Sin Archbishop, a long time ago, he also privately discussed the possibility of being able to possess a dragonhusk with his possession.

Miasma-Attuned Olfaction: Petelgeuse has the ability to smell the scent of the Witch. It is unknown why he has this ability.

Equipment
thumb|250px|Petelgeuse's Gospel.
Gospel (福音, Fukuin): As a member of the Witch Cult, Petelgeuse was the owner of a copy of a Gospel. Each Gospel is a replica of the Book of Wisdom, a book that had been in the possession of the Witch of Greed, Echidna. The Book of Wisdom would provide exact details of future events concerning the Witch of Greed, essentially bestowing Echidna with a form of precognition. Unlike the original Book of Wisdom, the Gospels of the Witch Cult are defective replicas, meaning that, although they detail the future of its owner, the events conveyed are subject to change and the information provided is often up for interpretation. The Gospels take the form of small black books that can only be read by their owners.

intro: Otto Suwen (オットー・スーウェン) is a former merchant and the current internal affairs officer of the Emilia Camp. He has played a supporting role throughout the story, except for Arc 1, Arc 2, and Arc 6.
appearance: Otto has grey hair that frames his face and falls just below his chin. He has sharp, bright blue eyes and a fair skin tone. He is considered to be somewhat handsome if he has a serious expression. However, he is usually either retorting, shouting, or panicking, ruining his looks. He has a medium build but has trained himself since he used to work as a merchant. Particularly being clad in green, he wears a green, belted wardrobe, as well as a dark green hood, held up by a red bow. He also wears a green Ushanka, decorated with a white feather. His hat is rimmed with gold and so is his outfit to an extent. As he comes from Picoutatte, he gives off a slight Arabian flair.
personality:
Otto is quite an unlucky person, first shown when he almost drowned in his first bath; he was accordingly born under an unlucky star. When he was young, he was treated as a pitiful child by others due to his Divine Protection, as they thought he was talking to imaginary objects. He is generally on the receiving end of jokes, with some people, such as Natsuki Subaru, suggesting that they use him as a shield, but despite this, he is loved by the others. He's easily embarrassed, sensitive, and considered weak or pathetic, which can lead to others underestimating him. Though Otto can be timid and prone to panic, he is intensely loyal to his friends and can be very courageous when it comes to protecting them. He helped Subaru in the Sanctuary even though it could've cost him his life, that not being the first time he's risked himself for his friends. He will even become angry on his friends’ behalf, especially when certain enemies mock the memory of those who were close to his friends, and like Subaru, he goes out of his way to help others while not showing any similar concern for himself.

Otto often curses his own carelessness, and he often tends to worry about the people he is close to, to the point that he becomes frustrated with them. This is most dominantly seen when dealing with Subaru’s actions, as he showed visible distress and anger when seeing his interactions with Roswaal or when he decided to protect Spica. He is also willing to play the villain when needed, acting as the wall before the naive Subaru and Emilia so that they don’t act recklessly or become needlessly involved in danger. On top of that, he is also a constantly wary person when dealing with people he can’t trust, as he went to restore the Book of Wisdom Roswaal owned in order to determine the plans he’d set up prior to the events of the Sanctuary.

Otto often finds himself stressing heavily over the situations around him, particularly after joining the Emilia Camp. Ever since the Battle for Priestella, his stress and worries have piled on repeatedly, and during the failed loop of Arc 9, those frustrations got to the point where he cried over it and believed that despite doing everything he could to help the people around him, it wasn't enough, and he began putting himself down for being unable to prevent such terrible things from happening. Despite this, after some encouragement from Emilia, he was able to keep himself going.

He considers himself to be a pacifist. Both in the present and during his time as a merchant, he would seldom interfere in other people's disputes or resort to violence unless he absolutely had to. However, should his role call for it, he will toss aside such sentiments. Upon joining the Emilia Camp, he realized this, and though he wasn't fond of the teasing that was brought along with it, he is fully aware that he needs to act in a way that his position would demand, such as utilizing violence. He was often forced to display shrewdness and meticulousness expected of a merchant, and during combat, his mentality of never knowing what might be useful allows him to be ready for most possibilities, including preparing for traps in the case that he and the people around him are targeted by an enemy, such as Otto keep fire magic stones on him and even preparing them underground like mines. That said, combined with this, if someone were to target the people that he considers family, whether that be his blood relatives or the people in the Emilia Camp, he will not hesitate to become ruthless, and combined with his Divine Protection, he can make a person's life a living hell without a chance to rest.
history:
Early Life
Twenty years before the beginning of the story, Otto was born in Picoutatte. He was born with the Divine Protection of the Soul of Language, which allowed him to hear voices and communicate with nonhuman beings. However, ever since he was born, Otto's life was a living hell. He would always hear different sounds and voices, screams, and death cries. It was so bad that even when his parents picked him up and talked into his ear, Otto was unable to hear them, let alone understand the meaning of their words and actions. As a result, Otto grew up without any emotions. He did not cry, he did not get angry, he did not get happy; all because, to him, everything sounded like the exact same thing. His parents strived to understand what was wrong with their son, but to no avail. At the end, their love for young Otto slowly faded and they started to pay more attention to his siblings. When Otto was five years old, his older brother presented him with a notebook and a pen and began teaching him how to write and communicate without speaking. Due to Otto's inability to hear, it took him ten times longer to learn how to write than it took an average kid, but that did not demoralize him, as he saw it as a way to kill some time. One day, he presented a piece of paper in front of his parents saying "thank you for everything," which utterly broke them. Coincidentally, it was also the first time Otto cried since he was born, as he finally realized the love his family harbored towards him, and it opened up his heart.

When Otto turned 8, he was able to differentiate the human and animal worlds much better than before. Sadly, his late realization meant his knowledge and education was far behind his age group. However, to everyone's amazement, he showed significant talent and will for learning. But sadly, things didn't go as smoothly as everyone hoped; Otto fell behind in a subject called "human relations" and was gradually isolated from his age group, leaving him without any friends.

At the age of 10, Otto finally learned how to truly differentiate between voices, which gradually led him to a realization that he possesses a Divine Protection. As soon as he confirmed his assumptions, he darted towards his older brother, whom he trusted the most, and explained everything to him. His brother was rather impressed with Otto's ability, but he warned him of the dangers that could appear if he ever revealed his ability to others; Divine Protections are god's gift, and some people would feel extremely jealous and start hating him for his power. Three days after the conversation with his brother, the news of Otto's Divine Protection spread around the entire town after his younger brother carelessly told his friends about Otto's Divine Protection. Otto was forced to demonstrate it in order to prove that his younger brother was not lying and from that day onward, he gained a new nickname: Zodda bug bastard.

Throughout the following years, Otto slowly managed to conceal his depressing past and got rid of the vile nickname. But of course, Otto's luck soon ran out when he was accused of a "crime" he did not commit for supposedly being in a love affair with Diadora Regundra, a daughter from Picoutatte's powerful Regundra family. Otto called forth his bug friends, who explained the truth to him, and Otto carelessly revealed it to the whole town, saying she slept with eight different guys, and he was not among them. Out of rage and shame, Diadora hired an assassin to kill Otto. Otto lost every ounce of respect and was hated by everyone. He was also subsequently exiled from his hometown. His father managed to get a friend of his to take Otto under his mentorship and, at the early age of sixteen, he set out into the world as a traveling merchant.

Throughout the following four years, Otto's bad luck really came forth; if he was transporting fruits, bad weather would come forth; if he took a shortcut, random bandits would attack him; and so forth. At one point, he even drove through a storm, which resulted in his carriage being stricken by lightning and all of his merchandise being reduced to ash. Luckily, Otto was born with a mercantile talent as great as his luck was poor. He rarely lost bets and deals, no matter the odds and, of course, he never went bankrupt. At times, he would even take on jobs to care for the infants of influential figures to earn travel expenses.

Otto's Peddling Record of Joy and Sorrow
At one point, having made a successful business venture in the town of Guineb, as he and Frufoo prepared to leave, he was invited by the town's mayor, Colin Lavril, to his residence. There, he was asked how he crossed the mountains, to which Otto refused to discuss his secret. Colin then introduced Otto to his son, Aheem, and stated that his fiancée, Marone Lisbon, had been kidnapped, and because of that, he wanted to know how to cross the mountains. Though Otto still refused to give up his secrets, he proposed to relay a rescue service for the girl. Afterward, he was guided by his son, but along the way, Aheem led Otto into a trap, which resulted in Otto being imprisoned by slave traders.

In a cell, he met a girl who called him Number Two and introduced herself as Marone. According to her, Aheem was not her fiancée. He had deceived her and given her to the slave traders. After a while, some of the slave traders appeared, and when he asked where Frufoo was, they claimed that she worked for them. At some point after this while still in the cell, he told Marone that he had the "Divine Protection of Guidance" and made an agreement with her. Afterward, when they were put on his dragon carriage, he was told to reveal his path through the mountains. The deal with Aheem was that he would provide the traders women in exchange for leaving Guineb alone. With Frufoo taking the carriage, Otto directed the traders where there was a supposed path that they could use. Then, after calling out to Marone as part of their agreement, they held on tight as Frufoo was signaled to crash the carriage.

Otto and Marone had their injuries treated in a hospital in a nearby town, where he revealed that Guineb's mayor and son were likely to be investigated for the incident and Aheem likely arrested. Upon asking if she would return to Guineb, Marone refused. When Marone asked for his name, he said she could keep calling him Number Two, and he gave her his own savings, enough for her to start a new life anywhere she wanted, lying to her by saying it was a reward for taking down the slave traders. Then, Otto took off, Frufoo scolding him for lying but believing it was fine, and she looked forward to seeing his dream come true.

Pre-Subjugation of Sloth
Sometime later, Otto misread the market trends and got into a lot of debt after the price of the oil he was transporting plummeted. Luckily, a friend of his told him about a great offer; one where he'd only have to transport someone to a specific place. But once again, Otto's luck ran dry, and he was captured by the Witch Cult. Just before he was about to be killed by the Witch Cultist, Ricardo Welkin came to the rescue. After his successful rescue, Otto Suwen met Natsuki Subaru.

The Emilia Camp's Great Evaluation Meeting
Following the Sanctuary Incident, Annerose Miload and Clind, who had been tasked with making preparations by Roswaal, arrived at the Sanctuary to board all the villagers on their carriages, intent on leading them out of the snow-covered and heavily damaged forest. Annerose was quick to scold Roswaal for his behavior and approved of his being struck, claiming to Garfiel that she would be his ally should he hassle him again. Moments later, the pair introduced themselves to Subaru and Otto, who had been claimed to be the new internal affairs minister for the Emilia Camp, surprising Subaru with their behavior and titles, and thanks to Clind, Subaru realized that Roswaal had their appearance already prepared. Though Clind claimed that they were a step closer to freeing Roswaal from the "spell" he was under, he teased Subaru when he exclaimed how he thought he said something important. Frederica then appeared and scolded Clind, claiming to Subaru that she knew him and that he was flawed despite his abilities, something which was seemingly proven when Petra said that the villagers had gathered together. Frederica attacked him, though Clind dodged her attacks with ease, and with Otto claiming that he would handle things there, he told Subaru that he should go see Emilia.

Approaching the tomb, where Annerose was talking with Emilia, Beatrice stood by his side, and Subaru warned her not to get too close to Clind. Noticing his state, Ram appeared and claimed that his nature hadn't changed since the last time she met him and that he behaved this way towards her in her youth and even thought that Rem had experienced it. After a warning that Clind did not differentiate between male and female, Annerose approached Subaru and questioned if he was willing to take responsibility for forcing a kiss onto Emilia, though Emilia appeared and defended Subaru by saying it was consensual. Acting like a "rival in love", the two argued, with Annerose even calling Subaru a homewrecker, Beatrice getting angry, and Ram stirring things up. Seeing them all, Emilia touched her crystal where Puck slept and called everyone there precious to her.

Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle Line 3
One night, a little while after the goddess statue incident, after managing to finish his work on time for once, he found himself in the company of Ram and Frederica, and the three drank together. The next morning, Otto found himself sleeping in the garden. When Petra went to look at the flowers and saw him, she splashed him in water to wake him up. Later, she was grumbling out loud to Garfiel, who ended up asking Otto about it while he was working. As they talked, they saw Subaru, Emilia, and Beatrice doing radio calisthenics outside. Though Otto didn't think it was a bad thing they were doing it, he showed concern about how Subaru intended to spread it, and after recalling something he had been told in Costuul, he left to go get Subaru and Emilia to stop the misunderstandings in the city.

After they left, Beatrice found herself in Otto's room, telling him where they went and saying it was easy to complain to Otto and entertaining to do so, much to Otto's distress. Beatrice advised him to take himself into consideration for once instead of solely paying attention to others. Shortly after, Emilia returned and visited Otto's room after hearing Frederica mentioning how he woke up that morning to someone who brings things to the mansion. Subaru appeared shortly after, and after Emilia expressed her concern, Otto looked to see how much work he had left, he asked if they could make time to have tea together.

Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle
Shortly after the decision to visit the Watergate City of Priestella was made, Petra was being extremely petulant because she was not one of the people who would be going to the Watergate City and was instead accompanying Roswaal. Otto listened to her complaints for a bit, even suggesting he would talk to the Margrave himself about it, which Petra refused. Otto asked Petra to baby-sit Roswaal whilst he was away, to which Petra agreed, saying she would have done that even if he had not asked. In return, she asked him to take care of Subaru and the others. Otto asked if Petra was worried about him, to which Petra replied that she saw no need to do so.

A while later, Frederica entered the room Otto was working in. Frederica apologized to Otto for Petra's discourteous manner earlier in the day. Otto tried to pass it off as nothing, but Frederica rebutted, saying that it would not be good for the girl's growth. She then continued to speak to Otto, mentioning that she was worried about Garfiel, as he wouldn't be in arm's reach to her where he was going. She was worried that her brother's behavior would cause problems to Emilia, and she politely asked Otto if he could look after everyone, especially Garfiel. Otto pledged that he would do his best and then asked if Frederica would be worried about Otto himself too, to which Frederica showed nothing but confusion.

After taking a bath, Otto was met by Ram in his room. After a bit of back and forth, Otto asked her if she had come here to talk to him about Priestella as well, to which she replied that she did, telling Otto that he had an extremely important duty as Emilia's adviser. This was because Roswaal's greatest wish would depend on Emilia's actions being carried out. Otto asked Ram if she was worried about him too, which Ram denied.

After Ram left as well, Otto reflected back on the conversations he had with the three maids. He surmised that their lack of worry about him must mean that they trusted him. After brushing his teeth in the washroom, he once again turned back towards his room. On his way there, he met with Emilia. They spoke a little, and Emilia told Otto that she was going to give it her best in Priestella. And before wishing him a good night, Emilia told him that as Otto was going to be there, everything would go okay, because they depended on him a lot.

Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle Line 2
One night, before having left for Priestella, Otto was staying up all night doing paperwork, drinking Coff to stave off his sleepiness. Ram was awake along with Otto. The two of them conversed a bit, as Ram prepared some tea for him. Ram seemed to understand that Otto had not forgiven Roswaal for his transgressions in the Sanctuary. They talked about it a bit, with Otto pledging he would strive to protect the environment around him no matter what. Ram surmised that Otto would protect it by doubting Roswaal, whereas she would do so by believing in Roswaal. Just as Otto was about to leave the room, Ram asked him what would need to happen for him to want to forgive Roswaal. To which Otto replied that he'd probably never be able to forgive him, but, if he had the opportunity, he could maybe think about clearing away his distrust of him.

In the Watergate City of Priestella, the night that they arrived there, Otto extracted himself away from Subaru and the others to perform an errand, carrying a bag with the remnants of Roswaal's Book of Wisdom. Though he initially thought to get rid of it, he decided against that and wanted to confirm its contents, leading him to visit the "Master Restorer" Dartz, who was famous for being able to repair items with his restoration magic, including, according to rumors, meteors.

After arriving at Dartz's shop, Otto presented the burnt book to him, and Dartz was able to immediately identify that it was an item surrounded by mystery. Otto asked if it was possible to restore it, and Dartz replied that with the item in this state, returning it to its original state would be a legendary feat. But, he said that he could do it. Dartz continued by asking what Otto intended to use it for. Otto replied by saying that after checking the contents of the book he would burn it completely it so that not even a fragment of it remained. Dartz agreed that he would take the book from Otto, to try and restore it. But before he did, Otto had brought him a present. As Dartz was renowned for his fondness of alcohol, Otto had brought him a bottle. They drank together, and the next morning he returned back to the Water Plumage Inn, completely drunk.

Otto Suwen's Internal Affairs Struggle Line 4
Following the Battle for Priestella, Otto, whose legs had been severely injured by Rui Arneb, attempted to use a cane to try to walk, only to fail and fall and ask for Garfiel's help. Afterward, Otto asked Garfiel if he was aware that despite the incident in Priestella, he and Garfiel didn't manage to achieve any real accomplishments and were unable to accompany Subaru and Emilia, and they felt lacking as a response. Garfiel agreed with his assessment and said that he needed to become stronger, that way he wouldn't lose to anyone again, not even Reinhard van Astrea. Feeling refreshed by the conversation and Garfiel's joke afterward, Otto agreed with his resolve.

Later, Felt, who had heard Garfiel's resolve, visited Otto with Reinhard in tow and teased him. Though Otto found it funny thinking that he used to call himself a humble merchant and that he seemed to have gone pretty far from that ideal, Felt sympathized, but she claimed that duty called and she had to fight. Afterward, though she joked that she was there to visit him to help eat the fruits he'd been gifted, she was there to thank him for his assistance, both in the battle with Lye Batenkaitos and Heinkel before that, and Reinhard agreed with her gratitude. Felt also claimed that they had a debt towards Otto now, which made Otto twist his expression unconsciously. Then, Felt and Reinhard took their leave, leaving Otto thinking about work.

Priestella Reconstruction Journal
Later, when Garfiel and a group of others were tasked with the retrieval of the remains of the Witch, Otto eventually found his way into the catacombs they were in and successfully helped them retrieve the remains.

Stand by me Pleiades and Missing Child Search
After the successful Pleiades Watchtower Expedition, the group returned and revealed the disappearance of Subaru and Rem to Vollachia. After having Clind drop of and retrieve the people necessary, the majority of the camp arrived in Picoutatte to smuggle themselves into the country. Unfortunately, Otto still had his issues to settle with the city’s main family’s daughter, Diadora. However, after the two apologized to each and managed to settle their grudges, Diadora and the Suwen Company assisted them in their goal.

Shortly after, the group passed through the Everlasting Darkness with the mole-people’s guidance. However, they ran into trouble when the representative of the molepeople, Musica, interrupted their travels in hopes of using their group as hostages in order to speak to Emilia, not knowing she was present among them due to her disguise. Thanks to the efforts of Petra, they were able to continue traveling and made it into Vollachia.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Although he is capable of defending himself against the likes of someone like Garfiel before his great jump in strength, Otto's actual combat strength is not very high. Despite this, the entire Emilia Camp agree he is perhaps the most dangerous member of the group because of his intellect. With his intellect combined with his incredibly versatile Divine Protection, Otto is a major supporter in wide scale conflicts, and his presence, ability to collect information, analytical abilities, and cautious nature have the potential for Otto to become key to achieving victory in wide scale conflicts.

Divine Protection

Divine Protection of the Soul of Language (言霊の加護, Kotodama no Kago): This allows Otto to communicate with creatures and comprehend their speech. Even if his ears and whole body are covered, his body can still pick up the vibrations in the air caused by speech and allow him to understand language, regardless of who it is, though at the same time, although he can understand audible creatures, the Divine Protection does not make his ears better. However, when he speaks with other creatures, as he speaks in the language of the creature he's talking with, it makes him look shady to others while he's using it. In his formative years, the words of creatures were incomprehensible to Otto, who had no explanation for the constant chattering he heard. However, as time went on, he began to understand more and more of what the animals were trying to say until he eventually fully understood their speech. Continuous use of this Divine Protection or expanding the number of voices and range of what he is listening to causes him to bleed out from his nose, which Subaru, as well as himself, refer to as overheating. While it doesn’t completely prevent this negative side effect, the physical boosts provided by Yang Magic can help reduce how much he bleeds, which allows him a greater amount of time with which he can use his Divine Protection continuously, and it can even extend the range at which his ears can pick up and hear voices. Even with this burden reduced, however, it is still possible to overload Otto's brain with the voices; if one is capable of it, by terrifying all the living creatures in the area, their terrible screams can flood Otto's ears to the point that his mind will feel as though it is boiling over, and it will threaten to make him lose consciousness. Likewise, Otto can still risk losing himself while submerged in sifting through the various voices, and if he loses the connection to his body, he will fail to recognize the voices as language, to the point that even the rustle of wind or clothes might be considered a voice, and Otto would lose his sanity.
Living Creature Assistance: Although he is unable to outright control the actions of creatures, Otto is able to make them do what he wants if they themselves wants to. By communicating with the birds and the insects always hidden from view, Otto possessed a sort of intelligence network that could tell him about circumstances happening far away. Likewise, so long as he convinces them to go along with his plans, he can even gather a practical army of living beings, such as over one hundred thousand Zodda Bugs, that can not only be used as surveillance but can also drop objects as large as boulders to assault his enemy from afar. However, this also means that the creatures must be alive, just like any other creature, for him to be able to hear or communicate with them, and if everything in a given direction has been killed, then he will be unable to hear anything in that given direction. Likewise, according to Otto, underground creatures often do not speak, making it difficult to communicate with them.
Intention Perception: Not only does his ability allow him to communicate with animals and insects, but it even allows him to intuit anything speech, even an infant's, by picking up on their "intentions". Thanks to his ability to pick up on a person's intentions, he is capable of determining whether a person has malice or not, as well as what kinds of affections they may have, even if said person is incapable of proper speech.
Channels: Otto has learned to adjust his Divine Protection, a domain only a handful of previous users had been able to reach. Because of this, he has learned to block his power to a certain extent, giving himself reprieves from the constant background noises, as well as to concentrate on the sounds in specific directions or in relation to what he believes is relevant. Because of Subaru, Otto refers to the different adjustments as "channels". As Otto still struggles with his Divine Protection, he normally keeps it disabled.

Intelligence
Keen Intellect: Otto is an intelligent man with shrewdness befitting a merchant. Aside from his skills as a businessman, he is also trusted as an adviser within his own camp, and Subaru and several others have even teased him for being a wartime adviser, as when it comes time for the camp to step onto the battlefield, Otto is one of the key strategists. In fact, in the non-canon Gluttony IF, the different members of the Emilia Camp agreed that Otto was the most dangerous one because of his intellect, believing that given enough time, he could come up with a way to counter most predicaments.

Skilled Negotiator: As a merchant, Otto is accomplished when it comes to negotiations in most affairs. He has used these skills to complete transactions for the camp, ensure others that it is beneficial for him and his camp to be present, and even to attempt trick someone like a Sin Archbishop to follow him into a trap; though in the last case, he failed due to a slight in his expression.

Magic
Although it is unclear what attribute he has an affinity for, due to tutoring he received as the son of a merchant, Otto has the capability to use earth, wind, and water magic. While he primarily uses earth, he has also employed wind and water magic to cast the sound his footsteps make into the distance.

Spells:
Dona (ドーナ): The user summons one earth wall from the ground. It is typically used for defense, but it can be applied for offense and evasive movement.
El Dona (エル・ドーナ): The user conjures a swarm of earth mana and pinpoints it at a target, which then bursts into spikes inside them expanding outward. Otto's use of this spell was cut from the Light Novel.
Ul Dona (ウル・ドーナ): Otto is able to lift thick walls of earth around himself in a shape of a dome.
Al Dona (アル・ドーナ): User summons an enormous blast of violent earth mana that shreds a target and the surrounding area upward. It's strong enough to pulverize the surrounding trees. Otto cannot use Al Dona normally, because he barely has above average magic talent.

Equipment
Fire Magic Stones: Otto keeps fire magic stones on his person as an in-case backup plan for if he becomes cornered. While he might keep some in a pouch, he also has some sewed into the seams of his clothing.
