intro: Russell Fellow (ラッセル・フェロー) is the chairman and treasurer of the Commerce Guild in the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. However, behind the scenes, he works as the current Director of the mysterious defense organization known as the Six Tongues. He played a supporting role in Arc 3 and Arc 10.
appearance: Russell is a tall man with dull blond hair and blue eyes. He wears a good quality suit with a limited number of adornments as to not look crude, giving off the impression of an able man.
personality:
Russell is a realist that is shrewd with money. He tends to decide on things based on profits and losses and, in his capacity as the treasurer of the Commerce Guild, is only interested in figuring out how he can earn the most, leading to him being described as a mosquito that tries to drain as much money as possible from his opponents. He has a notable reputation in the underworld of the Royal Capital, including in the slums, and although he is married, his marriage was purely for political purposes, therefore he has no love for his wife. Likewise, he is not the kind of person to spread rumors without there being any gain in return, and he would use whatever information was at his disposal to achieve his goals.

However, beneath this image lies a very cunning and ruthless man. Heavily loyal to the Kingdom, he is willing to do anything to maintain the authority of the Kingdom, including having people threaten members of House Astrea after learning the danger that a young Reinhard van Astrea. Furthermore, he has no qualms in using curses to torture his subordinates who fail him, and he is indifferent to their suffering so long as it means. Furthermore, due to his jobs as both a merchant and leader of an intelligence organization, Russell is distrusting by nature, which may lead him to question his allies when necessary. This being said, Russell is not incapable of compromise when necessary, and he is understanding when it comes to his allies keeping secrets if need be.
history:
Russell was born as the second son to the Fellow family. With his family's influence and connection to the Commerce Guild, he often had the chance to do business that allowed him to visit the castle grounds in place of his father and older brother. From a young age, he was involved with the Six Tongues, quickly acquiring a role that allowed him to act as a supervisor. As the son of a merchant who frequented Fareed Impusen, a noble who felt burning patriotism for Lugunica, Russell found himself in the position to give advice to the man, guiding him in a direction that led him to founding the Golden Wing Party while having him believe he made all of his choices of his own volition.

Once Upon a Time in Lugunica
Roughly 15 years before the events of the main story, at the age of 14, Russell Fellow set up Roswaal L. Mathers's mugging, right after the latter left the Royal Castle after the ceremony where he inherited the family name of Roswaal. By having his subordinate Belmont steal Roswaal's golden plume, which coincidentally resembled the symbol of the Golden Wing Faction, he aimed to insure that the man had no ill plans with the Kingdom. He accompanied Roswaal in reclaiming his plume from The Brotherhood, led by Marcos Gildark, a knight who deserted his position to support the residents of the slums, and witnessed the two fight. Later, he teamed up with Roswaal and helped him form an alliance between two rivalling groups: The Brotherhood, led by Marcos Gildark, and the Golden Wing Faction led by Fareed Impusen. In their conversation afterwards, Roswaal insinuated to Russell that he had caught on to how the Golden Wing Faction had been truly founded.

That same night, Russell met with Belmont, ordering him to accompany Fareed and the Brotherhood to Costuul. When asked about Roswaal, he said that the noble had caught on to more than he had bargained for, having perceived Russell's involvement with the Golden Wing Faction. Belmont also informed Russell that the Divine Protection of Mind-Changing had been detected from the Astrea Manor. The mansion was then invaded by multiple unknown assailants, and Heinkel suspected of and questioned for potentially holding intentions of insurrection by means of the Divine Protection of Mind-Changing. Quickly realizing that his son was the only person who could have used it, having so in an attempt to aid his father with convincing Marcos to rejoin the Royal Guard, he rushed to Reinhard's room and scolded for his actions, and the young boy, who had erased the Divine Protection forever, saw a figure outside of the mansion's window who mouthed to him a threat: that he must protect the Kingdom for his family.

Once Upon a Time in Lugunica II
Happening on Marcos some time later, Russell revealed that he had been aware of the knight's unrequited feelings for Theresia van Astrea, choosing to keep them hidden. Afterwards, dropped by the Royal Magic Research Institute as was Roswaal conducting an experiment, and Serena Dracroy, a noble from the Vollachia Empire who was visiting Lugunica as an envoy on official business, showed up, requesting a tour of the facility. When Roswaal left with Serena to educate her on magic, Ilzea, who had been a researcher in the Royal Magic Research Institute, was ordered by Russell to keep an eye on Roswaal's activity, worried that his enthusiasm to teach educate a noble from Vollachia in magic could lead to them using it in the future.

However, Roswaal had been preemptively aware that Ilzea was affiliated with Russell and had a means of contacting him. Detecting a wavelength of mana that resembled Serena's magic stone earrings as she was leaving Lugunica with Alagar in custody, Roswaal, realizing she had been put in a situation where the magic stones needed to be used, requested Ilzea to get in contact with Russell. Roswaal decided to to trace Serena's magic and contact them himself, and was given a Conversation Mirror by Russell, which he used later to contact him when notifying him of the situation with the assassins and seek his opinions. Once the situation was resolved, Alagar was allowed to remain in Lugunica so long as he hid his lineage, assuming the new identity of Gwain Merette, and being employed by the Fellow family.

At some point within the next five years, Russell succeeded Orphe's position as the Director of the Six Tongues, and at an unknown point in time, he also became the treasurer and representative of the Kingdom’s Commerce Guild.

Riot in Flanders
Following the failure of Helaine Gatness’s plan to replace the leader of The Balance with a pawn who was easier for her to manipulate and manage, she was taken into custody by the Six Tongues. Russell interrogated her, outlining that she disobeyed her orders by attempting to act on her plan and the balance of power in Flanders was satisfactory the way it was. Though he concluded that the incident was effective in measuring the abilities of the Golden Lion and the Hoffman family's son, once Helaine finished her explanation, he punished her with torture via a curse mark engraved on her back, inflicting intense pain to her when he placed his palm on it.

The Lion’s Ferocity
Following the Battle for Priestella, Felt and Reinhard escorted the captured Sin Archbishop of Wrath to the Royal Capital’s Prison Tower. As Reinhard took her into the tower, Russell met Felt outside of the tower and invited her to dinner at his home. Later that night, she and Reinhard attended his dinner, where Russell was left starstruck by their relationship. Shortly after, they began discussing the intensifying heretic hunts of the Holy Kingdom amidst rumors of a Witch appearing there for the first time in over a hundred years, the balance of power between the ten mayors of the City-States showing indications of an upcoming collapse, and signs of a civil war brewing in the Empire. Russell also mentions that big waves of change are rolling, one that hasn’t been seen in 400 years, which Felt attributes to Subaru and Emilia.
abilities_text:
Divine Protection of Evaluation (目利きの加護, Mekiki no Kago): This enables Russell to determine the value of an item, and if the item is in front of him, he can evaluate its condition and quality with perfect accuracy. However, if he is evaluating an item he has never seen before, he can only know if it is of good or bad quality, and he gains no knowledge of how it is used or how much it is worth. He is also able to apply it to determine the superiority or inferiority of earth dragons, or even the abilities and competence of people. Furthermore, the value of an item that he observes can change depending on certain conditions: although he determined the value of Subaru's cell phone to be of high quality, the value he sees is only exhibited when in Subaru's hands, otherwise its value drops.

Six Tongues (六枚舌, Roku-mai Jita): Russell is the current Director of the Six Tongues, a secret organization that acts as the backbone of Lugunica from the shadows. At his command, they take on numerous missions, whether it is to maintain order, to quash illegal organizations, or to subdue anyone who threatens the Kingdom.

intro: Roy Alphard (ロイ・アルファルド) is a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing the Bizarre Eating aspect of Gluttony, and he is the brother of Lye Batenkaitos and Rui Arneb. He was one of the main antagonists of Arc 5 and Arc 6 as well as a secondary antagonist in Arc 9.
appearance: Roy has long, disheveled red-tipped, dark brown hair tied into a braid behind his head, along with emerald green eyes that are yellow in the center and have a poisonous glimmer to them. He also has a young look, a mischievous smile, and wears a ripped, green cloth reminiscent of a men's cheongsam around his body. Like his siblings, his teeth are all pointed like fangs.
personality:
Like his siblings, Roy speaks using in a collective manner, speaking with terms like "we" or "us" rather than third or first-person speech; he also thrives on devouring the lives and memories of his opponents in a manner reminiscent of Lye and Rui. However, unlike his siblings, Roy does not care about what specifically he eats. As Bizarre Eating, Roy has no preferences and craves and "loves" all people equally, and as such, he desires to devour every last person in the world. Accordingly, he does not share Lye's fastidiousness with his meals, lacking the meticulousness with proving opponents' worth and distinct likes and dislikes his brother had. As he initially devoured his enemies, he placed his hopes on the chance that one of his dishes would one day fill him, and that he could find his own course to appease his hunger like his siblings did. His failure to find his desired meal often led him to feeling dispirited, despondent, and disappointed. As such, he did not place any special emphasis on the quality of his meals nor who it was he ate, which led to multiple criticisms by his siblings. It was also for this reason that he kept one of the heads of the Black Serpent hidden away, since it could effectively immobilize his meals without killing them, giving him the chance to devour their names and memories. He is even willing to expose the Serpent in a heavily populated area in order to do this.

After devouring Reid Astrea, however, who filled him to nearly literally bursting, his perspective changed. Understanding that his hunger may never be sated, Roy came to believe that, rather than wanting to sate his hunger, like his siblings attempt to do with their respective methods, what he wanted was a real feeling of living, and he was given a true purpose to devour his enemies. Likewise, whereas before, he would find no worth in many of the names and memories that he had devoured and kept stored away, forgotten, because of his change in perspective, he came to realize that even that which he had forgotten and saw no worth in did, in fact, carry worth, and he began to harbor gratitude toward every single thing he had eaten, believing that not a single thing in the world that he could eat was a foul ingredient. As such, during the temporary events of Arc 9, he came to the conclusion that even that which he had forgotten about could be useful and carry worth, something which led to him creating a new form of Eclipse, using the dregs from among what he had eaten.

Even if he comes across powerful enemies upon whom he cannot devour, he is willing to throw away his will to devour them and push his life to the brink and fight with everything he has available to him, even if it means he has to regurgitate some of his past meals or burn his soul. Compared to Lye, who would flee or postpone his dishes to prioritize his own life, Roy believes that if he allows someone to escape him, he may never again get a chance to devour that person, and his meal will be lost on the high chance that the two will never again meet. Furthermore, he thinks if he does not exert his maximum effort, it would be a disservice his enemy who went out of their way to bring out their full potential to fight and counter him, and that unless he invests his entire being into what he desires, he cannot truly express love, an ideology he shares with his “Mother”. He also seems to display a seeming joy for battle as well, actively choosing not to heal himself in favor of choosing methods of attack, even if it means using up his life force.
history:
Due to the young age of the Gluttony siblings, they were assumedly born less than two decades prior to the beginning of the story. As one of the three children of the previous Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, Leilani Alnair, Roy and his two siblings were kept in the womb by their mother for over three years through sheer force of will. After Leilani conquered the Augria Sand Dunes and became the first person to arrive at the Pleiades Watchtower in hundreds of years, she attempted to overwrite Shaula's memories with her Authority, causing the Star Keeper to shoot a white light through her chest and subsequently eject her from the tower. The shot was presumably responsible for killing one of her unborn triplets, this being Rui, and Leilani was later found by a man with medical knowledge who ascertained that one of her children had died, but the other two were alive. Against Leilani's own wishes, her two surviving children, Lye and Roy, were saved and delivered, and she died a few moments after they were born. Following Leilani's death, Rui's soul somehow persisted in the Corridor of Memories without being subjected to the soul filtering process, and the three siblings inherited their mother's Witch Factor of Gluttony.

According to Reid Astrea, Roy got involved in unknown circumstances because he did not have a “stance” of his own. Sometime after becoming the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony, Roy met his younger sister, Rui Arneb, for the first time when she possessed Lye's body. He later gained access to Eclipse after discovering it alongside Lye and began utilizing it to devour as many people as he wanted.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Due to his vast collection of abilities given to him through the use of his Authority, Roy is among the most skilled of martial artists in the world, capable of fighting and outclassing most warriors by using a wide variety of physical techniques, magic, and other such abilities alongside his Authority, which could also allow him to instantly defeat any number of strong warriors so long as he touched them and knew their names. What makes him even more dangerous is that, due to the unique aspect of his Authority, he had gone completely unnoticed until his ability was recognized after the events of Arc 3, meaning that he is not only strong, but he was also more than capable of escaping his enemies without anyone realizing exactly who or what he was. Furthermore, unlike his brother, his level of danger is further exacerbated by the indiscriminate nature of his point of view over his food.

Authority
Roy was one of the previous holders of the Witch Factor of Gluttony and could use its respective Authority, which granted him powers relating to consuming the memories, names, and souls connected to Od Lagna's Register of Names and replicating their abilities for himself.

Gluttony (暴食, Bōshoku): Roy can eat the name and memories of his opponent. To eat a name, he touches them with his left hand, then licks the palm of the same hand. Things such as experience, talent, and the likes and dislikes of human relationships serve as food for him, allowing him to take advantage of any abilities or memories his opponents had. Likewise, he can choose whether or not to eat only names, only memories, or both, though he claims that it difficult and is like trying to eat only the ingredients in a sandwich without removing the buns. However, if Roy eats a fake name, or if he attempts to eat the previous name of a person who has managed to change their name, such as through marriage or adoption, he becomes plagued with severe nausea. Similarly, attempting to devour the name and memories of someone with a soul too large and powerful puts Roy at the risk being taken over by said spirit, as in the case of Reid Astrea. Even after killing Roy, the names and memories of his victims will not return to their original owners. However, he can regurgitate specific names and memories in order shake those who were at some point attached to certain people. According to Roy, anything that the siblings eat goes to the same Stomach of Souls (魂の胃袋, Tamashī no Ibukuro), from which they can share and pull the same names and memories that their siblings have eaten.
Those that have had their names eaten have their existences erased from the world, destroying any human relationships along with negating any contracts with spirits.
Those that have their memories eaten become amnesic and any characteristics they may have had are reset, effectively making them into a different person.
Those that have both their name and memories eaten simply become a shell, and although they live, they no longer eat, excrete waste, or age, putting them in suspended animation.
They cannot eat the same person twice until that individual gains enough new memories to establish a different sense of self from their old one.
Roy could not eat the names or memories of non-humanoid beings, such as different animals, witchbeasts, or earth dragons.

Eclipse (蝕, Shoku): Eclipse is considered to be the trump card of Gluttony. It is split into two types: Solar Eclipse and Lunar Eclipse. Furthermore, as a result of his change in perspective in the wake of devouring Reid Astrea, during the struggle for the Grand Mogolade Geyser, Roy developed Eclipsing Binary, a new form of Eclipse, before its events were undone with Return by Death.
Lunar Eclipse (月食, Gesshoku): This allows the holder to use their victims' memories and harvest their skills and knowledge. Roy used Lunar Eclipse to boost his physical strength and speed in his fight against Julius and Ricardo Welkin. On top of that, Roy could also combine any number of memories and skills which would in turn allow him to create any sort of synthesized super-class technique he desired. However, Roy cannot bring forth the true potential of techniques in this manner, only being granted a portion of the technique's power. It is worth noting that by eating a person's name and using Lunar Eclipse, Roy does not gain his victims' Divine Protections, spiritual arts, or Authorities.
Solar Eclipse (日食, Nisshoku): This allows the holder to harvest their victims' name and transform their appearance accordingly. Rui, for example, transformed into Neiji Lockhart and numerous other victims she and her two brothers had eaten throughout the years using her sibling's body. By doing so, though he becomes limited in the number of techniques he can use, the techniques that belong to those who Roy has transformed into can achieve their full potential. Roy does not like using Solar Eclipse because he does not like the side effects of morphing into his victims, as he feels as though he loses his sense of self.
Eclipsing Binary (蝕連星, Shoku Rensei): In the events of the Arc 9 loop, Roy was able to manifest a new ability of his Authority that allowed Roy to extract and blend specific memories from the Stomach of Souls, then cast them towards his opponents. However, as the memories sent to his opponents were foreign to them, rather than experiencing the memories gathered by Roy, the memories hurled towards an opponent would incite them to recall the experience of the most similar memories they had. Roy utilized this power to take the concept of memories of agony and send it at his opponents, prompting each of them to experience a harsh feeling of agony they once underwent. 

Life Creation: Rui stated she and her brothers can create life with the usage of her Witch Factor of Gluttony, just like how Daphne created the witchbeasts four centuries ago. However, Rui has also stated she and her brothers had no reason to do so, hence they never followed through the idea. While all of this has been strictly stated by Rui, it's safe to assume Roy can also create life through the usage of his Witch Factor of Gluttony.
Witchbeast Control: Because Roy, Lye, and Rui each possess the Witch Factor of Gluttony previously owned by Daphne, they can direct witchbeasts to attack certain areas. This was why the White Whale’s attacks were coordinated with those of the Witch Cult. In Arc 6, Lye and Roy are able to get to the Pleiades Watchtower in half a day by commanding the witchbeasts in the Augria Sand Dunes and order them to attack the Watchtower. In Arc 9, Roy shows that he can command one of the heads of the Black Serpent, having it fight alongside him. The White Whale, as well as, to an extent, the Great Rabbit can also obey the Factor holder's will.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
Master Martial Prowess: Through the accumulation of souls eaten with his Authority, Roy gains any abilities his victims once had such as martial art techniques and weapon skills by using Lunar Eclipse. In turn, this grants him extraordinary combat strength. He was able to overpower both Julius and Ricardo, who are noted to be very strong.

Techniques
thumb|250px|Roy employing Lunar Eclipse to apply Ultimate Palm against Julius.
Ultimate Palm (絶掌, Zettenohira): Ultimate Palm is a powerful palm strike granting Roy the sheer power to push people flying back with the force of a car and to destroy physical objects like swords by merely colliding with them. This ability is implied to originally belong to an individual who claimed to slay eighty-eight “pretty boys”.

Serpent of the Twin Swords (双剣の蛇, Sō Ken no Hebi): With Serpent of the Twin Swords, Roy has the technique to swiftly use his daggers at high speeds, granting him the skill to direct a flurry of slashes at an opponent.

Carnivorous Beast (肉食獣, Nikushoku-jū): Carnivorous Beast allows Roy to strengthen his body and gives him two advantages: he can withstand powerful attacks and strengthen his limbs to deliver devastating blows that, from Subaru's perspective, would be as devastating as getting hit by a car. With it, he could prevent himself from being beheaded by point blank wind magic from Ram. This ability originally belonged to Beli Hainelga.

Palm of the Fist King (拳王の掌, Ken Ō no Tenohira): Palm of the Fist King allows Roy to strike his opponents with an extremely powerful fist, and its destructive force grants him the capability to blast and drill through steel or flesh. This ability originally belonged to Neiji Lockhart.

Leaper (跳躍者, Chōyaku-sha): Leaper allows Roy to use a short-range teleportation in quick succession, essentially allowing him to "leap" behind his opponents or avoid extremely precise and quick attacks. He is also capable of utilizing it vertically, making it appear as if he's flying. This ability originally belonged to Dorkell.

Snow Vallum (雪喰, Yukikui): A technique that allows Roy to enhance his physical might and grappling strength, and by doing so, he can stop the charge or attack of a beast larger than himself, such as a Guiltylowe. The technique originally belonged to Tislow, and it is fabled to have enough strength to stop an entire avalanche.

Compactor (圧搾屋, Assaku-ya): An ability that allows Roy to, by closing their hands together, manipulate the earth around him as if moving sand, and by doing so, everything from the edges from his vision can be gathered in one spot and crushed by the earth. By only partially using this technique can allow Roy to obstruct his opponents' line of sight by raising the earth. The technique originally belonged to Figdour.

Saintess of a Thousand Visages (千面聖女, Sen-men Seijo): A technique that allows Roy to see three hundred and sixty degrees degrees around himself from both left to right and top to bottom. The technique originally belonged to Iyerna.

Blighted Love Balladeer (悲恋歌人, Hiren Kajin): A technique that allows Roy to use his voice to freeze an opponent in place. It is unclear whether this falls under magic, as it is described as a curse ballad. The technique originally belonged to Notah.

Magic
Like with his martial prowess, due to having eaten numerous names and memories, Roy has obtained access to numerous magic abilities. However, this does not increase his mana pool, meaning that he might not be able to use spells to their fullest potential depending on the spells' respective mana consumptions.

thumb|250px|Roy employing Lunar Eclipse to apply Twilight Mage against Ricardo.
Twilight Mage (逢魔術師, Ōmajutsu-shi): Twilight Mage grants unique magical abilities to Roy, such as manipulating a stream of water into a pair of massive serpentine water dragons that can tear someone's body apart or countering the effects of others' magic by nullifying it with his own. This ability is implied to originally belong to an insignificant sorcerer who was a social outcast unloved by even their family.

Magic Manus Magister (魔弄師, Ma Rō-shi): A technique that allows Roy to manipulate multiple magic attributes to cast multiple spells at once, such as by simultaneously creating spears of flame, ice, and earth, which had the capacity to lock onto and fire at a target. The technique originally belonged to Yardray.

Unique Spells:
thumb|180x|Roy employing Blood Weeping Oni and Lord of Phantasmal Rainbows simultaneously.
Blood-Weeping Oni (血涙鬼, Ketsurui Oni): Blood-Weeping Oni allows Roy to manipulate his own spilt blood to bind and attack his enemies. He can also make his blood coagulate and return to his body, essentially allowing him to halt his own bleeding. This originally belonged to Advan.
Lord of Phantasmal Rainbows (虹幻公, Kōgen Kō): By using the residual mana of the corpses of witchbeasts as catalysts, Roy can create rainbow butterflies that create prismatic explosions upon contact with the target. Though, they can be made to detonate early by using the environment or magic in place of oneself. The technique is reminiscent of the prismatic spiritual arts of Julius Juukulius, meaning that the butterflies are likely made up of all six elements. These butterflies can also be used as mana tanks, from which Roy can absorb into his own body to maintain his mana stores. This originally belonged to Matclyma Jordon.

Intelligence
Keen Intellect: Despite coming off as a depraved lunatic, Roy is also deceptively smart and devious. After witnessing the display of a strange Authority, he was able to quickly deduce who was using it, despite lacking any prior knowledge of it, as well as realize that its ability was related to the shortening of events, despite the intangible nature of her Authority. Likewise, he is shown to prepare traps and plan for certain eventualities; when he was held captive by Aldebaran and had his curse's restrictions loosened, he was quick to form an alliance with another captive and had already prepared "insurance" in the eventuality that she would inevitably betray him, all the while planning for a massacre in the near future. On top of this, having devoured so many names and memories, he also has a vast stockpile of knowledge at the tips of his fingers, and the only thing he needs to do to access it is unearth it from his stockpile.

Curse
Oath Bound Curse Mark (誓約の呪印, Seiyaku no Juin): Upon being freed from his prison by Al in Arc 9, Roy had an oath bound curse mark carved onto him. According to his oath, if he was to ever break his promise and consume anyone with his Authority of Gluttony besides the one person Al has told him to eat, he would be engulfed in a purifying flame, scorching his body and tainting his soul, never allowing it to return to Od Lagna. However, Al repeatedly loosened the curse mark's conditions in order to allow for Roy to eat the memories of other people or his own name depending on the situation. In the end, Roy defied the conditions of the curse mark to devour a Witch, and was thereafter scorched by blue flames and killed by someone else before said flames could take his life. Following Subaru using Return by Death and undoing the events of the arc, Roy's death was reverted, and as such, he no longer has this curse.

Equipment
Claws & Daggers: Roy wields two claws from his hands that he uses with his speed and lightness. He also wields daggers that were hidden inside of his clothes.
Gospel (福音): As a member of the Witch Cult, Roy is the owner of a copy of a Gospel. Each Gospel was a replica of the Book of Wisdom, a book that had been in the possession of the Witch of Greed Echidna. The Book of Wisdom would provide exact details of future events concerning the Witch of Greed, essentially bestowing Echidna with a form of precognition. Unlike the original Book of Wisdom, the Gospels of the Witch Cult were imperfect replicas, meaning that, although they detailed the future of its owner, the events conveyed were subject to change and the information provided was often up for interpretation. The Gospels took the form of small black books that could only be read by their owners.

name: Sirius Romanée-Conti
name_jp: シリウス・ロマネコンティ
alias: Sin Archbishop of Wrath (憤怒の大罪司教, Fundo no Daizai Shikyō) ; Wrath (憤怒, Fundo)
intro: Sirius Romanée-Conti (シリウス・ロマネコンティ) is a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing Wrath. She was one of the main antagonists of Arc 5 alongside her fellow Sin Archbishops, leading an assault on the Watergate City of Priestella.
appearance:
Sirius is covered head-to-toe in white bandages, with only her mouth and left eye left unobscured, though some breaches in her bandages allow part of her full head of long silver hair to seep out. The visible eye is amethyst purple with a blue pupil, and her ears seem to be pointed. Around her neck, she bears a steel choker with the Witch Cult's coat of arms attached. Additionally, something similar to a red teardrop is constantly affixed below her left eye.

Her long golden steel chains are wrapped around her arms and trail along the ground as she moves. These chains have hooks on their edges which allow Sirius to wield them lethally in close combat. Other than her bandages and chains, the only other thing Sirius wears is a long purple cloak. The inside of the cloak is sky blue with several vertical red decorative lines. Although not visible, she carries the Gospel of the Witch Cult around in her cloak.
personality:
As shown by her position, Sirius can be wrathful when she becomes angry, though normally she gives off a disgusting aura. She is also Petelgeuse's stalker and is his self-proclaimed wife, arbitrarily adopting the madman's surname. She speaks in an intimate, rational manner, but with an off-putting attitude. Sirius has a distinct way of speaking, repeatedly apologizing to everyone about nothing or small things. She does not stand people who belittle her relationship with Petelgeuse as seen when she tried to kill Regulus for saying that she was disgusting for clinging to a deceased person. Strangely enough, she harbors hatred towards the Witch of Envy, going as far as promising Subaru (who she thought was Petelgeuse) that she would burn her before him if he ever managed to revive the Witch, and naturally, this hatred extends to Emilia, who bears the Witch’s resemblance. Sirius despises any woman that's too close to her beloved Petelgeuse, as seen when she expressed her hatred towards Beatrice for simply standing next to Subaru and asking him what he found so appealing about her, before threatening to burn her alive.

Sirius also seems to have no qualms with doing whatever she can to win in combat against opponents she dislikes, even going so far as to take a child hostage to protect her from particularly powerful combatants like Emilia and Priscilla. On the other hand, for those she holds no hatred for and are still superior to her, such as Reinhard, she does not seem to feel the need to do so. Instead, she will drag down everyone nearby while accepting her death.

Sirius demonstrated a twisted and freakish view of love. In her opinion, the best representation of love is to become one. To her, love is a prayer for becoming one, seeing the same things, feeling the same emotions, living the same life, and ending the same death. She also has a habit of excessively thanking and immediately thereafter apologizing to other people. After losing to Priscilla and Liliana in Priestella, Sirius began believing songs were wonderful despite misunderstanding the feelings behind songs. Even though she resultingly picked up the habit of humming, Sirius' songs are out of tune, out of pitch, without rhythm, and dissonant. Subaru and Felt found their sound irritating.
history:
Currently, little is known about Sirius' past including how she became the Sin Archbishop of Wrath and how she obtained the Witch Factor of Wrath. However, according to her, her hometown was destroyed by a Witch Hunt long ago. Presumably, since Sirius's Authority is thought to grant her extreme longevity, she has lived for a very long time, though it is unknown how long. Also, according to herself, Petelgeuse is the one who gave Sirius her name and her Wrath.

According to Petelgeuse, during the events of Arc 3, she was on a mission outside of Lugunica. At some point following the arc, Sirius retrieved Petelgeuse's remains, cremated them, and systematically found and slew all of his fingers with the hope she would find him.

The Lion's Ferocity
Following the Battle for Priestella, Sirius was escorted by Felt and Reinhard van Astrea. Though the traveling was expected to last for a month at best, due to the unnatural trouble and misfortune that seemed to plague Sirius, such as bandit or witchbeast attacks or damaged pathways, their arrival was delayed. Despite this, however, not a single member of the Witch Cult came to retrieve Sirius, and Wrath was left to speak with Felt, successfully creeping her out. In the end, she was brought to the Prison Tower, where she was to be held by Evil Sealing Stones, much to the Sin Archbishop’s chagrin.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Sirius is an incredibly powerful warrior capable of fighting against skilled fighters of Priscilla's and Emilia's caliber and even defending herself from Reinhard for a time. What makes her truly dangerous, however, is that she is capable of unleashing untold damage to a large number of people at once, and by connecting everyone to herself, she can force even the strongest warriors to hesitate to injure her.

Authority

Soulwashing (洗魂, Arai Tamashī): Sirius is the current holder of the Witch Factor of Wrath and can use its Authority. In a large but currently unspecified area of influence, Sirius can share or transmit her and other's emotions and senses to others. After polarizing emotions such as anger, sorrow, joy, or ecstasy, she can transmit it to any person in her vicinity, either taking control of them or resonating a certain emotion between a certain amount of people to raise it to the point of madness. Also, since she can share senses such as distress or pain, if anyone is injured or dies within the area of effect, she can force others within the same area to die or receive the same injuries, in the same way. On the other hand, if she is healed with others under the effects of her Authority, the effect will be transferred to everyone afflicted. The Authority's intensity seems to fade the further the range and extension, and the effectiveness can vary drastically between people. Sirius also possesses the ability to exclude people from the effects of her Authority. Her Authority can, however, be resisted by creating emotions intense enough to break them free from its influence. In the case of Priscilla, it was her excessive pride, whereas with Liliana and an entire affected crowd, a combination of roused emotions through Liliana's music and Priscilla's Soul Marriage Technique managed to free them. Likewise, other people can use her Authority against her: when an entire city was at its lowest and most desperate while under the Authority's influence, Subaru took advantage of her Authority to give those very same people hope and morale, to the point that the people were ready to take up arms and were no longer scared of their attackers. According to Subaru's observations, he believes that the more people there were, the more effective her Authority becomes, and if this is the case, the opposite is likely true, to the point that just having Reinhard to escort her alone would be plenty to not affect their surroundings. At the very least, there does seem to be a prerequisite for her Authority to affect people, as even when she was being escorted by Felt and Reinhard, it did not seem to take effect on them.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
Inhuman Strength: She is said to have the highest physical strength among the Sin Archbishops. Sirius can easily withstand strong attacks by simply blocking them with her bare hands. During her confrontation with Reinhard in the 3rd failed loop of Arc 5, Sirius displayed inhuman strength and resilience by blocking one of his kicks, which are powerful enough to send stone golems flying.

Chain Wielding Mastery: Sirius wields long golden chains made out of solid metal with razor-sharp hooks at the ends, which she tends to wrap around her entire body. The length of the chains seems to be infinite, and she stores them away in her black coat's sleeves or materializes them from thin air. When entering combat, Sirius shoots them out and freely controls their path of flight – it was mentioned that her control over her golden chains was unnatural and superhuman, as she could seemingly telepathically change their trajectory mid-air and home them on her target. The chains are incredibly sturdy and powerful, being capable of easily shattering stone walls with a single strike. Combined with her superhuman strength, incredible mastery of fire magic, and her ruthlessness, Sirius is easily able to overpower even the strongest of foes by repeatedly slashing at them with her golden chains with such force, that the sky was described to be just about ready to split in half. Furthermore, Sirius can also use her chains to propel herself to higher places, as was shown seconds before she was cut down by Reinhard in one of the failed loops; by extending her arms wide, she shot out her golden chains and hooked them to nearby buildings, launching herself up in the sky. Lastly, it should be worth mentioning that when serious, Sirius clads her golden chains in fire which burns so hot that it can easily shatter Emilia's ice spells which can resist even the highest of heat. As demonstrated when she fought Priscilla, Sirius can seemingly produce these chains from her own body; when she first made several of them appear, they erupted from her shoulders and knees, causing massive bleeding to her body, to deliver a widespread attack.

Longevity: Sirius possesses an abnormally long lifespan, though the specifics behind her longevity have yet to be revealed. It is unknown if her Authority of Wrath causes it.

Magic
Sirius is a master of fire magic, though her application of the fire affinity is a bit different than most others'.

Fire Magic: Sirius exhibits an uncanny mastery of fire magic, being capable of easily enveloping her arms or objects in a scorching-hot fire that can melt even Emilia's sturdy ice. By simply holding an object in her hands, Sirius can clad it in flames and greatly amplify her damage output. Having said that, the most common application of this technique can be seen with Sirius' golden chains; by wrapping them around her arms and igniting them, Sirius effectively turns her hands into flaming swords that can easily deflect sword or spear attacks and deal massive amounts of damage. Additionally, Sirius can perform ranged attacks using her fire magic; by enveloping her chains in fire, she can hit distant opponents not just with strikes capable of severing a human being in half, but she can also scorch them to death. Furthermore, if she uses her chains to peel off portions of her flesh, she is able to turn the blood that flies off from her body into greater flames that spew towards an enemy. During her confrontation with Regulus in Arc 5, Sirius managed to envelop Regulus in a vortex of apocalyptic flames that rose above the giant Time Tower and even melted the stone tiles on which Regulus was standing. Mere minutes later, Sirius proceeded to split the earth between Subaru and Regulus open and create a sea of flames between the fighting duo. Her fire control has been described as supernatural.

Other
thumb|right|250px|Sirius warping space to keep Tina hostage.
Spatial Manipulation: Sirius can warp space to some extent, allowing her to obscure people or objects behind a distortion in space. She employed this skill to keep Tina as a hostage.

Velocity Manipulation: Sirius displays a power that seemingly allow her to manipulate the speed at which a person or an object flows at. When Priscilla was approaching the Sin Archbishop, everything except her continued to progress at a normal speed while her velocity and momentum were unnaturally slowed, giving Sirius time to attack her while she was defenseless.

Equipment
Gospel (福音書, Fukuinsho): As a member of the Witch Cult, Sirius is the owner of a copy of a Gospel. Each Gospel is a replica of the Book of Wisdom, a book that had been in the possession of the Witch of Greed Echidna. The Book of Wisdom would provide exact details of future events concerning the Witch of Greed, essentially bestowing Echidna with a form of precognition. Unlike the original Book of Wisdom, the Gospels of the Witch Cult are imperfect replicas, meaning that, although they detail the future of its owner, the events conveyed are subject to change and the information provided is often up for interpretation. The Gospels take the form of small black books that only their owners can read.
Conversation Mirror: A meteor that allows the user to get in contact with people who hold other such mirrors.

name: Satella
alias: Witch of Envy (嫉妬の魔女, Shitto no Majo) ; The Jealous Witch (嫉妬深い魔女, Shittobukai Majo) ; Queen of the Castle of Shadows (影の城の女王, Kage no Shiro no Joō) ; The Witch (魔女, Majo)
nickname: Tella (テラ) (by Typhon) ; Tella-Tella (テラテラ) (by Daphne)
eye_color: Amethyst Purple (Witch of Envy) ; Purple (Iris) (Satella) ; Blue (Pupil) (Satella)
intro: Satella (サテラ) is the Witch of Envy. Once a member of the Witch Era Party, she became a Witch and perpetrated the Great Calamity 400 years ago. In reality, the Witch of Envy is a separate personality that formed when she took in the incompatible Witch Factor of Envy. Satella formally debuted in Arc 4 as a supporting character, whilst the Witch serves as an overarching antagonist throughout the series, appearing in most arcs so far, one way or another.
appearance:
Satella, according to legend, is a half-human/half-elf demi-human woman with silver hair and eyes that are amethyst with a bluish tint to them. As a half-elf, Satella's ears are noticeably pointed. When she manifested before Petelgeuse in a realm devoid of light, the details of her face and the shape of her body were both obscured by pitch-black veils made out of mist. The mist that engulfed her form was so impossibly dark that it blotted out the darkness of the realm. In this state, Satella's eyes can be seen glowing brightly in contrast to the rest of her form.

Beyond the shadows that obscure her appearance, Satella wears black thigh-high socks with orange frills on the top, a black one-piece mini-dress with orange flower decorations, and a long dark veil that covered a part of her face. Additionally, she also has a pair of earrings and an orange and black eight-pointed star hairpiece.

When she attacked the Sanctuary in Emilia's body, Satella's form was once again obscured. Although the contours of her body were difficult to ascertain, the shadows surrounding her made her seem as though she wore a dress of darkness and had long raven-black hair. Her voice was muffled to the point that it was difficult to distinguish whether it belonged to a man or a woman.

When Subaru encountered her at Echidna's tea party, she wore a black dress made of shadows that seemed to wave in accordance with her heartbeat. Initially, he was unable to see her face because of a black shadow covering her above her neck, which was created out of his reluctance to accept her. However, he later accepts her and becomes able to see her face, mentioning afterwards that she looks exactly the same as Emilia.
personality:
Contrary to popular belief, Satella and the Witch of Envy are separate personalities, formed when she took in an incompatible Witch Factor. The two personalities tend to fight each other. Both personalities love Subaru, though the Witch of Envy personality is much more aggressive about it, while Satella is much more reasonable and cares deeply about his well-being, with the love both feel for Subaru being the reason they gave him Return by Death, to prevent him from truly dying.

According to Beatrice, the Witch of Envy was starved for love before her imprisonment. For unknown reasons, the Witch is obsessively in love with Subaru, who, to his knowledge, had never met her before in his life. In the shadow world she calls home, Satella would simply sit idly and monotonously repeat the words "I love you" over and over again, seemingly swamped by her own obsessive feelings of love towards Subaru. She is incredibly possessive over Subaru, as she won't allow him to tell anyone else the secret of Return by Death. The Witch seems to have no remorse, nor does she pay attention to anyone other than Subaru, as she didn't hesitate to execute Emilia when Subaru told her about Return by Death, and when she later saw Petelgeuse within the world meant solely for Subaru and herself, her rage swelled, and she was quick to violently banish the spirit from their world. If the secret of Return by Death is revealed to another person, the Witch will find a method of bypassing her imprisonment and slaughter all of Subaru's allies in that timeline, presumably as a form of strong reprimand fueled by her possessiveness. Although she usually pays no heed to the words of anyone, including Subaru's, she once took noticeable offense after Subaru told her that he preferred the other Witches of Sin over her.

Alec Hoshin described Satella as an earnest, reckless, pure, and honest girl in spite of being burdened with a rough destiny, and according to the author, Satella apparently lacks common sense, and the situation is so serious that her dictionary doesn't even have the word common sense. When she later appeared in the Castle of Dreams as Satella instead of the Witch of Envy, though she still proclaimed her love for Subaru repeatedly like the Witch does, her kind and gentle nature was shown when she displayed extreme concern and panic for him when he willingly bit off his own tongue to avoid listening to her, cried while questioning what it is he saw in his trials, and listened to him patiently as he spoke to the other Witches, unlike the aggressively envious Witch. She has trusted and requested Subaru to one day kill her.
history:
In the years predating the Great Calamity, Satella travelled alongside Echidna, Flugel, Reid Astrea, Farsale Lugunica, and Alec Hoshin for unknown reasons, though according to Alec, it was a journey to save the world. According to Echidna, at the time of their travels, they needed to keep their identities secret. However, at one point during their travels, they ended up in the country of Magrizza. Despite attempting to hide their identities, Farsale declared his own name, resulting in a noble discovering them and inviting them to a banquet of nobles. The nation's crown prince, who was also in attendance at the banquet, became enamored by Echidna and went behind the scenes to arrange a marriage between the two of them, with Echidna's party going along with them after they were split from their capable fighters. However, at some point, for reasons yet to be explained, Reid and Volcanica went on a rampage, ultimately resulting in the marriage being cancelled and them being driven from the nation. It was a short time later that they learned that the Black Serpent destroyed Magrizza. According to Echidna, it was likely that they were being chased by the Black Serpent.

400 years ago, Satella absorbed the Witch Factor of Envy, which she had no compatibility with, resulting in the creation of her Witch of Envy personality. However, this alternate personality was not the reason for her subsequently going out of control and killing countless innocent people and nearly destroying the world. Despite the efforts of many, including the Divine Dragon, the First Sword Saint, and the Sage, Satella was unable to be killed and was instead sealed in a shrine that was watched over by Shaula until the end of Arc 6. Currently, the Pleiades Watchtower and Evil Sealing Stone Shrine are being watched over by the Divine Dragon itself, Volcanica.

Despite being physically imprisoned near the Great Waterfall, Satella somehow maintains a link to Subaru's body and is constantly aware of his actions, even managing to manifest in the shape of a shadowy figure of varying sizes multiple times throughout the story.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
In her era, Satella was one of the most powerful people alive whose defeat could only be attained by the combined efforts of the strongest heroes of the time. Among the Witches of Sin who were reviled by the world, Satella was easily the mightiest. She was able to swallow up half of the world and was said to eclipse the might of all of the other Witches combined. If not for the interference of the Sage and the Divine Dragon, Satella would have overwhelmed and defeated the first Sword Saint, despite his own overwhelming strength. Even within the modern era, the Witch remains almost completely unrivaled. The only two individuals who are said to counter Satella in some form are the current generation's Sword Saint, Reinhard van Astrea, and his legendary ancestor, Reid Astrea, who contributed to her defeat four hundred years ago. According to the author, if Satella and Reinhard were to fight like in Arc 9, it would end in a stalemate as she wouldn't be able to land a finishing blow, whereas Reinhard couldn't bypass her immortality. It is noted that the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine that officially serves as Satella's prison is unable to completely seal her due to reasons currently unknown and is constantly surrounded by a lethal miasma. In fact, during the events of Arc 9, she manifested outside of her seal without the need to possess Emilia, albeit incompletely.

Authority
Authority of Envy (嫉妬の権能, Shitto no Ken'nō): Satella is the current holder of the Witch Factor of Envy and can use its respective Authority.
Although the abilities of the Authority of Envy have yet to be revealed, in the web novel, Minerva mentioned during the Witches' Tea Party that Satella might direct her jealousy (妬み Netami) towards her if she stepped in between her and Subaru, suggesting that it's something that affects people remotely. This ability has been removed from the Light Novel, hence should not be considered as canon.

Magic
Satella is said to be a master of yin magic. According to Julius and Beatrice at the beginning of Arc 7, a shadow that was the product of the yin attribute with similar qualities to Shamak was what swallowed Subaru, Rem, and Spica. Beatrice speculated that it was trying to bring them to another location, but failed. While Subaru was within the shadows of the Yin Magic clump, he heard the Witch of Envy's voice, signaling that she has some sort of connection to it.

Other
Most of the abilities that Satella has shown to be capable of are of unknown origin. Her primary abilities are focused on the manipulation of miasma and magic, but at the same time, since it is unclear exactly which abilities fall under the scope of her Authority, her magic, or possibly other abilities, the following abilities cannot be properly classified.

Limited Omniscience: For unknown reasons, despite being sealed, Satella is aware of the happenings in the outside world. That being said, however, this seems to be limited towards everything surrounding or related to Subaru, likely due to some form of connection between them, and it is unclear just how much she can be aware of. Though she rarely reacts to anything he does or anything that happens around him, she is aware of whenever he attempts to speak about his Authority to others, which she does respond to. Furthermore, she seems to be aware of the people around him and connected to him, as she had once killed Emilia in front of his eyes, went to kill the sleeping Rem during one failed loop despite her not being told about her, and responded to when Rui Arneb attached herself to Subaru. Likewise, she is aware of his words when speaking in dream worlds, such as the Castle of Dreams, and she will immediately respond whenever someone manages to read his Books of the Dead, even if Subaru is sealed away and not immediately present within the area. This being said, there are times when she is unable to perceive the happenings around Subaru, those times being when his connection with her is severed or when he is speaking within the Corridor of Memories. That being said, in the case of the former, she is able to reform the connection between them if he calls out her name.

Shadow Manipulation: Satella is able to generate and control shadows on a gargantuan scale. In Arc 7, the shadow that appeared at the watchtower was thought by to be the product of the yin attribute and had similar qualities to Shamak, while in Arc 9, the shadow were claimed to be kneaded from her miasma. Whether this is a part of her Authority, however, is unknown.
thumb|251x251px|The Witch projecting a massive number of shadows at Garfiel Tinzel.
Shadow Tendrils: Satella is able to create shadow tendrils, which she uses to capture, impale, and decimate her enemies. The tendrils are strong enough to hold a transformed Garfiel in the air and incapacitate him. She is also able to slip the shadows into someone's body through wounds and disperse them outwards, effectively destroying the opponent from the inside out.
Devouring Shadows: In the instances in which she has appeared, even though she is still sealed, just showing up causes the entire area she is in to be completely enveloped in shadows. After covering the area in shadows, the Witch of Envy then begins absorbing everything around her–the more she absorbs, the more mass her vortex of shadows gains. During a failed loop in Arc 4, the entire Sanctuary was enveloped in shadows and everyone else was swallowed by the shadows.
Physical Attack Nullification: By creating a veil of shadow over her person, Satella can seemingly nullify physical damage directed at her. Even the mighty blows of Garfiel Tinzel merely dissipated upon making contact with the Witch of Envy.
thumb|250x250px|Satella holding Subaru's heart.
Shadow Hands: In some instances, she can also be seen creating hands from her shadows, similar to the Unseen Hand that came from the Authority of Sloth belonging to Witch Cult's Sin Archbishop of Sloth Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti. She often uses a shadow hand to grip Subaru's heart whenever he speaks about his ability to anyone who isn't her. According to Puck, Satella is capable of manifesting over two-thousand shadow hands at once. She can also make the hands go intangible, such as when one hand phases through Subaru's chest to squeeze his heart in Arc 3. According to one passage from Chapter 58 of Arc 5's web novel, Satella's shadow/magical hands and the Unseen Hands produced by the Authority of Sloth share similar properties, such as being able to phase through objects, but are not the same ability.

Time Manipulation: Though the Witch of Envy has yet been seen to freely manipulate time in her favor apart from stopping time around Subaru whenever he speaks about Return by Death or anything connected to it – though even that isn't confirmed to be thanks to her ability to manipulate time to certain extent – she was the one who gave Subaru his Authority, which he named Return By Death (死に戻り, Shinimodori), in order to prevent him from dying. It should also be noted that the Witch of Envy supposedly didn't grant Subaru this ability in order to save his friends, but rather, in order to challenge fate head-on without any restrictions, such as death. Furthermore, the true purpose for her granting Subaru his Authority is yet to be explained and all the information above was only speculated by Echidna in Arc 4.

Witch's Scent (魔女の香, Majo no Ka): The Evil Sealing Stone Shrine where Satella is sealed is covered in her scent, which is so thick that it distorts everything in one’s view. It invades the minds of anyone it touches, annihilates their flesh, and corrupts their soul.

Possession: During a failed loop of Arc 4, Satella was capable of leaving her seal and possessing Emilia's body so as to physically interact with Subaru. In a similar manner, after she lost sight Subaru in Arc 7, when she regained sight of him, she managed to semi-possess his body, producing an incredible mass of shadows from his body which responded to his emotions. The process which she does this by is unknown.

Immortality: One of Satella's most troublesome and dangerous abilities is her seemingly flawless immortality. Although she can be injured and defeated, Satella's body can't be destroyed by any external force. Even the Great Sage Flugel, who was said to be all-knowing, could not conceive a method to bring about Satella's death. Her immortality couldn't be bypassed by even Reid Astrea, the first Sword Saint, Volcanica, the Divine Dragon, and Flugel, the aforementioned Great Sage, eventually resulting in her being sealed away. It is unknown whether her immortality is part of her Authority of Envy or a completely different ability. By the time of Subaru's summoning, Satella has been alive for over four-hundred years while still sealed, though this inhuman longevity of hers is most likely due to her half-elf blood.

intro: Sekhmet (セクメト) was the Witch of Sloth. She formally debuted in Arc 4 as a supporting character.
appearance: Sekhmet was described as a beautiful yet languid woman in her mid-twenties with absurdly long, unkempt, magenta hair that went down to her toes. She was usually dressed in a sultry outfit that was primarily black and complemented her voluptuous and feminine physique rather perfectly. Her skin was described as pale, to the point one would consider it unhealthy; her face gave off an extremely debilitated and apathetic look. When Subaru first met her, he mistook her for a big ball of magenta fur.
personality:
True to her position as the Witch of Sloth, Sekhmet's personality could be summed up in one word: lazy, as could also be seen through her appearance. She was also lazy enough that she once even found breathing to be a pain and gave off a gloomy atmosphere.

As expected from her age, Sekhmet was rather mature and even philosophical at times. She usually remained neutral in arguments. However, if she deemed someone right, she always jumped on their side and assisted them as much as she could.
history:
Before she was born, Sekhmet's clan, the Giants, expected things from her, wanting to bring back their founder known as God. However, after she was born, she disappointed them, causing them to hold her in disdain and abandon her as punishment. Many years later, upon hearing of a wild woman in the mountains, men came and captured her, taking her down to the city. While there, she gained knowledge, a way of life, and emotions. Eventually, not understanding at the time that what she felt was gratitude and obligation, she snapped the necks of the men in the place she lived in and left. Returning to her homeland, she proceeded to kill her entire clan, not understanding at the time that what she felt was hatred and a desire for revenge. She then returned back to her previous home to give the men she killed a proper burial, and once she was alone, she felt a peace of mind, which she felt happy about.

Over 400 years ago, in a land away from the eastern lands, Sekhmet was partially responsible for driving the Dragons past the Great Waterfall just so she could rest. One day, for unknown reasons, she would enter into battle against Volcanica, ending with Sekhmet ironically falling from the Great Waterfall and dying.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Sekhmet has at one point been called among the strongest characters in the series, and among the Witches of Sin, she was considered the strongest, not including Satella. Her strength was such that she was not only sent to stop Typhon's campaigns, but she was also capable of contending with Volcanica for a time.

Authority
Authority of Sloth (怠惰の権能, Taida no Ken'nō): As the Witch of Sloth, Sekhmet was a user of the Authority of Sloth and was a compatible holder of its corresponding Witch Factor.
thumb|230x230px|Sekhmet using her Authority of Sloth to stop Minerva
Crushing Force: Sekhmet is seen manipulating an invisible force that allows her to hit and crush things without moving a muscle. This ability seems to be far stronger than her successor's Authority of Sloth, as apart from being completely invisible, the force seems to have a bigger radius, vastly superior speed, and a bigger area of effect. With it, Sekhmet clashed and drove away a number of Dragons past the Great Waterfall in life, and even managed to hold her own with the Divine Dragon, Volcanica, despite it coming out victorious in the end. According to Echidna, she is capable of killing the other five Witches of Sin in the Castle of Dreams in an instant, though despite being considered the strongest Witch in generations, she had shortcomings outside of her strength that could be taken advantage of, which Echidna speculated as possibly being due to her lineage as a giant.

intro: Rickert Hoffman (リッケルト・ホフマン) is the former Royal Instructor of the Kingdom of Lugunica and the central figure among the noble civil officials. Debuting in Arc 3's early stages, Rickert has yet to play a pivotal role in the main story.
appearance: Rickert is a middle-aged man with a thick beard, a small moustache, short slick-back grey hair, and black sanpaku eyes that have bags under them. He can usually be seen wearing a nobles' attire, befitting of his position in the Kingdom.
personality:
Rickert is a man prone to emotionally voicing his own opinions. He disagreed with the Council of Wise Men's decision to select any Royal Selection candidate who happened to be found and instead sought to select people who were suitable for the throne. Rickert was particularly discriminatory of Emilia for being a “half-devil” and Felt for being from the slums, although he later visited the latter to apologize to her once he learned of the possibility that she was the kidnapped daughter of Ford Lugunica.

According to his son Rachins, despite the strain in their relationship, Rickert is a man worthy of respect. Likewise, according to the author himself, he is a "very nice person". Also, he apparently enjoys to talk about the history of sword techniques.
history: In the past, Rickert was a knight and acted as the master of Julius Juukulius. He became the Royal Instructor, a position he inherited from his family, at an unknown age. He had a son, Rachins, who later left the Hoffman family when he was older and went to the Royal Capital's slums. At some point before the Great Conquest, Rickert and Marcos Gildark knew each other, and at one point, he was responsible for teaching swordsmanship to Julius Juukulius and Crusch Karsten. Although he taught others, after losing to a young Reinhard van Astrea, Rickert chose to retire and become a civil official. By the time the Royal Selection had begun, Rickert was the central figure amongst the country's civil servants.
abilities_text: Swordsmanship: Rickert was skilled enough with swordsmanship to be able to teach a young Julius and Crusch. However, it is stated that he is better at teaching others to use a sword than he is increasing his own skill with it.

intro: Shaula (シャウラ) is the apprentice of the Sage, Flugel. Mentioned throughout the series due to being confused for her master, she formally debuted in Arc 6 as a secondary antagonist for the beginning and climax as well as a supporting character throughout the majority of the arc.
appearance:
Shaula has green eyes with three additional red dots around her pupils and long blackish brown hair which she wore tied together in what she referred to as a scorpion tail. She was tall and had a model physique along with a large chest, all in all, being a very attractive woman. She only wore a black bikini-bra, a bowtie, a necklace, black hotpants accompanied with an orange belt, a tattered black-and-orange cloak, and knee-high boots each with orange pinstripe cuffs and a star emblem; which were of the same color pallet as Subaru's outfit.

When she took the form of a colossal scorpion, Shaula had a jet-black body, glowing red eyes and sharp pincers, which could be detached at-will. She also had a long tail with a stinger at the end of it. When entering her Attack Hue phase, her color gradually shifted from jet black to blood red.

Shaula has mentioned that Flugel and her mother were the ones who blessed her with her "design".

After her defeat in Arc 6's climax, Shaula transformed into a small crimson red scorpion. As of the end of Arc 6, it remains unclear whether or not the change is permanent though it is stated that at this point, she retains no human traits whatsoever, effectively making her a tiny witchbeast.
personality:
Shaula is described to be like a girl at the bottom of a girls' caste who runs errands for others. Though friendly with certain people, she tends to be thoughtless, so she is unfit for mental work. Also, she is unable to tell people apart and therefore refers to Subaru as her master based on smell alone, as he appears to smell the same as Flugel. Despite her usual empty-headed, unconcerned manner, Shaula has been shown to be deeply devoted to and fully loves her master, making him the most important person in the world to her. Whenever certain situations arrive on her doorstep, Shaula will recall his teachings and do her best to act on them; one such to show concern for and treat pregnant women with care, which she remembered even after 400 years. This being said, she tends to act dismissively towards strangers, and if someone attempts to take his place as the most important person to her, then she will not hesitate to attack even a pregnant woman for the transgression, though she would at least possibly provide said person a chance to survive.

Her devotion and love for Flugel completely takes up all of Shaula's mind and heart, to the point that she would kill others for him, and after mistaking Subaru for Flugel, all of this devotion has been pushed onto him. If he asked her to die for his sake, she would not hesitate; in fact, while she believed Subaru was Flugel, she even ordered him to kill her so that she wouldn't kill him. Upon leaving her to care for the Pleiades Watchtower, she waited diligently for centuries and counted the days while obeying Flugel, fully believing in his return. Her devotion was so great that it was unable to be painted over by the Authority of Leilani Alnair. Upon Subaru's approach to the tower, after coming to believe that her master had returned, she attempted to act on a certain command he gave her that she had forgotten, she became so excited to see him again that she left the tower to retrieve him personally, and she claimed that she would love him no matter how many centuries passed.

At the end of Arc 6, Shaula completely lost her humanity and became a small red scorpion witchbeast. She acts solely according to her instincts, as seen when she instinctively latches herself onto Meili, as a result of being heavily attracted to her Divine Protection of Demon Manipulation, which calms the small scorpion down.
history:
Great Calamity Era
Shaula was created in the distant past and travelled alongside the Witch Era Party. Although she is a witchbeast, it is currently unknown if she was a product of Daphne. Her appearance was designed by Echidna, her mother figure, and the Sage Flugel, whom she would serve as the apprentice of. During this time, Echidna made a deal with Reid Astrea to train her, and though he trained her, he also regularly touched her, much to Shaula's frustration and annoyance. At one point, the two sieged a fortress together. At another point, Shaula was at a banquet with the party and spoke to Farsale Lugunica, who claimed he did not want to be royalty. At another point, she spoke with Alec Hoshin, who told her of his dream to build a nation and invited Shaula to be its first citizen, though she refused in order to remain with Flugel.

After the triumphant battle against Satella, Flugel decided to give all his credit to Shaula for an unspecified reason, causing people to believe that she was the Sage. She later remained at the Pleiades Watchtower for 400 years, acting on Flugel's orders and watching over the Evil Sealing Stone Shrine. Over time, Shaula continued to train her Hell's Snipe so that she could impress Flugel upon his return, and she carved the number of days she waited into the wall of one of the tower's rooms, intending to tell Flugel that she waited patiently, just like he asked. She was also forced to fight off the numerous leaders of the Hungry Horse Kings that attempted to challenge her multiple times.

Scorpion Tale
At some point, a group of over 900 people crossed the Augria Sand Dunes in an attempt to reach the Pleiades Watchtower. Shaula had noticed and watched as the group steadily died off, save for one: a pregnant woman. Recalling the teachings she was given by Flugel about how to treat pregnant women, Shaula chose to kill the witchbeasts that were about to attack her and brought her to the tower, deciding she could stay there until the woman gave birth. Although she attempted to dismiss her, the woman, who introduced herself as Leilani Alnair, consistently acted self-deprecatingly humble before her, and her Authority attempted to work its way toward replacing her memories with "Leilani". Over time, once Leilani believed that her Authority had fully consumed her, she attempted to have Shaula listen to her and claimed that she was the most important person in Shaula's life. However, her Authority did not overwrite Shaula's devotion toward Flugel, and as punishment, Shaula shot her with one of her needles in her midsection. Afterward, she removed her from the tower and left her just outside of the Sand Time barrier with some provisions in an attempt to leave her a chance to survive. Shortly after this, all of her memories were reverted to normal, and she continued to wait for Flugel.

Julius Juukulius's Promise Keeping Notebook III
Following her attack on Subaru's group and the destruction of the Sand Time barrier, Shaula became excited at the thought of her master returning to the tower and went to retrieve Subaru personally. Shaula jumped and landed on their dragon carriage, knocking it over. After looking over the area and realizing Subaru wasn't there, she muttered her disappointment. As she was about to leave, however, Emilia grabbed her leg, causing her to fall and nearly attack her, but when she asked if she knew anything about the friends who had been blown away, Shaula lowered her hand and began walking away toward the tower, allowing the others to follow her and muttering "Coming soon". Once everyone gathered together, they chased after her. After bringing them to the tower, she left to retrieve Subaru's group. In the Sand Palace, upon witnessing Subaru fighting against a Hungry Horse King, and though she believed that her master would win, she chose to kill the witchbeast herself to receive Subaru's praise. After he passed out with Ram clutched in his arms, though she was a little annoyed that he was holding another woman, she dismissed it as a great man attracting women, and she brought him to the tower, claiming that she would love him no matter how many centuries passed.

A few hours later, she brought the others to the tower, and she kept her eyes on the unconscious Subaru the entire time. When Julius Juukulius reunited with "Anastasia", she mentioned that something seemed to have happened between her and Subaru, like a one-sided negotiation, as she had originally only intended to bring Subaru to the tower until she managed to convince her to guide the others there. Shortly after, they approached Shaula, and though Julius attempted to thank her and ask for her name, she turned her back to him, as she only intended to speak if Subaru had been involved. Nearby, Emilia and Beatrice were trying but failing to pry Subaru's arms off of Ram, as he had been holding her tight to protect, and though Julius went to help them, he questioned if Subaru was more worthy of the title of Knight, as he was trying to protect others even while unconscious.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
As a unique witchbeast created by the Witch of Gluttony, Shaula is mentioned to be strong enough that she can even force Reid Astrea to use both hands while in combat once every ten times. Subaru also mentioned she could potentially be more difficult to deal with than the Sin Archbishops themselves. She also stated she'd easily kill Emilia and others if Subaru said so. According to the author, Shaula is perhaps one of the strongest characters in the series at mid to long range, though she is much weaker at close range by comparison.

Humanoid Form

Hell's Snipe (ヘルズ・スナイプ, Heruzu Sunaipu): Shaula is able to connect her needles and her target together with mana and release it as if it's gravitating toward them. It is fast, powerful, and is able to be fired rapidly, and via what appeared to be a red dot, Shaula was capable of aiming it like a sniper. The immense power is easily able to snipe a person's head clean off, erase a Hungry Horse King's entire body from existence by showering it with projectiles, and blow people's limbs off without them even being aware of the incoming attack. It is worth mentioning that the needles are stated to be enchanted with magical powers and to carry high heat, meaning that Hell's Snipe may be a spell of Yang magic nature, though not confirmed.
Infinite Hell's Snipe (インフィニティッド・ヘルズ・スナイプ, Infinitiddo Heruzu Sunaipu): An advanced version of Hell's Snipe, Shaula is able to summon countless white magical circles, which can then be used to simultaneously shoot many needles in rapid succession towards her desired target(s).

Immense Physical Strength: As a witchbeast, Shaula's physical might is typically greater than a person's. She is shown to be able to lift an earth dragon and a dragon carriage with ease and both carry them around and move them up and down a layer of the Pleiades Watchtower.

Witchbeast Form

Crimson Scorpion (紅蠍, Benisasori): Any time a rule of the tower is broken, Shaula automatically becomes aware of it and is then forced, due to her contract, to unwillingly transform herself into her original form: a colossal scorpion witchbeast known as the Crimson Scorpion. During the process of her transformation, she loses her own will, and then she will then instinctively act and try to eliminate everyone in the tower as a "cold-blooded killing machine" without paying attention to the damages done.
Stinger: While in this form, Shaula can use her large stinger to fire at people in a similar manner to her Hell's Snipe. They fire at roughly the same speed and have power equivalent to said technique. She can fire her stinger in rapid succession, allowing her to easily kill a massive Earth Worm.
Pincers: Using her pincers, she is easily capable of snipping a person or witchbeast in half.
Carapace: Her carapace provides her with a good defense against physical attacks. Even when being attacked by Feathered Moles with their weight and mass being amplified via El Vita, her carapace was capable of withstanding it, and she came out practically unscathed.
Regeneration: Shaula is also capable of regeneration. Even should she lose her tail, it can regrow in a relatively short period of time.
Strong Legs: With her multiple scorpion legs, she can easily climb up vertical walls, like those of the Pleiades Watchtower. She can also use these legs to latch herself onto hard surfaces, and by doing so, it makes her difficult to move from where she's latched onto. Likewise, she also has great speed thanks to this. She can easily keep up with an earth dragon while being assaulted by witchbeasts without slowing down or falling behind.
thumb|right|250px|Shaula's pincer explodes after a loose piece of rubble touches it.
Explosive Body Parts: While she typically doesn't need it, if she is forced to lose a part of her body, she can leave that part behind as a trap for anyone chasing after her. If someone is nearby, the part that was lost swells and expands, and afterward, it unleashes a hail of light, like her stingers and her Hell's Snipe, that will assault everyone nearby. This attack can typically kill anything near it.
Attack Hue: If she is pushed, Shaula will also enter her Attack Hue, in which her dark carapace will shift from black to red. In this state, she becomes more aggressive, and her strength is amplified.

Tiny Scorpion: After her defeat in Arc 6 as the Crimson Scorpion, Shaula's form was reduced to that of a small red scorpion that could fit into a person's hands, and she lost her intelligence as a witchbeast, acting on instinct alone. She lost the majority of her power by being in this state, but she still remains lethal.
Stinger: Shaula still remains capable of firing her stinger in this form. It still retains enough power that it can easily pierce flesh and kill small animals, but how far, fast, and strong her stinger is now remains unknown.
