Receiving a positive response from Tishua, he left to use the bathroom.

Sword Demon Love Story
In the three months that followed the start of her engagement, Theresia brought Wilhelm to meet her parents. However, thanks to Veltol, their upcoming wedding faced numerous setbacks and obstacles. Thanks to his interference, three days before their official wedding date, he used his authority to force the Zergev Squadron to patrol a few towns around the Royal Capital, knowing full well that it would take three days to accomplish. Suspicious that this was her father's fault, she asked Bordeaux to look into it. Later, despite her frustrations, Wilhelm decided to take on this challenge, and as he prepared to leave, Theresia, who had fixed him food for on the road, saw him off. Afterward, speaking with Bordeaux Zergev, he confirmed her suspicions, and she resolved to meet with and scold her father. Two days later, Theresia and Carol went to confront Veltol. When they met, Theresia was quick to chide her father for his actions, and she even threatened to leave House Astrea because of him. Even Carol and her mother joined in to chide him. However, she believed in Wilhelm, and she knew that he would arrive on time for their wedding, despite her father's meddling. The next day, wearing her wedding dress, she waited patiently for the return for the Zergev Squadron with Carol and her parents. Eventually, Bordeaux arrived and informed her of the squad's return, and soon after, her wedding took place. Despite Wilhelm being unable to clean himself off after the mess he went through, Veltol entrusted his daughter to him, the wedding went off perfectly, and the two were married. At some point after this, Veltol ordered a sword for Wilhelm, the sword that would later be named the Holy Sword Astrea.

In the month that followed, Veltol made numerous appearances, much to Theresia's frustration, and eventually, he even suggested going along on the honeymoon as well, leading to another argument. However, with help from Tishua, they were able to get him to leave. Given two months for their honeymoon, they prepared to leave, taking Carol as Theresia's attendant, and they decided to visit the cities to the south of the Royal Capital. However, after arriving in Picoutatte, having left from Flanders, they found Veltol waiting there, leading to another argument. However, with his reason for visiting to collect the present for his wife, they accompanied him to the Suwen Company. With Veltol asking Wilhelm and Carol to allow him and Theresia to shop together, they left to observe the town. Inside the shop, however, they were met by a disrespectful Stride, who was targeting the Sword Saint. Leading Veltol to challenging him to a duel, he introduced Kurgan, who would serve as his champion, as Theresia had noticed Stride's apparent illness. After further insulting him, her, and Wilhelm, Veltol struck Stride for his remarks, leading Kurgan to ruthlessly beat him down and Stride to curse him. Taken to the hospital, she met with Wilhelm and was informed of Veltol's condition by the healer Garitch Fabless. Accordingly, the only way to remove the curse was to cut it off at the source. The next day, the curse receded after the destruction of the ring that caused it. However, he got into an argument with Theresia, and after she left to greet Tishua, who was informed of the incident and decided to visit the city, he spoke with Wilhelm, who gave him the accessory Theresia and Carol bought for him to give to Tishua. During their conversation, Wilhelm learned that Veltol's arm lost all function as an after-effect of the curse, and Veltol swore him to secrecy.

Sword Demon Battle Ballad
At a later time when Stride Vollachia attacked the Astrea Manor again, Veltol protected a pregnant Theresia and Tishua from the assassin's blade of Carol as she was controlled by Stride, resulting in his death.
abilities_text:
Pseudo-Curse: Before the beginning of the Silver Flower Dance of Picoutatte, Veltol was placed under the effects of Stride's Ten Hubristic Commandments, giving him a sort of curse different from typical ones. While under this curse's influence, he was left bedridden, and after the destruction of the ring responsible, it left his left arm permanently unusable.

Sword Skills: Veltol was below average with a sword.

appearance: Yaktol has grey hair and a slender face. He looks a little older than Theresia.
personality: Yaktol is a caring and nice man. Because of his relationship with Veltol when he helped him choose a gift for Tishua Astrea, the Suwen and the Astrea families became good friends in the later generations.
history:
Sword Demon Love Story
Prior to the honeymoon of Wilhelm and Theresia van Astrea, Veltol ordered a sword for Wilhelm. Later on, however, he met with Stride Vollachia, who used this order as an excuse to meet with Veltol and reach Theresia. When they arrived at his store, he apologized about Stride's visit and bore witness to Veltol's subsequent beating. After being passed along a message from Stride, the man left, and Yaktol chased after everyone to the hospital, where he informed Wilhelm and Theresia of his message. Afterward, he was dragged around by Carol Remendis to search for the man, though their efforts came up empty. The next day, he provided Wilhelm with his new sword and prayed for his victory in battle.

intro: Yae Tenzen (ヤエ・テンゼン) is a former member of the Priscilla Camp and presently a maid working at the Barielle Estate. Debuting as both a supporting and a twist antagonistic character in Tanpenshuu Volume 4's Pride and Prejudice and Zombies story, she plays a secondary antagonistic role in Arc 9.
appearance: Yae is a fair-skinned beautiful young woman around the age of twenty whose aura of charm and flexibility is akin to that of a cat. She has long, tied up pale red hair, cat-like jet black eyes, and slender, supple arms and legs. She wears a maid uniform adopted from a Japanese style, having a base of red with black and white mixed in, as well as black leggings and boots and a white headpiece.
personality:
An eccentric, gifted prodigy with excellent learning capabilities since childhood, Yae gained a reputation in the shinobi village as a girl who embodied the very essence of a shinobi. Due to her talent, she never knew fear during her training and easily overcame any difficulties in her path. In spite of her training, however, Yae believed that she did not fit the mold of the idealized image of a shinobi that the others in her village did, feeling it was troubling to have the expectation that she would placed onto her. As such, in betrayal of the expectations of her teacher, Fujirou Tenzen, she intentionally distanced herself from that image and acted counter to it, choosing to put on a frivolous attitude with an affable yet not intimate demeanor, speaking and conducting herself in such a way that was impossible to grasp. Bereft of aspirations typical of the shinobi, she unabashedly did not treat most things in life seriously, whether it concerned her interpersonal relationships, killing a target, or the possibility of her own death, having used this nature as a way to conceal her true intentions from the people around her in accordance with her training of suppressing her own emotions. With her sharp mind, she has learned and exemplified mastery in various shinobi techniques in under a year, researched and studied anything from potential future targets or threats, including those in a foreign nation, to miscellaneous subjects such as the identities and number of people in a small village or the corpse soldiers of the Demi-Human War, and she can easily recall said information at a moment's notice.

Because of her prodigal skill, Olbart Dunkelkenn has proclaimed that she was like himself, that having been so good everything made it seem as though everything around her had lost its spark and became uninteresting to her, something that often led to Olbart attempting to push her towards finding something to hold dear. However, Yae herself did not want to find anything precious to her due to her strong beliefs in the ways of a shinobi, as well as the fact that Yae despises being treated as if she was special, something which has influenced most of her personality, including not wishing to have expectations thrust on her. It is this part of her that she wanted to betray the expectations of those who considered her a prodigy in her own village, acting in behavior opposite of what should be considered the "typical" shinobi. She also agreed to the philosophy once stated by Olbart, in which she believed that she neither needed nor wanted any form of attachment, as if such attachment would make her "special" or for others to hold expectations for her. In fact, her feelings for this were so strong that when Olbart encouraged her to go against those teachings, she felt disgusted, and when pressed on the fact that she had become attached to and fallen in love with Aldebaran, she refuted this repeatedly. Likewise, despite her rebellious behavior toward her village elders, Yae often leaned on the shinobi teachings, keeping her emotions suppressed, not asking questions where they weren't necessary, and remaining obedient to her employer, something which ironically made her exemplify the very expectations of her fellow villagers.

Having never found anything she experienced in the past scary, Yae was first made to know "terror" by Al upon being placed in the position of the Aggressor of the Domain, which pierced her heart, broke down her will, and shattered her mind and prior way of being. The programming of her soul as a shinobi that once dictated that she suppress her emotions or commit suicide upon failure was overwritten by a severe feeling of terror and the absolute submission of her soul to Al, whom she views as a monster. As a result, Yae's attitude has changed from the unserious attitude she bore before, developing a distorted obsession towards Al and vowing to him that she will do anything to serve him so long as he refrains from frightening her the way he did before again. She remains unflinching in the face of those other than Al who threaten her safety, be it the Sword Demon or the Divine Dragon. Despite Yae's submission to Al, she often mixes her words with malice or an intent to verbally wound him, as well as to other people such as Heinkel. Furthermore, she frequently attempts to propose that he use her for "comfort", whether for her abilities, her body, or anything else, offering herself as an outlet to relax his mind, vent his frustrations, and fulfill any desire he may have, as insurance that he can persist long enough to fulfill his goal. Her motivation for supporting Al is to ensure that, once he fulfills his purpose, he dies, fervently convinced that she will never be able to feel safe again as long as he is alive. This being said, unbeknownst to her, her attachment and devotion towards Al was recognized in a failed loop as her love for him, which she had displayed by not wanting to forget him.
history:
Early Life
Like the other shinobi trainees in Vollachia's shinobi village, when Yae was a toddler, she was kidnapped from her parents, and she was put through the shinobi memory disposal process by Fujirou Tenzen, causing her to forget everything about her original parents and hometown. Being labelled Red Number 8, she went without a name for a good portion of her early life. In her days as a trainee, Yae was forced to go through intense training, regularly being forced to shed bled and experience excruciating pain, as well as overcoming various other obstacles and arts. Eventually, on the day she qualified to become a genin, Fujirou, having become her instructor, bestowed the girl with the name Yae, with the reason she received the name being unknown to her, and she also inherited his family name, Tenzen.

Fujirou, having come to realize how exceptional Yae was as a shinobi, began to want to bring out all her latent potential, with his obsession leading him to organize the Kodoku, an event similar to the Empire's Imperial Selection Ceremony in which Yae and thirty other genin were taken to a forced and ordered to kill each other until one was left standing. Ultimately, although she let a single genin who pleaded for his life escape, Yae was the last survivor, simultaneously betraying the expectations of Fujirou and his allies, yet increasing those very expectations. Having been displeased with their actions and their desire to repeat the Kodoku until she could meet them. Fujirou and his allies were all slain by Yae, with the previous Tenzen's last words to her being that she would overturn the very way of what a shinobi ought to be. By the time the village chief, Olbart Dunkelkenn, happened upon the scene, their blood had stained the sakura petals around them. As a result, Olbart gave Yae the epithet Crimson Sakura. Though she would wonder why she had been named Yae, due to Fujirou's death, she had lost her chance to ask him.

While her age was in the single digits, Yae completely mastered how to manipulate her body's latent mana with the Flow Method. In less than a year, she acquired more than ten techniques that would have taken most shinobi several years to learn. She even managed to master the Steel Thread Technique, which no shinobi had achieved in centuries. Developing a reputation as a genius girl, she began to adhere to the philosophy of the shinobi chieftain, Olbart, becoming his most treasured apprentice in the process.

Death unto the Weak, No Mercy
Years later, she met with Chisha Gold at his request to carry out the task of infiltrating Leip Barielle's staff due to his wife, Priscilla. He received her evaluation of her own skills and tasked her to stand by and closely observe Priscilla once hired and await the possibility of being given new instructions depending on the situation. In Lugunica, she was hired as a maid in the Barielle Manor by Leip shortly before his incapacitation, though she never met him in person before his death. In time, she worked her way up in the mansion and was appointed to the role of Grand Chamberlain by Priscilla.

Pride and Prejudice and Zombies
Yae worked alongside Priscilla and Al in the zombie infestation in Coffleton and the waterwheel among the Tenrill River. Confronting Edda Rayfast, the trio was ambushed, and Yae and Al were caught in a trap that the former escaped by kicking the latter's shoulder to grab ahold of the ceiling, causing him to fall into a large pit. Priscilla ordered Yae to retreat and search for Al. Happening upon Al in the underground water treatment facility several hours later, she followed his request to bring the Crimson Battlefront to slay the undead while he ventured to rescue Priscilla. The undead were successfully slain following this, and Al saved Priscilla. However, around this time, Yae had been given the order to assassinate Priscilla. On the same night of the zombie incident, Al revealed he knew that Yae was an assassin who had been sent to kill Priscilla. She rejected his offer to abandon her goal, and the two confronted each other in a brief fight. Yae disappeared following their encounter, and according to Al, she had decided to “resign” because of “familial matters”. In reality, he used the Aggressor side of his Authority to instill "terror" into Yae, traumatizing her. As a result, she became his servant, motivated by the sole wish to ascertain his death in the future.

Guardians of the Crimson Flame
Despite his claim to the contrary, in reality, Al used the Aggressor side of his Authority to instill “terror” into Yae, traumatizing her. As a result, she became his servant, and he ordered her to lay low elsewhere. They would meet up regularly in secret, and because she believed that a certain "suggestion" would come into play if she returned to Vollachia, she remained within Lugunica.

A short time later, a suicide squad comprised of ten shinobi was tasked by Chisha to kill Priscilla, which Yae failed to accomplish. Discovering there were signs of people visiting the base she had previously used, she determined that they intended to assassinate Priscilla during the upcoming Masquerade Night she was going to hold. During the night of the event, Al and Yae worked together to kill the nine shinobi around the mansion who were to be used as sacrificial distractions. Meanwhile, Hamayal Wesmi, the shinobi entrusted with carrying out the assassination, was met by Al in one of the hidden passageways to the Barielle Manor that were constructed under Leip's supervision. Hamayal sent his Phantom Wolf on Al, expecting it would defeat him, but he was met with one of Yae's steel threads and realized she was alive, sending him into a fury. However, Yae told Hamayal that she had not betrayed the shinobi to save herself, but rather because she had submitted to “terror”, and that the harbinger of it was getting up. Before Hamayal's eyes, Al had risen and overcome his Phantom Wolf, forcing it to submit to him by using the Aggressor side to his Authority. Being ordered to stand back, Yae watched as proceeded to use Al used his Authority against Hamayal to break his mind in a similar way to how hers was.

Following the incident, after Hamayal's Phantom Wolf was eradicated, thereby ending his own life, Yae and Al spoke with one another. Once they finished reviewing the aftermath of the Masquerade Night, including Hamayal's death, Yae revealed to Al that she viewed him as a monster, that her sheer terror of him was why she obeyed him, and that she would do anything for him to not be frightened by him. Internally deriding himself, Al affirmed to Yae that she would do nothing so long as she continued to obey his commands, with her voicing her understanding in response, having resigned her soul and submitted to him completely.

Prior to Aldebaran's Scheme
At some point before returning to Vollachia for the events of Arc 7, Al spoke to Yae in secret, and during this time, Yae, who had still been keeping an eye over Priscilla, bore witness as she wrote her will. Although Yae did not know if Priscilla had noticed she was there when she hid the will and mentioned Schult's safety, Yae remembered this event. Later, following Priscilla's death, Yae was somehow contacted by Aldebaran, who had decided to set forth to act on his purpose.

Yae Tenzen's Crimson Sakura State of Affairs
Following the reveal of Priscilla's will, Yae, who had every confidence that despite his defeat, Al was still alive, decided that, since it was the members of the Emilia Camp who had been there when he was defeated, she would attempt to gather information from Frederica Baumann, who was at the manor with Roswaal L. Mathers, so that she could come up with countermeasures for when Al returned and decided to finish his goal. Meeting with Frederica in the hallway, she asked the maid to be friends and brought her to have tea in her room. As they spoke, Yae got the sense that she could have genuinely become friends with Frederica if she hadn't had ulterior motives. After Frederica mentioned that she saw the members of the Emilia Camp like family, something that was foreign to Yae, she asked Yae if her relationship with Schult was anything like that, to which Yae wasn't certain how to define their relationship. As they spoke, Frederica mentioned that she was nervous about being invited by Yae and felt on guard, so to be friends with her, she proposed talking about less intrusive topics. Doing so led Frederica to point out Yae's use of loan words, which she had picked up from Al, though Yae decided to keep it a secret who she learned those words from. Realizing that she was having fun, Yae continued to talk with Frederica.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Although her abilities are more suited to killing rather than fighting, Yae is considered a genius among the shinobi. Both her employer, Chisha, and Olbart, the shinobi chieftain and second-most powerful shinobi in the present day, believed it was possible she could succeed the role of chieftain. She gauged that her skill was enough to assassinate the head of House Mathers or House Astrea, though not both, as she surmised that she would have needed to give her life to successfully eliminate one of them. In fact, in the web novel, she was proclaimed to have had so much raw talent as a shinobi that, with more experience, she had the potential to surpass Olbart, and furthermore, even rival Kararagi's Admirer. While she recognizes that her skill is inferior to Olbart's experiences, Yae has mastered the art of drawing her opponent's attention and clouding their mind, something crucial for a shinobi to do their jobs. Before her disappearance, Al accused her of being the woman who would kill Priscilla, having already done so once, and he regarded her capabilities vital for his own plans.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
Martial Arts: As a shinobi, Yae was taught in the art of melee combat. With her prodigal talent, she was able to master any martial art after experiencing it only once, and she would use those very techniques to defeat people of higher rank than herself. Likewise, she was able to master any shinobi tool shortly after first picking one up.

Extreme Muscular/Sanguine/Motor Control: Thanks to her training, Yae has mastered the ability to control her body so finely that she can focus her blood flow and completely and freely manipulate her body's muscles, allowing her various abilities that would ordinarily be considered impossible for the human body to be capable of.
Enhanced Dexterity: Yae is able to move her body so precisely, down to her smallest digits, including her tongue, that she is capable of using the Steel Thread Technique, a technique that requires the user to have full control over the smallest of movements of their body in order to use. Likewise, she is agile and a highly skilled acrobat, and when combined with her Steel Thread Technique, she is able to move at swift speeds, even allowing her to narrowly avoid deadly attacks brought about by people such as the Sword Demon.
Night Vision: After having been subject to training to improve her night vision, Yae has mastered manipulating the blood flow around her eyes so that she can see in the dark as if it was daytime.
Impact Redistribution: Yae is able to reduce impact damage done her by redirecting the force into her limbs, allowing her to avoid all but the most severe damage. This being said, doing so can cause her limbs to go numb if the impact is strong enough, and it is likely that if hits even stronger than that were to strike her, the damage could still be worse. This ability is said to be a shinobi survival technique.
Organ Manipulation: Yae is able to shift the position of her internal organs in order to avoid fatal damage.
Muscle Compaction: If a weapon manages to pierce her body, Yae can compress her muscles tightly, preventing the weapon from being pulled out.

Various Resistances: During her days training to become a shinobi, Yae was forced to experience numerous hardships in order to gain resistances to them.
Poison Resistance: As part of her training as a shinobi, Yae was forced to experience poisoning repeatedly until she was no longer affected by it. However, she is vulnerable to Jiranme, a highly lethal poison that can even kill a shinobi.
Extreme Pain/Exhaustion Resistance: Yae was forced to experience excruciating pain throughout her life, including having her entire skeleton broken multiple times over. Because of this, Yae can force her body to act even when going through pain so dreadful that most people would either have already died or been unable to move. Thanks to this training, she can force herself to move and fight even when her body is numb or in a near-death state.

Techniques
Shinobi Techniques (シノビの術技, Shinobi no Jutsugi): Yae has mastered a number of shinobi techniques despite her young age and excels with them so much so that she was regarded as a genius prodigy who followed Olbart's doctrine of being a shinobi. Her signature skill is the Steel Thread Technique, a secret technique that no shinobi other than her has been able to wield in centuries, and not only has she mastered the technique, but she even managed to improve upon it.

Steel Thread Technique (鋼糸術, Kōshi-jutsu): A technique which Yae uses steel wires to bind and trap her targets or bind things such as debris or fallen trees in the air, launch said debris like a cannon (with assistance), kill her enemies, rescue her allies, to close her wounds, or even to stand on midair. The greatest advantage to using this, however, is that it allows her to attack her opponents from every angle and hit enemies even when they are hiding somewhere out of Yae's vision while keeping herself at a distance safe from harm. Using this technique requires that she wears rings with steel wires within them. Yae is the only shinobi in the present day capable of using this technique, and according to Al, due to how much strength and proper control is required to use even one of these rings, the fact that she can use ten so masterfully is nothing short of incredible. On top of this, she is capable of using another ten with her toes and one with her tongue.
Steel Thread Iaido: A technique based off of the art of iaido, a quick draw technique used by katana wielders, Yae gathers several of her strings, compresses her strings together, and swings her strings extremely swiftly, moving at an opponent fast enough that most would be unable to defend against. Even among the few shinobi who were able to use the Steel Thread Technique in the past, only Yae, a genius among geniuses, had the capability to create this technique.

Intelligence
Keen Observation: Thanks to her knowledge of the human body, Yae is able to determine how someone will behave based on the slightest motions of their muscles, allowing her to respond appropriately and quickly. However, for opponents who are able to move and act faster than her, such as Wilhelm, or artificial creations that do not have muscles, such as Emilia's Ice Soldiers, she has a harder time avoiding or countering them.

Other
Stealth: Yae is a master of stealth. According to herself, aside from the chief of her village, there shouldn't have been many people who could notice her presence while concealed.

Equipment
Kunai: Yae carries several kunai on her person. Despite the knives being relatively short, not even being able to cleanly pierce a person's hand through, she is easily able to dispose of any enemy she faces by utilizing her precise throwing skills and masterfully targeting their weak spots, such as their heart or their forehead, killing them in seconds.
Steel Thread Rings: Yae carries with her twenty-one rings with wire-like steel threads within them, ten on her fingers, ten on her toes, and one on her tongue. They are strong enough that, with enough pressure, they can easily cut through flesh and bone and sever limbs from the body or even allow her and others to stand on them without breaking. She can also make the threads divide themselves and make themselves finer than before and near invisible to the eye, and by kissing her rings, she can ignite all of her threads at once. The rings themselves were killing armaments made by Groovy Gumlet.

name: Valgren
alias: Three-Headed (三つ首, Mitsu Kubi) ; Black Dragon (黒龍, Kokuryū)
relatives: Unnamed dragonkin (creation) (deceased)
intro: Valgren (バルグレン) was a Dragon that was summoned by Stride Vollachia roughly four decades before the start of the series during the events of Sword Demon Battle Ballad. It was reduced to ash by the Divine Dragon Volcanica.
appearance: Valgren was a black-scaled three headed Dragon. Each of its heads were lined by rows of sharp fangs, and its wings had claws on them. Its size spanned over tens of meters. It had two short legs compared to its size and arms with wings attached to them.
personality: Valgren was a vicious, blood-crazed Dragon, consumed by hatred. Its three heads are mentioned to fight with each other when tearing apart its prey. As a Dragonhusk, it can be presumed to have lost most of the personality it had before the creation of its dragonkin.
history:
At an unknown point in time, Valgren created a dragonkin, becoming a Dragonhusk in the process. Its dragonkin would go on to perish, leaving only a skull behind.

Sword Demon Battle Ballad
Around 40 years before the main story, Valgren was summoned near the southern Lugunican border with Vollachia, in the city of Picoutatte, by Stride Vollachia. In order to summon the Black Dragon, Stride used the skull of its dragonkin and soaked it in the blood of numerous sacrifices, alerting the Dragon of the location of its dragonkin's remains through its survival instincts. He then proceeded to use three of his rings, corresponding to Valgren's three souls, to bind the Dragon to his will. Out of the 500 knights sent to kill it, 50 were killed and 200 were annihilated before Valgren itself died. To cover up the fact that a Dragon was controlled by someone in Lugunica, Valgren was referred to as a Blight Dragon. Once Valgren broke free of Stride's control, it ate him and his wife, Melinda, with its three heads tearing them both to pieces and feasting on their bodies.

After his body was devoured, Stride's curse rings continued to influence Valgren. It was confronted by a young Wilhelm van Astrea and Grimm Fauzen, who both dealt a great deal of damage to the Dragon. During combat, Grimm and Wilhelm were both seriously wounded and could barely continue the fight. Just as the battle was about to close on a disastrous end, the fortieth King of the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica, Gionis Lugunica, appeared in the city, and with him, the Divine Dragon descended from the skies above. In a couple of minutes, Volcanica scorched Valgren away, put out the raging fired and healed all the damage the Blight Dragon had done, marking the end of the Subjugation of the Blight Dragon.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
As a Dragon, Valgren was incredibly strong, capable of pushing a young Wilhelm to his limits while fighting it. However, compared to other Dragons introduced, its strength has not been fully explored or is not as expansive as others of its kind, having shown neither the immense range of physical nor mana-based abilities as other Dragons have.

Physical Traits
Immense Physical Strength: Valgren was able to use a combination of its fangs, tail, and claws in close-quarters combat. Because Valgren's attacks were so powerful, even Wilhelm van Astrea attempts to parry them caused both of his shoulders to creak and some of his muscles to rupture, and just one of its blows was able to incapacitate Grimm Fauzen.

Magic
Dragon Breath: The most common ability that Valgren had shown was its ability to breathe fire. It burned with a pale green light, and it was hot enough to burn stone.

Flight: As a Dragon, Valgren could use its mana to fly.

intro: Tiga Rauleon (ティーガ・ラウレオン) is Melty Pristis's former knight. After defeating Wolf and Pooka, he fled from the Kingdom of Lugunica and went with Melty, Salum, and Pooka to pay a visit to the group of travelling entertainers he came from.
appearance: Tiga's attire consists of a long violet suit with gold highlights and black pants and boots. He adorns himself with a jet-black bowl-shape hat, a purple rose on his coat, and a gold pendant that is in the shape of the Divine Dragon.
personality: Tiga is a young man who acts as Melty's knight. He gives off a somewhat flirtatious vibe. Even though he is a knight, he is not from the Royal Army, but a guard of the Divine Dragon Church that Melty designated to accompany her. Due to not being susceptible to the effects of Melty's Evil Eye, he is with her and loves her of his own volition. However, when it comes to Melty, the atmosphere is completely different from usual, and similar to Subaru when he shows affection towards Emilia, Tiga shows affection towards Melty as more than a knight as he tells his feelings towards her, though she doesn't take him seriously due to his casual demeanor.
history: Before Tiga became a knight, he was an orphan until he was adopted by the ringleader of a group of traveling entertainers. As he was traveling, he met and befriended a girl named Melty, falling in love with her at first sight. He decided to leave the group of travelling entertainers and stay with her. Coincidentally, as the location of Faradar, the village of the Evil Eye Tribe, was intended to be a secret, he was prevented from leaving the village. Due to his Divine Protection of Insensitivity, Tiga was immune to the effects of Melty's Evil Eye of Bewitchment, but he never revealed this to her, leading her to believe that his decision to be at her side was caused by her. He stayed by Melty's side even after her village was attacked and she was separated from her family, including her brother, Salum, as well as after she started being overseen by Sakura Element.
abilities_text:
Divine Protection (加護, Kago): Tiga has the Divine Protection of Insensitivity (鈍感の加護, Donkan no Kago). It prevents his body and mind from being interfered with by any outside influences, whether that be magical enhancements or impairments. As such, this grants him the ability to see through a cognitive disruption spell and to be immune to Melty's Evil Eye of Bewitchment. He can also maintain his sense of calm with his power, allowing him to resist negative emotions such as fear, worry, anger, and sorrow.

Skilled Swordsman: Tiga is considerably skilled at using a sword in combat.

name: White Whale
alias: Witchbeast of the Mist (霧の魔獣, Kiri no Majū)
relatives: Daphne (creator)
intro: The White Whale (白鯨), infamously called the Witchbeast of the Mist, was one of the Three Great Witchbeasts created by the Witch of Gluttony, Daphne. It was one of the main antagonists of Arc 3.
appearance: The White Whale was an enormous witchbeast that took the shape of a massive airborne whale, and it is estimated to be around fifty meters long, if not larger. It had snow-white skin and was covered in tiny hairs. Like all witchbeasts, the White Whale had a large, curved horn protruding from its forehead. It had a glowing pinkish wheel-like sigil on its back that assisted its ability to fly. Its eyes, that were usually yellow, turned into red filled with rage when it felt threatened.
history: Following its birth approximately 400 years ago, the White Whale terrorized the world for centuries, becoming infamous for devouring merchants, entire armies sent to kill it, and even whole towns and cities. Around 385 years after its creation, the Great Conquest was organized in hopes of bringing down the White Whale once and for all. It was led by the Sword Saint of the time, Theresia van Astrea. Due in part to her Divine Protection of the Sword Saint leaving her during the attempted subjugation as well as outside interference, Theresia unfortunately died, and the conquest ended in failure. Only a few survivors of the failed subjugation squad had returned relatively safely, such as Conwood Melahau, who returned the Dragon Sword to the Astrea family after Theresia's death.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
The White Whale is an incredibly powerful witchbeast, so powerful that it managed to successfully evade subjugation for centuries and bring about an end to a large number of people, including the likes of a retired Sword Saint. In fact, if Subaru was not involved with its final subjugation, not only would it have entirely annihilated the entire force gathered to kill it, including Wilhelm and Crusch Karsten, it would have continued to threaten the world.

Physical Traits
Thick Skin: The White Whale had tough skin that allowed it to survive numerous physical assaults. Although not impenetrable, it could withstand being attacked by numerous strong fighters while taking relatively small damage. It also allowed it to survive being crushed by the massive weight of a fallen Flugel's Tree, though it was still trapped beneath it. However, this did not provide it a perfect defense. Warriors on the level of Wilhelm van Astrea could still deal unto it great harm and make it feel threatened. Likewise, it could use its massive body to crush its enemy under its weight as well, although it usually had no need to do so.

White Hairs: Across the White Whale's body were white hairs that scattered magical energy from incoming magic attacks. By doing so, it could reduce the force and the amount of damage it could sustain from magic. It was because of this that it could survive an entire magic bombardment and survive a strike from Crusch Karsten's magic and still survive and remain in the air. This being said, it did not provide the beast a perfect defense against magic. It still received damage and shed blood after being attacked with an entire onslaught of magic, and the damage accumulated was enough to make the White Whale feel threatened.

Large Maw: Although not usually necessary for the White Whale to attack, the beast has a massive mouth that can easily tear through the ground, and while it did not attack often in this manner, it could easily swallow any warrior unfortunate enough to fall in its path.

Pores: Across the White Whale's entire body, it had pores that allowed it to generate its signature mist.

Other
Mist Manipulation: The While Whale is able to freely manipulate the mist that it generates, utilizing it both for offense and for other purposes.
Mist of Diffusion (拡散型の霧, Kakusan-gata no Kiri)/Mist of Mental Contamination (精神汚染する霧, Seishin'osen suru Kiri): By releasing its modified mana, the White Whale produced a mist that it could use to freely swim around in. This ability essentially provided the beast with the ability of flight, giving it free reign over the skies, and the speed granted to it allowed it to easily keep up with and nearly outpace an earth dragon. By expanding the range of its mist, it can increase the area from which it can swim. People who are exposed to the mist that has been spread by the White Whale receive an experience akin to mana poisoning. Likewise, those people also experienced mental pain, such as hearing the sounds of pain on a chalkboard. Some people would experience it worse than others, with some people tearing at their own faces. Others, meanwhile, could resist it but visibly grimace at the pain.
Mist of Annihilation (消滅型の霧, Shōmetsu-gata no Kiri/消滅する霧, Shōmetsu suru Kiri): The White Whale was capable of weaponizing bursts of its mist with enough power to tear chunks out of the ground. Anyone stricken by this attack is not just physically erased, but even their names and memories are wiped from existence, leaving them forgotten to the world, akin to the victims of the Authority of Gluttony.
thumb|right|250px|The White Whale using its clones.
Mist Clones: When it felt that its life was in danger and entered its Attack Hue, the White Whale would create two clones of itself from its mist while it rose higher to the sky and out of danger. The clones lacked the original's full power, splitting its power and weight, but they were still strong enough to take down any opponents. Regardless of how much damage the clones received, they did not reflect onto the original's body. However, once the Whale itself died, the clones completely vanished.

Sky Swimming: The White Whale's biology allowed for it to naturally swim in the sky.

intro: Todd Fang (トッド・ファング) is a former soldier in the Sacred Vollachia Empire who held the rank of Private First-Class and Katya Aurélie's husband. Debuting in the beginning of Arc 7, Todd, alongside Jamal Aurélie, originally played a supporting role. However, he grew to be a recurring and bitter enemy of Natsuki Subaru, even into the beginning of Arc 8.
appearance:
Todd is a young man with short, bright, and spiky orange hair that is kept in place with a headband with armor attached beneath it. He possesses green eyes and noticeably sharp canine teeth. He is noted to likely be a bit older than Subaru. As per all Imperial Soldiers who are not Generals, Todd can be seen sporting Vollachia's standard military uniform issued to members of the Imperial Army, consisting of a red undershirt with long sleeves, a grey overshirt with short sleeves, and black pants as well as black boots, black gloves, a chest protector, and shoulder pads, all of which have small, red stripes on them. His head is adorned with a headband of the same red and black color pallet as the rest of his army attire. On his left side, Todd also straps a small red and black battle axe, which he uses instead of a standard sword seen being used with most other lower-ranked soldiers. 

Without his headband on, Todd keeps his hair worn in a bowl cut that covers the sides and back of his head, only having parts of his bangs cut in front of his eyes to allow him to see. As Todd is a halfbeast, when he utilizes the Beastification given to him by his half-wolf human blood, he can become a giant wolf beast with orange and while fur all across his body, a round, black nose, large ears, sharp white teeth, deep green eyes, as well as a large maw.
personality:
Todd initially presented himself as a very friendly and open individual, who faithfully follows orders and is extremely kind, friendly, and outgoing towards people around him. However, it soon turned out that Todd was a far more ruthless, sinister, and twisted individual than he appeared. He will manipulate or order everyone to get what he wants and needs, including from Jamal, who he has a close relationship with, and Arakiya, a superior who outclasses him in both rank and power. He is observant and meticulous, going as far as to stab Subaru in the shoulder because he didn't like his gaze and correctly concluded Subaru was trying to deceive him. Even though he originally acted very kindly towards Subaru, it was revealed that Todd was in fact always suspicious of Subaru from the very second the two met. Todd is also prepared to go to extreme lengths in order to get his way, as seen when he tested if a slaughtered witchbeast was poisonous enough to kill someone and giving it to the other soldiers after mixing it in water, killing said soldiers in order to avoid repercussions, and brutally slaughtering numerous innocent civilians in the Fortress City of Guaral while targeting Subaru's life in numerous failed loops. He was even willing to sacrifice his friend and future brother-in-law so that he could make a successful escape from his enemies, as well as kill every resident of an island and ruthlessly murder children without remorse.

Todd has claimed that he hates the way Vollachians behave, as he believes that giving up one's life, and especially so for another person, is a pointless endeavor, despite the fact that he also behaves in a survival of the fittest way. He has personally admitted to Subaru that some degree of his actions are based out of fear. If Todd finds himself in an unfavorable position, then he will often run away out of cowardice or choose not to act, such as when he initially attempted to escape from Guaral after its seizure. However, even if Todd is internally frightened, he will attempt to appear externally stronger in order to match the way of the Empire. At times when things terrify him, he will either attempt to kill that thing as soon as possible or avoid it at all costs, as he treats Subaru, whose existence completely terrifies him. Subaru has appraised Todd as scum comparable to the Witch Cult's Sin Archbishops. Despite his cautious and cowardly nature and his habit of probing every possible loophole that could be exploited, he does not consider himself to be particularly cautious or meticulous. His primary motivator to safely return home to Katya, who he believes is the one thing he cannot risk losing. Todd does not wish to neglect Katya, yet he finds her to be a flawed and loveable "item".
history:
Five years before the start of the main story, Todd was a bandit in the Fortified City of Garkla. After the destruction of the city resulting from the Sin Archbishop of Greed some years prior, numerous factions of bandits came into the city under one union and interfered with the rebuilding process. Todd, being one of their leaders, wanted to quit being a bandit and join the Imperial Army as a respected soldier from the very start of his tenure by gathering all of the other bandit leaders and turning them in. However, Jamal Aurélie, a soldier who was stationed in Garkla at that time, ended up slaying one of the other leaders, causing the bandits to lose their morale and end their assault on Garkla. Todd, having quit being a bandit after his plan was foiled, later met Jamal. At some point in the future, Todd was introduced to Jamal's younger sister, Katya, and she became his fiancée a year later. 

Sword Identity
Roughly two to three months before the start of the main story, Todd and Jamal were talking about the revolt that started at that point in time by Yorna Mishigure, the 7th ranking Diving General. During this conversation, Jamal talked about how he heard a rumor about testing people in the subjugation of Yorna's rebellion in order to see who would take the place of the former 9th ranking Divine General. After Jamal was asked about his source, he revealed that he had heard it from a few people who fled from a fortress that Yorna had attacked. After taking the time to gather more information, the two later captured the fled soldiers to turn them in as prisoners and helped to bring an end to the rebellion, though they received no reward for their contributions.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Todd is weak, and he is aware of it. Precisely because he is weak, Todd is ruthless, and he is willing to take any action to preserve his life or to kill anyone or anything that threatens his life. This makes him incredibly dangerous and easily capable of becoming responsible for large numbers of civilian, combatant, and even ally deaths, which he has shown in several failed loops. Furthermore, with his intelligence, he is able to strike at dangerous elements plaguing him and the side he chooses with ease, and because he is aware of his weakness, he does not take any unnecessary actions, willing to flee if necessary.

Divine Protection
Divine Protection of Ambushing (騙し討ちの加護, Damashiuchi no Kago): Although its exact effects are unknown, this Divine Protection enables werewolves to be difficult to find by other people, effectively making them vanish right before another person's eyes upon use. It is capable of allowing Todd to silently bypass Otto Suwen's Divine Protection, and in the Azamuku IF, it even allowed him to sneak up on and ambush someone as powerful and proficient in stealth as Olbart Dunkelkenn. However, even without his Divine Protection, Todd has shown himself to be excellent at hiding his presence.

Intelligence
Keen Intellect: The ability that makes Todd so dangerous is his intellect. He is extremely attentive and calculative, always approaching a situation while using logical reasoning and being two steps ahead of both his enemies and allies, which him to devise deadly traps and strategies to dispatch his foes without being forced to personally cross weapons with them. Depending on the target's supposed threat, Todd isn't afraid of causing collateral damage. During one failed loop, he sent a rogue dragon carriage zooming down the streets, killing tens of innocents as well as Subaru. In the following loop, he set a pub ablaze, once again killing innocents, just so he could kill Subaru. After joining forces with Arakiya, he managed to scare lesser spirits into his submission through under the threat of being devoured, expressing zero hesitation in exerting his will over them in order to use their abilities to his advantage in combat when necessary. He is also quite observant, able to determine the hiding spots of traps based on the feeling of the earth beneath his feet, the smell of smoke, and the location of a previous explosion.

Keen Orientation: Todd has been mentioned to easily be able to memorize a place or building's layout and geography by simply being there once. With this skill, Todd is very proficient at infiltrating places he's already been to and planning ambushes on his own soil.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
Beastification (獣化, Kemonoka): As a halfbeast of half-wolf human lineage, Todd has the ability to transform himself into a large orange wolf beast.

Enhanced Senses: Todd has displayed above average proficiency with multiple senses, presumably because of his half-wolf human blood.
Enhanced Vision: Todd possesses extremely enhanced eyesight. When Subaru was burning the Imperial flag after having captured Guaral, Todd was able to pick out his face from the other side of the city and see through his crossdressing disguise to determine that the Imperial Soldiers have been taken in by the “dancers” by using his unique ability. Todd also seems to use this ability when hunting Subaru prior to the Fall of Guaral, as if he is able to see and track Subaru consistently from completely out of sight.
Enhanced Olfaction: Todd possesses an extremely advanced sense of smell. Although Todd is not able to smell miasma, he possesses the ability to pinpoint someone's specific body odor. He has been able to use this in order to pinpoint an individual who he believed was related to Subaru at the time, despite not knowing the two were one and the same.

Equipment
Battle Axe: Todd can usually be seen wielding a short battle axe and is stated to be very skilled with it, more-so than the average Imperial Soldier. With it, and the small quantity of enhanced physical strength he receives from his half-wolf human lineage, he is able to swiftly dispatch foes with deadly accuracy and surprising amount of force. Despite perhaps not appearing as menacing as some other soldiers, Todd's proficiency in killing others with his axe is not to be underestimated.
Throwing Knives: As demonstrated during the witchbeast ambush, Todd is capable of quickly and accurately throwing knives, even when under heavy pressure.

intro: Utakata Shudrak (ウタカタ・シュドラク) is a member of the People of Shudrak located in the depths of the Buddheim Jungle, within the Sacred Vollachia Empire. She played a lesser supporting role in Arc 7.
appearance: Utakata is a small child with brown skin and green eyes. Her hair is black with tips that are dyed a peach color. She's noted to be about ten years of age.
personality: Utakata was shown to be rather wary of outsiders, likely due to being taught not to interact with people who are not part of the People of Shudrak. She displayed interest in both Subaru and Vincent, observing them from a distance while they were incarcerated. After the duo passed the Ritual of Blood by defeating the Elgina, Utakata warmed up to Vincent and especially to Subaru. Later on, she showed to be able to quickly befriend other children, Schult and Spica, with ease. Likewise, she is willing to help her friends by achieve their goals; she helped Spica sneak onto a carriage heading to Chaosflame because she wanted to stay with Subaru. She also views life and death similarly to the rest of her people; she is not averse to combat, and despite her own mother's death, which she witnessed with her own eyes, she not only accepted that it happened without a shred of sadness, but she even helped one of her people, Taritta Shudrak, from being accused of killing her.
history: Utakata was born to the Stargazer, Mariuli Shudrak. As a Shudrakian, she was raised as a hunter. When Mariuli killed herself through Taritta's knife, Utakata was there and saw the whole debacle, and she was the one to defend Taritta by saying that her mother did it to herself.
abilities_text: Marksman: Despite her age, Utakata is very skilled with the bow. Due to her lack of strength, however, she's opted to use poisonous arrows rather than normal ones. Despite this "handicap", she was easily capable of dispatching Subaru in a failed loop with one single shot. Utakata is also stated to be more skilled with the bow than Kuna.

intro: Zikr Osman (ズィクル・オスマン) is a Second-Class General of the Sacred Vollachia Empire's Imperial Army. Though his initial role in his debut was as the general sent to quell the People of Shudrak, he ended up playing a supporting role in Arc 7 and Arc 8.
appearance: Zikr is a short, plump, and rather frail-looking man. He has a thick moustache, bushy eyebrows, and a hairstyle that would best be described as an afro. He wears a decorated military uniform and has a sword to his side.
personality:
While he is a lustful, kind, and very respectful man when talking to women, or even those dressed as women, Zikr is also a very tactful individual who thinks about his problems whilst acting accordingly instead of throwing everything at a problem. Unlike other generals, Zikr takes time to bond with his troops and gets to know them. Zikr is very devoted to the emperor, and upon learning that the dancer Bianca is actually Vincent, he surrendered himself and his troops immediately and pledged loyalty to him. He is also shown to be rather caring towards his allies, as shown when he shielded Subaru from Arakiya’s attack. Also, though he originally despised being called the Coward and was willing to take up the moniker of the Womanizer to wash away that name, after being praised by the emperor for the reason he was called the Coward, he has taken to referring to himself as such and doing so proudly.

Although Zikr himself is also a man of the Empire and is willing to take up arms for his country, despite his own lacking skill with the sword, he also sympathizes with those who are afraid or unable to bring themselves to fight, such as Heinkel Astrea. In fact, he even believes it to be too cruel to impose the imperial way onto people like that, especially when they were not a part of the Empire.
history:
Zikr was born into House Osman, which was a household that produced a lineage of soldiers for many generations. However, due to a blood imbalance in his generation, he was the only male born in his family. Due to this, he was raised in an environment with four older sisters and six younger sisters. He soon joined the Imperial Army at a young age, and from there, he began to desire giving kindness to women whilst receiving kindness from then in return.

Eventually, Zikr became a general, and he began employing skillful and steady tactics while making sure that his allies took few casualties. Although he was initially known as the "Coward" for his methods, Zikr's tastes in women gave him many opportunities to speak with other soldiers and officers, and in combination with his threatening prowess as a commander, he soon became known in the army as the "Womanizer".

During Gaoran Peitiet’s rebellion, Zikr was still a Third-Class General. He was promoted to become a Second-Class General at some point before his appearance in Arc 7.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Despite his rank within the Imperial Army, Zikr is not a very strong man. Instead, the danger lies within his mind and leadership skills which has allowed him to ascend in a power-worshipping nation.

Intelligence
Keen Intellect: Zikr became a General Second-Class, not for his physical strength, but for his strategical mind. He often finds manners of taking victory with as little direct confrontation as possible, something which has left him dubbed as the Coward, a title that even his emperor respects. It is because of this that he was entrusted with handling the Shudrakians in Buddheim Jungle and defending Guaral.

Equipment
Sword: Zikr carries a sword with him. However, he does not have much skill with the blade, so it is more of an ornament for him or something he uses while leading and rallying his troops.

intro: Taritta Shudrak (タリッタ・シュドラク) is a member and former Chieftain of the People of Shudrak who live in the depths of the Buddheim Jungle in the Vollachia Empire. She played a supporting role in Arc 7.
appearance: Taritta is a tall woman with brown skin and black hair, which has been dyed blue at the tips. Like her Shudrak counterparts, she wears revealing clothing with big round golden earrings. During the siege of Guaral, she dressed to appear as an exotic dancer. On the road to Chaosflame, she wore a white dress shirt with a bow tie under a purple blazer and purple dress jeans.
personality:
Unlike most of her people, Taritta is reserved and highly unconfident about her abilities despite being a warrior. She feels disappointment for perceiving herself to have inferior abilities to her older sister, so she consequentially allows herself to be ordered around by other people. She even confided in Subaru about her inferiority complex and that she didn't feel like she would be able to effectively lead her people like her sister could, and she even claimed to be jealous over how Subaru was able to be so confident while he was in his role as "Natsumi Schwartz". However, when she is hunting, Taritta is calm and efficient in executing techniques to finish a prey off.

Her lack of confidence stems from guilt for the death of her soul sister, Mariuli, as Taritta holds herself responsible for her death and believes that she let Mariuli die. She shows hatred to the stars that changed Mariuli by choosing her as a Stargazer. Believing they contributed to her early death, she would disobey their will and break her promise with Mariuli if she judged it to be the right thing.
history:
Taritta was born on the same day as Mariuli, her soul sister. The two were inseparable while growing up. Unlike her soul sister, Taritta was able to become a hunter like her most of the other Shudraks, while Mariuli took care of the children due to her frail constitution. Eventually, Mariuli became a Stargazer and soon became very sick, almost reaching her demise. Before her death, she told Taritta of her "commandment", being a mission to kill a traveler with black hair and black eyes in order to prevent them from triggering the "Great Disaster", which would spell the end for the Empire. After relaying her commandment, Mariuli plunged Taritta's knife into her chest and died as a result, with Utakata witnessing this event.

Due to the circumstances of having her knife found in Mariuli's chest, Taritta was initially suspected of murdering Mariuli, but Utakata defended her innocence. After the incident was settled, Taritta resolved day after day to carrying out Mariuli's commandment on her behalf, and she waited patiently like a hunter for the "traveler" foretold by the commandment to appear.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Taritta is a powerful warrior capable of handling herself against numerous physically enhanced enemies at once, and she is such a prodigy that even her sister acknowledges her. This being said, her strength is still such that she cannot contend with truly powerful people.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
Skilled Markswoman: Just like her fellow Shudrakians, Taritta is very skilled with her bow. She can easily dispatch her targets from afar. Even amongst the Shudrak, her marksmanship is exceptional, as she is able to locate weak spots and accurately aim at them with relative ease while others struggled to do the same, as well as easily shoot flying dragons out of the sky with headshots after no more than a mere glance.

Enhanced Eyesight: Taritta has excellent eyesight that can easily surpass a beastified Frederica Baumann's, allowing her to see across a battlefield with ease.

Other
Excellent Stealth: As a hunter, being able to hide herself from her prey is a common tactic. She was easily able to find and hide from Subaru when he first arrived in Buddheim Jungle, and though she just barely failed in the main timeline, she was responsible for Subaru's first death in Vollachia.

Equipment
Bow and Arrow: Like most Shudrakians, she wields a bow for combat.

intro: Toska Astrea (トスカ・アストレア) is one of the main supporting characters in Re:Zero Prequel: Loving the Days Gone By, a side story released with Re:Zero 2nd Season BD 5.
appearance: Throughout most of Loving the Days Gone By, Toska was around 15 years of age. He was a relatively tall and handsome young boy with flaming red hair and sky-blue eyes, characteristics that indicate a person's connection to House Astrea. He was usually seen dressed in rough clothes befitting of his family's profession as farmers and was equipped with a rough satchel made out of fur. Around his waist, Toska wore a tawdry sword which was noted to look rather old and borderline useless.
personality:
Toska had a rather timid personality, but he was ultimately a very brave man. When his childhood friend Remina was set up as a sacrifice for the Blight Dragons, he wasted no time and darted towards the Palace of the Witch, overcoming numerous trials and obstacles just to reach it. When faced with two Artificial Spirits, he was able to retain his composure and voice his wishes, which in turn prompted both Beatrice and Puck to help him. Despite him being a meager 15 years old, he displayed immense courage, despite facing powerful beings such as Great Spirits, Witches, and Dragons themselves.

He was also shown to be rather high-spirited and fun to be around with, once he got more familiar with the other party. He was even capable of cracking jokes and pranks on Beatrice, despite her being the daughter of the Witch. His personality was rather in-tone with Puck's, resulting in them forming a rather friendly bond.

Toska is also shown to be easily influenced by others, as seen when he retold the story about his older brother telling him how he'll become stronger if he ate stronger beings. This resulted in him being prepared to eat an entire Guiltylowe, despite it tasting horribly and even being toxic for consumption.

Furthermore, Toska was shown to be rather humble. Despite possessing inhuman strength, speed, agility, and skills with the sword, he considered himself normal. Whenever the two Artificial Spirits complimented him, Toska's replies were always that of embarrassment and denial, stating he's slightly better than average at best. One could easily surmise this self-dejection came from growing up in the shadow of the first Sword Saint Reid Astrea. This also led him to underestimate his achievements, as shown when he called an aquatic witchbeast that had terrorized a nearby town for a while, "a fish".
history:
Toska was born in a secluded and tiny village called Carnattse, to a family of farmers. When he was about 15 years of age, Toska's childhood friend Remina was chosen as a sacrifice for the Blight Dragons, due to them wanting to take revenge on Toska's brother's family, as his older brother had slaughtered their leader, Amangam. As running away with her would result in the destruction of the village, Toska opted for a different kind of salvation–seeking the Witch of Greed to have his wish granted.

Toska then started his journey, successfully managed to reach the Witch's palace at the top of a mountain, thanks to his powerful body and sharp determination fueled by his mighty wish. To his surprise, he was welcomed by the Witch of Greed's daughter, Beatrice, who back then had the task of acting as a proxy instead of her absent mother. Toska's wish having been accepted by Beatrice, him, her and Puck then started their 9 days long journey to Carnattse in order to save Remina from the Blight Dragon.

Once the trio arrived at the village, Beatrice quickly made a plan after noticing that the villagers had no intent of fighting the Dragon. The plan ended up in Beatrice successfully killing the Blight Dragon by surprise, but unfortunately for them, the Dragon they killed was actually under the orders of Fargall: the Dragon behind the sacrifice. Fargall was in fact scheming to slaughter all villagers of Carnattse in reprisal due to Toska's brother having killed a Dragon leader. This led to a fight between Puck in his Star Beastification form, Beatrice, and Toska and Fargall. With the help of the villagers, Toska's group emerged victorious. However, as they were thinking they finally saved Remina and the village, an army of one hundred Silver Dragons appeared in the sky, determined to kill Toska and his kin. Toska, Beatrice, and Puck, refusing to give up, were ready to fight the Dragons with all their might, until the Witch of Greed suddenly arrived, and with one single spell, managed to annihilate the Dragons as stars were falling down onto them. After Echidna's attack, only four Dragons remained alive, Fargall being one of them, and they finally surrendered and complied.

Sometime after Fargall's defeat, Toska and Remina's wedding was held, in which Echidna, Beatrice, and Puck took part in. Once Puck left to start his journey, Toska made a vow with Beatrice, promising that he shall one day repay his debt to her. Later on, Toska and Remina had many children, who also had children, who then had children too.

More than a century after the trio's journey to Carnattse, Toska, now an old man, heard about Beatrice's everlasting solitude and decided to repay his debt by helping her. Roswaal D. Mathers then brought Toska to the Forbidden Library, in which he begged Beatrice to take his hand; he wanted her to leave so that she wouldn't feel lonely anymore. Unfortunately for him, Beatrice refused to give up on the contract and duty given by her mother, which resulted in her kicking Toska out of the library. After being kicked out, Toska lied on the ground, started to wail and cry while pleading for someone to save the kindhearted girl from solitude as he was wishing for her happiness. 

Toska then died of old age an unknown amount of time later.
abilities_text:
Overall Power
Toska's strength could only be described as inhuman. He was easily able to defeat a Guiltylowe and even compete with a Dragon. Furthermore, having grown up with Reid, he became accustomed to being punched by him and was even capable of catching his strikes. Despite that, it's worth noting that Toska is still vastly weaker to his older brother. According to him, during their duels, he could not stop shaking out of fear, a feeling he'd later experience when facing off Blight Dragons.

Physical Traits/Flow Method
Inhuman Speed: Toska was shown to easily be able to sprint at the speed of gale. He traversed the path down the mountain in mere half a day when it would take over a day for a normal person to get back down to the Witch's Forest. To a bystander observing him run, it would appear as if Toska's legs were invisible.

Inhuman Swordsmanship: Toska was very skilled with his sword. According to Puck, his abilities were nothing short of monstrous. He was easily able to cut down multiple Guiltylowe and even referred to them as "stupid dogs".

name: Ubilk
alias: Stargazer (星詠み Hoshiyomi)
intro: Ubilk (ウビルク) is a former Stargazer in the Sacred Vollachia Empire. He worked for Vollachia's emperor, Vincent Vollachia. He played an antagonistic role in The Sword Wolf of the Scintillating Flame and a supporting role in Arc 7 and Arc 8.
appearance: Ubilk is a handsome young man with rather long grey hair and livid grey eyes. Roughly 7 years ago, he was seen wearing tattered clothing consisting of an oversized dark long-sleeved robe and pants of the same color as well as a white-striped, purple undershirt. In the present, his robe is fixed of its tears and has an added hood. Furthermore, Ubilk can be seen sporting a necklace with a green crystal and twin bows tying his long hair in place. On the center of his chest is a burn scar where his Evil Eye once laid.
personality:
Ubilk initially acted like an energetic and kind man, who was willing to help other people in need. Despite living on an island designated for gladiators, Ubilk wasn't much of a fighter. He instead acted as a male prostitute for the female gladiators; however, he was also noted to sleep with the former Island Chief in order to gain his favor. Underneath his facade, Ubilk was a brilliant and ruthless tactician. He spearheaded the Gladiator Island's rebellion against the Empire, did not shy away from killing guards, and even ordered Hornet to kill Al so the rebellion would not be compromised.

After officially taking up the role of a Stargazer, Ubilk became indifferent to others, yet aloof and distant to them at the same time. He has an inability to understand and express proper emotions while showing a variety of fitting words and facial expressions to get his points across, causing his mostly positive attempts at conveying himself to appear as if they were forced and taught to him by someone else. However, Ubilk’s demeanor hides the husk of a being who only exists to unwaveringly obsess over his commandment and to fanatically desire its fulfillment.

Ubilk’s primary desire, like nearly all other Stargazers, was to follow the commandment handed down to him by the stars, otherwise known as the Observers. The method in which commandments are received varies, but Ubilk claimed that he received his in something like a dream. In addition, he could not resist following the fate passed down in the commandment he saw, and he would not have lied about their contents if pressed. Despite this, according to Olbart, Ubilk was unlike other Stargazers. When he fulfilled his commandment and stopped being a Stargazer, he still held gratitude to the stars for changing his life, and was even willing to cause damage to the city of Garkla in order to receive another commandment and become a Stargazer once again before Katya Aurélie convinced him otherwise.
history:
The Sword Wolf of the Scintillating Flame
Though the majority of Ubilk's life remains a mystery, he was sent to Gladiator Island Ginunhive, where he acted as a male prostitute to avoid fighting and certain death for five years. Shortly after Vincent Vollachia's coronation, he spearheaded a rebellion on the Gladiator Island. He accomplished this by slowly convincing the other gladiators to join his side for the five years he had been there. At the beginning of the rebellion, Ubilk killed Auran, the assigned guard of Al, the only gladiator who had not joined him. When Al refused to join in an act of sedition, Ubilk ordered Hornet to kill him shortly afterwards, though the one-armed man would barely escape certain death.

Although his claimed goal was to seek independence for Ginunhive and he took a noble claiming to be Serena Dracroy hostage, Ubilk knew that members of the Nine Divine Generals would be deployed to the Gladiator Island and decimate all forces behind the revolt. Ubilk would later speak of his plans to Priscilla Pendleton, who was pretending to be Serena. He divulged that he was one of the few surviving members of the Evil Eye Tribe, which were purged in numerous wars across the years, and that his true goals involved buying time for something. Before he could be apprehended, Ubilk was thought to have escaped Ginunhive via a teleportation mechanism within the room of the island's head, and although his true reason behind scheming the uprising remains unknown, Priscilla speculated his aim was to take the emperor's life.

Death unto the Weak, No Mercy ZERO
At some point around or after the rebellion he raised, Ubilk became a Stargazer. It is unknown if he had already been one during his rebellion. After his escape from Ginunhive, Ubilk found his way to the Crystal Palace and introduced himself as a Stargazer, burned off his Evil Eye in front of Chisha Gold, and after prophesizing Gaoran Peitiet's rebellion, he was allowed by Vincent to be a unique personage who had access to enter the Crystal Palace in order to deliver prophecies to him.

Sword Identity
Two to three months after the death of Balleroy Temeglyph, Ubilk attended a meeting centered around the topic of Balleroy's replacement, only to be unwelcomed due to his sudden appearance and his failure to predict events concerning the previous rebellion. While there, Ubilk prophesized Yorna's rebellion by using his power and suggested using the revolt as a way to determine who would take Balleroy's place.

Pre-Imperial Coup
During one of Ubilk's visits to the castle, he spoke with Chisha and Vincent, saying that the Great Disaster had been foretold by the stars, something that he brought up with the intention of informing Chisha about. When Chisha began questioning him, having not heard of this Great Disaster, Ubilk claimed that it would bring ruin, also mentioning Yang Sword's glow, implying he knew about what went down with Prisca and resulting in Chisha nearly killing him for it. Afterward, he claimed that it would be the death of Vincent Vollachia that would trigger the Great Disaster.

A few days later, having come to realize that he had no way to directly reject Vincent's thoughts, Chisha cornered Ubilk, intent on getting answers out of him. Despite the threats of Ubilk's inevitable death because of Vincent's possible death, Ubilk was undeterred and merely claimed that his role was to prevent the destruction that was to follow the Great Disaster, and if the Great Disaster didn't occur, since he would need to fulfill his commandment, he would become one of the causes to trigger the Great Disaster. Though Chisha was tempted to kill him to prevent that, Ubilk merely claimed another Stargazer would appear in his place. Afterward, he mentioned that four disasters would occur to destroy the world and that the time to stop one of them has come. As he thought about what to do, he asked how the commandment was conveyed to Ubilk, and when Ubilk said he would have dreams, Chisha claimed to wonder which Vincent it was he saw in his dream, using his Noh to paint over himself and become "Vincent Vollachia".
abilities_text:
Evil Eye (魔眼 Magan): Ubilk is a member of the Evil Eye Tribe, and like the other members of his tribe, he was born with an Evil Eye which, in his case, was situated in the middle of his chest. Although the power itself was never outright stated, according to Ubilk and Priscilla, it was what allowed him to start his rebellion on Ginunhive in the first place. Priscilla came to the idea that it could have had an ability related to sensing the emotions of others, though Ubilk denied his Evil Eye was that convenient and claimed it would not have worked on her anyway, suggesting that there were requirements for it to work on someone. He later burned it off of his body, leaving nothing but a scar.

Stargazer (星詠み, Hoshiyomi): Ubilk was a Stargazer who used his power of peering into the future in order to preserve the Vollachia Empire's stability, namely with things such as larger-scale rebellions or conflicts. However, Ubilk seemingly worked for the greater benefit of the nation, and not solely for the emperor's good, which is why he allowed for Vincent to be dethroned and exiled. He has claimed that the stars guide him, even when crossing a battlefield. Berstetz had once seen this in action, as Ubilk managed to leisurely cross a literal storm of projectiles and forest of swords without so much as getting a single scratch.

Excellent Tactician: Though he doesn't show this side of himself after becoming a Stargazer, Ubilk is a remarkable tactician, which he displayed when he began the revolt in Ginunhive and gathered supporters to his cause.
